verses.la: Beátus vir, qui non ábiit in consílio impiórum, et in via peccatórum non stetit, * et in cáthedra pestiléntiæ non sedit:
verses.en: Blessed is the man who hath not walked in the counsel of the ungodly, nor stood in the way of sinners, * nor sat in the chair of pestilence.

verses.la: Sed in lege Dómini volúntas eius, * et in lege eius meditábitur die ac nocte.
verses.en: But his will is in the law of the Lord, * and on his law he shall meditate day and night.

verses.la: Et fólium eius non défluet: * et ómnia quæcúmque fáciet, prosperabúntur.
verses.en: And his leaf shall not fall off: * and all whatsoever he shall do shall prosper.

verses.la: Non sic ímpii, non sic: * sed tamquam pulvis, quem próicit ventus a fácie terræ.
verses.en: Not so the wicked, not so: * but like the dust, which the wind driveth from the face of the earth.

verses.la: Ídeo non resúrgent ímpii in iudício: * neque peccatóres in concílio iustórum.
verses.en: Therefore the wicked shall not rise again in judgment: * nor sinners in the council of the just.

verses.la: Quóniam novit Dóminus viam iustórum: * et iter impiórum períbit.
verses.en: For the Lord knoweth the way of the just: * and the way of the wicked shall perish.

verses.la: Quare fremuérunt gentes: * et pópuli meditáti sunt inánia?
verses.en: Why have the Gentiles raged, * and the people devised vain things?

verses.la: Astitérunt reges terræ, et príncipes convenérunt in unum * advérsus Dóminum, et advérsus Christum eius.
verses.en: The kings of the earth stood up, and the princes met together, * against the Lord and against his Christ.

verses.la: Dirumpámus víncula eórum: * et proiciámus a nobis iugum ipsórum.
verses.en: Let us break their bonds asunder: * and let us cast away their yoke from us.

verses.la: Qui hábitat in cælis, irridébit eos: * et Dóminus subsannábit eos.
verses.en: He that dwelleth in heaven shall laugh at them: * and the Lord shall deride them.

verses.la: Tunc loquétur ad eos in ira sua, * et in furóre suo conturbábit eos.
verses.en: Then shall he speak to them in his anger, * and trouble them in his rage.

verses.la: Ego autem constitútus sum Rex ab eo super Sion montem sanctum eius, * prǽdicans præcéptum eius.
verses.en: But I am appointed king by him over Sion his holy mountain, * preaching his commandment.

verses.la: Dóminus dixit ad me: * Fílius meus es tu, ego hódie génui te.
verses.en: The Lord hath said to me: * Thou art my son, this day have I begotten thee.

verses.la: Póstula a me, et dabo tibi gentes hereditátem tuam, * et possessiónem tuam términos terræ.
verses.en: Ask of me, and I will give thee the Gentiles for thy inheritance, * and the utmost parts of the earth for thy possession.

verses.la: Reges eos in virga férrea, * et tamquam vas fíguli confrínges eos.
verses.en: Thou shalt rule them with a rod of iron, * and shalt break them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.

verses.la: Et nunc, reges, intellégite: * erudímini, qui iudicátis terram.
verses.en: And now, O ye kings, understand: * receive instruction, you that judge the earth.

verses.la: Servíte Dómino in timóre: * et exsultáte ei cum tremóre.
verses.en: Serve ye the Lord with fear: * and rejoice unto him with trembling.

verses.la: Apprehéndite disciplínam, nequándo irascátur Dóminus, * et pereátis de via iusta.
verses.en: Embrace discipline, lest at any time the Lord be angry, * and you perish from the just way.

verses.la: Cum exárserit in brevi ira eius: * beáti omnes qui confídunt in eo.
verses.en: When his wrath shall be kindled in a short time, * blessed are all they that trust in him.

verses.la: Dómine, quid multiplicáti sunt qui tríbulant me? * multi insúrgunt advérsum me.
verses.en: Why, O Lord, are they multiplied that afflict me? * many are they who rise up against me.

verses.la: Multi dicunt ánimæ meæ: * Non est salus ipsi in Deo eius.
verses.en: Many say to my soul: * There is no salvation for him in his God.

verses.la: Tu autem, Dómine, suscéptor meus es, * glória mea, et exáltans caput meum.
verses.en: But thou, O Lord art my protector, * my glory, and the lifter up of my head.

verses.la: Voce mea ad Dóminum clamávi: * et exaudívit me de monte sancto suo.
verses.en: I have cried to the Lord with my voice: * and he hath heard me from his holy hill.

verses.la: Ego dormívi, et soporátus sum: * et exsurréxi, quia Dóminus suscépit me.
verses.en: I have slept and taken my rest: * and I have risen up, because the Lord hath protected me.

verses.la: Non timébo míllia pópuli circumdántis me: * exsúrge, Dómine, salvum me fac, Deus meus.
verses.en: I will not fear thousands of the people, surrounding me: * arise, O Lord; save me, O my God.

verses.la: Quóniam tu percussísti omnes adversántes mihi sine causa: * dentes peccatórum contrivísti.
verses.en: For thou hast struck all them who are my adversaries without cause: * thou hast broken the teeth of sinners.

verses.la: Dómini est salus: * et super pópulum tuum benedíctio tua.
verses.en: Salvation is of the Lord: * and thy blessing is upon thy people.

verses.la: Miserére mei, * et exáudi oratiónem meam.
verses.en: Have mercy on me: * and hear my prayer.

verses.la: Fílii hóminum, úsquequo gravi corde? * ut quid dilígitis vanitátem, et quǽritis mendácium?
verses.en: O ye sons of men, how long will you be dull of heart? * Why do you love vanity, and seek after lying?

verses.la: Et scitóte quóniam mirificávit Dóminus sanctum suum: * Dóminus exáudiet me cum clamávero ad eum.
verses.en: Know ye also that the Lord hath made his holy one wonderful: * the Lord will hear me when I shall cry unto him.

verses.la: Irascímini, et nolíte peccáre: * quæ dícitis in córdibus vestris, in cubílibus vestris compungímini.
verses.en: Be ye angry, and sin not: * the things you say in your hearts, be sorry for them upon your beds.

verses.la: Sacrificáte sacrifícium iustítiæ, et speráte in Dómino. * Multi dicunt: Quis osténdit nobis bona?
verses.en: Offer up the sacrifice of justice, and trust in the Lord: * many say, Who sheweth us good things?

verses.la: Signátum est super nos lumen vultus tui, Dómine: * dedísti lætítiam in corde meo.
verses.en: The light of thy countenance, O Lord, is signed upon us: * thou hast given gladness in my heart.

verses.la: A fructu fruménti, vini, et ólei sui * multiplicáti sunt.
verses.en: By the fruit of their corn, their wine, and oil, * they are multiplied.

verses.la: In pace in idípsum * dórmiam, et requiéscam;
verses.en: In peace in the selfsame * I will sleep, and I will rest:

verses.la: Quóniam tu, Dómine, singuláriter in spe * constituísti me.
verses.en: For thou, O Lord, singularly * hast settled me in hope.

verses.la: Verba mea áuribus pércipe, Dómine, * intéllege clamórem meum.
verses.en: Give ear, O Lord, to my words * understand my cry.

verses.la: Inténde voci oratiónis meæ, * Rex meus et Deus meus.
verses.en: Hearken to the voice of my prayer, * O my King and my God.

verses.la: Quóniam ad te orábo: * Dómine, mane exáudies vocem meam.
verses.en: For to thee will I pray: * O Lord, in the morning thou shalt hear my voice.

verses.la: Mane astábo tibi et vidébo: * quóniam non Deus volens iniquitátem tu es.
verses.en: In the morning I will stand before thee, and will see: * because thou art not a God that willest iniquity.

verses.la: Neque habitábit iuxta te malígnus: * neque permanébunt iniústi ante óculos tuos.
verses.en: Neither shall the wicked dwell near thee: * nor shall the unjust abide before thy eyes.

verses.la: Virum sánguinum et dolósum abominábitur Dóminus: * ego autem in multitúdine misericórdiæ tuæ.
verses.en: The bloody and the deceitful man the Lord will abhor. * But as for me in the multitude of thy mercy,

verses.la: Introíbo in domum tuam: * adorábo ad templum sanctum tuum in timóre tuo.
verses.en: I will come into thy house; * I will worship towards thy holy temple, in thy fear.

verses.la: Dómine, deduc me in iustítia tua: * propter inimícos meos dírige in conspéctu tuo viam meam.
verses.en: Conduct me, O Lord, in thy justice: * because of my enemies, direct my way in thy sight.

verses.la: Quóniam non est in ore eórum véritas: * cor eórum vanum est.
verses.en: For there is no truth in their mouth: * their heart is vain.

verses.la: Décidant a cogitatiónibus suis, secúndum multitúdinem impietátum eórum expélle eos, * quóniam irritavérunt te, Dómine.
verses.en: Let them fall from their devices: according to the multitude of their wickednesses cast them out: * for they have provoked thee, O Lord.

verses.la: Et gloriabúntur in te omnes, qui díligunt nomen tuum, * quóniam tu benedíces iusto.
verses.en: And all they that love thy name shall glory in thee: * For thou wilt bless the just.

verses.la: Dómine, ut scuto bonæ voluntátis tuæ * coronásti nos.
verses.en: O Lord, thou hast crowned us, * as with a shield of thy good will.

verses.la: Dómine, ne in furóre tuo árguas me, * neque in ira tua corrípias me.
verses.en: Lord, rebuke me not in thy indignation, * nor chastise me in thy wrath.

verses.la: Miserére mei, Dómine, quóniam infírmus sum: * sana me, Dómine, quóniam conturbáta sunt ossa mea.
verses.en: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am weak: * heal me, O Lord, for my bones are troubled.

verses.la: Et ánima mea turbáta est valde: * sed tu, Dómine, úsquequo?
verses.en: And my soul is troubled exceedingly: * but thou, O Lord, how long?

verses.la: Convértere, Dómine, et éripe ánimam meam: * salvum me fac propter misericórdiam tuam.
verses.en: Turn to me, O Lord, and deliver my soul: * O save me for thy mercy’s sake.

verses.la: Quóniam non est in morte qui memor sit tui: * in inférno autem quis confitébitur tibi?
verses.en: For there is no one in death, that is mindful of thee: * and who shall confess to thee in hell?

verses.la: Laborávi in gémitu meo, lavábo per síngulas noctes lectum meum: * lácrimis meis stratum meum rigábo.
verses.en: I have laboured in my groanings, every night I will wash my bed: * I will water my couch with my tears.

verses.la: Turbátus est a furóre óculus meus: * inveterávi inter omnes inimícos meos.
verses.en: My eye is troubled through indignation: * I have grown old amongst all my enemies.

verses.la: Discédite a me, omnes, qui operámini iniquitátem: * quóniam exaudívit Dóminus vocem fletus mei.
verses.en: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity: * for the Lord hath heard the voice of my weeping.

verses.la: Exaudívit Dóminus deprecatiónem meam, * Dóminus oratiónem meam suscépit.
verses.en: The Lord hath heard my supplication: * the Lord hath received my prayer.

verses.la: Erubéscant, et conturbéntur veheménter omnes inimíci mei: * convertántur et erubéscant valde velóciter.
verses.en: Let all my enemies be ashamed, and be very much troubled: * let them be turned back, and be ashamed very speedily.

verses.la: Dómine, Deus meus, in te sperávi: * salvum me fac ex ómnibus persequéntibus me, et líbera me.
verses.en: O Lord my God, in thee have I put my trust: * save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me.

verses.la: Nequándo rápiat ut leo ánimam meam, * dum non est qui rédimat, neque qui salvum fáciat.
verses.en: Lest at any time he seize upon my soul like a lion, * while there is no one to redeem me, nor to save.

verses.la: Dómine, Deus meus, si feci istud, * si est iníquitas in mánibus meis:
verses.en: O Lord my God, if I have done this thing, * if there be iniquity in my hands:

verses.la: Si réddidi retribuéntibus mihi mala, * décidam mérito ab inimícis meis inánis.
verses.en: If I have rendered to them that repaid me evils, * let me deservedly fall empty before my enemies.

verses.la: Persequátur inimícus ánimam meam, et comprehéndat, et concúlcet in terra vitam meam, * et glóriam meam in púlverem dedúcat.
verses.en: Let the enemy pursue my soul, and take it, and tread down my life on the earth, * and bring down my glory to the dust.

verses.la: Et exsúrge, Dómine, Deus meus, in præcépto quod mandásti: * et synagóga populórum circúmdabit te.
verses.en: And arise, O Lord my God, in the precept which thou hast commanded: * and a congregation of people shall surround thee.

verses.la: Et propter hanc in altum regrédere: * Dóminus iúdicat pópulos.
verses.en: And for their sakes return thou on high. * The Lord judgeth the people.

verses.la: Iúdica me, Dómine, secúndum iustítiam meam, * et secúndum innocéntiam meam super me.
verses.en: Judge me, O Lord, according to my justice, * and according to my innocence in me.

verses.la: Consumétur nequítia peccatórum, et díriges iustum, * scrutans corda et renes, Deus.
verses.en: The wickedness of sinners shall be brought to nought: and thou shalt direct the just: * the searcher of hearts and reins is God.

verses.la: Iustum adiutórium meum a Dómino, * qui salvos facit rectos corde.
verses.en: Just is my help from the Lord: * who saveth the upright of heart.

verses.la: Deus iudex iustus, fortis, et pátiens: * numquid iráscitur per síngulos dies?
verses.en: God is a just judge, strong and patient: * is he angry every day?

verses.la: Nisi convérsi fuéritis, gládium suum vibrábit: * arcum suum teténdit, et parávit illum.
verses.en: Except you will be converted, he will brandish his sword: * he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.

verses.la: Et in eo parávit vasa mortis: * sagíttas suas ardéntibus effécit.
verses.en: And in it he hath prepared the instruments of death, * he hath made ready his arrows for them that burn.

verses.la: Ecce, partúriit iniustítiam: * concépit dolórem, et péperit iniquitátem.
verses.en: Behold he hath been in labour with injustice; * he hath conceived sorrow, and brought forth iniquity.

verses.la: Lacum apéruit, et effódit eum: * et íncidit in fóveam quam fecit.
verses.en: He hath opened a pit and dug it: * and he is fallen into the hole he made.

verses.la: Convertétur dolor eius in caput eius: * et in vérticem ipsíus iníquitas eius descéndet.
verses.en: His sorrow shall be turned on his own head: * and his iniquity shall come down upon his crown.

verses.la: Confitébor Dómino secúndum iustítiam eius: * et psallam nómini Dómini altíssimi.
verses.en: I will give glory to the Lord according to his justice: * and will sing to the name of the Lord the most High.

verses.la: Quóniam eleváta est magnificéntia tua, * super cælos.
verses.en: For thy magnificence is elevated * above the heavens.

verses.la: Ex ore infántium et lacténtium perfecísti laudem propter inimícos tuos, * ut déstruas inimícum et ultórem.
verses.en: Out of the mouth of infants and of sucklings thou hast perfected praise, because of thy enemies, * that thou mayst destroy the enemy and the avenger.

verses.la: Quóniam vidébo cælos tuos, ópera digitórum tuórum: * lunam et stellas, quæ tu fundásti.
verses.en: For I will behold thy heavens, the works of thy fingers: * the moon and the stars which thou hast founded.

verses.la: Quid est homo quod memor es eius? * aut fílius hóminis, quóniam vísitas eum?
verses.en: What is man that thou art mindful of him? * or the son of man that thou visitest him?

verses.la: Minuísti eum paulo minus ab Ángelis, glória et honóre coronásti eum: * et constituísti eum super ópera mánuum tuárum.
verses.en: Thou hast made him a little less than the angels, thou hast crowned him with glory and honour: * and hast set him over the works of thy hands.

verses.la: Ómnia subiecísti sub pédibus eius, * oves et boves univérsas: ínsuper et pécora campi.
verses.en: Thou hast subjected all things under his feet, * all sheep and oxen: moreover the beasts also of the fields.

verses.la: Vólucres cæli, et pisces maris, * qui perámbulant sémitas maris.
verses.en: The birds of the air, and the fishes of the sea, * that pass through the paths of the sea.

verses.la: Dómine, Dóminus noster, * quam admirábile est nomen tuum in univérsa terra!
verses.en: O Lord our Lord, * how admirable is thy name in all the earth!

verses.la: Confitébor tibi, Dómine, in toto corde meo: * narrábo ómnia mirabília tua.
verses.en: I will give praise to thee, O Lord, with my whole heart: * I will relate all thy wonders.

verses.la: Lætábor et exsultábo in te: * psallam nómini tuo, Altíssime.
verses.en: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: * I will sing to thy name, O thou most high.

verses.la: In converténdo inimícum meum retrórsum: * infirmabúntur, et períbunt a fácie tua.
verses.en: When my enemy shall be turned back: * they shall be weakened and perish before thy face.

verses.la: Quóniam fecísti iudícium meum et causam meam: * sedísti super thronum, qui iúdicas iustítiam.
verses.en: For thou hast maintained my judgment and my cause: * thou hast sat on the throne, who judgest justice.

verses.la: Increpásti gentes, et périit ímpius: * nomen eórum delésti in ætérnum, et in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.en: Thou hast rebuked the Gentiles, and the wicked one hath perished: * thou hast blotted out their name for ever and ever.

verses.la: Périit memória eórum cum sónitu: * et Dóminus in ætérnum pérmanet.
verses.en: Their memory hath perished with a noise. * But the Lord remaineth for ever.

verses.la: Parávit in iudício thronum suum: * et ipse iudicábit orbem terræ in æquitáte, iudicábit pópulos in iustítia.
verses.en: He hath prepared his throne in judgment: * And he shall judge the world in equity, he shall judge the people in justice.

verses.la: Et factus est Dóminus refúgium páuperi: * adiútor in opportunitátibus, in tribulatióne.
verses.en: And the Lord is become a refuge for the poor: * a helper in due time in tribulation.

verses.la: Et sperent in te qui novérunt nomen tuum: * quóniam non dereliquísti quæréntes te, Dómine.
verses.en: And let them trust in thee who know thy name: * for thou hast not forsaken them that seek thee, O Lord.

verses.la: Psállite Dómino, qui hábitat in Sion: * annuntiáte inter gentes stúdia eius:
verses.en: Sing ye to the Lord, who dwelleth in Sion: * declare his ways among the Gentiles.

verses.la: Quóniam requírens sánguinem eórum recordátus est: * non est oblítus clamórem páuperum.
verses.en: For requiring their blood he hath remembered them: * he hath not forgotten the cry of the poor.

verses.la: Miserére mei, Dómine: * vide humilitátem meam de inimícis meis.
verses.en: Have mercy on me, O Lord: * see my humiliation which I suffer from my enemies.

verses.la: Qui exáltas me de portis mortis, * ut annúntiem omnes laudatiónes tuas in portis fíliæ Sion.
verses.en: Thou that liftest me up from the gates of death, * that I may declare all thy praises in the gates of the daughter of Sion.

verses.la: In láqueo isto, quem abscondérunt, * comprehénsus est pes eórum.
verses.en: Their foot hath been taken * in the very snare which they hid.

verses.la: Cognoscétur Dóminus iudícia fáciens: * in opéribus mánuum suárum comprehénsus est peccátor.
verses.en: The Lord shall be known when he executeth judgments: * the sinner hath been caught in the works of his own hands.

verses.la: Convertántur peccatóres in inférnum, * omnes gentes quæ obliviscúntur Deum.
verses.en: The wicked shall be turned into hell, * all the nations that forget God.

verses.la: Quóniam non in finem oblívio erit páuperis: * patiéntia páuperum non períbit in finem.
verses.en: For the poor man shall not be forgotten to the end: * the patience of the poor shall not perish for ever.

verses.la: Exsúrge, Dómine, non confortétur homo: * iudicéntur gentes in conspéctu tuo.
verses.en: Arise, O Lord, let not man be strengthened: * let the Gentiles be judged in thy sight.

verses.la: Constítue, Dómine, legislatórem super eos: * ut sciant gentes quóniam hómines sunt.
verses.en: Appoint, O Lord, a lawgiver over them: * that the Gentiles may know themselves to be but men.

verses.la: Ut quid, Dómine, recessísti longe, * ‡ déspicis in opportunitátibus, in tribulatióne?
verses.en: Why, O Lord, hast thou retired afar off? * ‡ why dost thou slight us in our wants, in the time of trouble?

verses.la: Dum supérbit ímpius, incénditur pauper: * comprehendúntur in consíliis quibus cógitant.
verses.en: Whilst the wicked man is proud, the poor is set on fire: * they are caught in the counsels which they devise.

verses.la: Quóniam laudátur peccátor in desidériis ánimæ suæ: * et iníquus benedícitur.
verses.en: For the sinner is praised in the desires of his soul: * and the unjust man is blessed.

verses.la: Exacerbávit Dóminum peccátor, * secúndum multitúdinem iræ suæ non quæret.
verses.en: The sinner hath provoked the Lord, * according to the multitude of his wrath he will not seek him.

verses.la: Auferúntur iudícia tua a fácie eius: * ómnium inimicórum suórum dominábitur.
verses.en: Thy judgments are removed from his sight: * he shall rule over all his enemies.

verses.la: Dixit enim in corde suo: * Non movébor a generatióne in generatiónem sine malo.
verses.en: For he hath said in his heart: * I shall not be moved from generation to generation, and shall be without evil.

verses.la: Cuius maledictióne os plenum est, et amaritúdine, et dolo: * sub lingua eius labor et dolor.
verses.en: His mouth is full of cursing, and of bitterness, and of deceit: * under his tongue are labour and sorrow.

verses.la: Sedet in insídiis cum divítibus in occúltis: * ut interfíciat innocéntem.
verses.en: He sitteth in ambush with the rich, in private places, * that he may kill the innocent.

verses.la: Insidiátur ut rápiat páuperem: * rápere páuperem, dum áttrahit eum.
verses.en: He lieth in ambush, that he may catch the poor man: * so catch the poor, whilst he draweth him to him.

verses.la: In láqueo suo humiliábit eum: * inclinábit se, et cadet, cum dominátus fúerit páuperum.
verses.en: In his net he will bring him down, * he will crouch and fall, when he shall have power over the poor.

verses.la: Dixit enim in corde suo: Oblítus est Deus, * avértit fáciem suam ne vídeat in finem.
verses.en: For he hath said in his heart: God hath forgotten, * he hath turned away his face, not to see to the end.

verses.la: Exsúrge, Dómine Deus, exaltétur manus tua: * ‡ ne obliviscáris páuperum.
verses.en: Arise, O Lord God, let thy hand be exalted: * ‡ forget not the poor.

verses.la: Propter quid irritávit ímpius Deum? * dixit enim in corde suo: Non requíret.
verses.en: Wherefore hath the wicked provoked God? * for he hath said in his heart: He will not require it.

verses.la: Tibi derelíctus est pauper: * órphano tu eris adiútor.
verses.en: To thee is the poor man left: * thou wilt be a helper to the orphan.

verses.la: Cóntere brácchium peccatóris et malígni: * quærétur peccátum illíus, et non inveniétur.
verses.en: Break thou the arm of the sinner and of the malignant: * his sin shall be sought, and shall not be found.

verses.la: Dóminus regnábit in ætérnum, et in sǽculum sǽculi: * períbitis, gentes, de terra illíus.
verses.en: The Lord shall reign to eternity, yea, for ever and ever: * ye Gentiles shall perish from his land.

verses.la: Desidérium páuperum exaudívit Dóminus: * præparatiónem cordis eórum audívit auris tua.
verses.en: The Lord hath heard the desire of the poor: * thy ear hath heard the preparation of their heart.

verses.la: Iudicáre pupíllo et húmili, * ut non appónat ultra magnificáre se homo super terram.
verses.en: To judge for the fatherless and for the humble, * that man may no more presume to magnify himself upon earth.

verses.la: In Dómino confído: quómodo dícitis ánimæ meæ: * Tránsmigra in montem sicut passer?
verses.en: In the Lord I put my trust: how then do you say to my soul: * Get thee away from hence to the mountain, like a sparrow?

verses.la: Quóniam ecce peccatóres intendérunt arcum, paravérunt sagíttas suas in pháretra, * ut sagíttent in obscúro rectos corde.
verses.en: For, lo, the wicked have bent their bow: they have prepared their arrows in the quiver, * to shoot in the dark the upright of heart.

verses.la: Quóniam quæ perfecísti, destruxérunt: * iustus autem quid fecit?
verses.en: For they have destroyed the things which thou hast made: * but what has the just man done?

verses.la: Óculi eius in páuperem respíciunt: * pálpebræ eius intérrogant fílios hóminum.
verses.en: His eyes look on the poor man: * his eyelids examine the sons of men.

verses.la: Dóminus intérrogat iustum et ímpium: * qui autem díligit iniquitátem, odit ánimam suam.
verses.en: The Lord trieth the just and the wicked: * but he that loveth iniquity, hateth his own soul.

verses.la: Pluet super peccatóres láqueos: * ignis, et sulphur, et spíritus procellárum pars cálicis eórum.
verses.en: He shall rain snares upon sinners: * fire and brimstone, and storms of winds, shall be the portion of their cup.

verses.la: Quóniam iustus Dóminus, et iustítias diléxit: * æquitátem vidit vultus eius.
verses.en: For the Lord is just, and hath loved justice: * his countenance hath beheld righteousness.

verses.la: Salvum me fac, Dómine, quóniam defécit sanctus: * quóniam diminútæ sunt veritátes a fíliis hóminum.
verses.en: Save me, O Lord, for there is now no saint: * truths are decayed from among the children of men.

verses.la: Vana locúti sunt unusquísque ad próximum suum: * lábia dolósa, in corde et corde locúti sunt.
verses.en: They have spoken vain things every one to his neighbour: * with deceitful lips, and with a double heart have they spoken.

verses.la: Dispérdat Dóminus univérsa lábia dolósa, * et linguam magníloquam.
verses.en: May the Lord destroy all deceitful lips, * and the tongue that speaketh proud things.

verses.la: Qui dixérunt: Linguam nostram magnificábimus, lábia nostra a nobis sunt, * quis noster Dóminus est?
verses.en: Who have said: We will magnify our tongue; our lips are our own; * who is Lord over us?

verses.la: Ponam in salutári: * fiduciáliter agam in eo.
verses.en: I will set him in safety; * I will deal confidently in his regard.

verses.la: Elóquia Dómini, elóquia casta: * argéntum igne examinátum, probátum terræ purgátum séptuplum.
verses.en: The words of the Lord are pure words: * as silver tried by the fire, purged from the earth, refined seven times.

verses.la: Tu, Dómine, servábis nos: et custódies nos * a generatióne hac in ætérnum.
verses.en: Thou, O Lord, wilt preserve us: and keep us * from this generation for ever.

verses.la: In circúitu ímpii ámbulant: * secúndum altitúdinem tuam multiplicásti fílios hóminum.
verses.en: The wicked walk round about: * according to thy highness, thou hast multiplied the children of men.

verses.la: Úsquequo, Dómine, obliviscéris me in finem? * Úsquequo avértis fáciem tuam a me?
verses.en: How long, O Lord, wilt thou forget me unto the end? * how long dost thou turn away thy face from me?

verses.la: Quámdiu ponam consília in ánima mea, * dolórem in corde meo per diem?
verses.en: How long shall I take counsels in my soul, * sorrow in my heart all the day?

verses.la: Úsquequo exaltábitur inimícus meus super me? * réspice, et exáudi me, Dómine, Deus meus.
verses.en: How long shall my enemy be exalted over me? * Consider, and hear me, O Lord my God.

verses.la: Illúmina óculos meos ne umquam obdórmiam in morte: * nequándo dicat inimícus meus: Præválui advérsus eum.
verses.en: Enlighten my eyes that I never sleep in death: * lest at any time my enemy say: I have prevailed against him.

verses.la: Qui tríbulant me, exsultábunt si motus fúero: * ego autem in misericórdia tua sperávi.
verses.en: They that trouble me will rejoice when I am moved: * but I have trusted in thy mercy.

verses.la: Exsultábit cor meum in salutári tuo: cantábo Dómino qui bona tríbuit mihi: * et psallam nómini Dómini altíssimi.
verses.en: My heart shall rejoice in thy salvation: I will sing to the Lord, who giveth me good things: * yea, I will sing to the name of the Lord the most High.

verses.la: Corrúpti sunt, et abominábiles facti sunt in stúdiis suis: * non est qui fáciat bonum, non est usque ad unum.
verses.en: They are corrupt, and are become abominable in their ways: * there is none that doth good, no not one.

verses.la: Dóminus de cælo prospéxit super fílios hóminum, * ut vídeat si est intéllegens, aut requírens Deum.
verses.en: The Lord hath looked down from heaven upon the children of men, * to see if there be any that understand and seek God.

verses.la: Contrítio et infelícitas in viis eórum, et viam pacis non cognovérunt: * non est timor Dei ante óculos eórum.
verses.en: Destruction and unhappiness in their ways; and the way of peace they have not known: * there is no fear of God before their eyes.

verses.la: Nonne cognóscent omnes qui operántur iniquitátem, * qui dévorant plebem meam sicut escam panis?
verses.en: Shall not all they know that work iniquity, * who devour my people as they eat bread?

verses.la: Dóminum non invocavérunt, * illic trepidavérunt timóre, ubi non erat timor.
verses.en: They have not called upon the Lord: * there have they trembled for fear, where there was no fear.

verses.la: Quóniam Dóminus in generatióne iusta est, consílium ínopis confudístis: * quóniam Dóminus spes eius est.
verses.en: For the Lord is in the just generation: you have confounded the counsel of the poor man; * but the Lord is his hope.

verses.la: Quis dabit ex Sion salutáre Israël? * cum avérterit Dóminus captivitátem plebis suæ, exsultábit Iacob, et lætábitur Israël.
verses.en: Who shall give out of Sion the salvation of Israel? * when the Lord shall have turned away the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

verses.la: Dómine, quis habitábit in tabernáculo tuo? * aut quis requiéscet in monte sancto tuo?
verses.en: Lord, who shall dwell in thy tabernacle? * or who shall rest in thy holy hill?

verses.la: Qui ingréditur sine mácula, * et operátur iustítiam:
verses.en: He that walketh without blemish, * and worketh justice:

verses.la: Nec fecit próximo suo malum, * et oppróbrium non accépit advérsus próximos suos.
verses.en: Nor hath done evil to his neighbour: * nor taken up a reproach against his neighbours.

verses.la: Qui iurat próximo suo, et non décipit, * qui pecúniam suam non dedit ad usúram, et múnera super innocéntem non accépit.
verses.en: He that sweareth to his neighbour, and deceiveth not; * He that hath not put out his money to usury, nor taken bribes against the innocent:

verses.la: Qui facit hæc: * non movébitur in ætérnum.
verses.en: He that doth these things, * shall not be moved for ever.

verses.la: Consérva me, Dómine, quóniam sperávi in te. * Dixi Dómino: Deus meus es tu, quóniam bonórum meórum non eges.
verses.en: Preserve me, O Lord, for I have put my trust in thee. * I have said to the Lord, thou art my God, for thou hast no need of my goods.

verses.la: Sanctis, qui sunt in terra eius, * mirificávit omnes voluntátes meas in eis.
verses.en: To the saints, who are in his land, * he hath made wonderful all my desires in them.

verses.la: Non congregábo conventícula eórum de sanguínibus, * nec memor ero nóminum eórum per lábia mea.
verses.en: I will not gather together their meetings for blood offerings: * nor will I be mindful of their names by my lips.

verses.la: Dóminus pars hereditátis meæ, et cálicis mei: * tu es, qui restítues hereditátem meam mihi.
verses.en: The Lord is the portion of my inheritance and of my cup: * it is thou that wilt restore my inheritance to me.

verses.la: Funes cecidérunt mihi in præcláris: * étenim heréditas mea præclára est mihi.
verses.en: The lines are fallen unto me in goodly places: * for my inheritance is goodly to me.

verses.la: Benedícam Dóminum, qui tríbuit mihi intelléctum: * ínsuper et usque ad noctem increpuérunt me renes mei.
verses.en: I will bless the Lord, who hath given me understanding: * moreover my reins also have corrected me even till night.

verses.la: Providébam Dóminum in conspéctu meo semper: * quóniam a dextris est mihi, ne commóvear.
verses.en: I set the Lord always in my sight: * for he is at my right hand, that I be not moved.

verses.la: Propter hoc lætátum est cor meum, et exsultávit lingua mea: * ínsuper et caro mea requiéscet in spe.
verses.en: Therefore my heart hath been glad, and my tongue hath rejoiced: * moreover my flesh also shall rest in hope.

verses.la: Quóniam non derelínques ánimam meam in inférno: * nec dabis sanctum tuum vidére corruptiónem.
verses.en: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; * nor wilt thou give thy holy one to see corruption.

verses.la: Notas mihi fecísti vias vitæ, adimplébis me lætítia cum vultu tuo: * delectatiónes in déxtera tua usque in finem.
verses.en: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life, thou shalt fill me with joy with thy countenance: * at thy right hand are delights even to the end.

verses.la: Áuribus pércipe oratiónem meam, * non in lábiis dolósis.
verses.en: Give ear unto my prayer, * which proceedeth not from deceitful lips.

verses.la: De vultu tuo iudícium meum pródeat: * óculi tui vídeant æquitátes.
verses.en: Let my judgment come forth from thy countenance: * let thy eyes behold the things that are equitable.

verses.la: Probásti cor meum, et visitásti nocte: * igne me examinásti, et non est invénta in me iníquitas.
verses.en: Thou hast proved my heart, and visited it by night, * thou hast tried me by fire: and iniquity hath not been found in me.

verses.la: Ut non loquátur os meum ópera hóminum: * propter verba labiórum tuórum ego custodívi vias duras.
verses.en: That my mouth may not speak the works of men: * for the sake of the words of thy lips, I have kept hard ways.

verses.la: Pérfice gressus meos in sémitis tuis: * ut non moveántur vestígia mea.
verses.en: Perfect thou my goings in thy paths: * that my footsteps be not moved.

verses.la: Ego clamávi, quóniam exaudísti me, Deus: * inclína aurem tuam mihi, et exáudi verba mea.
verses.en: I have cried to thee, for thou, O God, hast heard me: * O incline thy ear unto me, and hear my words.

verses.la: Mirífica misericórdias tuas, * qui salvos facis sperántes in te.
verses.en: Shew forth thy wonderful mercies; * thou who savest them that trust in thee.

verses.la: Sub umbra alárum tuárum prótege me: * a fácie impiórum qui me afflixérunt.
verses.en: Protect me under the shadow of thy wings: * from the face of the wicked who have afflicted me.

verses.la: Inimíci mei ánimam meam circumdedérunt, ádipem suum conclusérunt: * os eórum locútum est supérbiam.
verses.en: My enemies have surrounded my soul: They have shut up their fat: * their mouth hath spoken proudly.

verses.la: Proiciéntes me nunc circumdedérunt me: * óculos suos statuérunt declináre in terram.
verses.en: They have cast me forth, and now they have surrounded me: * they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth.

verses.la: Suscepérunt me sicut leo parátus ad prædam: * et sicut cátulus leónis hábitans in ábditis.
verses.en: They have taken me, as a lion prepared for the prey; * and as a young lion dwelling in secret places.

verses.la: Exsúrge, Dómine, prǽveni eum, et supplánta eum: * éripe ánimam meam ab ímpio, frámeam tuam ab inimícis manus tuæ.
verses.en: Arise, O Lord, disappoint him and supplant him; * deliver my soul from the wicked one; thy sword from the enemies of thy hand.

verses.la: Saturáti sunt fíliis: * et dimisérunt relíquias suas párvulis suis.
verses.en: They are full of children: * and they have left to their little ones the rest of their substance.

verses.la: Ego autem in iustítia apparébo conspéctui tuo: * satiábor cum apparúerit glória tua.
verses.en: But as for me, I will appear before thy sight in justice: * I shall be satisfied when thy glory shall appear.

verses.la: Misit de summo, et accépit me: * et assúmpsit me de aquis multis.
verses.en: He sent from on high, and took me: * and received me out of many waters.

verses.la: Erípuit me de inimícis meis fortíssimis, et ab his qui odérunt me: * quóniam confortáti sunt super me.
verses.en: He delivered me from my strongest enemies, and from them that hated me: * for they were too strong for me.

verses.la: Prævenérunt me in die afflictiónis meæ: * et factus est Dóminus protéctor meus.
verses.en: They prevented me in the day of my affliction: * and the Lord became my protector.

verses.la: Et edúxit me in latitúdinem: * salvum me fecit, quóniam vóluit me.
verses.en: And he brought me forth into a large place: * he saved me, because he was well pleased with me.

verses.la: Et retríbuet mihi Dóminus secúndum iustítiam meam: * et secúndum puritátem mánuum meárum retríbuet mihi:
verses.en: And the Lord will reward me according to my justice; * and will repay me according to the cleanness of my hands:

verses.la: Quia custodívi vias Dómini, * nec ímpie gessi a Deo meo.
verses.en: Because I have kept the ways of the Lord; * and have not done wickedly against my God.

verses.la: Quóniam ómnia iudícia eius in conspéctu meo: * et iustítias eius non répuli a me.
verses.en: For all his judgments are in my sight: * and his justices I have not put away from me.

verses.la: Et ero immaculátus cum eo: * et observábo me ab iniquitáte mea.
verses.en: And I shall be spotless with him: * and shall keep myself from my iniquity.

verses.la: Et retríbuet mihi Dóminus secúndum iustítiam meam: * et secúndum puritátem mánuum meárum in conspéctu oculórum eius.
verses.en: And the Lord will reward me according to my justice: * and according to the cleanness of my hands before his eyes.

verses.la: Cum sancto sanctus eris, * et cum viro innocénte ínnocens eris:
verses.en: With the holy thou wilt be holy; * and with the innocent man thou wilt be innocent:

verses.la: Et cum elécto eléctus eris: * et cum pervérso pervertéris.
verses.en: And with the elect thou wilt be elect: * and with the perverse thou wilt be perverted.

verses.la: Quóniam tu pópulum húmilem salvum fácies: * et óculos superbórum humiliábis.
verses.en: For thou wilt save the humble people; * but wilt bring down the eyes of the proud.

verses.la: Quóniam tu illúminas lucérnam meam, Dómine: * Deus meus, illúmina ténebras meas.
verses.en: For thou lightest my lamp, O Lord: * O my God, enlighten my darkness.

verses.la: Quóniam in te erípiar a tentatióne, * et in Deo meo transgrédiar murum.
verses.en: For by thee I shall be delivered from temptation; * and through my God I shall go over a wall.

verses.la: Deus meus, impollúta via eius: elóquia Dómini igne examináta: * protéctor est ómnium sperántium in se.
verses.en: As for my God, his way is undefiled: the words of the Lord are fire-tried: * he is the protector of all that trust in him.

verses.la: Quóniam quis Deus præter Dóminum? * aut quis Deus præter Deum nostrum?
verses.en: For who is God but the Lord? * or who is God but our God?

verses.la: Deus, qui præcínxit me virtúte: * et pósuit immaculátam viam meam.
verses.en: God, who hath girt me with strength; * and made my way blameless.

verses.la: Qui perfécit pedes meos tamquam cervórum, * et super excélsa státuens me.
verses.en: Who hath made my feet like the feet of harts: * and who setteth me upon high places.

verses.la: Qui docet manus meas ad prǽlium: * et posuísti, ut arcum ǽreum, brácchia mea.
verses.en: Who teacheth my hands to war: * and thou hast made my arms like a brazen bow.

verses.la: Cæli enárrant glóriam Dei: * et ópera mánuum eius annúntiat firmaméntum.
verses.en: The heavens shew forth the glory of God, * and the firmament declareth the work of his hands.

verses.la: Dies diéi erúctat verbum, * et nox nocti índicat sciéntiam.
verses.en: Day to day uttereth speech, * and night to night sheweth knowledge.

verses.la: Non sunt loquélæ, neque sermónes, * quorum non audiántur voces eórum.
verses.en: There are no speeches nor languages, * where their voices are not heard.

verses.la: In omnem terram exívit sonus eórum: * et in fines orbis terræ verba eórum.
verses.en: Their sound hath gone forth into all the earth: * and their words unto the ends of the world.

verses.la: Exsultávit ut gigas ad curréndam viam, * a summo cælo egréssio eius:
verses.en: Hath rejoiced as a giant to run the way: * his going out is from the end of heaven,

verses.la: Et occúrsus eius usque ad summum eius: * nec est qui se abscóndat a calóre eius.
verses.en: And his circuit even to the end thereof: * and there is no one that can hide himself from his heat.

verses.la: Lex Dómini immaculáta, convértens ánimas: * testimónium Dómini fidéle, sapiéntiam præstans párvulis.
verses.en: The law of the Lord is unspotted, converting souls: * the testimony of the Lord is faithful, giving wisdom to little ones.

verses.la: Iustítiæ Dómini rectæ, lætificántes corda: * præcéptum Dómini lúcidum, illúminans óculos.
verses.en: The justices of the Lord are right, rejoicing hearts: * the commandment of the Lord is lightsome, enlightening the eyes.

verses.la: Timor Dómini sanctus, pérmanens in sǽculum sǽculi: * iudícia Dómini vera, iustificáta in semetípsa.
verses.en: The fear of the Lord is holy, enduring for ever and ever: * the judgments of the Lord are true, justified in themselves.

verses.la: Desiderabília super aurum et lápidem pretiósum multum: * et dulcióra super mel et favum.
verses.en: More to be desired than gold and many precious stones: * and sweeter than honey and the honeycomb.

verses.la: Étenim servus tuus custódit ea, * in custodiéndis illis retribútio multa.
verses.en: For thy servant keepeth them, * and in keeping them there is a great reward.

verses.la: Delícta quis intéllegit? ab occúltis meis munda me: * et ab aliénis parce servo tuo.
verses.en: Who can understand sins? from my secret ones cleanse me, O Lord: * and from those of others spare thy servant.

verses.la: Si mei non fúerint domináti, tunc immaculátus ero: * et emundábor a delícto máximo.
verses.en: If they shall have no dominion over me, then shall I be without spot: * and I shall be cleansed from the greatest sin.

verses.la: Dómine, adiútor meus, * et redémptor meus.
verses.en: O Lord, my helper, * and my redeemer.

verses.la: Exáudiat te Dóminus in die tribulatiónis: * ‡ prótegat te nomen Dei Iacob.
verses.en: May the Lord hear thee in the day of tribulation: * ‡ may the name of the God of Jacob protect thee.

verses.la: Mittat tibi auxílium de sancto: * et de Sion tueátur te.
verses.en: May he send thee help from the sanctuary: * and defend thee out of Sion.

verses.la: Memor sit omnis sacrifícii tui: * et holocáustum tuum pingue fiat.
verses.en: May he be mindful of all thy sacrifices: * and may thy whole burnt offering be made fat.

verses.la: Tríbuat tibi secúndum cor tuum: * et omne consílium tuum confírmet.
verses.en: May he give thee according to thy own heart; * and confirm all thy counsels.

verses.la: Lætábimur in salutári tuo: * et in nómine Dei nostri magnificábimur.
verses.en: We will rejoice in thy salvation; * and in the name of our God we shall be exalted.

verses.la: Exáudiet illum de cælo sancto suo: * in potentátibus salus déxteræ eius.
verses.en: He will hear him from his holy heaven: * the salvation of his right hand is in powers.

verses.la: Hi in cúrribus, et hi in equis: * nos autem in nómine Dómini, Dei nostri invocábimus.
verses.en: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: * but we will call upon the name of the Lord, our God.

verses.la: Ipsi obligáti sunt, et cecidérunt: * nos autem surréximus et erécti sumus.
verses.en: They are bound, and have fallen: * but we are risen, and are set upright.

verses.la: Dómine, salvum fac regem: * et exáudi nos in die, qua invocavérimus te.
verses.en: O Lord, save the king: * and hear us in the day that we shall call upon thee.

verses.la: Dómine, in virtúte tua lætábitur rex: * ‡ et super salutáre tuum exsultábit veheménter.
verses.en: The king rejoices in thy strength, O Lord; * ‡ and in thy salvation he shall rejoice exceedingly.

verses.la: Desidérium cordis eius tribuísti ei: * et voluntáte labiórum eius non fraudásti eum.
verses.en: Thou hast given him his heart’s desire: * and hast not withholden from him the will of his lips.

verses.la: Quóniam prævenísti eum in benedictiónibus dulcédinis: * posuísti in cápite eius corónam de lápide pretióso.
verses.en: For thou hast prevented him with blessings of sweetness: * thou hast set on his head a crown of precious stones.

verses.la: Vitam pétiit a te: * et tribuísti ei longitúdinem diérum in sǽculum, et in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.en: He asked life of thee: * and thou hast given him length of days for ever and ever.

verses.la: Magna est glória eius in salutári tuo: * glóriam et magnum decórem impónes super eum.
verses.en: His glory is great in thy salvation: * glory and great beauty shalt thou lay upon him.

verses.la: Quóniam dabis eum in benedictiónem in sǽculum sǽculi: * lætificábis eum in gáudio cum vultu tuo.
verses.en: For thou shalt give him to be a blessing for ever and ever: * thou shalt make him joyful in gladness with thy countenance.

verses.la: Quóniam rex sperat in Dómino: * et in misericórdia Altíssimi non commovébitur.
verses.en: For the king hopeth in the Lord: * and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.

verses.la: Inveniátur manus tua ómnibus inimícis tuis: * déxtera tua invéniat omnes, qui te odérunt.
verses.en: Let thy hand be found by all thy enemies: * let thy right hand find out all them that hate thee.

verses.la: Pones eos ut clíbanum ignis in témpore vultus tui: * Dóminus in ira sua conturbábit eos, et devorábit eos ignis.
verses.en: Thou shalt make them as an oven of fire, * in the time of thy anger: the Lord shall trouble them in his wrath, and fire shall devour them.

verses.la: Fructum eórum de terra perdes: * et semen eórum a fíliis hóminum.
verses.en: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth: * and their seed from among the children of men.

verses.la: Quóniam declinavérunt in te mala: * cogitavérunt consília, quæ non potuérunt stabilíre.
verses.en: For they have intended evils against thee: * they have devised counsels which they have not been able to establish.

verses.la: Quóniam pones eos dorsum: * in relíquiis tuis præparábis vultum eórum.
verses.en: For thou shalt make them turn their back: * in thy remnants thou shalt prepare their face.

verses.la: Exaltáre, Dómine, in virtúte tua: * cantábimus et psallémus virtútes tuas.
verses.en: Be thou exalted, O Lord, in thy own strength: * we will sing and praise thy power.

verses.la: Deus, Deus meus, réspice in me: quare me dereliquísti? * longe a salúte mea verba delictórum meórum.
verses.en: O God my God, look upon me: why hast thou forsaken me? * Far from my salvation are the words of my sins.

verses.la: Deus meus, clamábo per diem, et non exáudies: * et nocte, et non ad insipiéntiam mihi.
verses.en: O my God, I shall cry by day, and thou wilt not hear: * and by night, and it shall not be reputed as folly in me.

verses.la: Tu autem in sancto hábitas, * laus Israël.
verses.en: But thou dwellest in the holy place, * the praise of Israel.

verses.la: In te speravérunt patres nostri: * speravérunt, et liberásti eos.
verses.en: In thee have our fathers hoped: * they have hoped, and thou hast delivered them.

verses.la: Ad te clamavérunt, et salvi facti sunt: * in te speravérunt, et non sunt confúsi.
verses.en: They cried to thee, and they were saved: * they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.

verses.la: Ego autem sum vermis, et non homo: * oppróbrium hóminum, et abiéctio plebis.
verses.en: But I am a worm, and no man: * the reproach of men, and the outcast of the people.

verses.la: Omnes vidéntes me, derisérunt me: * locúti sunt lábiis, et movérunt caput.
verses.en: All they that saw me have laughed me to scorn: * they have spoken with the lips, and wagged the head.

verses.la: Sperávit in Dómino, erípiat eum: * salvum fáciat eum, quóniam vult eum.
verses.en: He hoped in the Lord, let him deliver him: * let him save him, seeing he delighteth in him.

verses.la: Quóniam tu es, qui extraxísti me de ventre: * spes mea ab ubéribus matris meæ. In te proiéctus sum ex útero:
verses.en: For thou art he that hast drawn me out of the womb: * my hope from the breasts of my mother. I was cast upon thee from the womb.

verses.la: De ventre matris meæ Deus meus es tu, * ne discésseris a me:
verses.en: From my mother’s womb thou art my God, * depart not from me.

verses.la: Quóniam tribulátio próxima est: * quóniam non est qui ádiuvet.
verses.en: For tribulation is very near: * for there is none to help me.

verses.la: Circumdedérunt me vítuli multi: * tauri pingues obsedérunt me.
verses.en: Many calves have surrounded me: * fat bulls have besieged me.

verses.la: Aperuérunt super me os suum, * sicut leo rápiens et rúgiens.
verses.en: They have opened their mouths against me, * as a lion ravening and roaring.

verses.la: Factum est cor meum tamquam cera liquéscens * in médio ventris mei.
verses.en: My heart is become like wax melting * in the midst of my bowels.

verses.la: Áruit tamquam testa virtus mea, et lingua mea adhǽsit fáucibus meis: * et in púlverem mortis deduxísti me.
verses.en: My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue hath cleaved to my jaws: * and thou hast brought me down into the dust of death.

verses.la: Fodérunt manus meas et pedes meos: * dinumeravérunt ómnia ossa mea.
verses.en: They have dug my hands and feet. * They have numbered all my bones.

verses.la: Ipsi vero consideravérunt et inspexérunt me: * divisérunt sibi vestiménta mea, et super vestem meam misérunt sortem.
verses.en: And they have looked and stared upon me. * They parted my garments amongst them; and upon my vesture they cast lots.

verses.la: Tu autem, Dómine, ne elongáveris auxílium tuum a me: * ad defensiónem meam cónspice.
verses.en: But thou, O Lord, remove not thy help to a distance from me; * look towards my defence.

verses.la: Érue a frámea, Deus, ánimam meam: * et de manu canis únicam meam:
verses.en: Deliver, O God, my soul from the sword: * my only one from the hand of the dog.

verses.la: Salva me ex ore leónis: * et a córnibus unicórnium humilitátem meam.
verses.en: Save me from the lion’s mouth; * and my lowness from the horns of the unicorns.

verses.la: Narrábo nomen tuum frátribus meis: * in médio ecclésiæ laudábo te.
verses.en: I will declare thy name to my brethren: * in the midst of the church will I praise thee.

verses.la: Qui timétis Dóminum, laudáte eum: * univérsum semen Iacob, glorificáte eum.
verses.en: Ye that fear the Lord, praise him: * all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him.

verses.la: Nec avértit fáciem suam a me: * et cum clamárem ad eum, exaudívit me.
verses.en: Neither hath he turned away his face from me: * and when I cried to him he heard me.

verses.la: Apud te laus mea in ecclésia magna: * vota mea reddam in conspéctu timéntium eum.
verses.en: With thee is my praise in a great church: * I will pay my vows in the sight of them that fear him.

verses.la: Edent páuperes, et saturabúntur: et laudábunt Dóminum qui requírunt eum: * vivent corda eórum in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.en: The poor shall eat and shall be filled: and they shall praise the Lord that seek him: * their hearts shall live for ever and ever.

verses.la: Et adorábunt in conspéctu eius * univérsæ famíliæ géntium.
verses.en: And all the kindreds of the Gentiles * shall adore in his sight.

verses.la: Quóniam Dómini est regnum: * et ipse dominábitur géntium.
verses.en: For the kingdom is the Lord’s; * and he shall have dominion over the nations.

verses.la: Manducavérunt et adoravérunt omnes pingues terræ: * in conspéctu eius cadent omnes qui descéndunt in terram.
verses.en: All the fat ones of the earth have eaten and have adored: * all they that go down to the earth shall fall before him.

verses.la: Et ánima mea illi vivet: * et semen meum sérviet ipsi.
verses.en: And to him my soul shall live: * and my seed shall serve him.

verses.la: Annuntiábitur Dómino generátio ventúra: * et annuntiábunt cæli iustítiam eius pópulo qui nascétur, quem fecit Dóminus.
verses.en: There shall be declared to the Lord a generation to come: * and the heavens shall shew forth his justice to a people that shall be born, which the Lord hath made.

verses.la: Dóminus regit me, et nihil mihi déerit: * in loco páscuæ ibi me collocávit.
verses.en: The Lord ruleth me: and I shall want nothing. * He hath set me in a place of pasture.

verses.la: Super aquam refectiónis educávit me: * ánimam meam convértit.
verses.en: He hath brought me up, on the water of refreshment: * he hath converted my soul.

verses.la: Dedúxit me super sémitas iustítiæ, * propter nomen suum.
verses.en: He hath led me on the paths of justice, * for his own name’s sake.

verses.la: Virga tua, et báculus tuus: * ipsa me consoláta sunt.
verses.en: Thy rod and thy staff, * they have comforted me.

verses.la: Impinguásti in óleo caput meum: * et calix meus inébrians quam præclárus est!
verses.en: Thou hast anointed my head with oil; * and my chalice which inebriateth me, how goodly is it!

verses.la: Et ut inhábitem in domo Dómini, * in longitúdinem diérum.
verses.en: And that I may dwell in the house of the Lord * unto length of days.

verses.la: Dómini est terra, et plenitúdo eius: * orbis terrárum, et univérsi qui hábitant in eo.
verses.en: The earth is the Lord’s and the fulness thereof: * the world, and all they that dwell therein.

verses.la: Quia ipse super mária fundávit eum: * et super flúmina præparávit eum.
verses.en: For he hath founded it upon the seas; * and hath prepared it upon the rivers.

verses.la: Quis ascéndet in montem Dómini? * aut quis stabit in loco sancto eius?
verses.en: Who shall ascend into the mountain of the Lord: * or who shall stand in his holy place?

verses.la: Ínnocens mánibus et mundo corde, * qui non accépit in vano ánimam suam, nec iurávit in dolo próximo suo.
verses.en: The innocent in hands, and clean of heart, * who hath not taken his soul in vain, nor sworn deceitfully to his neighbour.

verses.la: Hic accípiet benedictiónem a Dómino: * et misericórdiam a Deo, salutári suo.
verses.en: He shall receive a blessing from the Lord, * and mercy from God his Saviour.

verses.la: Hæc est generátio quæréntium eum, * quæréntium fáciem Dei Iacob.
verses.en: This is the generation of them that seek him, * of them that seek the face of the God of Jacob.

verses.la: Attóllite portas, príncipes, vestras, et elevámini, portæ æternáles: * et introíbit Rex glóriæ.
verses.en: Lift up your gates, O ye princes, and be ye lifted up, O eternal gates: * and the King of Glory shall enter in.

verses.la: Quis est iste Rex glóriæ? * Dóminus fortis et potens: Dóminus potens in prǽlio.
verses.en: Who is this King of Glory? * the Lord who is strong and mighty: the Lord mighty in battle.

verses.la: Attóllite portas, príncipes, vestras, et elevámini, portæ æternáles: * et introíbit Rex glóriæ.
verses.en: Lift up your gates, O ye princes, and be ye lifted up, O eternal gates: * and the King of Glory shall enter in.

verses.la: Quis est iste Rex glóriæ? * Dóminus virtútum ipse est Rex glóriæ.
verses.en: Who is this King of Glory? * the Lord of hosts, he is the King of Glory.

verses.la: Ad te, Dómine, levávi ánimam meam: * Deus meus, in te confído, non erubéscam.
verses.en: To thee, O Lord, have I lifted up my soul: * In thee, O my God, I put my trust; let me not be ashamed.

verses.la: Neque irrídeant me inimíci mei: * étenim univérsi, qui sústinent te, non confundéntur.
verses.en: Neither let my enemies laugh at me: * for none of them that wait on thee shall be confounded.

verses.la: Vias tuas, Dómine, demónstra mihi: * et sémitas tuas édoce me.
verses.en: Shew, O Lord, thy ways to me, * and teach me thy paths.

verses.la: Dírige me in veritáte tua, et doce me: * quia tu es, Deus, salvátor meus, et te sustínui tota die.
verses.en: Direct me in thy truth, and teach me; * for thou art God my Saviour; and on thee have I waited all the day long.

verses.la: Reminíscere miseratiónum tuárum, Dómine, * et misericordiárum tuárum, quæ a sǽculo sunt.
verses.en: Remember, O Lord, thy bowels of compassion; * and thy mercies that are from the beginning of the world.

verses.la: Secúndum misericórdiam tuam meménto mei tu: * propter bonitátem tuam, Dómine.
verses.en: According to thy mercy remember thou me: * for thy goodness’ sake, O Lord.

verses.la: Dulcis et rectus Dóminus: * propter hoc legem dabit delinquéntibus in via.
verses.en: The Lord is sweet and righteous: * therefore he will give a law to sinners in the way.

verses.la: Díriget mansuétos in iudício: * docébit mites vias suas.
verses.en: He will guide the mild in judgment: * he will teach the meek his ways.

verses.la: Univérsæ viæ Dómini, misericórdia et véritas, * requiréntibus testaméntum eius et testimónia eius.
verses.en: All the ways of the Lord are mercy and truth, * to them that seek after his covenant and his testimonies.

verses.la: Propter nomen tuum, Dómine, propitiáberis peccáto meo: * multum est enim.
verses.en: For thy name’s sake, O Lord, thou wilt pardon my sin: * for it is great.

verses.la: Quis est homo qui timet Dóminum? * legem státuit ei in via, quam elégit.
verses.en: Who is the man that feareth the Lord? * He hath appointed him a law in the way he hath chosen.

verses.la: Ánima eius in bonis demorábitur: * et semen eius hereditábit terram.
verses.en: His soul shall dwell in good things: * and his seed shall inherit the land.

verses.la: Firmaméntum est Dóminus timéntibus eum: * et testaméntum ipsíus ut manifestétur illis.
verses.en: The Lord is a firmament to them that fear him: * and his covenant shall be made manifest to them.

verses.la: Óculi mei semper ad Dóminum: * quóniam ipse evéllet de láqueo pedes meos.
verses.en: My eyes are ever towards the Lord: * for he shall pluck my feet out of the snare.

verses.la: Réspice in me, et miserére mei: * quia únicus et pauper sum ego.
verses.en: Look thou upon me, and have mercy on me; * for I am alone and poor.

verses.la: Tribulatiónes cordis mei multiplicátæ sunt: * de necessitátibus meis érue me.
verses.en: The troubles of my heart are multiplied: * deliver me from my necessities.

verses.la: Vide humilitátem meam, et labórem meum: * et dimítte univérsa delícta mea.
verses.en: See my abjection and my labour; * and forgive me all my sins.

verses.la: Réspice inimícos meos quóniam multiplicáti sunt, * et ódio iníquo odérunt me.
verses.en: Consider my enemies for they are multiplied, * and have hated me with an unjust hatred.

verses.la: Custódi ánimam meam, et érue me: * non erubéscam quóniam sperávi in te.
verses.en: Keep thou my soul, and deliver me: * I shall not be ashamed, for I have hoped in thee.

verses.la: Innocéntes et recti adhæsérunt mihi: * quia sustínui te.
verses.en: The innocent and the upright have adhered to me: * because I have waited on thee.

verses.la: Líbera, Deus, Israël, * ex ómnibus tribulatiónibus suis.
verses.en: Deliver Israel, O God, * from all his tribulations.

verses.la: Dóminus protéctor vitæ meæ, * a quo trepidábo?
verses.en: The Lord is the protector of my life: * of whom shall I be afraid?

verses.la: Qui tríbulant me inimíci mei, * ipsi infirmáti sunt, et cecidérunt.
verses.en: My enemies that trouble me, * have themselves been weakened, and have fallen.

verses.la: Si exsúrgat advérsum me prǽlium, * in hoc ego sperábo.
verses.en: If a battle should rise up against me, * in this will I be confident.

verses.la: Ut vídeam voluptátem Dómini, * et vísitem templum eius.
verses.en: That I may see the delight of the Lord, * and may visit his temple.

verses.la: Quóniam abscóndit me in tabernáculo suo: * in die malórum protéxit me in abscóndito tabernáculi sui.
verses.en: For he hath hidden me in his tabernacle; * in the day of evils, he hath protected me in the secret place of his tabernacle.

verses.la: Circuívi, et immolávi in tabernáculo eius hóstiam vociferatiónis: * cantábo, et psalmum dicam Dómino.
verses.en: I have gone round, and have offered up in his tabernacle a sacrifice of jubilation: * I will sing, and recite a psalm to the Lord.

verses.la: Exáudi, Dómine, vocem meam, qua clamávi ad te: * miserére mei, et exáudi me.
verses.en: Hear, O Lord, my voice, with which I have cried to thee: * have mercy on me and hear me.

verses.la: Tibi dixit cor meum, exquisívit te fácies mea: * fáciem tuam, Dómine, requíram.
verses.en: My heart hath said to thee: My face hath sought thee: * thy face, O Lord, will I still seek.

verses.la: Adiútor meus esto: * ne derelínquas me, neque despícias me, Deus, salutáris meus.
verses.en: Be thou my helper, * forsake me not; do not thou despise me, O God my Saviour.

verses.la: Quóniam pater meus, et mater mea dereliquérunt me: * Dóminus autem assúmpsit me.
verses.en: For my father and my mother have left me: * but the Lord hath taken me up.

verses.la: Legem pone mihi, Dómine, in via tua: * et dírige me in sémitam rectam propter inimícos meos.
verses.en: Set me, O Lord, a law in thy way, * and guide me in the right path, because of my enemies.

verses.la: Ne tradíderis me in ánimas tribulántium me: * quóniam insurrexérunt in me testes iníqui, et mentíta est iníquitas sibi.
verses.en: Deliver me not over to the will of them that trouble me; * for unjust witnesses have risen up against me; and iniquity hath lied to itself.

verses.la: Credo vidére bona Dómini * in terra vivéntium.
verses.en: I believe to see the good things of the Lord * in the land of the living.

verses.la: Exspécta Dóminum, viríliter age: * et confortétur cor tuum, et sústine Dóminum.
verses.en: Expect the Lord, do manfully, * and let thy heart take courage, and wait thou for the Lord.

verses.la: Afférte Dómino, fílii Dei: * afférte Dómino fílios aríetum.
verses.en: Bring to the Lord, O ye children of God: * bring to the Lord the offspring of rams.

verses.la: Afférte Dómino glóriam et honórem, afférte Dómino glóriam nómini eius: * adoráte Dóminum in átrio sancto eius.
verses.en: Bring to the Lord glory and honour: bring to the Lord glory to his name: * adore ye the Lord in his holy court.

verses.la: Vox Dómini super aquas, Deus maiestátis intónuit: * Dóminus super aquas multas.
verses.en: The voice of the Lord is upon the waters; the God of majesty hath thundered, * The Lord is upon many waters.

verses.la: Vox Dómini in virtúte: * vox Dómini in magnificéntia.
verses.en: The voice of the Lord is in power; * the voice of the Lord in magnificence.

verses.la: Vox Dómini confringéntis cedros: * et confrínget Dóminus cedros Líbani:
verses.en: The voice of the Lord breaketh the cedars: * yea, the Lord shall break the cedars of Libanus.

verses.la: Et commínuet eas tamquam vítulum Líbani: * et diléctus quemádmodum fílius unicórnium.
verses.en: And shall reduce them to pieces, as a calf of Libanus, * and as the beloved son of unicorns.

verses.la: Vox Dómini intercidéntis flammam ignis: * vox Dómini concutiéntis desértum: et commovébit Dóminus desértum Cades.
verses.en: The voice of the Lord divideth the flame of fire: * The voice of the Lord shaketh the desert: and the Lord shall shake the desert of Cades.

verses.la: Vox Dómini præparántis cervos, et revelábit condénsa: * et in templo eius omnes dicent glóriam.
verses.en: The voice of the Lord prepareth the stags: and he will discover the thick woods: * and in his temple all shall speak his glory.

verses.la: Dóminus dilúvium inhabitáre facit: * et sedébit Dóminus Rex in ætérnum.
verses.en: The Lord maketh the flood to dwell: * and the Lord shall sit king for ever.

verses.la: Dóminus virtútem pópulo suo dabit: * Dóminus benedícet pópulo suo in pace.
verses.en: The Lord will give strength to his people: * the Lord will bless his people with peace.

verses.la: Exaltábo te, Dómine, quóniam suscepísti me: * ‡ nec delectásti inimícos meos super me.
verses.en: I will extol thee, O Lord, for thou hast upheld me: * ‡ and hast not made my enemies to rejoice over me.

verses.la: Dómine, Deus meus, clamávi ad te, * et sanásti me.
verses.en: O Lord my God, I have cried to thee, * and thou hast healed me.

verses.la: Dómine, eduxísti ab inférno ánimam meam: * salvásti me a descendéntibus in lacum.
verses.en: Thou hast brought forth, O Lord, my soul from hell: * thou hast saved me from them that go down into the pit.

verses.la: Psállite Dómino, sancti eius: * et confitémini memóriæ sanctitátis eius.
verses.en: Sing to the Lord, O ye his saints: * and give praise to the memory of his holiness.

verses.la: Ad vésperum demorábitur fletus: * et ad matutínum lætítia.
verses.en: In the evening weeping shall have place, * and in the morning gladness.

verses.la: Ego autem dixi in abundántia mea: * Non movébor in ætérnum.
verses.en: And in my abundance I said: * I shall never be moved.

verses.la: Avertísti fáciem tuam a me, * et factus sum conturbátus.
verses.en: Thou turnedst away thy face from me, * and I became troubled.

verses.la: Ad te, Dómine, clamábo: * et ad Deum meum deprecábor.
verses.en: To thee, O Lord, will I cry: * and I will make supplication to my God.

verses.la: Numquid confitébitur tibi pulvis, * aut annuntiábit veritátem tuam?
verses.en: Shall dust confess to thee, * or declare thy truth?

verses.la: Audívit Dóminus, et misértus est mei: * Dóminus factus est adiútor meus.
verses.en: The Lord hath heard, and hath had mercy on me: * the Lord became my helper.

verses.la: Convertísti planctum meum in gáudium mihi: * conscidísti saccum meum, et circumdedísti me lætítia:
verses.en: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into joy: * thou hast cut my sackcloth, and hast compassed me with gladness:

verses.la: Ut cantet tibi glória mea, et non compúngar: * Dómine, Deus meus, in ætérnum confitébor tibi.
verses.en: To the end that my glory may sing to thee, and I may not regret: * O Lord my God, I will give praise to thee for ever.

verses.la: In te, Dómine, sperávi, non confúndar in ætérnum: * in iustítia tua líbera me.
verses.en: In thee, O Lord, have I hoped, let me never be confounded: * deliver me in thy justice.

verses.la: Esto mihi in Deum protectórem, et in domum refúgii: * ut salvum me fácias.
verses.en: Be thou unto me a God, a protector, and a house of refuge, * to save me.

verses.la: Quóniam fortitúdo mea, et refúgium meum es tu: * et propter nomen tuum dedúces me, et enútries me.
verses.en: For thou art my strength and my refuge; * and for thy name’s sake thou wilt lead me, and nourish me.

verses.la: Edúces me de láqueo hoc, quem abscondérunt mihi: * quóniam tu es protéctor meus.
verses.en: Thou wilt bring me out of this snare, which they have hidden for me: * for thou art my protector.

verses.la: In manus tuas comméndo spíritum meum: * redemísti me, Dómine, Deus veritátis.
verses.en: Into thy hands I commend my spirit: * thou hast redeemed me, O Lord, the God of truth.

verses.la: Ego autem in Dómino sperávi: * exsultábo, et lætábor in misericórdia tua.
verses.en: But I have hoped in the Lord: * I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy.

verses.la: Quóniam respexísti humilitátem meam, * salvásti de necessitátibus ánimam meam.
verses.en: For thou hast regarded my humility, * thou hast saved my soul out of distresses.

verses.la: Nec conclusísti me in mánibus inimíci: * statuísti in loco spatióso pedes meos.
verses.en: And thou hast not shut me up in the hands of the enemy: * thou hast set my feet in a spacious place.

verses.la: Miserére mei, Dómine, quóniam tríbulor: * conturbátus est in ira óculus meus, ánima mea, et venter meus:
verses.en: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am afflicted: * my eye is troubled with wrath, my soul, and my belly:

verses.la: Infirmáta est in paupertáte virtus mea: * et ossa mea conturbáta sunt.
verses.en: My strength is weakened through poverty * and my bones are disturbed.

verses.la: Qui vidébant me, foras fugérunt a me: * oblivióni datus sum, tamquam mórtuus a corde.
verses.en: They that saw me without fled from me. * I am forgotten as one dead from the heart.

verses.la: Factus sum tamquam vas pérditum: * quóniam audívi vituperatiónem multórum commorántium in circúitu.
verses.en: I am become as a vessel that is destroyed. * For I have heard the blame of many that dwell round about.

verses.la: In eo dum convenírent simul advérsum me, * accípere ánimam meam consiliáti sunt.
verses.en: While they assembled together against me, * they consulted to take away my life.

verses.la: Ego autem in te sperávi, Dómine: * dixi: Deus meus es tu: in mánibus tuis sortes meæ.
verses.en: But I have put my trust in thee, O Lord: * I said: Thou art my God. My lots are in thy hands.

verses.la: Éripe me de manu inimicórum meórum, * et a persequéntibus me.
verses.en: Deliver me out of the hands of my enemies; * and from them that persecute me.

verses.la: Illústra fáciem tuam super servum tuum, salvum me fac in misericórdia tua: * Dómine, non confúndar, quóniam invocávi te.
verses.en: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; save me in thy mercy. * Let me not be confounded, O Lord, for I have called upon thee.

verses.la: Erubéscant ímpii, et deducántur in inférnum: * muta fiant lábia dolósa.
verses.en: Let the wicked be ashamed, and be brought down to hell. * Let deceitful lips be made dumb.

verses.la: Quæ loquúntur advérsus iustum iniquitátem: * in supérbia, et in abusióne.
verses.en: Which speak iniquity against the just, * with pride and abuse.

verses.la: Perfecísti eis, qui sperant in te, * in conspéctu filiórum hóminum.
verses.en: Which thou hast wrought for them that hope in thee, * in the sight of the sons of men.

verses.la: Próteges eos in tabernáculo tuo * a contradictióne linguárum.
verses.en: Thou shalt protect them in thy tabernacle * from the contradiction of tongues.

verses.la: Benedíctus Dóminus: * quóniam mirificávit misericórdiam suam mihi in civitáte muníta.
verses.en: Blessed be the Lord, * for he hath shewn his wonderful mercy to me in a fortified city.

verses.la: Ídeo exaudísti vocem oratiónis meæ, * dum clamárem ad te.
verses.en: Therefore thou hast heard the voice of my prayer, * when I cried to thee.

verses.la: Dilígite Dóminum omnes sancti eius: * quóniam veritátem requíret Dóminus, et retríbuet abundánter faciéntibus supérbiam.
verses.en: O love the Lord, all ye his saints: * for the Lord will require truth, and will repay them abundantly that act proudly.

verses.la: Viríliter ágite, et confortétur cor vestrum, * omnes, qui sperátis in Dómino.
verses.en: Do ye manfully, and let your heart be strengthened, * all ye that hope in the Lord.

verses.la: Beáti quorum remíssæ sunt iniquitátes: * et quorum tecta sunt peccáta.
verses.en: Blessed are those whose iniquities are forgiven * and whose sins are covered.

verses.la: Beátus vir, cui non imputávit Dóminus peccátum, * nec est in spíritu eius dolus.
verses.en: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord hath not imputed sin, * and in whose spirit there is no guile.

verses.la: Quóniam tácui, inveteravérunt ossa mea, * dum clamárem tota die.
verses.en: Because I was silent my bones grew old; * whilst I cried out all the day long.

verses.la: Quóniam die ac nocte graváta est super me manus tua: * convérsus sum in ærúmna mea, dum confígitur spina.
verses.en: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: * I am turned in my anguish, whilst the thorn is fastened.

verses.la: Dixi: Confitébor advérsum me iniustítiam meam Dómino: * et tu remisísti impietátem peccáti mei.
verses.en: I said I will confess against myself my injustice to the Lord: * and thou hast forgiven the wickedness of my sin.

verses.la: Verúmtamen in dilúvio aquárum multárum, * ad eum non approximábunt.
verses.en: And yet in a flood of many waters, * they shall not come nigh unto him.

verses.la: Tu es refúgium meum a tribulatióne, quæ circúmdedit me: * exsultátio mea, érue me a circumdántibus me.
verses.en: Thou art my refuge from the trouble which hath encompassed me: * my joy, deliver me from them that surround me.

verses.la: Intelléctum tibi dabo, et ínstruam te in via hac, qua gradiéris: * firmábo super te óculos meos.
verses.en: I will give thee understanding, and I will instruct thee in this way, in which thou shalt go: * I will fix my eyes upon thee.

verses.la: In camo et freno maxíllas eórum constrínge, * qui non appróximant ad te.
verses.en: With bit and bridle bind fast their jaws, * who come not near unto thee.

verses.la: Multa flagélla peccatóris, * sperántem autem in Dómino misericórdia circúmdabit.
verses.en: Many are the scourges of the sinner, * but mercy shall encompass him that hopeth in the Lord.

verses.la: Lætámini in Dómino et exsultáte, iusti, * et gloriámini, omnes recti corde.
verses.en: Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, ye just, * and glory, all ye right of heart.

verses.la: Exsultáte, iusti, in Dómino: * rectos decet collaudátio.
verses.en: Rejoice in the Lord, O ye just: * praise becometh the upright.

verses.la: Confitémini Dómino in cíthara: * in psaltério decem chordárum psállite illi.
verses.en: Give praise to the Lord on the harp; * sing to him with the psaltery, the instrument of ten strings.

verses.la: Cantáte ei cánticum novum: * bene psállite ei in vociferatióne.
verses.en: Sing to him a new canticle, * sing well unto him with a loud noise.

verses.la: Quia rectum est verbum Dómini, * et ómnia ópera eius in fide.
verses.en: For the word of the Lord is right, * and all his works are done with faithfulness.

verses.la: Díligit misericórdiam et iudícium: * misericórdia Dómini plena est terra.
verses.en: He loveth mercy and judgment; * the earth is full of the mercy of the Lord.

verses.la: Verbo Dómini cæli firmáti sunt: * et spíritu oris eius omnis virtus eórum.
verses.en: By the word of the Lord the heavens were established; * and all the power of them by the spirit of his mouth:

verses.la: Cóngregans sicut in utre aquas maris: * ponens in thesáuris abýssos.
verses.en: Gathering together the waters of the sea, as in a vessel; * laying up the depths in storehouses.

verses.la: Tímeat Dóminum omnis terra: * ab eo autem commoveántur omnes inhabitántes orbem.
verses.en: Let all the earth fear the Lord, * and let all the inhabitants of the world be in awe of him.

verses.la: Quóniam ipse dixit, et facta sunt: * ipse mandávit, et creáta sunt.
verses.en: For he spoke and they were made: * he commanded and they were created.

verses.la: Dóminus díssipat consília géntium: * réprobat autem cogitatiónes populórum, et réprobat consília príncipum.
verses.en: The Lord bringeth to nought the counsels of nations; * and he rejecteth the devices of people, and casteth away the counsels of princes.

verses.la: Consílium autem Dómini in ætérnum manet: * cogitatiónes cordis eius in generatióne et generatiónem.
verses.en: But the counsel of the Lord standeth for ever: * the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

verses.la: Beáta gens, cuius est Dóminus, Deus eius: * pópulus, quem elégit in hereditátem sibi.
verses.en: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord: * the people whom he hath chosen for his inheritance.

verses.la: De cælo respéxit Dóminus: * vidit omnes fílios hóminum.
verses.en: The Lord hath looked from heaven: * he hath beheld all the sons of men.

verses.la: De præparáto habitáculo suo * respéxit super omnes, qui hábitant terram.
verses.en: From his habitation which he hath prepared, * he hath looked upon all that dwell on the earth.

verses.la: Qui finxit sigillátim corda eórum: * qui intéllegit ómnia ópera eórum.
verses.en: He who hath made the hearts of every one of them: * who understandeth all their works.

verses.la: Non salvátur rex per multam virtútem: * et gigas non salvábitur in multitúdine virtútis suæ.
verses.en: The king is not saved by a great army: * nor shall the giant be saved by his own great strength.

verses.la: Fallax equus ad salútem: * in abundántia autem virtútis suæ non salvábitur.
verses.en: Vain is the horse for safety: * neither shall he be saved by the abundance of his strength.

verses.la: Ecce, óculi Dómini super metuéntes eum: * et in eis, qui sperant super misericórdia eius:
verses.en: Behold the eyes of the Lord are on them that fear him: * and on them that hope in his mercy.

verses.la: Ut éruat a morte ánimas eórum: * et alat eos in fame.
verses.en: To deliver their souls from death; * and feed them in famine.

verses.la: Ánima nostra sústinet Dóminum: * quóniam adiútor et protéctor noster est.
verses.en: Our soul waiteth for the Lord: * for he is our helper and protector.

verses.la: Quia in eo lætábitur cor nostrum: * et in nómine sancto eius sperávimus.
verses.en: For in him our heart shall rejoice: * and in his holy name we have trusted.

verses.la: Fiat misericórdia tua, Dómine, super nos: * quemádmodum sperávimus in te.
verses.en: Let thy mercy, O Lord, be upon us, * as we have hoped in thee.

verses.la: Benedícam Dóminum in omni témpore: * semper laus eius in ore meo.
verses.en: I will bless the Lord at all times, * his praise shall be always in my mouth.

verses.la: In Dómino laudábitur ánima mea: * áudiant mansuéti, et læténtur.
verses.en: In the Lord shall my soul be praised: * let the meek hear and rejoice.

verses.la: Magnificáte Dóminum mecum: * et exaltémus nomen eius in idípsum.
verses.en: O magnify the Lord with me; * and let us extol his name together.

verses.la: Exquisívi Dóminum, et exaudívit me: * et ex ómnibus tribulatiónibus meis erípuit me.
verses.en: I sought the Lord, and he heard me; * and he delivered me from all my troubles.

verses.la: Accédite ad eum, et illuminámini: * et fácies vestræ non confundéntur.
verses.en: Come ye to him and be enlightened: * and your faces shall not be confounded.

verses.la: Iste pauper clamávit, et Dóminus exaudívit eum: * et de ómnibus tribulatiónibus eius salvávit eum.
verses.en: This poor man cried, and the Lord heard him: * and saved him out of all his troubles.

verses.la: Immíttet Ángelus Dómini in circúitu timéntium eum: * et erípiet eos.
verses.en: The Angel of the Lord shall encamp round about them that fear him: * and shall deliver them.

verses.la: Gustáte, et vidéte quóniam suávis est Dóminus: * beátus vir, qui sperat in eo.
verses.en: O taste, and see that the Lord is sweet: * blessed is the man that hopeth in him.

verses.la: Timéte Dóminum, omnes sancti eius: * quóniam non est inópia timéntibus eum.
verses.en: Fear the Lord, all ye his saints: * for there is no want to them that fear him.

verses.la: Dívites eguérunt et esuriérunt: * inquiréntes autem Dóminum non minuéntur omni bono.
verses.en: The rich have wanted, and have suffered hunger: * but they that seek the Lord shall not be deprived of any good.

verses.la: Veníte, fílii, audíte me: * timórem Dómini docébo vos.
verses.en: Come, children, hearken to me: * I will teach you the fear of the Lord.

verses.la: Quis est homo qui vult vitam: * díligit dies vidére bonos?
verses.en: Who is the man that desireth life: * who loveth to see good days?

verses.la: Próhibe linguam tuam a malo: * et lábia tua ne loquántur dolum.
verses.en: Keep thy tongue from evil, * and thy lips from speaking guile.

verses.la: Divérte a malo, et fac bonum: * inquíre pacem, et perséquere eam.
verses.en: Turn away from evil and do good: * seek after peace and pursue it.

verses.la: Óculi Dómini super iustos: * et aures eius in preces eórum.
verses.en: The eyes of the Lord are upon the just: * and his ears unto their prayers.

verses.la: Vultus autem Dómini super faciéntes mala: * ut perdat de terra memóriam eórum.
verses.en: But the countenance of the Lord is against them that do evil things: * to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

verses.la: Clamavérunt iusti, et Dóminus exaudívit eos: * et ex ómnibus tribulatiónibus eórum liberávit eos.
verses.en: The just cried, and the Lord heard them: * and delivered them out of all their troubles.

verses.la: Iuxta est Dóminus iis, qui tribuláto sunt corde: * et húmiles spíritu salvábit.
verses.en: The Lord is nigh unto them that are of a contrite heart: * and he will save the humble of spirit.

verses.la: Multæ tribulatiónes iustórum: * et de ómnibus his liberábit eos Dóminus.
verses.en: Many are the afflictions of the just; * but out of them all will the Lord deliver them.

verses.la: Custódit Dóminus ómnia ossa eórum: * unum ex his non conterétur.
verses.en: The Lord keepeth all their bones, * not one of them shall be broken.
