verses.la: Mors peccatórum péssima: * et qui odérunt iustum, delínquent.
verses.en: The death of the wicked is very evil: * and they that hate the just shall be guilty.

verses.la: Rédimet Dóminus ánimas servórum suórum: * et non delínquent omnes qui sperant in eo.
verses.en: The Lord will redeem the souls of his servants: * and none of them that trust in him shall offend.

verses.la: Iúdica, Dómine, nocéntes me, * expúgna impugnántes me.
verses.en: Judge thou, O Lord, them that wrong me: * overthrow them that fight against me.

verses.la: Apprehénde arma et scutum: * et exsúrge in adiutórium mihi.
verses.en: Take hold of arms and shield: * and rise up to help me.

verses.la: Effúnde frámeam, et conclúde advérsus eos, qui persequúntur me: * dic ánimæ meæ: Salus tua ego sum.
verses.en: Bring out the sword, and shut up the way against them that persecute me: * say to my soul: I am thy salvation.

verses.la: Avertántur retrórsum, et confundántur * cogitántes mihi mala.
verses.en: Let them be turned back and be confounded * that devise against me.

verses.la: Fiant tamquam pulvis ante fáciem venti: * et Ángelus Dómini coárctans eos.
verses.en: Let them become as dust before the wind: * and let the Angel of the Lord straiten them.

verses.la: Fiat via illórum ténebræ et lúbricum: * et Ángelus Dómini pérsequens eos.
verses.en: Let their way become dark and slippery; * and let the Angel of the Lord pursue them.

verses.la: Quóniam gratis abscondérunt mihi intéritum láquei sui: * supervácue exprobravérunt ánimam meam.
verses.en: For without cause they have hidden their net for me unto destruction: * without cause they have upbraided my soul.

verses.la: Véniat illi láqueus, quem ignórat: et cáptio, quam abscóndit, apprehéndat eum: * et in láqueum cadat in ipsum.
verses.en: Let the snare which he knoweth not come upon him: and let the net which he hath hidden catch him: * and into that very snare let them fall.

verses.la: Ánima autem mea exsultábit in Dómino: * et delectábitur super salutári suo.
verses.en: But my soul shall rejoice in the Lord; * and shall be delighted in his salvation.

verses.la: Erípiens ínopem de manu fortiórum eius: * egénum et páuperem a diripiéntibus eum.
verses.en: Who deliverest the poor from the hand of them that are stronger than he; * the needy and the poor from them that strip him.

verses.la: Surgéntes testes iníqui, * quæ ignorábam interrogábant me.
verses.en: Unjust witnesses rising up * have asked me things I knew not.

verses.la: Retribuébant mihi mala pro bonis: * sterilitátem ánimæ meæ.
verses.en: They repaid me evil for good: * to the depriving me of my soul.

verses.la: Humiliábam in ieiúnio ánimam meam: * et orátio mea in sinu meo convertétur.
verses.en: I humbled my soul with fasting; * and my prayer shall be turned into my bosom.

verses.la: Quasi próximum, et quasi fratrem nostrum, sic complacébam: * quasi lugens et contristátus, sic humiliábar.
verses.en: As a neighbour and as an own brother, so did I please: * as one mourning and sorrowful so was I humbled.

verses.la: Et advérsum me lætáti sunt, et convenérunt: * congregáta sunt super me flagélla, et ignorávi.
verses.en: But they rejoiced against me, and came together: * scourges were gathered together upon me, and I knew not.

verses.la: Dissipáti sunt, nec compúncti, tentavérunt me, subsannavérunt me subsannatióne: * frenduérunt super me déntibus suis.
verses.en: They were separated, and repented not: they tempted me, they scoffed at me with scorn: * they gnashed upon me with their teeth.

verses.la: Dómine, quando respícies? * restítue ánimam meam a malignitáte eórum, a leónibus únicam meam.
verses.en: Lord, when wilt thou look upon me? * rescue thou my soul from their malice: my only one from the lions.

verses.la: Confitébor tibi in ecclésia magna, * in pópulo gravi laudábo te.
verses.en: I will give thanks to thee in a great church; * I will praise thee in a strong people.

verses.la: Non supergáudeant mihi qui adversántur mihi iníque: * qui odérunt me gratis et ánnuunt óculis.
verses.en: Let not them that are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: * who have hated me without cause, and wink with the eyes.

verses.la: Quóniam mihi quidem pacífice loquebántur: * et in iracúndia terræ loquéntes, dolos cogitábant.
verses.en: For they spoke indeed peaceably to me; * and speaking in the anger of the earth they devised guile.

verses.la: Et dilatavérunt super me os suum: * dixérunt: Euge, euge, vidérunt óculi nostri.
verses.en: And they opened their mouth wide against me; * they said: Well done, well done, our eyes have seen it.

verses.la: Vidísti, Dómine, ne síleas: * Dómine, ne discédas a me.
verses.en: Thou hast seen, O Lord, be not thou silent: * O Lord, depart not from me.

verses.la: Exsúrge et inténde iudício meo: * Deus meus, et Dóminus meus in causam meam.
verses.en: Arise, and be attentive to my judgment: * to my cause, my God, and my Lord.

verses.la: Iúdica me secúndum iustítiam tuam, Dómine, Deus meus, * et non supergáudeant mihi.
verses.en: Judge me, O Lord my God according to thy justice, * and let them not rejoice over me.

verses.la: Non dicant in córdibus suis: Euge, euge, ánimæ nostræ: * nec dicant: Devorávimus eum.
verses.en: Let them not say in their hearts: It is well, it is well, to our mind: * neither let them say: We have swallowed him up.

verses.la: Induántur confusióne et reveréntia * qui magna loquúntur super me.
verses.en: Let them be clothed with confusion and shame, * who speak great things against me.

verses.la: Exsúltent et læténtur qui volunt iustítiam meam: * et dicant semper: Magnificétur Dóminus qui volunt pacem servi eius.
verses.en: Let them rejoice and be glad, who are well pleased with my justice, * and let them say always: The Lord be magnified, who delights in the peace of his servant.

verses.la: Et lingua mea meditábitur iustítiam tuam, * tota die laudem tuam.
verses.en: And my tongue shall meditate thy justice, * thy praise all the day long.

verses.la: Dixit iniústus ut delínquat in semetípso: * non est timor Dei ante óculos eius.
verses.en: The unjust hath said within himself, that he would sin: * there is no fear of God before his eyes.

verses.la: Quóniam dolóse egit in conspéctu eius: * ut inveniátur iníquitas eius ad ódium.
verses.en: For in his sight he hath done deceitfully, * that his iniquity may be found unto hatred.

verses.la: Verba oris eius iníquitas, et dolus: * nóluit intellégere ut bene ágeret.
verses.en: The words of his mouth are iniquity and guile: * he would not understand that he might do well.

verses.la: Iniquitátem meditátus est in cubíli suo: * ástitit omni viæ non bonæ, malítiam autem non odívit.
verses.en: He hath devised iniquity on his bed, * he hath set himself on every way that is not good: but evil he hath not hated.

verses.la: Dómine, in cælo misericórdia tua: * et véritas tua usque ad nubes.
verses.en: O Lord, thy mercy is in heaven, * and thy truth reacheth even to the clouds.

verses.la: Hómines, et iuménta salvábis, Dómine: * quemádmodum multiplicásti misericórdiam tuam, Deus.
verses.en: Men and beasts thou wilt preserve, O Lord: * O how hast thou multiplied thy mercy, O God!

verses.la: Fílii autem hóminum, * in tégmine alárum tuárum sperábunt.
verses.en: But the children of men * shall put their trust under the covert of thy wings.

verses.la: Inebriabúntur ab ubertáte domus tuæ: * et torrénte voluptátis tuæ potábis eos.
verses.en: They shall be inebriated with the plenty of thy house; * and thou shalt make them drink of the torrent of thy pleasure.

verses.la: Quóniam apud te est fons vitæ: * et in lúmine tuo vidébimus lumen.
verses.en: For with thee is the fountain of life; * and in thy light we shall see light.

verses.la: Præténde misericórdiam tuam sciéntibus te, * et iustítiam tuam his, qui recto sunt corde.
verses.en: Extend thy mercy to them that know thee, * and thy justice to them that are right in heart.

verses.la: Non véniat mihi pes supérbiæ: * et manus peccatóris non móveat me.
verses.en: Let not the foot of pride come to me, * and let not the hand of the sinner move me.

verses.la: Ibi cecidérunt qui operántur iniquitátem: * expúlsi sunt, nec potuérunt stare.
verses.en: There the workers of iniquity are fallen, * they are cast out, and could not stand.

verses.la: Noli æmulári in malignántibus: * neque zeláveris faciéntes iniquitátem.
verses.en: Be not emulous of evildoers; * nor envy them that work iniquity.

verses.la: Quóniam tamquam fænum velóciter aréscent: * et quemádmodum ólera herbárum cito décident.
verses.en: For they shall shortly wither away as grass, * and as the green herbs shall quickly fall.

verses.la: Spera in Dómino, et fac bonitátem: * et inhábita terram, et pascéris in divítiis eius.
verses.en: Trust in the Lord, and do good, * and dwell in the land, and thou shalt be fed with its riches.

verses.la: Delectáre in Dómino: * et dabit tibi petitiónes cordis tui.
verses.en: Delight in the Lord, * and he will give thee the requests of thy heart.

verses.la: Revéla Dómino viam tuam, et spera in eo: * et ipse fáciet.
verses.en: Commit thy way to the Lord, and trust in him, * and he will do it.

verses.la: Et edúcet quasi lumen iustítiam tuam: et iudícium tuum tamquam merídiem: * súbditus esto Dómino, et ora eum.
verses.en: And he will bring forth thy justice as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday: * be subject to the Lord and pray to him.

verses.la: Noli æmulári in eo, qui prosperátur in via sua: * in hómine faciénte iniustítias.
verses.en: Envy not the man who prospereth in his way; * the man who doth unjust things.

verses.la: Désine ab ira, et derelínque furórem: * noli æmulári ut malignéris.
verses.en: Cease from anger, and leave rage; * have no emulation to do evil.

verses.la: Quóniam qui malignántur, exterminabúntur: * sustinéntes autem Dóminum, ipsi hereditábunt terram.
verses.en: For the evildoers shall be cut off: * but they that wait upon the Lord shall inherit the land.

verses.la: Et adhuc pusíllum, et non erit peccátor: * et quæres locum eius et non invénies.
verses.en: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: * and thou shalt seek his place, and shalt not find it.

verses.la: Mansuéti autem hereditábunt terram: * et delectabúntur in multitúdine pacis.
verses.en: But the meek shall inherit the land, * and shall delight in abundance of peace.

verses.la: Observábit peccátor iustum: * et stridébit super eum déntibus suis.
verses.en: The sinner shall watch the just man: * and shall gnash upon him with his teeth.

verses.la: Dóminus autem irridébit eum: * quóniam próspicit quod véniet dies eius.
verses.en: But the Lord shall laugh at him: * for he foreseeth that his day shall come.

verses.la: Ut deíciant páuperem et ínopem: * ut trucídent rectos corde.
verses.en: To cast down the poor and needy, * to kill the upright of heart.

verses.la: Gládius eórum intret in corda ipsórum: * et arcus eórum confringátur.
verses.en: Let their sword enter into their own hearts, * and let their bow be broken.

verses.la: Mélius est módicum iusto, * super divítias peccatórum multas.
verses.en: Better is a little to the just, * than the great riches of the wicked.

verses.la: Quóniam brácchia peccatórum conteréntur: * confírmat autem iustos Dóminus.
verses.en: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken in pieces; * but the Lord strengtheneth the just.

verses.la: Novit Dóminus dies immaculatórum: * et heréditas eórum in ætérnum erit.
verses.en: The Lord knoweth the days of the undefiled; * and their inheritance shall be for ever.

verses.la: Non confundéntur in témpore malo, et in diébus famis saturabúntur: * quia peccatóres períbunt.
verses.en: They shall not be confounded in the evil time; and in the days of famine they shall be filled, * because the wicked shall perish.

verses.la: Inimíci vero Dómini mox ut honorificáti fúerint et exaltáti: * deficiéntes, quemádmodum fumus defícient.
verses.en: And the enemies of the Lord, presently after they shall be honoured and exalted, * shall come to nothing and vanish like smoke.

verses.la: Mutuábitur peccátor, et non solvet: * iustus autem miserétur et tríbuet.
verses.en: The sinner shall borrow, and not pay again; * but the just sheweth mercy and shall give.

verses.la: Quia benedicéntes ei hereditábunt terram: * maledicéntes autem ei disperíbunt.
verses.en: For such as bless him shall inherit the land: * but such as curse him shall perish.

verses.la: Apud Dóminum gressus hóminis dirigéntur: * et viam eius volet.
verses.en: With the Lord shall the steps of a man be directed, * and he shall like well his way.

verses.la: Cum cecíderit non collidétur: * quia Dóminus suppónit manum suam.
verses.en: When he shall fall he shall not be bruised, * for the Lord putteth his hand under him.

verses.la: Iúnior fui, étenim sénui: * et non vidi iustum derelíctum, nec semen eius quærens panem.
verses.en: I have been young, and now am old; * and I have not seen the just forsaken, nor his seed seeking bread.

verses.la: Tota die miserétur et cómmodat: * et semen illíus in benedictióne erit.
verses.en: He sheweth mercy, and lendeth all the day long; * and his seed shall be in blessing.

verses.la: Declína a malo, et fac bonum: * et inhábita in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.en: Decline from evil and do good, * and dwell for ever and ever.

verses.la: Iniústi puniéntur: * et semen impiórum períbit.
verses.en: The unjust shall be punished, * and the seed of the wicked shall perish.

verses.la: Iusti autem hereditábunt terram: * et inhabitábunt in sǽculum sǽculi super eam.
verses.en: But the just shall inherit the land, * and shall dwell therein for evermore.

verses.la: Os iusti meditábitur sapiéntiam, * et lingua eius loquétur iudícium.
verses.en: The mouth of the just shall meditate wisdom: * and his tongue shall speak judgment.

verses.la: Lex Dei eius in corde ipsíus, * et non supplantabúntur gressus eius.
verses.en: The law of his God is in his heart, * and his steps shall not be supplanted.

verses.la: Consíderat peccátor iustum: * et quærit mortificáre eum.
verses.en: The wicked watcheth the just man, * and seeketh to put him to death.

verses.la: Dóminus autem non derelínquet eum in mánibus eius: * nec damnábit eum, cum iudicábitur illi.
verses.en: But the Lord will not leave him in his hands; * nor condemn him when he shall be judged.

verses.la: Exspécta Dóminum, et custódi viam eius: et exaltábit te ut hereditáte cápias terram: * cum períerint peccatóres vidébis.
verses.en: Expect the Lord and keep his way: and he will exalt thee to inherit the land: * when the sinners shall perish thou shalt see.

verses.la: Vidi ímpium superexaltátum, * et elevátum sicut cedros Líbani.
verses.en: I have seen the wicked highly exalted, * and lifted up like the cedars of Libanus.

verses.la: Et transívi, et ecce non erat: * et quæsívi eum, et non est invéntus locus eius.
verses.en: And I passed by, and lo, he was not: * and I sought him and his place was not found.

verses.la: Custódi innocéntiam, et vide æquitátem: * quóniam sunt relíquiæ hómini pacífico.
verses.en: Keep innocence, and behold justice: * for there are remnants for the peaceable man.

verses.la: Iniústi autem disperíbunt simul: * relíquiæ impiórum interíbunt.
verses.en: But the unjust shall be destroyed together: * the remnants of the wicked shall perish.

verses.la: Salus autem iustórum a Dómino: * et protéctor eórum in témpore tribulatiónis.
verses.en: But the salvation of the just is from the Lord, * and he is their protector in the time of trouble.

verses.la: Et adiuvábit eos Dóminus et liberábit eos: * et éruet eos a peccatóribus, et salvábit eos: quia speravérunt in eo.
verses.en: And the Lord will help them and deliver them: * and he will rescue them from the wicked, and save them, because they have hoped in him.

verses.la: Dómine, ne in furóre tuo árguas me, * neque in ira tua corrípias me.
verses.en: Rebuke me not, O Lord, in thy indignation; * nor chastise me in thy wrath.

verses.la: Quóniam sagíttæ tuæ infíxæ sunt mihi: * et confirmásti super me manum tuam.
verses.en: For thy arrows are fastened in me: * and thy hand hath been strong upon me.

verses.la: Non est sánitas in carne mea a fácie iræ tuæ: * non est pax óssibus meis a fácie peccatórum meórum.
verses.en: There is no health in my flesh, because of thy wrath: * there is no peace for my bones, because of my sins.

verses.la: Quóniam iniquitátes meæ supergréssæ sunt caput meum: * et sicut onus grave gravátæ sunt super me.
verses.en: For my iniquities are gone over my head: * and as a heavy burden are become heavy upon me.

verses.la: Putruérunt et corrúptæ sunt cicatríces meæ, * a fácie insipiéntiæ meæ.
verses.en: My sores are putrified and corrupted, * because of my foolishness.

verses.la: Miser factus sum, et curvátus sum usque in finem: * tota die contristátus ingrediébar.
verses.en: I am become miserable, and am bowed down even to the end: * I walked sorrowful all the day long.

verses.la: Quóniam lumbi mei impléti sunt illusiónibus: * et non est sánitas in carne mea.
verses.en: For my loins are filled with illusions; * and there is no health in my flesh.

verses.la: Afflíctus sum, et humiliátus sum nimis: * rugiébam a gémitu cordis mei.
verses.en: I am afflicted and humbled exceedingly: * I roared with the groaning of my heart.

verses.la: Dómine, ante te omne desidérium meum: * et gémitus meus a te non est abscónditus.
verses.en: Lord, all my desire is before thee, * and my groaning is not hidden from thee.

verses.la: Cor meum conturbátum est, derelíquit me virtus mea: * et lumen oculórum meórum, et ipsum non est mecum.
verses.en: My heart is troubled, my strength hath left me, * and the light of my eyes itself is not with me.

verses.la: Et qui iuxta me erant, de longe stetérunt: * et vim faciébant qui quærébant ánimam meam.
verses.en: And they that were near me stood afar off: * and they that sought my soul used violence.

verses.la: Et qui inquirébant mala mihi, locúti sunt vanitátes: * et dolos tota die meditabántur.
verses.en: And they that sought evils to me spoke vain things, * and studied deceits all the day long.

verses.la: Ego autem tamquam surdus non audiébam: * et sicut mutus non apériens os suum.
verses.en: But I, as a deaf man, heard not: * and as a dumb man not opening his mouth.

verses.la: Et factus sum sicut homo non áudiens: * et non habens in ore suo redargutiónes.
verses.en: And I became as a man that heareth not: * and that hath no reproofs in his mouth.

verses.la: Quóniam in te, Dómine, sperávi: * tu exáudies me, Dómine, Deus meus.
verses.en: For in thee, O Lord, have I hoped: * thou wilt hear me, O Lord my God.

verses.la: Quia dixi: Nequándo supergáudeant mihi inimíci mei: * et dum commovéntur pedes mei, super me magna locúti sunt.
verses.en: For I said: Lest at any time my enemies rejoice over me: * and whilst my feet are moved, they speak great things against me.

verses.la: Quóniam ego in flagélla parátus sum: * et dolor meus in conspéctu meo semper.
verses.en: For I am ready for scourges: * and my sorrow is continually before me.

verses.la: Quóniam iniquitátem meam annuntiábo: * et cogitábo pro peccáto meo.
verses.en: For I will declare my iniquity: * and I will think for my sin.

verses.la: Inimíci autem mei vivunt, et confirmáti sunt super me: * et multiplicáti sunt qui odérunt me iníque.
verses.en: But my enemies live, and are stronger than I: * and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

verses.la: Qui retríbuunt mala pro bonis, detrahébant mihi: * quóniam sequébar bonitátem.
verses.en: They that render evil for good, have detracted me, * because I followed goodness.

verses.la: Ne derelínquas me, Dómine, Deus meus: * ne discésseris a me.
verses.en: Forsake me not, O Lord my God: * do not thou depart from me.

verses.la: Inténde in adiutórium meum, * Dómine, Deus, salútis meæ.
verses.en: Attend unto my help, * O Lord, the God of my salvation.

verses.la: Pósui ori meo custódiam, * cum consísteret peccátor advérsum me.
verses.en: I have set guard to my mouth, * when the sinner stood against me.

verses.la: Obmútui, et humiliátus sum, et sílui a bonis: * et dolor meus renovátus est.
verses.en: I was dumb, and was humbled, and kept silence from good things: * and my sorrow was renewed.

verses.la: Concáluit cor meum intra me: * et in meditatióne mea exardéscet ignis.
verses.en: My heart grew hot within me: * and in my meditation a fire shall flame out.

verses.la: Et númerum diérum meórum quis est: * ut sciam quid desit mihi.
verses.en: And what is the number of my days: * that I may know what is wanting to me.

verses.la: Verúmtamen univérsa vánitas, * omnis homo vivens.
verses.en: And indeed all things are vanity: * every man living.

verses.la: Thesaurízat: * et ignórat cui congregábit ea.
verses.en: He storeth up: * and he knoweth not for whom he shall gather these things.

verses.la: Et nunc quæ est exspectátio mea? Nonne Dóminus? * Et substántia mea apud te est.
verses.en: And now what is my hope? Is it not the Lord? * And my substance is with thee.

verses.la: Ab ómnibus iniquitátibus meis érue me: * oppróbrium insipiénti dedísti me.
verses.en: Deliver thou me from all my iniquities: * thou hast made me a reproach to the fool.

verses.la: Obmútui, et non apérui os meum, quóniam tu fecísti: * ámove a me plagas tuas.
verses.en: I was dumb, and I opened not my mouth, because thou hast done it: * remove thy scourges from me.

verses.la: Et tabéscere fecísti sicut aráneam ánimam eius: * verúmtamen vane conturbátur omnis homo.
verses.en: And thou hast made his soul to waste away like a spider: * surely in vain is any man disquieted.

verses.la: Ne síleas: quóniam ádvena ego sum apud te, et peregrínus, * sicut omnes patres mei.
verses.en: Be not silent: for I am a stranger with thee, * and a sojourner as all my fathers were.

verses.la: Remítte mihi, ut refrígerer priúsquam ábeam, * et ámplius non ero.
verses.en: O forgive me, that I may be refreshed, before I go hence, * and be no more.

verses.la: Exspéctans exspectávi Dóminum, * et inténdit mihi.
verses.en: With expectation I have waited for the Lord, * and he was attentive to me.

verses.la: Et státuit super petram pedes meos: * et diréxit gressus meos.
verses.en: And he set my feet upon a rock, * and directed my steps.

verses.la: Vidébunt multi, et timébunt: * et sperábunt in Dómino.
verses.en: Many shall see, and shall fear: * and they shall hope in the Lord.

verses.la: Beátus vir, cuius est nomen Dómini spes eius: * et non respéxit in vanitátes et insánias falsas.
verses.en: Blessed is the man whose trust is in the name of the Lord; * and who hath not had regard to vanities, and lying follies.

verses.la: Annuntiávi et locútus sum: * multiplicáti sunt super númerum.
verses.en: I have declared and I have spoken * they are multiplied above number.

verses.la: Holocáustum et pro peccáto non postulásti: * tunc dixi: Ecce, vénio.
verses.en: Burnt offering and sin offering thou didst not require: * then said I, Behold I come.

verses.la: In cápite libri scriptum est de me ut fácerem voluntátem tuam: * Deus meus, vólui, et legem tuam in médio cordis mei.
verses.en: In the head of the book it is written of me that I should do thy will: * O my God, I have desired it, and thy law in the midst of my heart.

verses.la: Annuntiávi iustítiam tuam in ecclésia magna, * ecce, lábia mea non prohibébo: Dómine, tu scisti.
verses.en: I have declared thy justice in a great church, * lo, I will not restrain my lips: O Lord, thou knowest it.

verses.la: Non abscóndi misericórdiam tuam et veritátem tuam * a concílio multo.
verses.en: I have not concealed thy mercy and thy truth * from a great council.

verses.la: Tu autem, Dómine, ne longe fácias miseratiónes tuas a me: * misericórdia tua et véritas tua semper suscepérunt me.
verses.en: Withhold not thou, O Lord, thy tender mercies from me: * thy mercy and thy truth have always upheld me.

verses.la: Multiplicátæ sunt super capíllos cápitis mei: * et cor meum derelíquit me.
verses.en: They are multiplied above the hairs of my head: * and my heart hath forsaken me.

verses.la: Compláceat tibi, Dómine, ut éruas me: * Dómine, ad adiuvándum me réspice.
verses.en: Be pleased, O Lord to deliver me: * look down, O Lord, to help me.

verses.la: Convertántur retrórsum, et revereántur, * qui volunt mihi mala.
verses.en: Let them be turned backward and be ashamed * that desire evils to me.

verses.la: Ferant conféstim confusiónem suam, * qui dicunt mihi: Euge, euge.
verses.en: Let them immediately bear their confusion, * that say to me: ’T is well, ’t is well.

verses.la: Exsúltent et læténtur super te omnes quæréntes te: * et dicant semper: Magnificétur Dóminus: qui díligunt salutáre tuum.
verses.en: Let all that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: * and let such as love thy salvation say always: The Lord be magnified.

verses.la: Adiútor meus, et protéctor meus tu es: * Deus meus, ne tardáveris.
verses.en: Thou art my helper and my protector: * O my God, be not slack.

verses.la: Beátus qui intéllegit super egénum, et páuperem: * in die mala liberábit eum Dóminus.
verses.en: Blessed is he that understandeth concerning the needy and the poor: * the Lord will deliver him in the evil day.

verses.la: Dóminus consérvet eum, et vivíficet eum, et beátum fáciat eum in terra: * et non tradat eum in ánimam inimicórum eius.
verses.en: The Lord preserve him and give him life, and make him blessed upon the earth: * and deliver him not up to the will of his enemies.

verses.la: Dóminus opem ferat illi super lectum dolóris eius: * univérsum stratum eius versásti in infirmitáte eius.
verses.en: The Lord help him on his bed of sorrow: * thou hast turned all his couch in his sickness.

verses.la: Ego dixi: Dómine, miserére mei: * sana ánimam meam, quia peccávi tibi.
verses.en: I said: O Lord, be thou merciful to me: * heal my soul, for I have sinned against thee.

verses.la: Inimíci mei dixérunt mala mihi: * Quando moriétur, et períbit nomen eius?
verses.en: My enemies have spoken evils against me: * when shall he die and his name perish?

verses.la: Egrediebátur foras, * et loquebátur in idípsum.
verses.en: He went out * and spoke to the same purpose.

verses.la: Advérsum me susurrábant omnes inimíci mei: * advérsum me cogitábant mala mihi.
verses.en: All my enemies whispered together against me: * they devised evils to me.

verses.la: Verbum iníquum constituérunt advérsum me: * Numquid qui dormit non adíciet ut resúrgat?
verses.en: They determined against me an unjust word: * shall he that sleepeth rise again no more?

verses.la: Étenim homo pacis meæ, in quo sperávi: * qui edébat panes meos, magnificávit super me supplantatiónem.
verses.en: For even the man of my peace, in whom I trusted, * who ate my bread, hath greatly supplanted me.

verses.la: Tu autem, Dómine, miserére mei, et resúscita me: * et retríbuam eis.
verses.en: But thou, O Lord, have mercy on me, and raise me up again: * and I will requite them.

verses.la: In hoc cognóvi quóniam voluísti me: * quóniam non gaudébit inimícus meus super me.
verses.en: By this I know, that thou hast had a good will for me: * because my enemy shall not rejoice over me.

verses.la: Me autem propter innocéntiam suscepísti: * et confirmásti me in conspéctu tuo in ætérnum.
verses.en: But thou hast upheld me by reason of my innocence: * and hast established me in thy sight for ever.

verses.la: Benedíctus Dóminus, Deus Israël, a sǽculo et usque in sǽculum: * fiat, fiat.
verses.en: Blessed be the Lord the God of Israel from eternity to eternity. * So be it. So be it.

verses.la: Quemádmodum desíderat cervus ad fontes aquárum: * ita desíderat ánima mea ad te, Deus.
verses.en: As the hart panteth after the fountains of water; * so my soul panteth after thee, O God.

verses.la: Sitívit ánima mea ad Deum fortem vivum: * quando véniam, et apparébo ante fáciem Dei?
verses.en: My soul hath thirsted after the strong living God; * when shall I come and appear before the face of God?

verses.la: Fuérunt mihi lácrimæ meæ panes die ac nocte: * dum dícitur mihi cotídie: Ubi est Deus tuus?
verses.en: My tears have been my bread day and night, * whilst it is said to me daily: Where is thy God?

verses.la: In voce exsultatiónis, et confessiónis: * sonus epulántis.
verses.en: With the voice of joy and praise; * the noise of one feasting.

verses.la: Spera in Deo, quóniam adhuc confitébor illi: * salutáre vultus mei, et Deus meus.
verses.en: Hope in God, for I will still give praise to him: * the salvation of my countenance, and my God.

verses.la: Ad meípsum ánima mea conturbáta est: * proptérea memor ero tui de terra Iordánis, et Hermóniim a monte módico.
verses.en: My soul is troubled within myself: * therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan and Hermoniim, from the little hill.

verses.la: Ómnia excélsa tua, et fluctus tui * super me transiérunt.
verses.en: All thy heights and thy billows * have passed over me.

verses.la: Apud me orátio Deo vitæ meæ, * dicam Deo: Suscéptor meus es.
verses.en: With me is prayer to the God of my life. * I will say to God: Thou art my support.

verses.la: Quare oblítus es mei? * et quare contristátus incédo, dum afflígit me inimícus?
verses.en: Why hast thou forgotten me? * and why go I mourning, whilst my enemy afflicteth me?

verses.la: Dum dicunt mihi per síngulos dies: Ubi est Deus tuus? * quare tristis es, ánima mea? et quare contúrbas me?
verses.en: Whilst they say to me day by day: Where is thy God? * Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why dost thou disquiet me?

verses.la: Spera in Deo, quóniam adhuc confitébor illi: * salutáre vultus mei, et Deus meus.
verses.en: Hope thou in God, for I will still give praise to him: * the salvation of my countenance, and my God.

verses.la: Iúdica me, Deus, et discérne causam meam de gente non sancta, * ab hómine iníquo, et dolóso érue me.
verses.en: Judge me, O God, and distinguish my cause from the nation that is not holy: * deliver me from the unjust and deceitful man.

verses.la: Quia tu es, Deus, fortitúdo mea: * quare me repulísti? et quare tristis incédo, dum afflígit me inimícus?
verses.en: For thou art God my strength: * why hast thou cast me off? and why do I go sorrowful whilst the enemy afflicteth me?

verses.la: Emítte lucem tuam et veritátem tuam: * ipsa me deduxérunt, et adduxérunt in montem sanctum tuum, et in tabernácula tua.
verses.en: Send forth thy light and thy truth: * they have conducted me, and brought me unto thy holy hill, and into thy tabernacles.

verses.la: Et introíbo ad altáre Dei: * ad Deum, qui lætíficat iuventútem meam.
verses.en: And I will go in to the altar of God: * to God who giveth joy to my youth.

verses.la: Confitébor tibi in cíthara, Deus, Deus meus: * quare tristis es, ánima mea? et quare contúrbas me?
verses.en: To thee, O God my God, I will give praise upon the harp: * why art thou sad, O my soul? and why dost thou disquiet me?

verses.la: Spera in Deo, quóniam adhuc confitébor illi: * salutáre vultus mei, et Deus meus.
verses.en: Hope in God, for I will still give praise to him: * the salvation of my countenance, and my God.

verses.la: Lingua mea cálamus scribæ: * velóciter scribéntis.
verses.en: My tongue is the pen of a scrivener * that writeth swiftly.

verses.la: Speciósus forma præ fíliis hóminum, diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis: * proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
verses.en: Thou art beautiful above the sons of men: grace is poured abroad in thy lips; * therefore hath God blessed thee for ever.

verses.la: Accíngere gládio tuo super femur tuum, * potentíssime.
verses.en: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, * O thou most mighty.

verses.la: Propter veritátem, et mansuetúdinem, et iustítiam: * et dedúcet te mirabíliter déxtera tua.
verses.en: Because of truth and meekness and justice: * and thy right hand shall conduct thee wonderfully.

verses.la: Sagíttæ tuæ acútæ, pópuli sub te cadent: * in corda inimicórum Regis.
verses.en: Thy arrows are sharp: under thee shall people fall, * into the hearts of the king’s enemies.

verses.la: Sedes tua, Deus, in sǽculum sǽculi: * virga directiónis virga regni tui.
verses.en: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: * the sceptre of thy kingdom is a sceptre of uprightness.

verses.la: Dilexísti iustítiam, et odísti iniquitátem: * proptérea unxit te Deus, Deus tuus, óleo lætítiæ præ consórtibus tuis.
verses.en: Thou hast loved justice, and hated iniquity: * therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

verses.la: Myrrha, et gutta, et cásia a vestiméntis tuis, a dómibus ebúrneis: * ex quibus delectavérunt te fíliæ regum in honóre tuo.
verses.en: Myrrh and stacte and cassia perfume thy garments, from the ivory houses: * out of which the daughters of kings have delighted thee in thy glory.

verses.la: Ástitit regína a dextris tuis in vestítu deauráto: * circúmdata varietáte.
verses.en: The queen stood on thy right hand, in gilded clothing; * surrounded with variety.

verses.la: Audi fília, et vide, et inclína aurem tuam: * et oblivíscere pópulum tuum et domum patris tui.
verses.en: Hearken, O daughter, and see, and incline thy ear: * and forget thy people and thy father’s house.

verses.la: Et concupíscet Rex decórem tuum: * quóniam ipse est Dóminus Deus tuus, et adorábunt eum.
verses.en: And the king shall greatly desire thy beauty; * for he is the Lord thy God, and him they shall adore.

verses.la: Et fíliæ Tyri in munéribus * vultum tuum deprecabúntur: omnes dívites plebis.
verses.en: And the daughters of Tyre with gifts, * yea, all the rich among the people, shall entreat thy countenance.

verses.la: Omnis glória eius fíliæ Regis ab intus, * in fímbriis áureis circumamícta varietátibus.
verses.en: All the glory of the king’s daughter is within, * in golden borders, clothed round about with varieties.

verses.la: Adducéntur Regi vírgines post eam: * próximæ eius afferéntur tibi.
verses.en: After her shall virgins be brought to the king: * her neighbours shall be brought to thee.

verses.la: Afferéntur in lætítia et exsultatióne: * adducéntur in templum Regis.
verses.en: They shall be brought with gladness and rejoicing: * they shall be brought into the temple of the king.

verses.la: Pro pátribus tuis nati sunt tibi fílii: * constítues eos príncipes super omnem terram.
verses.en: Instead of thy fathers, sons are born to thee: * thou shalt make them princes over all the earth.

verses.la: Proptérea pópuli confitebúntur tibi in ætérnum: * et in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.en: Therefore shall people praise thee for ever; yea, * for ever and ever.

verses.la: Deus noster refúgium, et virtus: * adiútor in tribulatiónibus, quæ invenérunt nos nimis.
verses.en: Our God is our refuge and strength: * a helper in troubles, which have found us exceedingly.

verses.la: Proptérea non timébimus dum turbábitur terra: * et transferéntur montes in cor maris.
verses.en: Therefore we will not fear, when the earth shall be troubled; * and the mountains shall be removed into the heart of the sea.

verses.la: Sonuérunt, et turbátæ sunt aquæ eórum: * conturbáti sunt montes in fortitúdine eius.
verses.en: Their waters roared and were troubled: * the mountains were troubled with his strength.

verses.la: Flúminis ímpetus lætíficat civitátem Dei: * sanctificávit tabernáculum suum Altíssimus.
verses.en: The stream of the river maketh the city of God joyful: * the most High hath sanctified his own tabernacle.

verses.la: Deus in médio eius, non commovébitur: * adiuvábit eam Deus mane dilúculo.
verses.en: God is in the midst thereof, it shall not be moved: * God will help it in the morning early.

verses.la: Conturbátæ sunt gentes, et inclináta sunt regna: * dedit vocem suam, mota est terra.
verses.en: Nations were troubled, and kingdoms were bowed down: * he uttered his voice, the earth trembled.

verses.la: Dóminus virtútum nobíscum: * suscéptor noster Deus Iacob.
verses.en: The Lord of armies is with us: * the God of Jacob is our protector.

verses.la: Veníte, et vidéte ópera Dómini, quæ pósuit prodígia super terram: * áuferens bella usque ad finem terræ.
verses.en: Come and behold ye the works of the Lord: what wonders he hath done upon earth, * making wars to cease even to the end of the earth.

verses.la: Arcum cónteret, et confrínget arma: * et scuta combúret igni.
verses.en: He shall destroy the bow, and break the weapons: * and the shield he shall burn in the fire.

verses.la: Vacáte, et vidéte quóniam ego sum Deus: * exaltábor in géntibus, et exaltábor in terra.
verses.en: Be still and see that I am God; * I will be exalted among the nations, and I will be exalted in the earth.

verses.la: Dóminus virtútum nobíscum: * suscéptor noster Deus Iacob.
verses.en: The Lord of armies is with us: * the God of Jacob is our protector.

verses.la: Omnes gentes, pláudite mánibus: * iubiláte Deo in voce exsultatiónis.
verses.en: O clap your hands, all ye nations: * shout unto God with the voice of joy,

verses.la: Quóniam Dóminus excélsus, terríbilis: * Rex magnus super omnem terram.
verses.en: For the Lord is high, terrible: * a great king over all the earth.

verses.la: Subiécit pópulos nobis: * et gentes sub pédibus nostris.
verses.en: He hath subdued the people under us; * and the nations under our feet.

verses.la: Elégit nobis hereditátem suam: * spéciem Iacob, quam diléxit.
verses.en: He hath chosen for us his inheritance, * the beauty of Jacob which he hath loved.

verses.la: Ascéndit Deus in iúbilo: * et Dóminus in voce tubæ.
verses.en: God is ascended with jubilee, * and the Lord with the sound of trumpet.

verses.la: Psállite Deo nostro, psállite: * psállite Regi nostro, psállite.
verses.en: Sing praises to our God, sing ye: * sing praises to our king, sing ye.

verses.la: Quóniam Rex omnis terræ Deus: * psállite sapiénter.
verses.en: For God is the king of all the earth: * sing ye wisely.

verses.la: Regnábit Deus super gentes: * Deus sedet super sedem sanctam suam.
verses.en: God shall reign over the nations: * God sitteth on his holy throne.

verses.la: Príncipes populórum congregáti sunt cum Deo Ábraham: * quóniam dii fortes terræ veheménter eleváti sunt.
verses.en: The princes of the people are gathered together, with the God of Abraham: * for the strong gods of the earth are exceedingly exalted.

verses.la: Magnus Dóminus, et laudábilis nimis in civitáte Dei nostri, ‡ in monte sancto eius.
verses.en: Great is the Lord, and exceedingly to be praised in the city of our God, ‡ in his holy mountain.

verses.la: Fundátur exsultatióne univérsæ terræ mons Sion, * látera Aquilónis, cívitas Regis magni.
verses.en: With the joy of the whole earth is mount Sion founded, * on the sides of the north, the city of the great king.

verses.la: Deus in dómibus eius cognoscétur: * cum suscípiet eam.
verses.en: In her houses shall God be known, * when he shall protect her.

verses.la: Quóniam ecce reges terræ congregáti sunt: * convenérunt in unum.
verses.en: For behold the kings of the earth assembled themselves: * they gathered together.

verses.la: Ipsi vidéntes sic admiráti sunt, conturbáti sunt, commóti sunt: * tremor apprehéndit eos.
verses.en: So they saw, and they wondered, they were troubled, they were moved: * trembling took hold of them.

verses.la: Ibi dolóres ut parturiéntis: * in spíritu veheménti cónteres naves Tharsis.
verses.en: There were pains as of a woman in labour; * with a vehement wind thou shalt break in pieces the ships of Tharsis.

verses.la: Sicut audívimus, sic vídimus in civitáte Dómini virtútum, in civitáte Dei nostri: * Deus fundávit eam in ætérnum.
verses.en: As we have heard, so have we seen, in the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God: * God hath founded it for ever.

verses.la: Suscépimus, Deus, misericórdiam tuam, * in médio templi tui.
verses.en: We have received thy mercy, O God, * in the midst of thy temple.

verses.la: Secúndum nomen tuum, Deus, sic et laus tua in fines terræ: * iustítia plena est déxtera tua.
verses.en: According to thy name, O God, so also is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: * thy right hand is full of justice.

verses.la: Lætétur mons Sion, et exsúltent fíliæ Iudæ: * propter iudícia tua, Dómine.
verses.en: Let mount Sion rejoice, and the daughters of Juda be glad; * because of thy judgments, O Lord.

verses.la: Circúmdate Sion, et complectímini eam: * narráte in túrribus eius.
verses.en: Surround Sion, and encompass her: * tell ye in her towers.

verses.la: Pónite corda vestra in virtúte eius: * et distribúite domos eius, ut enarrétis in progénie áltera.
verses.en: Set your hearts on her strength; and distribute her houses, * that ye may relate it in another generation.

verses.la: Quóniam hic est Deus, Deus noster in ætérnum et in sǽculum sǽculi: * ipse reget nos in sǽcula.
verses.en: For this is God, our God unto eternity, and for ever and ever: * he shall rule us for evermore.

verses.la: Audíte hæc, omnes gentes: * áuribus percípite omnes, qui habitátis orbem:
verses.en: Hear these things, all ye nations: * give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world.

verses.la: Quique terrígenæ, et fílii hóminum: * simul in unum dives et pauper.
verses.en: All you that are earthborn, and you sons of men: * both rich and poor together.

verses.la: Os meum loquétur sapiéntiam: * et meditátio cordis mei prudéntiam.
verses.en: My mouth shall speak wisdom: * and the meditation of my heart understanding.

verses.la: Inclinábo in parábolam aurem meam: * apériam in psaltério propositiónem meam.
verses.en: I will incline my ear to a parable; * I will open my proposition on the psaltery.

verses.la: Cur timébo in die mala? * iníquitas calcánei mei circúmdabit me:
verses.en: Why shall I fear in the evil day? * the iniquity of my heel shall encompass me.

verses.la: Qui confídunt in virtúte sua: * et in multitúdine divitiárum suárum gloriántur.
verses.en: They that trust in their own strength, * and glory in the multitude of their riches,

verses.la: Frater non rédimit, rédimet homo: * non dabit Deo placatiónem suam.
verses.en: No brother can redeem, nor shall man redeem: * he shall not give to God his ransom,

verses.la: Et prétium redemptiónis ánimæ suæ: * et laborábit in ætérnum, et vivet adhuc in finem.
verses.en: Nor the price of the redemption of his soul: * and shall labour for ever, and shall still live unto the end.

verses.la: Et relínquent aliénis divítias suas: * et sepúlcra eórum domus illórum in ætérnum.
verses.en: And they shall leave their riches to strangers: * and their sepulchres shall be their houses for ever.

verses.la: Tabernácula eórum in progénie et progénie: * vocavérunt nómina sua in terris suis.
verses.en: Their dwelling places to all generations: * they have called their lands by their names.

verses.la: Et homo, cum in honóre esset, non intelléxit: * comparátus est iuméntis insipiéntibus, et símilis factus est illis.
verses.en: And man when he was in honour did not understand; * he is compared to senseless beasts, and is become like to them.

verses.la: Hæc via illórum scándalum ipsis: * et póstea in ore suo complacébunt.
verses.en: This way of theirs is a stumbling block to them: * and afterwards they shall delight in their mouth.

verses.la: Et dominabúntur eórum iusti in matutíno: * et auxílium eórum veteráscet in inférno a glória eórum.
verses.en: And the just shall have dominion over them in the morning; * and their help shall decay in hell from their glory.

verses.la: Verúmtamen Deus rédimet ánimam meam de manu ínferi: * cum accéperit me.
verses.en: But God will redeem my soul from the hand of hell, * when he shall receive me.

verses.la: Ne timúeris, cum dives factus fúerit homo: * et cum multiplicáta fúerit glória domus eius.
verses.en: Be not thou afraid, when a man shall be made rich, * and when the glory of his house shall be increased.

verses.la: Quóniam cum interíerit, non sumet ómnia: * neque descéndet cum eo glória eius.
verses.en: For when he shall die he shall take nothing away; * nor shall his glory descend with him.

verses.la: Quia ánima eius in vita ipsíus benedicétur: * confitébitur tibi cum beneféceris ei.
verses.en: For in his lifetime his soul will be blessed: * and he will praise thee when thou shalt do well to him.

verses.la: Introíbit usque in progénies patrum suórum: * et usque in ætérnum non vidébit lumen.
verses.en: He shall go in to the generations of his fathers: * and he shall never see light.

verses.la: Homo, cum in honóre esset, non intelléxit: * comparátus est iuméntis insipiéntibus, et símilis factus est illis.
verses.en: Man when he was in honour did not understand: * he hath been compared to senseless beasts, and made like to them.

verses.la: A solis ortu usque ad occásum: * ex Sion spécies decóris eius.
verses.en: From the rising of the sun, to the going down thereof: * out of Sion the loveliness of his beauty.

verses.la: Ignis in conspéctu eius exardéscet: * et in circúitu eius tempéstas válida.
verses.en: A fire shall burn before him: * and a mighty tempest shall be round about.

verses.la: Advocábit cælum desúrsum: * et terram discérnere pópulum suum.
verses.en: He shall call heaven from above, * and the earth, to judge his people.

verses.la: Congregáte illi sanctos eius: * qui órdinant testaméntum eius super sacrifícia.
verses.en: Gather ye together his saints to him: * who set his covenant before sacrifices.

verses.la: Et annuntiábunt cæli iustítiam eius: * quóniam Deus iudex est.
verses.en: And the heavens shall declare his justice: * for God is judge.

verses.la: Audi, pópulus meus, et loquar: Israël, et testificábor tibi: * Deus, Deus tuus ego sum.
verses.en: Hear, O my people, and I will speak: O Israel, and I will testify to thee: * I am God, thy God.

verses.la: Non in sacrifíciis tuis árguam te: * holocáusta autem tua in conspéctu meo sunt semper.
verses.en: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices: * and thy burnt offerings are always in my sight.

verses.la: Non accípiam de domo tua vítulos: * neque de grégibus tuis hircos.
verses.en: I will not take calves out of thy house: * nor he goats out of thy flocks.

verses.la: Quóniam meæ sunt omnes feræ silvárum: * iuménta in móntibus et boves.
verses.en: For all the beasts of the woods are mine: * the cattle on the hills, and the oxen.

verses.la: Cognóvi ómnia volatília cæli: * et pulchritúdo agri mecum est.
verses.en: I know all the fowls of the air: * and with me is the beauty of the field.

verses.la: Si esuríero, non dicam tibi: * meus est enim orbis terræ, et plenitúdo eius.
verses.en: If I should be hungry, I would not tell thee: * for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.

verses.la: Numquid manducábo carnes taurórum? * aut sánguinem hircórum potábo?
verses.en: Shall I eat the flesh of bullocks? * or shall I drink the blood of goats?

verses.la: Ímmola Deo sacrifícium laudis: * et redde Altíssimo vota tua.
verses.en: Offer to God the sacrifice of praise: * and pay thy vows to the most High.

verses.la: Et ínvoca me in die tribulatiónis: * éruam te, et honorificábis me.
verses.en: And call upon me in the day of trouble: * I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.

verses.la: Peccatóri autem dixit Deus: * Quare tu enárras iustítias meas, et assúmis testaméntum meum per os tuum?
verses.en: But to the sinner God hath said: * Why dost thou declare my justices, and take my covenant in thy mouth?

verses.la: Tu vero odísti disciplínam: * et proiecísti sermónes meos retrórsum:
verses.en: Seeing thou hast hated discipline: * and hast cast my words behind thee.

verses.la: Si vidébas furem, currébas cum eo: * et cum adúlteris portiónem tuam ponébas.
verses.en: If thou didst see a thief thou didst run with him: * and with adulterers thou hast been a partaker.

verses.la: Os tuum abundávit malítia: * et lingua tua concinnábat dolos.
verses.en: Thy mouth hath abounded with evil, * and thy tongue framed deceits.

verses.la: Sedens advérsus fratrem tuum loquebáris, et advérsus fílium matris tuæ ponébas scándalum: * hæc fecísti, et tácui.
verses.en: Sitting thou didst speak against thy brother, and didst lay a scandal against thy mother’s son: * these things hast thou done, and I was silent.

verses.la: Existimásti, iníque, quod ero tui símilis: * árguam te, et státuam contra fáciem tuam.
verses.en: Thou thoughtest unjustly that I should be like to thee: * but I will reprove thee, and set before thy face.

verses.la: Intellégite hæc, qui obliviscímini Deum: * nequándo rápiat, et non sit qui erípiat.
verses.en: Understand these things, you that forget God; * lest he snatch you away, and there be none to deliver you.

verses.la: Sacrifícium laudis honorificábit me: * et illic iter, quo osténdam illi salutáre Dei.
verses.en: The sacrifice of praise shall glorify me: * and there is the way by which I will shew him the salvation of God.

verses.la: Et secúndum multitúdinem miseratiónum tuárum, * dele iniquitátem meam.
verses.en: And according to the multitude of thy tender mercies * blot out my iniquity.

verses.la: Ámplius lava me ab iniquitáte mea: * et a peccáto meo munda me.
verses.en: Wash me yet more from my iniquity, * and cleanse me from my sin.

verses.la: Quóniam iniquitátem meam ego cognósco: * et peccátum meum contra me est semper.
verses.en: For I know my iniquity, * and my sin is always before me.

verses.la: Tibi soli peccávi, et malum coram te feci: * ut iustificéris in sermónibus tuis, et vincas cum iudicáris.
verses.en: To thee only have I sinned, and have done evil before thee: * that thou mayst be justified in thy words, and mayst overcome when thou art judged.

verses.la: Ecce enim, in iniquitátibus concéptus sum: * et in peccátis concépit me mater mea.
verses.en: For behold I was conceived in iniquities; * and in sins did my mother conceive me.

verses.la: Ecce enim, veritátem dilexísti: * incérta et occúlta sapiéntiæ tuæ manifestásti mihi.
verses.en: For behold thou hast loved truth: * the uncertain and hidden things of thy wisdom thou hast made manifest to me.

verses.la: Aspérges me hyssópo, et mundábor: * lavábis me, et super nivem dealbábor.
verses.en: Thou shalt sprinkle me with hyssop, and I shall be cleansed: * thou shalt wash me, and I shall be made whiter than snow.

verses.la: Audítui meo dabis gáudium et lætítiam: * et exsultábunt ossa humiliáta.
verses.en: To my hearing thou shalt give joy and gladness: * and the bones that have been humbled shall rejoice.

verses.la: Avérte fáciem tuam a peccátis meis: * et omnes iniquitátes meas dele.
verses.en: Turn away thy face from my sins, * and blot out all my iniquities.

verses.la: Cor mundum crea in me, Deus: * et spíritum rectum ínnova in viscéribus meis.
verses.en: Create a clean heart in me, O God: * and renew a right spirit within my bowels.

verses.la: Ne proícias me a fácie tua: * et spíritum sanctum tuum ne áuferas a me.
verses.en: Cast me not away from thy face; * and take not thy holy spirit from me.

verses.la: Redde mihi lætítiam salutáris tui: * et spíritu principáli confírma me.
verses.en: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation, * and strengthen me with a perfect spirit.

verses.la: Docébo iníquos vias tuas: * et ímpii ad te converténtur.
verses.en: I will teach the unjust thy ways: * and the wicked shall be converted to thee.

verses.la: Líbera me de sanguínibus, Deus, Deus salútis meæ: * et exsultábit lingua mea iustítiam tuam.
verses.en: Deliver me from blood, O God, thou God of my salvation: * and my tongue shall extol thy justice.

verses.la: Dómine, lábia mea apéries: * et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.
verses.en: O Lord, thou wilt open my lips: * and my mouth shall declare thy praise.

verses.la: Quóniam si voluísses sacrifícium, dedíssem útique: * holocáustis non delectáberis.
verses.en: For if thou hadst desired sacrifice, I would indeed have given it: * with burnt offerings thou wilt not be delighted.

verses.la: Sacrifícium Deo spíritus contribulátus: * cor contrítum, et humiliátum, Deus, non despícies.
verses.en: A sacrifice to God is an afflicted spirit: * a contrite and humbled heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

verses.la: Benígne fac, Dómine, in bona voluntáte tua Sion: * ut ædificéntur muri Ierúsalem.
verses.en: Deal favourably, O Lord, in thy good will with Sion; * that the walls of Jerusalem may be built up.

verses.la: Tunc acceptábis sacrifícium iustítiæ, oblatiónes, et holocáusta: * tunc impónent super altáre tuum vítulos.
verses.en: Then shalt thou accept the sacrifice of justice, oblations and whole burnt offerings: * then shall they lay calves upon thy altar.

verses.la: Deus, in nómine tuo salvum me fac: * et in virtúte tua iúdica me.
verses.en: Save me, O God, by thy name, * and judge me in thy strength.

verses.la: Deus, exáudi oratiónem meam: * áuribus pércipe verba oris mei.
verses.en: O God, hear my prayer: * give ear to the words of my mouth.

verses.la: Quóniam aliéni insurrexérunt advérsum me, et fortes quæsiérunt ánimam meam: * et non proposuérunt Deum ante conspéctum suum.
verses.en: For strangers have risen up against me; and the mighty have sought after my soul: * and they have not set God before their eyes.

verses.la: Ecce enim, Deus ádiuvat me: * et Dóminus suscéptor est ánimæ meæ.
verses.en: For behold God is my helper: * and the Lord is the protector of my soul.

verses.la: Avérte mala inimícis meis: * et in veritáte tua dispérde illos.
verses.en: Turn back the evils upon my enemies; * and cut them off in thy truth.

verses.la: Voluntárie sacrificábo tibi, * et confitébor nómini tuo, Dómine: quóniam bonum est:
verses.en: I will freely sacrifice to thee, * and will give praise, O God, to thy name: because it is good:

verses.la: Quóniam ex omni tribulatióne eripuísti me: * et super inimícos meos despéxit óculus meus.
verses.en: For thou hast delivered me out of all trouble: * and my eye hath looked down upon my enemies.

verses.la: Miserére mei, Deus, quóniam conculcávit me homo: * tota die impúgnans tribulávit me.
verses.en: Have mercy on me, O God, for man hath trodden me under foot; * all the day long he hath afflicted me fighting against me.

verses.la: Conculcavérunt me inimíci mei tota die: * quóniam multi bellántes advérsum me.
verses.en: My enemies have trodden on me all the day long; * for they are many that make war against me.

verses.la: Ab altitúdine diéi timébo: * ego vero in te sperábo.
verses.en: From the height of the day I shall fear: * but I will trust in thee.

verses.la: In Deo laudábo sermónes meos, in Deo sperávi: * non timébo quid fáciat mihi caro.
verses.en: In God I will praise my words, in God I have put my trust: * I will not fear what flesh can do against me.

verses.la: Tota die verba mea exsecrabántur: * advérsum me omnes cogitatiónes eórum in malum.
verses.en: All the day long they detested my words: * all their thoughts were against me unto evil.

verses.la: Inhabitábunt et abscóndent: * ipsi calcáneum meum observábunt.
verses.en: They will dwell and hide themselves: * they will watch my heel.

verses.la: Sicut sustinuérunt ánimam meam, pro níhilo salvos fácies illos: * in ira pópulos confrínges.
verses.en: As they have waited for my soul, for nothing shalt thou save them: * in thy anger thou shalt break the people in pieces.

verses.la: Sicut et in promissióne tua: * tunc converténtur inimíci mei retrórsum:
verses.en: As also in thy promise. * Then shall my enemies be turned back.

verses.la: In quacúmque die invocávero te: * ecce, cognóvi, quóniam Deus meus es.
verses.en: In what day soever I shall call upon thee, * behold I know thou art my God.

verses.la: In Deo laudábo verbum, in Dómino laudábo sermónem: * in Deo sperávi, non timébo quid fáciat mihi homo.
verses.en: In God will I praise the word, in the Lord will I praise his speech. * In God have I hoped, I will not fear what man can do to me.

verses.la: In me sunt, Deus, vota tua, * quæ reddam, laudatiónes tibi.
verses.en: In me, O God, are vows to thee, * which I will pay, praises to thee:

verses.la: Quóniam eripuísti ánimam meam de morte, et pedes meos de lapsu: * ut pláceam coram Deo in lúmine vivéntium.
verses.en: Because thou hast delivered my soul from death, my feet from falling: * that I may please in the sight of God, in the light of the living.

verses.la: Éripe me de inimícis meis, Deus meus: * et ab insurgéntibus in me líbera me.
verses.en: Deliver me from my enemies, O my God; * and defend me from them that rise up against me.

verses.la: Éripe me de operántibus iniquitátem: * et de viris sánguinum salva me.
verses.en: Deliver me from them that work iniquity, * and save me from bloody men.

verses.la: Quia ecce cepérunt ánimam meam: * irruérunt in me fortes.
verses.en: For behold they have caught my soul: * the mighty have rushed in upon me:

verses.la: Neque iníquitas mea, neque peccátum meum, Dómine: * sine iniquitáte cucúrri, et diréxi.
verses.en: Neither is it my iniquity, nor my sin, O Lord: * without iniquity have I run, and directed my steps.

verses.la: Inténde ad visitándas omnes gentes: * non misereáris ómnibus, qui operántur iniquitátem.
verses.en: Attend to visit all the nations: * have no mercy on all them that work iniquity.

verses.la: Converténtur ad vésperam: et famem patiéntur ut canes, * et circuíbunt civitátem.
verses.en: They shall return at evening, and shall suffer hunger like dogs: * and shall go round about the city.

verses.la: Ecce, loquéntur in ore suo, et gládius in lábiis eórum: * quóniam quis audívit?
verses.en: Behold they shall speak with their mouth, and a sword is in their lips: * for who, say they, hath heard us?

verses.la: Et tu, Dómine, deridébis eos: * ad níhilum dedúces omnes gentes.
verses.en: But thou, O Lord, shalt laugh at them: * thou shalt bring all the nations to nothing.

verses.la: Fortitúdinem meam ad te custódiam, quia, Deus, suscéptor meus es: * Deus meus, misericórdia eius prævéniet me.
verses.en: I will keep my strength to thee: for thou art my protector: * my God, his mercy shall prevent me.

verses.la: Dispérge illos in virtúte tua: * et depóne eos, protéctor meus, Dómine:
verses.en: And scatter them by thy power; * and bring them down, O Lord, my protector:

verses.la: Et de exsecratióne et mendácio annuntiabúntur in consummatióne: * in ira consummatiónis, et non erunt.
verses.en: And for their cursing and lying they shall be talked of, when they are consumed: * when they are consumed by thy wrath, and they shall be no more.

verses.la: Et scient quia Deus dominábitur Iacob: * et fínium terræ.
verses.en: And they shall know that God will rule Jacob, * and all the ends of the earth.

verses.la: Converténtur ad vésperam: et famem patiéntur ut canes, * et circuíbunt civitátem.
verses.en: They shall return at evening and shall suffer hunger like dogs: * and shall go round about the city.

verses.la: Ipsi dispergéntur ad manducándum: * si vero non fúerint saturáti, et murmurábunt.
verses.en: They shall be scattered abroad to eat, * and shall murmur if they be not filled.

verses.la: Quia factus es suscéptor meus, * et refúgium meum, in die tribulatiónis meæ.
verses.en: For thou art become my support, * and my refuge, in the day of my trouble.

verses.la: Adiútor meus, tibi psallam, quia, Deus, suscéptor meus es: * Deus meus, misericórdia mea.
verses.en: Unto thee, O my helper, will I sing, for thou art God my defence: * my God my mercy.

verses.la: Exáudi, Deus, deprecatiónem meam: * inténde oratióni meæ.
verses.en: Hear, O God, my supplication: * be attentive to my prayer.

verses.la: A fínibus terræ ad te clamávi: * dum anxiarétur cor meum, in petra exaltásti me.
verses.en: To thee have I cried from the ends of the earth: * when my heart was in anguish, thou hast exalted me on a rock.

verses.la: Deduxísti me, quia factus es spes mea: * turris fortitúdinis a fácie inimíci.
verses.en: Thou hast conducted me; for thou hast been my hope: * a tower of strength against the face of the enemy.

verses.la: Inhabitábo in tabernáculo tuo in sǽcula: * prótegar in velaménto alárum tuárum.
verses.en: In thy tabernacle I shall dwell for ever: * I shall be protected under the covert of thy wings.

verses.la: Quóniam tu, Deus meus, exaudísti oratiónem meam: * dedísti hereditátem timéntibus nomen tuum.
verses.en: For thou, my God, hast heard my prayer: * thou hast given an inheritance to them that fear thy name.

verses.la: Dies super dies regis adícies: * annos eius usque in diem generatiónis et generatiónis.
verses.en: Thou wilt add days to the days of the king: * his years even to generation and generation.

verses.la: Pérmanet in ætérnum in conspéctu Dei: * misericórdiam et veritátem eius quis requíret?
verses.en: He abideth for ever in the sight of God: * his mercy and truth who shall search?

verses.la: Sic psalmum dicam nómini tuo in sǽculum sǽculi: * ut reddam vota mea de die in diem.
verses.en: So will I sing a psalm to thy name for ever and ever: * that I may pay my vows from day to day.

verses.la: Nonne Deo subiécta erit ánima mea? * ab ipso enim salutáre meum.
verses.en: Shall not my soul be subject to God? * for from him is my salvation.

verses.la: Nam et ipse Deus meus, et salutáris meus: * suscéptor meus, non movébor ámplius.
verses.en: For he is my God and my saviour: * he is my protector, I shall be moved no more.

verses.la: Quoúsque irrúitis in hóminem? * interfícitis univérsi vos: tamquam paríeti inclináto et macériæ depúlsæ?
verses.en: How long do you rush in upon a man? * you all kill, as if you were thrusting down a leaning wall, and a tottering fence.

verses.la: Verúmtamen prétium meum cogitavérunt repéllere, cucúrri in siti: * ore suo benedicébant, et corde suo maledicébant.
verses.en: But they have thought to cast away my price; I ran in thirst: * they blessed with their mouth, but cursed with their heart.

verses.la: Verúmtamen Deo subiécta esto, ánima mea: * quóniam ab ipso patiéntia mea.
verses.en: But be thou, O my soul, subject to God: * for from him is my patience.

verses.la: Quia ipse Deus meus, et salvátor meus: * adiútor meus, non emigrábo.
verses.en: For he is my God and my saviour: * he is my helper, I shall not be moved.

verses.la: In Deo salutáre meum, et glória mea: * Deus auxílii mei, et spes mea in Deo est.
verses.en: In God is my salvation and my glory: * he is the God of my help, and my hope is in God.

verses.la: Speráte in eo omnis congregátio pópuli, effúndite coram illo corda vestra: * Deus adiútor noster in ætérnum.
verses.en: Trust in him, all ye congregation of people: pour out your hearts before him. * God is our helper for ever.

verses.la: Verúmtamen vani fílii hóminum, mendáces fílii hóminum in statéris: * ut decípiant ipsi de vanitáte in idípsum.
verses.en: But vain are the sons of men, the sons of men are liars in the balances: * that by vanity they may together deceive.

verses.la: Nolíte speráre in iniquitáte, et rapínas nolíte concupíscere: * divítiæ si áffluant, nolíte cor appónere.
verses.en: Trust not in iniquity, and cover not robberies: * if riches abound, set not your heart upon them.

verses.la: Semel locútus est Deus, duo hæc audívi, quia potéstas Dei est, et tibi, Dómine, misericórdia: * quia tu reddes unicuíque iuxta ópera sua.
verses.en: God hath spoken once, these two things have I heard, that power belongeth to God, and mercy to thee, O Lord; * for thou wilt render to every man according to his works.

verses.la: Sitívit in te ánima mea, * quam multiplíciter tibi caro mea.
verses.en: For thee my soul hath thirsted; * for thee my flesh, O how many ways!

verses.la: In terra desérta, et ínvia, et inaquósa: * sic in sancto appárui tibi, ut vidérem virtútem tuam, et glóriam tuam.
verses.en: In a desert land, and where there is no way, and no water: * so in the sanctuary have I come before thee, to see thy power and thy glory.

verses.la: Quóniam mélior est misericórdia tua super vitas: * lábia mea laudábunt te.
verses.en: For thy mercy is better than lives: * thee my lips shall praise.

verses.la: Sic benedícam te in vita mea: * et in nómine tuo levábo manus meas.
verses.en: Thus will I bless thee all my life long: * and in thy name I will lift up my hands.

verses.la: Sicut ádipe et pinguédine repleátur ánima mea: * et lábiis exsultatiónis laudábit os meum.
verses.en: Let my soul be filled as with marrow and fatness: * and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips.

verses.la: Si memor fui tui super stratum meum, in matutínis meditábor in te: * quia fuísti adiútor meus.
verses.en: If I have remembered thee upon my bed, I will meditate on thee in the morning: * because thou hast been my helper.

verses.la: Et in velaménto alárum tuárum exsultábo, adhǽsit ánima mea post te: * me suscépit déxtera tua.
verses.en: And I will rejoice under the covert of thy wings: my soul hath stuck close to thee: * thy right hand hath received me.

verses.la: Ipsi vero in vanum quæsiérunt ánimam meam, introíbunt in inferióra terræ: * tradéntur in manus gládii, partes vúlpium erunt.
verses.en: But they have sought my soul in vain, they shall go into the lower parts of the earth: * they shall be delivered into the hands of the sword, they shall be the portions of foxes.

verses.la: Rex vero lætábitur in Deo, laudabúntur omnes qui iurant in eo: * quia obstrúctum est os loquéntium iníqua.
verses.en: But the king shall rejoice in God, all they shall be praised that swear by him: * because the mouth is stopped of them that speak wicked things.

verses.la: Exáudi, Deus, oratiónem meam cum déprecor: * a timóre inimíci éripe ánimam meam.
verses.en: Hear, O God, my prayer, when I make supplication to thee: * deliver my soul from the fear of the enemy.

verses.la: Protexísti me a convéntu malignántium: * a multitúdine operántium iniquitátem.
verses.en: Thou hast protected me from the assembly of the malignant; * from the multitude of the workers of iniquity.

verses.la: Quia exacuérunt ut gládium linguas suas: * intendérunt arcum rem amáram, ut sagíttent in occúltis immaculátum.
verses.en: For they have whetted their tongues like a sword; * they have bent their bow a bitter thing, to shoot in secret the undefiled.

verses.la: Narravérunt ut abscónderent láqueos: * dixérunt: Quis vidébit eos?
verses.en: They have talked of hiding snares; * they have said: Who shall see them?

verses.la: Accédet homo ad cor altum: * et exaltábitur Deus.
verses.en: Man shall come to a deep heart: * and God shall be exalted.

verses.la: Sagíttæ parvulórum factæ sunt plagæ eórum: * et infirmátæ sunt contra eos linguæ eórum.
verses.en: The arrows of children are their wounds: * and their tongues against them are made weak.

verses.la: Conturbáti sunt omnes qui vidébant eos: * et tímuit omnis homo.
verses.en: All that saw them were troubled; * and every man was afraid.

verses.la: Et annuntiavérunt ópera Dei, * et facta eius intellexérunt.
verses.en: And they declared the works of God: * and understood his doings.

verses.la: Lætábitur iustus in Dómino, et sperábit in eo, * et laudabúntur omnes recti corde.
verses.en: The just shall rejoice in the Lord, and shall hope in him: * and all the upright in heart shall be praised.

verses.la: Te decet hymnus, Deus, in Sion: * et tibi reddétur votum in Ierúsalem.
verses.en: A hymn, O God, becometh thee in Sion: * and a vow shall be paid to thee in Jerusalem.

verses.la: Exáudi oratiónem meam: * ad te omnis caro véniet.
verses.en: O hear my prayer: * all flesh shall come to thee.

verses.la: Verba iniquórum prævaluérunt super nos: * et impietátibus nostris tu propitiáberis.
verses.en: The words of the wicked have prevailed over us: * and thou wilt pardon our transgressions.

verses.la: Replébimur in bonis domus tuæ: * sanctum est templum tuum, mirábile in æquitáte.
verses.en: We shall be filled with the good things of thy house; holy is thy temple, * wonderful in justice.

verses.la: Exáudi nos, Deus, salutáris noster, * spes ómnium fínium terræ, et in mari longe.
verses.en: Hear us, O God our saviour, * who art the hope of all the ends of the earth, and in the sea afar off.

verses.la: Prǽparans montes in virtúte tua, accínctus poténtia: * qui contúrbas profúndum maris sonum flúctuum eius.
verses.en: Thou who preparest the mountains by thy strength, being girded with power: * who troublest the depth of the sea, the noise of its waves.

verses.la: Turbabúntur gentes, et timébunt qui hábitant términos a signis tuis: * éxitus matutíni, et véspere delectábis.
verses.en: The Gentiles shall be troubled, and they that dwell in the uttermost borders shall be afraid at thy signs: * thou shalt make the outgoings of the morning and of the evening to be joyful.

verses.la: Flumen Dei replétum est aquis, parásti cibum illórum: * quóniam ita est præparátio eius.
verses.en: The river of God is filled with water, thou hast prepared their food; * for so is its preparation.

verses.la: Rivos eius inébria, multíplica genímina eius: * in stillicídiis eius lætábitur gérminans.
verses.en: Fill up plentifully the streams thereof, multiply its fruits; * it shall spring up and rejoice in its showers.

verses.la: Benedíces corónæ anni benignitátis tuæ: * et campi tui replebúntur ubertáte.
verses.en: Thou shalt bless the crown of the year of thy goodness: * and thy fields shall be filled with plenty.

verses.la: Pinguéscent speciósa desérti: * et exsultatióne colles accingéntur.
verses.en: The beautiful places of the wilderness shall grow fat: * and the hills shall be girded about with joy.

verses.la: Indúti sunt aríetes óvium, et valles abundábunt fruménto: * clamábunt, étenim hymnum dicent.
verses.en: The rams of the flock are clothed, and the vales shall abound with corn: * they shall shout, yea they shall sing a hymn.

verses.la: Iubiláte Deo, omnis terra, psalmum dícite nómini eius: * date glóriam laudi eius.
verses.en: Shout with joy to God, all the earth, sing ye a psalm to his name; * give glory to his praise.

verses.la: Dícite Deo: Quam terribília sunt ópera tua, Dómine! * in multitúdine virtútis tuæ mentiéntur tibi inimíci tui.
verses.en: Say unto God, How terrible are thy works, O Lord! * in the multitude of thy strength thy enemies shall lie to thee.

verses.la: Omnis terra adóret te, et psallat tibi: * psalmum dicat nómini tuo.
verses.en: Let all the earth adore thee, * and sing to thee: let it sing a psalm to thy name.

verses.la: Veníte, et vidéte ópera Dei: * terríbilis in consíliis super fílios hóminum.
verses.en: Come and see the works of God; * who is terrible in his counsels over the sons of men.

verses.la: Qui convértit mare in áridam, in flúmine pertransíbunt pede: * ibi lætábimur in ipso.
verses.en: Who turneth the sea into dry land, in the river they shall pass on foot: * there shall we rejoice in him.

verses.la: Qui dominátur in virtúte sua in ætérnum, óculi eius super gentes respíciunt: * qui exásperant non exalténtur in semetípsis.
verses.en: Who by his power ruleth for ever: his eyes behold the nations; * let not them that provoke him be exalted in themselves.

verses.la: Benedícite, gentes, Deum nostrum: * et audítam fácite vocem laudis eius,
verses.en: O bless our God, ye Gentiles: * and make the voice of his praise to be heard.

verses.la: Qui pósuit ánimam meam ad vitam: * et non dedit in commotiónem pedes meos.
verses.en: Who hath set my soul to live: * and hath not suffered my feet to be moved:

verses.la: Quóniam probásti nos, Deus: * igne nos examinásti, sicut examinátur argéntum.
verses.en: For thou, O God, hast proved us: * thou hast tried us by fire, as silver is tried.

verses.la: Induxísti nos in láqueum, posuísti tribulatiónes in dorso nostro: * imposuísti hómines super cápita nostra.
verses.en: Thou hast brought us into a net, thou hast laid afflictions on our back: * thou hast set men over our heads.

verses.la: Transívimus per ignem et aquam: * et eduxísti nos in refrigérium.
verses.en: We have passed through fire and water, * and thou hast brought us out into a refreshment.

verses.la: Introíbo in domum tuam in holocáustis: * reddam tibi vota mea, quæ distinxérunt lábia mea.
verses.en: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: * I will pay thee my vows, which my lips have uttered,

verses.la: Et locútum est os meum, * in tribulatióne mea.
verses.en: And my mouth hath spoken, * when I was in trouble.

verses.la: Holocáusta medulláta ófferam tibi cum incénso aríetum: * ófferam tibi boves cum hircis.
verses.en: I will offer up to thee holocausts full of marrow, with burnt offerings of rams: * I will offer to thee bullocks with goats.

verses.la: Veníte, audíte, et narrábo, omnes, qui timétis Deum: * quanta fecit ánimæ meæ.
verses.en: Come and hear, all ye that fear God, * and I will tell you what great things he hath done for my soul.

verses.la: Ad ipsum ore meo clamávi, * et exaltávi sub lingua mea.
verses.en: I cried to him with my mouth: * and I extolled him with my tongue.

verses.la: Iniquitátem si aspéxi in corde meo, * non exáudiet Dóminus.
verses.en: If I have looked at iniquity in my heart, * the Lord will not hear me.

verses.la: Proptérea exaudívit Deus, * et atténdit voci deprecatiónis meæ.
verses.en: Therefore hath God heard me, * and hath attended to the voice of my supplication.

verses.la: Benedíctus Deus, * qui non amóvit oratiónem meam, et misericórdiam suam a me.
verses.en: Blessed be God, * who hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.

verses.la: Deus misereátur nostri, et benedícat nobis: * illúminet vultum suum super nos, et misereátur nostri.
verses.en: May God have mercy on us, and bless us: * may he cause the light of his countenance to shine upon us, and may he have mercy on us.

verses.la: Ut cognoscámus in terra viam tuam, * in ómnibus géntibus salutáre tuum.
verses.en: That we may know thy way upon earth: * thy salvation in all nations.

verses.la: Confiteántur tibi pópuli, Deus: * confiteántur tibi pópuli omnes.
verses.en: Let people confess to thee, O God: * let all people give praise to thee.

verses.la: Læténtur et exsúltent gentes: * quóniam iúdicas pópulos in æquitáte, et gentes in terra dírigis.
verses.en: Let the nations be glad and rejoice: * for thou judgest the people with justice, and directest the nations upon earth.

verses.la: Confiteántur tibi pópuli, Deus, confiteántur tibi pópuli omnes: * terra dedit fructum suum.
verses.en: Let the people, O God, confess to thee: * let all the people give praise to thee: the earth hath yielded her fruit.

verses.la: Benedícat nos Deus, Deus noster, benedícat nos Deus: * et métuant eum omnes fines terræ.
verses.en: May God, our God bless us, may God bless us: * and all the ends of the earth fear him.

verses.la: Exsúrgat Deus, et dissipéntur inimíci eius, * ‡ et fúgiant qui odérunt eum, a fácie eius.
verses.en: Let God arise, and let his enemies be scattered: * ‡ and let them that hate him flee from before his face.

verses.la: Sicut déficit fumus, defíciant: * sicut fluit cera a fácie ignis, sic péreant peccatóres a fácie Dei.
verses.en: As smoke vanisheth, so let them vanish away: * as wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

verses.la: Et iusti epuléntur, et exsúltent in conspéctu Dei: * et delecténtur in lætítia.
verses.en: And let the just feast, and rejoice before God: * and be delighted with gladness.

verses.la: Exsultáte in conspéctu eius: * turbabúntur a fácie eius, patris orphanórum et iúdicis viduárum.
verses.en: Rejoice ye before him: * but the wicked shall be troubled at his presence, who is the father of orphans, and the judge of widows.

verses.la: Deus in loco sancto suo: * Deus, qui inhabitáre facit uníus moris in domo:
verses.en: God in his holy place: * God who maketh men of one manner to dwell in a house:

verses.la: Qui edúcit vinctos in fortitúdine, * simíliter eos qui exásperant, qui hábitant in sepúlcris.
verses.en: Who bringeth out them that were bound in strength; * in like manner them that provoke, that dwell in sepulchres.

verses.la: Deus, cum egrederéris in conspéctu pópuli tui, * cum pertransíres in desérto:
verses.en: O God, when thou didst go forth in the sight of thy people, * when thou didst pass through the desert:

verses.la: Terra mota est, étenim cæli distillavérunt a fácie Dei Sínai, * a fácie Dei Israël.
verses.en: The earth was moved, and the heavens dropped at the presence of the God of Sinai, * at the presence of the God of Israel.

verses.la: Plúviam voluntáriam segregábis, Deus, hereditáti tuæ: * et infirmáta est, tu vero perfecísti eam.
verses.en: Thou shalt set aside for thy inheritance a free rain, * O God: and it was weakened, but thou hast made it perfect.

verses.la: Animália tua habitábunt in ea: * parásti in dulcédine tua páuperi, Deus.
verses.en: In it shall thy animals dwell; * in thy sweetness, O God, thou hast provided for the poor.

verses.la: Dóminus dabit verbum evangelizántibus, * virtúte multa.
verses.en: The Lord shall give the word to them that preach good tidings, * with great power.

verses.la: Rex virtútum dilécti, dilécti: * et speciéi domus divídere spólia.
verses.en: The king of powers is of the beloved, * of the beloved; and the beauty of the house shall divide spoils.

verses.la: Si dormiátis inter médios cleros, pennæ colúmbæ deargentátæ, * et posterióra dorsi eius in pallóre auri.
verses.en: If you sleep among the midst of lots, you shall be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, * and the hinder parts of her back with the paleness of gold.

verses.la: Dum discérnit cæléstis reges super eam, nive dealbabúntur in Selmon: * mons Dei, mons pinguis.
verses.en: When he that is in heaven appointeth kings over her, they shall be whited with snow in Selmon. * The mountain of God is a fat mountain,

verses.la: Mons coagulátus, mons pinguis: * ut quid suspicámini montes coagulátos?
verses.en: a curdled mountain, a fat mountain; * Why suspect, ye curdled mountains?

verses.la: Mons, in quo beneplácitum est Deo habitáre in eo: * étenim Dóminus habitábit in finem.
verses.en: A mountain in which God is well pleased to dwell: * for there the Lord shall dwell unto the end.

verses.la: Currus Dei decem míllibus múltiplex, míllia lætántium: * Dóminus in eis in Sina in sancto.
verses.en: The chariot of God is attended by ten thousands; thousands of them that rejoice: * the Lord is among them in Sinai, in the holy place.

verses.la: Étenim non credéntes, * inhabitáre Dóminum Deum.
verses.en: Yea for those also that do not believe, * the dwelling of the Lord God.

verses.la: Benedíctus Dóminus die cotídie: * prósperum iter fáciet nobis Deus salutárium nostrórum.
verses.en: Blessed be the Lord day by day: * the God of our salvation will make our journey prosperous to us.

verses.la: Deus noster, Deus salvos faciéndi: * et Dómini Dómini éxitus mortis.
verses.en: Our God is the God of salvation: * and of the Lord, of the Lord are the issues from death.

verses.la: Verúmtamen Deus confrínget cápita inimicórum suórum: * vérticem capílli perambulántium in delíctis suis.
verses.en: But God shall break the heads of his enemies: * the hairy crown of them that walk on in their sins.

verses.la: Dixit Dóminus: Ex Basan convértam, * convértam in profúndum maris:
verses.en: The Lord said: I will turn them from Basan, * I will turn them into the depth of the sea:

verses.la: Ut intingátur pes tuus in sánguine: * lingua canum tuórum ex inimícis, ab ipso.
verses.en: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of thy enemies; * the tongue of thy dogs be red with the same.

verses.la: Vidérunt ingréssus tuos, Deus: * ingréssus Dei mei: regis mei qui est in sancto.
verses.en: They have seen thy goings, O God, * the goings of my God: of my king who is in his sanctuary.

verses.la: Prævenérunt príncipes coniúncti psalléntibus: * in médio iuvenculárum tympanistriárum.
verses.en: Princes went before joined with singers, * in the midst of young damsels playing on timbrels.

verses.la: In ecclésiis benedícite Deo Dómino, * de fóntibus Israël.
verses.en: In the churches bless ye God the Lord, * from the fountains of Israel.
