verses.la: Príncipes Iuda, duces eórum: * príncipes Zábulon, príncipes Néphtali.
verses.en: The princes of Juda are their leaders: * the princes of Zabulon, the princes of Nephthali.

verses.la: Manda, Deus, virtúti tuæ: * confírma hoc, Deus, quod operátus es in nobis.
verses.en: Command thy strength, O God: * confirm, O God, what thou hast wrought in us.

verses.la: A templo tuo in Ierúsalem, * tibi ófferent reges múnera.
verses.en: From thy temple in Jerusalem, * kings shall offer presents to thee.

verses.la: Díssipa gentes, quæ bella volunt: vénient legáti ex Ægýpto: * Æthiópia prævéniet manus eius Deo.
verses.en: Scatter thou the nations that delight in wars: ambassadors shall come out of Egypt: * Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands to God.

verses.la: Psállite Deo, qui ascéndit super cælum cæli, * ad Oriéntem.
verses.en: Sing ye to God, who mounteth above the heaven of heavens, * to the east.

verses.la: Ecce dabit voci suæ vocem virtútis, date glóriam Deo super Israël, * magnificéntia eius, et virtus eius in núbibus.
verses.en: Behold he will give to his voice the voice of power: give ye glory to God for Israel, * his magnificence, and his power is in the clouds.

verses.la: Mirábilis Deus in sanctis suis, Deus Israël ipse dabit virtútem, et fortitúdinem plebi suæ, * benedíctus Deus.
verses.en: God is wonderful in his saints: the God of Israel is he who will give power and strength to his people; * blessed be God.

verses.la: Salvum me fac, Deus: * quóniam intravérunt aquæ usque ad ánimam meam.
verses.en: Save me, O God: * for the waters are come in even unto my soul.

verses.la: Veni in altitúdinem maris: * et tempéstas demérsit me.
verses.en: I am come into the depth of the sea: * and a tempest hath overwhelmed me.

verses.la: Laborávi clamans, raucæ factæ sunt fauces meæ: * defecérunt óculi mei, dum spero in Deum meum.
verses.en: I have laboured with crying; my jaws are become hoarse: * my eyes have failed, whilst I hope in my God.

verses.la: Confortáti sunt qui persecúti sunt me inimíci mei iniúste: * quæ non rápui, tunc exsolvébam.
verses.en: My enemies are grown strong who have wrongfully persecuted me: * then did I pay that which I took not away.

verses.la: Deus, tu scis insipiéntiam meam: * et delícta mea a te non sunt abscóndita.
verses.en: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; * and my offences are not hidden from thee.

verses.la: Non confundántur super me * qui quærunt te, Deus Israël.
verses.en: Let them not be confounded on my account, * who seek thee, O God of Israel.

verses.la: Quóniam propter te sustínui oppróbrium: * opéruit confúsio fáciem meam.
verses.en: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; * shame hath covered my face.

verses.la: Extráneus factus sum frátribus meis, * et peregrínus fíliis matris meæ.
verses.en: I am become a stranger to my brethren, * and an alien to the sons of my mother.

verses.la: Quóniam zelus domus tuæ comédit me: * et oppróbria exprobrántium tibi cecidérunt super me.
verses.en: For the zeal of thy house hath eaten me up: * and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.

verses.la: Et opérui in ieiúnio ánimam meam: * et factum est in oppróbrium mihi.
verses.en: And I covered my soul in fasting: * and it was made a reproach to me.

verses.la: Et pósui vestiméntum meum cilícium: * et factus sum illis in parábolam.
verses.en: And I made haircloth my garment: * and I became a byword to them.

verses.la: Ego vero oratiónem meam ad te, Dómine: * tempus benepláciti, Deus.
verses.en: But as for me, my prayer is to thee, O Lord; * for the time of thy good pleasure, O God.

verses.la: In multitúdine misericórdiæ tuæ exáudi me, * in veritáte salútis tuæ:
verses.en: In the multitude of thy mercy hear me, * in the truth of thy salvation.

verses.la: Éripe me de luto, ut non infígar: * líbera me ab iis, qui odérunt me, et de profúndis aquárum.
verses.en: Draw me out of the mire, that I may not stick fast: * deliver me from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.

verses.la: Non me demérgat tempéstas aquæ, neque absórbeat me profúndum: * neque úrgeat super me púteus os suum.
verses.en: Let not the tempest of water drown me, nor the deep swallow me up: * and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.

verses.la: Exáudi me, Dómine, quóniam benígna est misericórdia tua: * secúndum multitúdinem miseratiónum tuárum réspice in me.
verses.en: Hear me, O Lord, for thy mercy is kind; * look upon me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.

verses.la: Et ne avértas fáciem tuam a púero tuo: * quóniam tríbulor, velóciter exáudi me.
verses.en: And turn not away thy face from thy servant: * for I am in trouble, hear me speedily.

verses.la: Inténde ánimæ meæ, et líbera eam: * propter inimícos meos éripe me.
verses.en: Attend to my soul, and deliver it: * save me because of my enemies.

verses.la: Tu scis impropérium meum, et confusiónem meam, * et reveréntiam meam.
verses.en: Thou knowest my reproach, and my confusion, * and my shame.

verses.la: Et sustínui qui simul contristarétur, et non fuit: * et qui consolarétur, et non invéni.
verses.en: And I looked for one that would grieve together with me, * but there was none: and for one that would comfort me, and I found none.

verses.la: Et dedérunt in escam meam fel: * et in siti mea potavérunt me acéto.
verses.en: And they gave me gall for my food, * and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

verses.la: Fiat mensa eórum coram ipsis in láqueum, * et in retributiónes, et in scándalum.
verses.en: Let their table become as a snare before them, * and a recompense, and a stumblingblock.

verses.la: Obscuréntur óculi eórum ne vídeant: * et dorsum eórum semper incúrva.
verses.en: Let their eyes be darkened that they see not; * and their back bend thou down always.

verses.la: Effúnde super eos iram tuam: * et furor iræ tuæ comprehéndat eos.
verses.en: Pour out thy indignation upon them: * and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.

verses.la: Fiat habitátio eórum desérta: * et in tabernáculis eórum non sit qui inhábitet.
verses.en: Let their habitation be made desolate: * and let there be none to dwell in their tabernacles.

verses.la: Quóniam quem tu percussísti, persecúti sunt: * et super dolórem vúlnerum meórum addidérunt.
verses.en: Because they have persecuted him whom thou hast smitten; * and they have added to the grief of my wounds.

verses.la: Appóne iniquitátem super iniquitátem eórum: * et non intrent in iustítiam tuam.
verses.en: Add thou iniquity upon their iniquity: * and let them not come into thy justice.

verses.la: Deleántur de libro vivéntium: * et cum iustis non scribántur.
verses.en: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living; * and with the just let them not be written.

verses.la: Ego sum pauper et dolens: * salus tua, Deus, suscépit me.
verses.en: I am poor and sorrowful: * thy salvation, O God, hath set me up.

verses.la: Laudábo nomen Dei cum cántico: * et magnificábo eum in laude:
verses.en: I will praise the name of God with a canticle: * and I will magnify him with praise.

verses.la: Et placébit Deo super vítulum novéllum: * córnua producéntem et úngulas.
verses.en: And it shall please God better than a young calf, * that bringeth forth horns and hoofs.

verses.la: Vídeant páuperes et læténtur: * quǽrite Deum, et vivet ánima vestra.
verses.en: Let the poor see and rejoice: * seek ye God, and your soul shall live.

verses.la: Quóniam exaudívit páuperes Dóminus: * et vinctos suos non despéxit.
verses.en: For the Lord hath heard the poor: * and hath not despised his prisoners.

verses.la: Laudent illum cæli et terra, * mare et ómnia reptília in eis.
verses.en: Let the heavens and the earth praise him; * the sea, and every thing that creepeth therein.

verses.la: Et inhabitábunt ibi, * et hereditáte acquírent eam.
verses.en: And they shall dwell there, * and acquire it by inheritance.

verses.la: Et semen servórum eius possidébit eam: * et qui díligunt nomen eius, habitábunt in ea.
verses.en: And the seed of his servants shall possess it; * and they that love his name shall dwell therein.

verses.la: Deus, in adiutórium meum inténde: * Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.
verses.en: O God, come to my assistance; * O Lord, make haste to help me.

verses.la: Confundántur et revereántur, * qui quærunt ánimam meam.
verses.en: Let them be confounded and ashamed * that seek my soul:

verses.la: Avertántur statim erubescéntes, * qui dicunt mihi: Euge, euge.
verses.en: Let them be presently turned away blushing for shame * that say to me: ’T is well, ’t is well.

verses.la: Exsúltent et læténtur in te omnes qui quærunt te, * et dicant semper: Magnificétur Dóminus: qui díligunt salutáre tuum.
verses.en: Let all that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee; * and let such as love thy salvation say always: The Lord be magnified.

verses.la: Adiútor meus, et liberátor meus es tu: * Dómine, ne moréris.
verses.en: Thou art my helper and my deliverer: * O Lord, make no delay.

verses.la: In te, Dómine, sperávi, non confúndar in ætérnum: * in iustítia tua líbera me, et éripe me.
verses.en: In thee, O Lord, I have hoped, let me never be put to confusion: * deliver me in thy justice, and rescue me.

verses.la: Inclína ad me aurem tuam, * et salva me.
verses.en: Incline thy ear unto me, * and save me.

verses.la: Quóniam firmaméntum meum, * et refúgium meum es tu.
verses.en: For thou art my firmament * and my refuge.

verses.la: Deus meus, éripe me de manu peccatóris, * et de manu contra legem agéntis et iníqui:
verses.en: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the sinner, * and out of the hand of the transgressor of the law and of the unjust.

verses.la: Quóniam tu es patiéntia mea, Dómine: * Dómine, spes mea a iuventúte mea.
verses.en: For thou art my patience, O Lord: * my hope, O Lord, from my youth.

verses.la: In te confirmátus sum ex útero: * de ventre matris meæ tu es protéctor meus.
verses.en: By thee have I been confirmed from the womb: * from my mother’s womb thou art my protector.

verses.la: In te cantátio mea semper: * tamquam prodígium factus sum multis: et tu adiútor fortis.
verses.en: Of thee shall I continually sing: * I am become unto many as a wonder, but thou art a strong helper.

verses.la: Repleátur os meum laude, ut cantem glóriam tuam: * tota die magnitúdinem tuam.
verses.en: Let my mouth be filled with praise, that I may sing thy glory; * thy greatness all the day long.

verses.la: Ne proícias me in témpore senectútis: * cum defécerit virtus mea, ne derelínquas me.
verses.en: Cast me not off in the time of old age: * when my strength shall fail, do not thou forsake me.

verses.la: Quia dixérunt inimíci mei mihi: * et qui custodiébant ánimam meam, consílium fecérunt in unum.
verses.en: For my enemies have spoken against me; * and they that watched my soul have consulted together,

verses.la: Dicéntes: Deus derelíquit eum, persequímini, et comprehéndite eum: * quia non est qui erípiat.
verses.en: Saying: God hath forsaken him: pursue and take him, * for there is none to deliver him.

verses.la: Deus, ne elongéris a me: * Deus meus, in auxílium meum réspice.
verses.en: O God, be not thou far from me: * O my God, make haste to my help.

verses.la: Confundántur, et defíciant detrahéntes ánimæ meæ: * operiántur confusióne, et pudóre qui quærunt mala mihi.
verses.en: Let them be confounded and come to nothing that detract my soul; * let them be covered with confusion and shame that seek my hurt.

verses.la: Ego autem semper sperábo: * et adíciam super omnem laudem tuam.
verses.en: But I will always hope; * and will add to all thy praise.

verses.la: Os meum annuntiábit iustítiam tuam: * tota die salutáre tuum.
verses.en: My mouth shall shew forth thy justice; * thy salvation all the day long.

verses.la: Quóniam non cognóvi litteratúram, introíbo in poténtias Dómini: * Dómine, memorábor iustítiæ tuæ solíus.
verses.en: Because I have not known learning, I will enter into the powers of the Lord: * O Lord, I will be mindful of thy justice alone.

verses.la: Deus, docuísti me a iuventúte mea: * et usque nunc pronuntiábo mirabília tua.
verses.en: Thou hast taught me, O God, from my youth: * and till now I will declare thy wonderful works.

verses.la: Donec annúntiem brácchium tuum * generatióni omni, quæ ventúra est:
verses.en: Until I shew forth thy arm * to all the generation that is to come:

verses.la: Poténtiam tuam, et iustítiam tuam, Deus, usque in altíssima, quæ fecísti magnália: * Deus, quis símilis tibi?
verses.en: Thy power, and thy justice, O God, even to the highest great things thou hast done: * O God, who is like to thee?

verses.la: Quantas ostendísti mihi tribulatiónes multas et malas: et convérsus vivificásti me: * et de abýssis terræ íterum reduxísti me:
verses.en: How great troubles hast thou shewn me, many and grievous: and turning thou hast brought me to life, * and hast brought me back again from the depths of the earth:

verses.la: Multiplicásti magnificéntiam tuam: * et convérsus consolátus es me.
verses.en: Thou hast multiplied thy magnificence; * and turning to me thou hast comforted me.

verses.la: Nam et ego confitébor tibi in vasis psalmi veritátem tuam: * Deus, psallam tibi in cíthara, Sanctus Israël.
verses.en: For I will also confess to thee thy truth with the instruments of psaltery: * O God, I will sing to thee with the harp,

verses.la: Exsultábunt lábia mea cum cantávero tibi: * et ánima mea, quam redemísti.
verses.en: My lips shall greatly rejoice, when I shall sing to thee; * and my soul which thou hast redeemed.

verses.la: Sed et lingua mea tota die meditábitur iustítiam tuam: * cum confúsi et revériti fúerint, qui quærunt mala mihi.
verses.en: Yea and my tongue shall meditate on thy justice all the day; * when they shall be confounded and put to shame that seek evils to me.

verses.la: Iudicáre pópulum tuum in iustítia, * et páuperes tuos in iudício.
verses.en: To judge thy people with justice, * and thy poor with judgment.

verses.la: Suscípiant montes pacem pópulo: * et colles iustítiam.
verses.en: Let the mountains receive peace for the people: * and the hills justice.

verses.la: Iudicábit páuperes pópuli, et salvos fáciet fílios páuperum: * et humiliábit calumniatórem.
verses.en: He shall judge the poor of the people, and he shall save the children of the poor: * and he shall humble the oppressor.

verses.la: Et permanébit cum sole, et ante lunam, * in generatióne et generatiónem.
verses.en: And he shall continue with the sun, and before the moon, * throughout all generations.

verses.la: Descéndet sicut plúvia in vellus: * et sicut stillicídia stillántia super terram.
verses.en: He shall come down like rain upon the fleece; * and as showers falling gently upon the earth.

verses.la: Oriétur in diébus eius iustítia, et abundántia pacis: * donec auferátur luna.
verses.en: In his days shall justice spring up, and abundance of peace, * till the moon be taken away.

verses.la: Et dominábitur a mari usque ad mare: * et a flúmine usque ad términos orbis terrárum.
verses.en: And he shall rule from sea to sea, * and from the river unto the ends of the earth.

verses.la: Coram illo prócident Æthíopes: * et inimíci eius terram lingent.
verses.en: Before him the Ethiopians shall fall down: * and his enemies shall lick the ground.

verses.la: Reges Tharsis, et ínsulæ múnera ófferent: * reges Árabum et Saba dona addúcent.
verses.en: The kings of Tharsis and the islands shall offer presents: * the kings of the Arabians and of Saba shall bring gifts:

verses.la: Et adorábunt eum omnes reges terræ: * omnes gentes sérvient ei:
verses.en: And all kings of the earth shall adore him: * all nations shall serve him.

verses.la: Quia liberábit páuperem a poténte: * et páuperem, cui non erat adiútor.
verses.en: For he shall deliver the poor from the mighty: * and the needy that had no helper.

verses.la: Parcet páuperi et ínopi: * et ánimas páuperum salvas fáciet.
verses.en: He shall spare the poor and needy: * and he shall save the souls of the poor.

verses.la: Ex usúris et iniquitáte rédimet ánimas eórum: * et honorábile nomen eórum coram illo.
verses.en: He shall redeem their souls from usuries and iniquity: * and their names shall be honourable in his sight.

verses.la: Et vivet, et dábitur ei de auro Arábiæ, et adorábunt de ipso semper: * tota die benedícent ei.
verses.en: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Arabia, for him they shall always adore: * they shall bless him all the day.

verses.la: Et erit firmaméntum in terra in summis móntium, superextollétur super Líbanum fructus eius: * et florébunt de civitáte sicut fænum terræ.
verses.en: And there shall be a firmament on the earth on the tops of mountains, above Libanus shall the fruit thereof be exalted: * and they of the city shall flourish like the grass of the earth.

verses.la: Et benedicéntur in ipso omnes tribus terræ: * omnes gentes magnificábunt eum.
verses.en: And in him shall all the tribes of the earth be blessed: * all nations shall magnify him.

verses.la: Benedíctus Dóminus, Deus Israël, * qui facit mirabília solus:
verses.en: Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, * who alone doth wonderful things.

verses.la: Et benedíctum nomen maiestátis eius in ætérnum: * et replébitur maiestáte eius omnis terra: fiat, fiat.
verses.en: And blessed be the name of his majesty for ever: * and the whole earth shall be filled with his majesty. So be it. So be it.

verses.la: Quam bonus Israël Deus, * his, qui recto sunt corde!
verses.en: How good is God to Israel, * to them that are of a right heart!

verses.la: Mei autem pæne moti sunt pedes: * pæne effúsi sunt gressus mei.
verses.en: But my feet were almost moved; * my steps had wellnigh slipped.

verses.la: Quia zelávi super iníquos, * pacem peccatórum videns.
verses.en: Because I had a zeal on occasion of the wicked, * seeing the prosperity of sinners.

verses.la: Quia non est respéctus morti eórum: * et firmaméntum in plaga eórum.
verses.en: For there is no regard to their death, * nor is there strength in their stripes.

verses.la: In labóre hóminum non sunt, * et cum homínibus non flagellabúntur:
verses.en: They are not in the labour of men: * neither shall they be scourged like other men.

verses.la: Ídeo ténuit eos supérbia, * opérti sunt iniquitáte et impietáte sua.
verses.en: Therefore pride hath held them fast: * they are covered with their iniquity and their wickedness.

verses.la: Pródiit quasi ex ádipe iníquitas eórum: * transiérunt in afféctum cordis.
verses.en: Their iniquity hath come forth, as it were from fatness: * they have passed into the affection of the heart.

verses.la: Cogitavérunt, et locúti sunt nequítiam: * iniquitátem in excélso locúti sunt.
verses.en: They have thought and spoken wickedness: * they have spoken iniquity on high.

verses.la: Posuérunt in cælum os suum: * et lingua eórum transívit in terra.
verses.en: They have set their mouth against heaven: * and their tongue hath passed through the earth.

verses.la: Ídeo convertétur pópulus meus hic: * et dies pleni inveniéntur in eis.
verses.en: Therefore will my people return here * and full days shall be found in them.

verses.la: Et dixérunt: Quómodo scit Deus, * et si est sciéntia in excélso?
verses.en: And they said: How doth God know? * and is there knowledge in the most High?

verses.la: Ecce, ipsi peccatóres, et abundántes in sǽculo, * obtinuérunt divítias.
verses.en: Behold these are sinners; and yet abounding in the world * they have obtained riches.

verses.la: Et dixi: Ergo sine causa iustificávi cor meum, * et lavi inter innocéntes manus meas:
verses.en: And I said: Then have I in vain justified my heart, * and washed my hands among the innocent.

verses.la: Et fui flagellátus tota die, * et castigátio mea in matutínis.
verses.en: And I have been scourged all the day; * and my chastisement hath been in the mornings.

verses.la: Si dicébam: Narrábo sic: * ecce, natiónem filiórum tuórum reprobávi.
verses.en: If I said: I will speak thus; * behold I should condemn the generation of thy children.

verses.la: Existimábam ut cognóscerem hoc, * labor est ante me:
verses.en: I studied that I might know this thing, * it is a labour in my sight:

verses.la: Donec intrem in Sanctuárium Dei: * et intéllegam in novíssimis eórum.
verses.en: Until I go into the sanctuary of God, * and understand concerning their last ends.

verses.la: Verúmtamen propter dolos posuísti eis: * deiecísti eos dum allevaréntur.
verses.en: But indeed for deceits thou hast put it to them: * when they were lifted up, thou hast cast them down.

verses.la: Quómodo facti sunt in desolatiónem, súbito defecérunt: * periérunt propter iniquitátem suam.
verses.en: How are they brought to desolation? they have suddenly ceased to be: * they have perished by reason of their iniquity.

verses.la: Velut sómnium surgéntium, Dómine, * in civitáte tua imáginem ipsórum ad níhilum rédiges.
verses.en: As the dream of them that awake, O Lord; * so in thy city thou shalt bring their image to nothing.

verses.la: Quia inflammátum est cor meum, et renes mei commutáti sunt: * et ego ad níhilum redáctus sum, et nescívi.
verses.en: For my heart hath been inflamed, and my reins have been changed: * and I am brought to nothing, and I knew not.

verses.la: Ut iuméntum factus sum apud te: * et ego semper tecum.
verses.en: I am become as a beast before thee: * and I am always with thee.

verses.la: Tenuísti manum déxteram meam: et in voluntáte tua deduxísti me, * et cum glória suscepísti me.
verses.en: Thou hast held me by my right hand; and by thy will thou hast conducted me, * and with thy glory thou hast received me.

verses.la: Quid enim mihi est in cælo? * et a te quid vólui super terram?
verses.en: For what have I in heaven? * and besides thee what do I desire upon earth?

verses.la: Defécit caro mea, et cor meum: * Deus cordis mei, et pars mea Deus in ætérnum.
verses.en: For thee my flesh and my heart hath fainted away: * thou art the God of my heart, and the God that is my portion for ever.

verses.la: Quia ecce, qui elóngant se a te, períbunt: * perdidísti omnes, qui fornicántur abs te.
verses.en: For behold they that go far from thee shall perish: * thou hast destroyed all them that are disloyal to thee.

verses.la: Ut annúntiem omnes prædicatiónes tuas, * in portis fíliæ Sion.
verses.en: That I may declare all thy praises, * in the gates of the daughter of Sion.

verses.la: Ut quid, Deus, repulísti in finem: * irátus est furor tuus super oves páscuæ tuæ?
verses.en: O God, why hast thou cast us off unto the end: * why is thy wrath enkindled against the sheep of thy pasture?

verses.la: Redemísti virgam hereditátis tuæ: * mons Sion, in quo habitásti in eo.
verses.en: The sceptre of thy inheritance which thou hast redeemed: * mount Sion in which thou hast dwelt.

verses.la: Leva manus tuas in supérbias eórum in finem: * quanta malignátus est inimícus in sancto!
verses.en: Lift up thy hands against their pride unto the end; * see what things the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.

verses.la: Et gloriáti sunt qui odérunt te: * in médio solemnitátis tuæ.
verses.en: And they that hate thee have made their boasts, * in the midst of thy solemnity.

verses.la: Posuérunt signa sua, signa: * et non cognovérunt sicut in éxitu super summum.
verses.en: They have set up their ensigns for signs, * and they knew not both in the going out and on the highest top.

verses.la: Quasi in silva lignórum secúribus excidérunt iánuas eius in idípsum: * in secúri et áscia deiecérunt eam.
verses.en: As with axes in a wood of trees, they have cut down at once the gates thereof, * with axe and hatchet they have brought it down.

verses.la: Incendérunt igni Sanctuárium tuum: * in terra polluérunt tabernáculum nóminis tui.
verses.en: They have set fire to thy sanctuary: * they have defiled the dwelling place of thy name on the earth.

verses.la: Dixérunt in corde suo cognátio eórum simul: * Quiéscere faciámus omnes dies festos Dei a terra.
verses.en: They said in their heart, the whole kindred of them together: * Let us abolish all the festival days of God from the land.

verses.la: Signa nostra non vídimus, iam non est prophéta: * et nos non cognóscet ámplius.
verses.en: Our signs we have not seen, there is now no prophet: * and he will know us no more.

verses.la: Úsquequo, Deus, improperábit inimícus: * irrítat adversárius nomen tuum in finem?
verses.en: How long, O God, shall the enemy reproach: * is the adversary to provoke thy name for ever?

verses.la: Ut quid avértis manum tuam, et déxteram tuam, * de médio sinu tuo in finem?
verses.en: Why dost thou turn away thy hand: and thy right hand * out of the midst of thy bosom for ever?

verses.la: Deus autem Rex noster ante sǽcula: * operátus est salútem in médio terræ.
verses.en: But God is our king before ages: * he hath wrought salvation in the midst of the earth.

verses.la: Tu confirmásti in virtúte tua mare: * contribulásti cápita dracónum in aquis.
verses.en: Thou by thy strength didst make the sea firm: * thou didst crush the heads of the dragons in the waters.

verses.la: Tu confregísti cápita dracónis: * dedísti eum escam pópulis Æthíopum.
verses.en: Thou hast broken the heads of the dragon: * thou hast given him to be meat for the people of the Ethiopians.

verses.la: Tu dirupísti fontes, et torréntes: * tu siccásti flúvios Ethan.
verses.en: Thou hast broken up the fountains and the torrents: * thou hast dried up the Ethan rivers.

verses.la: Tuus est dies, et tua est nox: * tu fabricátus es auróram et solem.
verses.en: Thine is the day, and thine is the night: * thou hast made the morning light and the sun.

verses.la: Tu fecísti omnes términos terræ: * æstátem et ver tu plasmásti ea.
verses.en: Thou hast made all the borders of the earth: * the summer and the spring were formed by thee.

verses.la: Memor esto huius, inimícus improperávit Dómino: * et pópulus insípiens incitávit nomen tuum.
verses.en: Remember this, the enemy hath reproached the Lord: * and a foolish people hath provoked thy name.

verses.la: Ne tradas béstiis ánimas confiténtes tibi, * et ánimas páuperum tuórum ne obliviscáris in finem.
verses.en: Deliver not up to beasts the souls that confess to thee: * and forget not to the end the souls of thy poor.

verses.la: Réspice in testaméntum tuum: * quia repléti sunt, qui obscuráti sunt terræ dómibus iniquitátum.
verses.en: Have regard to thy covenant: * for they that are the obscure of the earth have been filled with dwellings of iniquity.

verses.la: Ne avertátur húmilis factus confúsus: * pauper et inops laudábunt nomen tuum.
verses.en: Let not the humble be turned away with confusion: * the poor and needy shall praise thy name.

verses.la: Exsúrge, Deus, iúdica causam tuam: * memor esto improperiórum tuórum, eórum quæ ab insipiénte sunt tota die.
verses.en: Arise, O God, judge thy own cause: * remember thy reproaches with which the foolish man hath reproached thee all the day.

verses.la: Ne obliviscáris voces inimicórum tuórum: * supérbia eórum, qui te odérunt, ascéndit semper.
verses.en: Forget not the voices of thy enemies: * the pride of them that hate thee ascendeth continually.

verses.la: Confitébimur tibi, Deus: * confitébimur, et invocábimus nomen tuum.
verses.en: We will praise thee, O God: * we will praise, and we will call upon thy name.

verses.la: Narrábimus mirabília tua: * cum accépero tempus, ego iustítias iudicábo.
verses.en: We will relate thy wondrous works: * when I shall take a time, I will judge justices.

verses.la: Liquefácta est terra, et omnes qui hábitant in ea: * ego confirmávi colúmnas eius.
verses.en: The earth is melted, and all that dwell therein: * I have established the pillars thereof.

verses.la: Dixi iníquis: Nolíte iníque ágere: * et delinquéntibus: Nolíte exaltáre cornu:
verses.en: I said to the wicked: Do not act wickedly: * and to the sinners: Lift not up the horn.

verses.la: Nolíte extóllere in altum cornu vestrum: * nolíte loqui advérsus Deum iniquitátem.
verses.en: Lift not up your horn on high: * speak not iniquity against God.

verses.la: Quia neque ab Oriénte, neque ab Occidénte, neque a desértis móntibus: * quóniam Deus iudex est.
verses.en: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the desert hills: * for God is the judge.

verses.la: Hunc humíliat, et hunc exáltat: * quia calix in manu Dómini vini meri plenus misto.
verses.en: One he putteth down, and another he lifteth up: * for in the hand of the Lord there is a cup of strong wine full of mixture.

verses.la: Et inclinávit ex hoc in hoc: verúmtamen fæx eius non est exinaníta: * bibent omnes peccatóres terræ.
verses.en: And he hath poured it out from this to that: but the dregs thereof are not emptied: * all the sinners of the earth shall drink.

verses.la: Ego autem annuntiábo in sǽculum: * cantábo Deo Iacob.
verses.en: But I will declare for ever: * I will sing to the God of Jacob.

verses.la: Et ómnia córnua peccatórum confríngam: * et exaltabúntur córnua iusti.
verses.en: And I will break all the horns of sinners: * but the horns of the just shall be exalted.

verses.la: Notus in Iudǽa Deus: * in Israël magnum nomen eius.
verses.en: In Judea God is known: * his name is great in Israel.

verses.la: Et factus est in pace locus eius: * et habitátio eius in Sion.
verses.en: And his place is in peace: * and his abode in Sion:

verses.la: Ibi confrégit poténtias árcuum, * scutum, gládium, et bellum.
verses.en: There hath he broken the powers of bows, * the shield, the sword, and the battle.

verses.la: Illúminans tu mirabíliter a móntibus ætérnis: * turbáti sunt omnes insipiéntes corde.
verses.en: Thou enlightenest wonderfully from the everlasting hills. * All the foolish of heart were troubled.

verses.la: Dormiérunt somnum suum: * et nihil invenérunt omnes viri divitiárum in mánibus suis.
verses.en: They have slept their sleep; * and all the men of riches have found nothing in their hands.

verses.la: Ab increpatióne tua, Deus Iacob, * dormitavérunt qui ascendérunt equos.
verses.en: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, * they have all slumbered that mounted on horseback.

verses.la: Tu terríbilis es, et quis resístet tibi? * ex tunc ira tua.
verses.en: Thou art terrible, and who shall resist thee? * from that time thy wrath.

verses.la: De cælo audítum fecísti iudícium: * terra trémuit et quiévit,
verses.en: Thou hast caused judgment to be heard from heaven: * the earth trembled and was still,

verses.la: Cum exsúrgeret in iudícium Deus, * ut salvos fáceret omnes mansuétos terræ.
verses.en: When God arose in judgment, * to save all the meek of the earth.

verses.la: Quóniam cogitátio hóminis confitébitur tibi: * et relíquiæ cogitatiónis diem festum agent tibi.
verses.en: For the thought of man shall give praise to thee: * and the remainders of the thought shall keep holiday to thee.

verses.la: Vovéte, et réddite Dómino, Deo vestro: * omnes, qui in circúitu eius affértis múnera.
verses.en: Vow ye, and pay to the Lord your God: * all you that are round about him bring presents.

verses.la: Terríbili et ei qui aufert spíritum príncipum, * terríbili apud reges terræ.
verses.en: To him that is terrible, even to him who taketh away the spirit of princes: * to the terrible with the kings of the earth.

verses.la: Voce mea ad Dóminum clamávi: * voce mea ad Deum, et inténdit mihi.
verses.en: I cried to the Lord with my voice; * to God with my voice, and he gave ear to me.

verses.la: In die tribulatiónis meæ Deum exquisívi, mánibus meis nocte contra eum: * et non sum decéptus.
verses.en: In the day of my trouble I sought God, with my hands lifted up to him in the night, * and I was not deceived.

verses.la: Rénuit consolári ánima mea, * memor fui Dei, et delectátus sum, et exercitátus sum: et defécit spíritus meus.
verses.en: My soul refused to be comforted: * I remembered God, and was delighted, and was exercised, and my spirit swooned away.

verses.la: Anticipavérunt vigílias óculi mei: * turbátus sum, et non sum locútus.
verses.en: My eyes prevented the watches: * I was troubled, and I spoke not.

verses.la: Cogitávi dies antíquos: * et annos ætérnos in mente hábui.
verses.en: I thought upon the days of old: * and I had in my mind the eternal years.

verses.la: Et meditátus sum nocte cum corde meo, * et exercitábar, et scopébam spíritum meum.
verses.en: And I meditated in the night with my own heart: * and I was exercised and I swept my spirit.

verses.la: Numquid in ætérnum proíciet Deus: * aut non appónet ut complacítior sit adhuc?
verses.en: Will God then cast off for ever? * or will he never be more favourable again?

verses.la: Aut in finem misericórdiam suam abscíndet, * a generatióne in generatiónem?
verses.en: Or will he cut off his mercy for ever, * from generation to generation?

verses.la: Aut obliviscétur miseréri Deus? * aut continébit in ira sua misericórdias suas?
verses.en: Or will God forget to shew mercy? * or will he in his anger shut up his mercies?

verses.la: Et dixi: Nunc cœpi: * hæc mutátio déxteræ Excélsi.
verses.en: And I said, Now have I begun: * this is the change of the right hand of the most High.

verses.la: Memor fui óperum Dómini: * quia memor ero ab inítio mirabílium tuórum.
verses.en: I remembered the works of the Lord: * for I will be mindful of thy wonders from the beginning.

verses.la: Et meditábor in ómnibus opéribus tuis: * et in adinventiónibus tuis exercébor.
verses.en: And I will meditate on all thy works: * and will be employed in thy inventions.

verses.la: Deus, in sancto via tua: quis Deus magnus sicut Deus noster? * tu es Deus qui facis mirabília.
verses.en: Thy way, O God, is in the holy place: who is the great God like our God? * Thou art the God that dost wonders.

verses.la: Notam fecísti in pópulis virtútem tuam: * redemísti in brácchio tuo pópulum tuum, fílios Iacob et Ioseph.
verses.en: Thou hast made thy power known among the nations: * with thy arm thou hast redeemed thy people, the children of Jacob and of Joseph.

verses.la: Vidérunt te aquæ, Deus, vidérunt te aquæ: * et timuérunt, et turbátæ sunt abýssi.
verses.en: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee: * and they were afraid, and the depths were troubled.

verses.la: Étenim sagíttæ tuæ tránseunt: * vox tonítrui tui in rota.
verses.en: For thy arrows pass: * the voice of thy thunder in a wheel.

verses.la: Illuxérunt coruscatiónes tuæ orbi terræ: * commóta est, et contrémuit terra.
verses.en: Thy lightnings enlightened the world: * the earth shook and trembled.

verses.la: In mari via tua, et sémitæ tuæ in aquis multis: * et vestígia tua non cognoscéntur.
verses.en: Thy way is in the sea, and thy paths in many waters: * and thy footsteps shall not be known.

verses.la: Deduxísti sicut oves pópulum tuum, * in manu Móysi et Aaron.
verses.en: Thou hast conducted thy people like sheep, * by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

verses.la: Atténdite, pópule meus, legem meam: * inclináte aurem vestram in verba oris mei.
verses.en: Attend, O my people, to my law: * incline your ears to the words of my mouth.

verses.la: Apériam in parábolis os meum: * loquar propositiónes ab inítio.
verses.en: I will open my mouth in parables: * I will utter propositions from the beginning.

verses.la: Quanta audívimus et cognóvimus ea: * et patres nostri narravérunt nobis.
verses.en: How great things have we heard and known, * and our fathers have told us.

verses.la: Narrántes laudes Dómini, et virtútes eius: * et mirabília eius, quæ fecit.
verses.en: Declaring the praises of the Lord, and his powers, * and his wonders which he hath done.

verses.la: Quanta mandávit pátribus nostris nota fácere ea fíliis suis: * ut cognóscat generátio áltera.
verses.en: How great things he commanded our fathers, that they should make the same known to their children: * that another generation might know them.

verses.la: Fílii qui nascéntur, et exsúrgent, * et narrábunt fíliis suis.
verses.en: The children that should be born and should rise up, * and declare them to their children.

verses.la: Ut ponant in Deo spem suam, et non obliviscántur óperum Dei: * et mandáta eius exquírant.
verses.en: That they may put their hope in God and may not forget the works of God: * and may seek his commandments.

verses.la: Generátio, quæ non diréxit cor suum: * et non est créditus cum Deo spíritus eius.
verses.en: A generation that set not their heart aright: * and whose spirit was not faithful to God.

verses.la: Fílii Ephrem intendéntes et mitténtes arcum: * convérsi sunt in die belli.
verses.en: The sons of Ephraim who bend and shoot with the bow: * they have turned back in the day of battle.

verses.la: Non custodiérunt testaméntum Dei: * et in lege eius noluérunt ambuláre.
verses.en: They kept not the covenant of God: * and in his law they would not walk.

verses.la: Et oblíti sunt benefactórum eius: * et mirabílium eius quæ osténdit eis.
verses.en: And they forgot his benefits, * and his wonders that he had shewn them.

verses.la: Coram pátribus eórum fecit mirabília in terra Ægýpti: * in campo Táneos.
verses.en: Wonderful things did he do in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, * in the field of Tanis.

verses.la: Interrúpit mare, et perdúxit eos: * et státuit aquas quasi in utre.
verses.en: He divided the sea and brought them through: * and he made the waters to stand as in a vessel.

verses.la: Et dedúxit eos in nube diéi: * et tota nocte in illuminatióne ignis.
verses.en: And he conducted them with a cloud by day: * and all the night with a light of fire.

verses.la: Interrúpit petram in erémo: * et adaquávit eos velut in abýsso multa.
verses.en: He struck the rock in the wilderness: * and gave them to drink, as out of the great deep.

verses.la: Et edúxit aquam de petra: * et dedúxit tamquam flúmina aquas.
verses.en: He brought forth water out of the rock: * and made streams run down as rivers.

verses.la: Et apposuérunt adhuc peccáre ei: * in iram excitavérunt Excélsum in inaquóso.
verses.en: And they added yet more sin against him: * they provoked the most High to wrath in the place without water.

verses.la: Et tentavérunt Deum in córdibus suis, * ut péterent escas animábus suis.
verses.en: And they tempted God in their hearts, * by asking meat for their desires.

verses.la: Et male locúti sunt de Deo: * dixérunt: Numquid póterit Deus paráre mensam in desérto?
verses.en: And they spoke ill of God: * they said: Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?

verses.la: Numquid et panem póterit dare, * aut paráre mensam pópulo suo?
verses.en: Can he also give bread, * or provide a table for his people?

verses.la: Ídeo audívit Dóminus, et dístulit: * et ignis accénsus est in Iacob, et ira ascéndit in Israël.
verses.en: Therefore the Lord heard, and was angry: * and a fire was kindled against Jacob, and wrath came up against Israel.

verses.la: Quia non credidérunt in Deo: * nec speravérunt in salutári eius:
verses.en: Because they believed not in God: * and trusted not in his salvation.

verses.la: Et mandávit núbibus désuper: * et iánuas cæli apéruit.
verses.en: And he had commanded the clouds from above, * and had opened the doors of heaven.

verses.la: Et pluit illis manna ad manducándum: * et panem cæli dedit eis.
verses.en: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, * and had given them the bread of heaven.

verses.la: Panem Angelórum manducávit homo, * cibária misit eis in abundántia.
verses.en: Man ate the bread of angels: * he sent them provisions in abundance.

verses.la: Tránstulit Austrum de cælo: * et indúxit in virtúte sua Áfricum.
verses.en: He removed the south wind from heaven: * and by his power brought in the southwest wind.

verses.la: Et pluit super eos sicut púlverem carnes: * et sicut arénam maris volatília pennáta.
verses.en: And he rained upon them flesh as dust: * and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea.

verses.la: Et cecidérunt in médio castrórum eórum: * circa tabernácula eórum.
verses.en: And they fell in the midst of their camp, * round about their pavilions.

verses.la: Et manducavérunt, et saturáti sunt nimis, et desidérium eórum áttulit eis: * non sunt fraudáti a desidério suo.
verses.en: So they did eat, and were filled exceedingly, and he gave them their desire: * they were not defrauded of that which they craved.

verses.la: Adhuc escæ eórum erant in ore ipsórum: * et ira Dei ascéndit super eos.
verses.en: As yet their meat was in their mouth: * and the wrath of God came upon them.

verses.la: Et occídit pingues eórum, * et eléctos Israël impedívit.
verses.en: And he slew the fat ones amongst them, * and brought down the chosen men of Israel.

verses.la: In ómnibus his peccavérunt adhuc: * et non credidérunt in mirabílibus eius.
verses.en: In all these things they sinned still: * and they believed not for his wondrous works.

verses.la: Et defecérunt in vanitáte dies eórum: * et anni eórum cum festinatióne.
verses.en: And their days were consumed in vanity, * and their years in haste.

verses.la: Cum occíderet eos, quærébant eum: * et revertebántur, et dilúculo veniébant ad eum.
verses.en: When he slew them, then they sought him: * and they returned, and came to him early in the morning.

verses.la: Et rememoráti sunt quia Deus adiútor est eórum: * et Deus excélsus redémptor eórum est.
verses.en: And they remembered that God was their helper: * and the most high God their redeemer.

verses.la: Et dilexérunt eum in ore suo, * et lingua sua mentíti sunt ei.
verses.en: And they loved him with their mouth: * and with their tongue they lied unto him:

verses.la: Cor autem eórum non erat rectum cum eo: * nec fidéles hábiti sunt in testaménto eius.
verses.en: But their heart was not right with him: * nor were they counted faithful in his covenant.

verses.la: Et abundávit ut avérteret iram suam: * et non accéndit omnem iram suam:
verses.en: And many a time did he turn away his anger: * and did not kindle all his wrath.

verses.la: Et recordátus est quia caro sunt: * spíritus vadens et non rédiens.
verses.en: And he remembered that they are flesh: * a wind that goeth and returneth not.

verses.la: Quóties exacerbavérunt eum in desérto, * in iram concitavérunt eum in inaquóso?
verses.en: How often did they provoke him in the desert: * and move him to wrath in the place without water?

verses.la: Et convérsi sunt, et tentavérunt Deum: * et Sanctum Israël exacerbavérunt.
verses.en: And they turned back and tempted God: * and grieved the holy one of Israel.

verses.la: Non sunt recordáti manus eius, * die qua redémit eos de manu tribulántis.
verses.en: They remembered not his hand, * in the day that he redeemed them from the hand of him that afflicted them:

verses.la: Sicut pósuit in Ægýpto signa sua, * et prodígia sua in campo Táneos.
verses.en: How he wrought his signs in Egypt, * and his wonders in the field of Tanis.

verses.la: Et convértit in sánguinem flúmina eórum: * et imbres eórum, ne bíberent.
verses.en: And he turned their rivers into blood, * and their showers that they might not drink.

verses.la: Misit in eos cœnomyíam, et comédit eos: * et ranam, et dispérdidit eos.
verses.en: He sent amongst them diverse sorts of flies, which devoured them: * and frogs which destroyed them.

verses.la: Et dedit ærúgini fructus eórum: * et labóres eórum locústæ.
verses.en: And he gave up their fruits to the blast, * and their labours to the locust.

verses.la: Et occídit in grándine víneas eórum: * et moros eórum in pruína.
verses.en: And he destroyed their vineyards with hail, * and their mulberry trees with hoarfrost.

verses.la: Et trádidit grándini iuménta eórum: * et possessiónem eórum igni.
verses.en: And he gave up their cattle to the hail, * and their stock to the fire.

verses.la: Misit in eos iram indignatiónis suæ: * indignatiónem, et iram, et tribulatiónem: immissiónes per ángelos malos.
verses.en: And he sent upon them the wrath of his indignation: * indignation and wrath and trouble, which he sent by evil angels.

verses.la: Viam fecit sémitæ iræ suæ, non pepércit a morte animábus eórum: * et iuménta eórum in morte conclúsit.
verses.en: He made a way for a path to his anger: * he spared not their souls from death, and their cattle he shut up in death.

verses.la: Et percússit omne primogénitum in terra Ægýpti: * primítias omnis labóris eórum in tabernáculis Cham.
verses.en: And he killed all the firstborn in the land of Egypt: * the firstfruits of all their labour in the tabernacles of Cham.

verses.la: Et ábstulit sicut oves pópulum suum: * et perdúxit eos tamquam gregem in desérto.
verses.en: And he took away his own people as sheep: * and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

verses.la: Et dedúxit eos in spe, et non timuérunt: * et inimícos eórum opéruit mare.
verses.en: And he brought them out in hope, and they feared not: * and the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

verses.la: Et eiécit a fácie eórum gentes: * et sorte divísit eis terram in funículo distributiónis.
verses.en: And he cast out the Gentiles before them: * and by lot divided to them their land by a line of distribution.

verses.la: Et habitáre fecit in tabernáculis eórum: * tribus Israël.
verses.en: And he made the tribes of Israel * to dwell in their tabernacles.

verses.la: Et tentavérunt, et exacerbavérunt Deum excélsum: * et testimónia eius non custodiérunt.
verses.en: Yet they tempted, and provoked the most high God: * and they kept not his testimonies.

verses.la: Et avertérunt se, et non servavérunt pactum: * quemádmodum patres eórum convérsi sunt in arcum pravum.
verses.en: And they turned away, and kept not the covenant: * even like their fathers they were turned aside as a crooked bow.

verses.la: In iram concitavérunt eum in cóllibus suis: * et in sculptílibus suis ad æmulatiónem eum provocavérunt.
verses.en: They provoked him to anger on their hills: * and moved him to jealousy with their graven things.

verses.la: Audívit Deus, et sprevit: * et ad níhilum redégit valde Israël.
verses.en: God heard, and despised them, * and he reduced Israel exceedingly as it were to nothing.

verses.la: Et répulit tabernáculum Silo: * tabernáculum suum, ubi habitávit in homínibus.
verses.en: And he put away the tabernacle of Silo, * his tabernacle where he dwelt among men.

verses.la: Et trádidit in captivitátem virtútem eórum: * et pulchritúdinem eórum in manus inimíci.
verses.en: And he delivered their strength into captivity: * and their beauty into the hands of the enemy.

verses.la: Et conclúsit in gládio pópulum suum: * et hereditátem suam sprevit.
verses.en: And he shut up his people under the sword: * and he despised his inheritance.

verses.la: Iúvenes eórum comédit ignis: * et vírgines eórum non sunt lamentátæ.
verses.en: Fire consumed their young men: * and their maidens were not lamented.

verses.la: Sacerdótes eórum in gládio cecidérunt: * et víduæ eórum non plorabántur.
verses.en: Their priests fell by the sword: * and their widows did not mourn.

verses.la: Et excitátus est tamquam dórmiens Dóminus: * tamquam potens crapulátus a vino.
verses.en: And the Lord was awaked as one out of sleep, * and like a mighty man that hath been surfeited with wine.

verses.la: Et percússit inimícos suos in posterióra: * oppróbrium sempitérnum dedit illis.
verses.en: And he smote his enemies on the hinder parts: * he put them to an everlasting reproach.

verses.la: Et répulit tabernáculum Ioseph: * et tribum Éphraim non elégit.
verses.en: And he rejected the tabernacle of Joseph: * and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:

verses.la: Sed elégit tribum Iuda, * montem Sion quem diléxit.
verses.en: But he chose the tribe of Juda, * mount Sion which he loved.

verses.la: Et ædificávit sicut unicórnium sanctifícium suum in terra, * quam fundávit in sǽcula.
verses.en: And he built his sanctuary as of unicorns, in the land * which he founded for ever.

verses.la: Et elégit David, servum suum, et sústulit eum de grégibus óvium: * de post fœtántes accépit eum,
verses.en: And he chose his servant David, and took him from the flocks of sheep: * he brought him from following the ewes great with young,

verses.la: Páscere Iacob, servum suum, * et Israël, hereditátem suam:
verses.en: To feed Jacob his servant, * and Israel his inheritance.

verses.la: Et pavit eos in innocéntia cordis sui: * et in intelléctibus mánuum suárum dedúxit eos.
verses.en: And he fed them in the innocence of his heart: * and conducted them by the skilfulness of his hands.

verses.la: Deus, venérunt gentes in hereditátem tuam, polluérunt templum sanctum tuum: * posuérunt Ierúsalem in pomórum custódiam.
verses.en: O God, the heathens are come into thy inheritance, they have defiled thy holy temple: * they have made Jerusalem as a place to keep fruit.

verses.la: Posuérunt morticína servórum tuórum, escas volatílibus cæli: * carnes sanctórum tuórum béstiis terræ.
verses.en: They have given the dead bodies of thy servants to be meat for the fowls of the air: * the flesh of thy saints for the beasts of the earth.

verses.la: Effudérunt sánguinem eórum tamquam aquam in circúitu Ierúsalem: * et non erat qui sepelíret.
verses.en: They have poured out their blood as water, round about Jerusalem, * and there was none to bury them.

verses.la: Facti sumus oppróbrium vicínis nostris: * subsannátio et illúsio his, qui in circúitu nostro sunt.
verses.en: We are become a reproach to our neighbours: * a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.

verses.la: Úsquequo, Dómine, irascéris in finem: * accendétur velut ignis zelus tuus?
verses.en: How long, O Lord, wilt thou be angry for ever: * shall thy zeal be kindled like a fire?

verses.la: Effúnde iram tuam in gentes, quæ te non novérunt: * et in regna quæ nomen tuum non invocavérunt:
verses.en: Pour out thy wrath upon the nations that have not known thee: * and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.

verses.la: Quia comedérunt Iacob: * et locum eius desolavérunt.
verses.en: Because they have devoured Jacob; * and have laid waste his place.

verses.la: Ne memíneris iniquitátum nostrárum antiquárum, cito antícipent nos misericórdiæ tuæ: * quia páuperes facti sumus nimis.
verses.en: Remember not our former iniquities: let thy mercies speedily prevent us, * for we are become exceeding poor.

verses.la: Ádiuva nos, Deus, salutáris noster: et propter glóriam nóminis tui, Dómine, líbera nos: * et propítius esto peccátis nostris, propter nomen tuum:
verses.en: Help us, O God, our saviour: and for the glory of thy name, O Lord, deliver us: * and forgive us our sins for thy name’s sake:

verses.la: Últio sánguinis servórum tuórum, qui effúsus est: * intróeat in conspéctu tuo gémitus compeditórum.
verses.en: By the revenging the blood of thy servants, which hath been shed: * let the sighing of the prisoners come in before thee.

verses.la: Secúndum magnitúdinem brácchii tui, * pósside fílios mortificatórum.
verses.en: According to the greatness of thy arm, * take possession of the children of them that have been put to death.

verses.la: Et redde vicínis nostris séptuplum in sinu eórum: * impropérium ipsórum, quod exprobravérunt tibi, Dómine.
verses.en: And render to our neighbours sevenfold in their bosom: * the reproach wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.

verses.la: In generatiónem et generatiónem * annuntiábimus laudem tuam.
verses.en: We will shew forth thy praise, * unto generation and generation.

verses.la: Exsultáte Deo, adiutóri nostro: * iubiláte Deo Iacob.
verses.en: Rejoice to God, our helper: * sing aloud to the God of Jacob.

verses.la: Súmite psalmum, et date týmpanum: * psaltérium iucúndum cum cíthara.
verses.en: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel: * the pleasant psaltery with the harp.

verses.la: Buccináte in Neoménia tuba, * in insígni die solemnitátis vestræ.
verses.en: Blow up the trumpet on the new moon, * on the noted day of your solemnity.

verses.la: Quia præcéptum in Israël est: * et iudícium Deo Iacob.
verses.en: For it is a commandment in Israel, * and a judgment to the God of Jacob.

verses.la: Testimónium in Ioseph pósuit illud, cum exíret de terra Ægýpti: * linguam, quam non nóverat, audívit.
verses.en: He ordained it for a testimony in Joseph, when he came out of the land of Egypt: * he heard a tongue which he knew not.

verses.la: Divértit ab onéribus dorsum eius: * manus eius in cóphino serviérunt.
verses.en: He removed his back from the burdens: * his hands had served in baskets.

verses.la: In tribulatióne invocásti me, et liberávi te: * exaudívi te in abscóndito tempestátis: probávi te apud aquam contradictiónis.
verses.en: Thou calledst upon me in affliction, and I delivered thee: * I heard thee in the secret place of tempest: I proved thee at the waters of contradiction.

verses.la: Audi, pópulus meus, et contestábor te: * Israël, si audíeris me, non erit in te deus recens, neque adorábis deum aliénum.
verses.en: Hear, O my people, and I will testify to thee: * O Israel, if thou wilt hearken to me; there shall be no new god in thee: neither shalt thou adore a strange god.

verses.la: Ego enim sum Dóminus Deus tuus, qui edúxi te de terra Ægýpti: * diláta os tuum, et implébo illud.
verses.en: For I am the Lord thy God, who brought thee out of the land of Egypt: * open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

verses.la: Et non audívit pópulus meus vocem meam: * et Israël non inténdit mihi.
verses.en: But my people heard not my voice: * and Israel hearkened not to me.

verses.la: Et dimísi eos secúndum desidéria cordis eórum: * ibunt in adinventiónibus suis.
verses.en: So I let them go according to the desires of their heart: * they shall walk in their own inventions.

verses.la: Si pópulus meus audísset me: * Israël si in viis meis ambulásset:
verses.en: If my people had heard me: * if Israel had walked in my ways:

verses.la: Pro níhilo fórsitan inimícos eórum humiliássem: * et super tribulántes eos misíssem manum meam.
verses.en: I should soon have humbled their enemies, * and laid my hand on them that troubled them.

verses.la: Inimíci Dómini mentíti sunt ei: * et erit tempus eórum in sǽcula.
verses.en: The enemies of the Lord have lied to him: * and their time shall be for ever.

verses.la: Et cibávit eos ex ádipe fruménti: * et de petra, melle saturávit eos.
verses.en: And he fed them with the fat of wheat, * and filled them with honey out of the rock.

verses.la: Deus, quis símilis erit tibi? * Ne táceas, neque compescáris, Deus.
verses.en: O God, who shall be like to thee? * Hold not thy peace, neither be O God, thou still,

verses.la: Quóniam ecce inimíci tui sonuérunt: * et qui odérunt te extulérunt caput.
verses.en: For lo, thy enemies have made a noise: * and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.

verses.la: Super pópulum tuum malignavérunt consílium: * et cogitavérunt advérsus sanctos tuos.
verses.en: They have taken a malicious counsel against thy people, * and have consulted against thy saints.

verses.la: Dixérunt: Veníte, et disperdámus eos de gente: * et non memorétur nomen Israël ultra.
verses.en: They have said: Come and let us destroy them, * so that they be not a nation: and let the name of Israel be remembered no more.

verses.la: Quóniam cogitavérunt unanímiter: * simul advérsum te testaméntum disposuérunt, tabernácula Idumæórum et Ismahelítæ:
verses.en: For they have contrived with one consent: * they have made a covenant together against thee; the tabernacles of the Edomites, and the Ismahelites:

verses.la: Moab, et Agaréni, Gebal, et Ammon, et Ámalec: * alienígenæ cum habitántibus Tyrum.
verses.en: Moab, and the Agarens, Gebal, and Ammon and Amalec: * the Philistines, with the inhabitants of Tyre.

verses.la: Étenim Assur venit cum illis: * facti sunt in adiutórium fíliis Lot.
verses.en: Yea, and the Assyrian also is joined with them: * they are come to the aid of the sons of Lot.

verses.la: Fac illis sicut Mádian, et Sísaræ: * sicut Iabin in torrénte Cisson.
verses.en: Do to them as thou didst to Madian and to Sisara: * as to Jabin at the brook of Cisson.

verses.la: Disperiérunt in Endor: * facti sunt ut stercus terræ.
verses.en: Who perished at Endor: * and became as dung for the earth.

verses.la: Pone príncipes eórum sicut Oreb, et Zeb, * et Zébee, et Sálmana:
verses.en: Make their princes like Oreb, and Zeb, * and Zebee, and Salmana.

verses.la: Omnes príncipes eórum: * qui dixérunt: Hereditáte possideámus Sanctuárium Dei.
verses.en: All their princes, * who have said: Let us possess the sanctuary of God for an inheritance.

verses.la: Deus meus, pone illos ut rotam: * et sicut stípulam ante fáciem venti.
verses.en: O my God, make them like a wheel; * and as stubble before the wind.

verses.la: Sicut ignis, qui combúrit silvam: * et sicut flamma combúrens montes:
verses.en: As fire which burneth the wood: * and as a flame burning mountains:

verses.la: Ita persequéris illos in tempestáte tua: * et in ira tua turbábis eos.
verses.en: So shalt thou pursue them with thy tempest: * and shalt trouble them in thy wrath.

verses.la: Imple fácies eórum ignomínia: * et quærent nomen tuum, Dómine.
verses.en: Fill their faces with shame; * and they shall seek thy name, O Lord.

verses.la: Erubéscant, et conturbéntur in sǽculum sǽculi: * et confundántur, et péreant.
verses.en: Let them be ashamed and troubled for ever and ever: * and let them be confounded and perish.

verses.la: Et cognóscant quia nomen tibi Dóminus: * tu solus Altíssimus in omni terra.
verses.en: And let them know that the Lord is thy name: * thou alone art the most High over all the earth.

verses.la: Quam dilécta tabernácula tua, Dómine virtútum: * concupíscit, et déficit ánima mea in átria Dómini.
verses.en: How lovely are thy tabernacles, O Lord of hosts! * my soul longeth and fainteth for the courts of the Lord.

verses.la: Cor meum, et caro mea * exsultavérunt in Deum vivum.
verses.en: My heart and my flesh * have rejoiced in the living God.

verses.la: Altária tua, Dómine virtútum: * Rex meus, et Deus meus.
verses.en: Thy altars, O Lord of hosts, * my king and my God.

verses.la: Beáti, qui hábitant in domo tua, Dómine: * in sǽcula sæculórum laudábunt te.
verses.en: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house, O Lord: * they shall praise thee for ever and ever.

verses.la: Beátus vir, cuius est auxílium abs te: * ascensiónes in corde suo dispósuit, in valle lacrimárum in loco, quem pósuit.
verses.en: Blessed is the man whose help is from thee: * in his heart he hath disposed to ascend by steps, in the vale of tears, in the place which he hath set.

verses.la: Étenim benedictiónem dabit legislátor, ibunt de virtúte in virtútem: * vidébitur Deus deórum in Sion.
verses.en: For the lawgiver shall give a blessing, they shall go from virtue to virtue: * the God of gods shall be seen in Sion.

verses.la: Dómine, Deus virtútum, exáudi oratiónem meam: * áuribus pércipe, Deus Iacob.
verses.en: O Lord God of hosts, hear my prayer: * give ear, O God of Jacob.

verses.la: Protéctor noster, áspice, Deus: * et réspice in fáciem Christi tui:
verses.en: Behold, O God our protector: * and look on the face of thy Christ.

verses.la: Elégi abiéctus esse in domo Dei mei: * magis quam habitáre in tabernáculis peccatórum.
verses.en: I have chosen to be an abject in the house of my God, * rather than to dwell in the tabernacles of sinners.

verses.la: Quia misericórdiam, et veritátem díligit Deus: * grátiam et glóriam dabit Dóminus.
verses.en: For God loveth mercy and truth: * the Lord will give grace and glory.

verses.la: Non privábit bonis eos, qui ámbulant in innocéntia: * Dómine virtútum, beátus homo, qui sperat in te.
verses.en: He will not deprive of good things them that walk in innocence: * O Lord of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.

verses.la: Benedixísti, Dómine, terram tuam: * avertísti captivitátem Iacob.
verses.en: Lord, thou hast blessed thy land: * thou hast turned away the captivity of Jacob.

verses.la: Remisísti iniquitátem plebis tuæ: * operuísti ómnia peccáta eórum.
verses.en: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people: * thou hast covered all their sins.

verses.la: Mitigásti omnem iram tuam: * avertísti ab ira indignatiónis tuæ.
verses.en: Thou hast mitigated all thy anger: * thou hast turned away from the wrath of thy indignation.

verses.la: Convérte nos, Deus, salutáris noster: * et avérte iram tuam a nobis.
verses.en: Convert us, O God our saviour: * and turn off thy anger from us.

verses.la: Numquid in ætérnum irascéris nobis? * aut exténdes iram tuam a generatióne in generatiónem?
verses.en: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever: * or wilt thou extend thy wrath from generation to generation?

verses.la: Deus, tu convérsus vivificábis nos: * et plebs tua lætábitur in te.
verses.en: Thou wilt turn, O God, and bring us to life: * and thy people shall rejoice in thee.

verses.la: Osténde nobis, Dómine, misericórdiam tuam: * et salutáre tuum da nobis.
verses.en: Shew us, O Lord, thy mercy; * and grant us thy salvation.

verses.la: Et super sanctos suos: * et in eos, qui convertúntur ad cor.
verses.en: And unto his saints: * and unto them that are converted to the heart.

verses.la: Verúmtamen prope timéntes eum salutáre ipsíus: * ut inhábitet glória in terra nostra.
verses.en: Surely his salvation is near to them that fear him: * that glory may dwell in our land.

verses.la: Misericórdia, et véritas obviavérunt sibi: * iustítia, et pax osculátæ sunt.
verses.en: Mercy and truth have met each other: * justice and peace have kissed.

verses.la: Véritas de terra orta est: * et iustítia de cælo prospéxit.
verses.en: Truth is sprung out of the earth: * and justice hath looked down from heaven.

verses.la: Étenim Dóminus dabit benignitátem: * et terra nostra dabit fructum suum.
verses.en: For the Lord will give goodness: * and our earth shall yield her fruit.

verses.la: Iustítia ante eum ambulábit: * et ponet in via gressus suos.
verses.en: Justice shall walk before him: * and shall set his steps in the way.

verses.la: Inclína, Dómine, aurem tuam, et exáudi me: * quóniam inops, et pauper sum ego.
verses.en: Incline thy ear, O Lord, and hear me: * for I am needy and poor.

verses.la: Custódi ánimam meam, quóniam sanctus sum: * salvum fac servum tuum, Deus meus, sperántem in te.
verses.en: Preserve my soul, for I am holy: * save thy servant, O my God, that trusteth in thee.

verses.la: Miserére mei, Dómine, quóniam ad te clamávi tota die: * lætífica ánimam servi tui, quóniam ad te, Dómine, ánimam meam levávi.
verses.en: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I have cried to thee all the day. * Give joy to the soul of thy servant, for to thee, O Lord, I have lifted up my soul.

verses.la: Quóniam tu, Dómine, suávis, et mitis: * et multæ misericórdiæ ómnibus invocántibus te.
verses.en: For thou, O Lord, art sweet and mild: * and plenteous in mercy to all that call upon thee.

verses.la: Áuribus pércipe, Dómine, oratiónem meam: * et inténde voci deprecatiónis meæ.
verses.en: Give ear, O Lord, to my prayer: * and attend to the voice of my petition.

verses.la: In die tribulatiónis meæ clamávi ad te: * quia exaudísti me.
verses.en: I have called upon thee in the day of my trouble: * because thou hast heard me.

verses.la: Non est símilis tui in diis, Dómine: * et non est secúndum ópera tua.
verses.en: There is none among the gods like unto thee, O Lord: * and there is none according to thy works.

verses.la: Omnes gentes quascúmque fecísti, vénient, et adorábunt coram te, Dómine: * et glorificábunt nomen tuum.
verses.en: All the nations thou hast made shall come and adore before thee, O Lord: * and they shall glorify thy name.

verses.la: Quóniam magnus es tu, et fáciens mirabília: * tu es Deus solus.
verses.en: For thou art great and dost wonderful things: * thou art God alone.

verses.la: Deduc me, Dómine, in via tua, et ingrédiar in veritáte tua: * lætétur cor meum ut tímeat nomen tuum.
verses.en: Conduct me, O Lord, in thy way, and I will walk in thy truth: * let my heart rejoice that it may fear thy name.

verses.la: Confitébor tibi, Dómine, Deus meus, in toto corde meo, * et glorificábo nomen tuum in ætérnum:
verses.en: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with my whole heart, * and I will glorify thy name for ever:

verses.la: Quia misericórdia tua magna est super me: * et eruísti ánimam meam ex inférno inferióri.
verses.en: For thy mercy is great towards me: * and thou hast delivered my soul out of the lower hell.

verses.la: Deus, iníqui insurrexérunt super me, et synagóga poténtium quæsiérunt ánimam meam: * et non proposuérunt te in conspéctu suo.
verses.en: O God, the wicked are risen up against me, and the assembly of the mighty have sought my soul: * and they have not set thee before their eyes.

verses.la: Et tu, Dómine, Deus miserátor et miséricors, * pátiens, et multæ misericórdiæ, et verax,
verses.en: And thou, O Lord, art a God of compassion, and merciful, * patient, and of much mercy, and true.

verses.la: Réspice in me, et miserére mei, * da impérium tuum púero tuo: et salvum fac fílium ancíllæ tuæ.
verses.en: O look upon me, and have mercy on me: * give thy command to thy servant, and save the son of thy handmaid.

verses.la: Fac mecum signum in bonum, ut vídeant qui odérunt me, et confundántur: * quóniam tu, Dómine, adiuvísti me, et consolátus es me.
verses.en: Shew me a token for good: that they who hate me may see, and be confounded, * because thou, O Lord, hast helped me and hast comforted me.

verses.la: Fundaménta eius in móntibus sanctis: * díligit Dóminus portas Sion super ómnia tabernácula Iacob.
verses.en: The foundations thereof are in the holy mountains: * The Lord loveth the gates of Sion above all the tabernacles of Jacob.

verses.la: Gloriósa dicta sunt de te, * cívitas Dei.
verses.en: Glorious things are said of thee, * O city of God.

verses.la: Ecce, alienígenæ, et Tyrus, et pópulus Æthíopum, * hi fuérunt illic.
verses.en: Behold the foreigners, and Tyre, and the people of the Ethiopians, * these were there.

verses.la: Numquid Sion dicet: Homo, et homo natus est in ea: * et ipse fundávit eam Altíssimus?
verses.en: Shall not Sion say: This man and that man is born in her? * and the Highest himself hath founded her.

verses.la: Dóminus narrábit in scriptúris populórum, et príncipum: * horum, qui fuérunt in ea.
verses.en: The Lord shall tell in his writings of peoples and of princes, * of them that have been in her.

verses.la: Sicut lætántium ómnium * habitátio est in te.
verses.en: The dwelling in thee * is as it were of all rejoicing.

verses.la: Dómine, Deus salútis meæ: * in die clamávi, et nocte coram te.
verses.en: Lord, the God of my salvation: * I have cried in the day, and in the night before thee.

verses.la: Intret in conspéctu tuo orátio mea: * inclína aurem tuam ad precem meam:
verses.en: Let my prayer come in before thee: * incline thy ear to my petition.

verses.la: Quia repléta est malis ánima mea: * et vita mea inférno appropinquávit.
verses.en: For my soul is filled with evils: * and my life hath drawn nigh to hell.

verses.la: Æstimátus sum cum descendéntibus in lacum: * factus sum sicut homo sine adiutório, inter mórtuos liber.
verses.en: I am counted among them that go down to the pit: * I am become as a man without help, free among the dead.

verses.la: Sicut vulneráti dormiéntes in sepúlcris, quorum non es memor ámplius: * et ipsi de manu tua repúlsi sunt.
verses.en: Like the slain sleeping in the sepulchres, whom thou rememberest no more: * and they are cast off from thy hand.

verses.la: Posuérunt me in lacu inferióri: * in tenebrósis, et in umbra mortis.
verses.en: They have laid me in the lower pit: * in the dark places, and in the shadow of death.

verses.la: Super me confirmátus est furor tuus: * et omnes fluctus tuos induxísti super me.
verses.en: Thy wrath is strong over me: * and all thy waves thou hast brought in upon me.

verses.la: Tráditus sum, et non egrediébar: * óculi mei languérunt præ inópia.
verses.en: I was delivered up, and came not forth: * my eyes languished through poverty.

verses.la: Clamávi ad te, Dómine, tota die: * expándi ad te manus meas.
verses.en: All the day I cried to thee, O Lord: * I stretched out my hands to thee.

verses.la: Numquid mórtuis fácies mirabília: * aut médici suscitábunt, et confitebúntur tibi?
verses.en: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? * or shall physicians raise to life, and give praise to thee?

verses.la: Numquid narrábit áliquis in sepúlcro misericórdiam tuam, * et veritátem tuam in perditióne?
verses.en: Shall any one in the sepulchre declare thy mercy: * and thy truth in destruction?

verses.la: Numquid cognoscéntur in ténebris mirabília tua, * et iustítia tua in terra obliviónis?
verses.en: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark; * and thy justice in the land of forgetfulness?

verses.la: Et ego ad te, Dómine, clamávi: * et mane orátio mea prævéniet te.
verses.en: But I, O Lord, have cried to thee: * and in the morning my prayer shall prevent thee.

verses.la: Ut quid, Dómine, repéllis oratiónem meam: * avértis fáciem tuam a me?
verses.en: Lord, why castest thou off my prayer: * why turnest thou away thy face from me?

verses.la: Pauper sum ego, et in labóribus a iuventúte mea: * exaltátus autem, humiliátus sum et conturbátus.
verses.en: I am poor, and in labours from my youth: * and being exalted have been humbled and troubled.

verses.la: In me transiérunt iræ tuæ: * et terróres tui conturbavérunt me.
verses.en: Thy wrath hath come upon me: * and thy terrors have troubled me.

verses.la: Circumdedérunt me sicut aqua tota die: * circumdedérunt me simul.
verses.en: They have come round about me like water all the day: * they have compassed me about together.

verses.la: Elongásti a me amícum et próximum: * et notos meos a miséria.
verses.en: Friend and neighbour thou hast put far from me: * and my acquaintance, because of misery.

verses.la: In generatiónem et generatiónem * annuntiábo veritátem tuam in ore meo.
verses.en: I will shew forth thy truth with my mouth * to generation and generation.

verses.la: Quóniam dixísti: In ætérnum misericórdia ædificábitur in cælis: * præparábitur véritas tua in eis.
verses.en: For thou hast said: Mercy shall be built up for ever in the heavens: * thy truth shall be prepared in them.

verses.la: Dispósui testaméntum eléctis meis, iurávi David, servo meo: * Usque in ætérnum præparábo semen tuum.
verses.en: I have made a covenant with my elect: I have sworn to David my servant: * Thy seed will I settle for ever.

verses.la: Et ædificábo in generatiónem et generatiónem * sedem tuam.
verses.en: And I will build up thy throne * unto generation and generation.

verses.la: Confitebúntur cæli mirabília tua, Dómine: * étenim veritátem tuam in ecclésia sanctórum.
verses.en: The heavens shall confess thy wonders, O Lord: * and thy truth in the church of the saints.

verses.la: Quóniam quis in núbibus æquábitur Dómino: * símilis erit Deo in fíliis Dei?
verses.en: For who in the clouds can be compared to the Lord: * or who among the sons of God shall be like to God?

verses.la: Deus, qui glorificátur in consílio sanctórum: * magnus et terríbilis super omnes qui in circúitu eius sunt.
verses.en: God, who is glorified in the assembly of the saints: * great and terrible above all them that are about him.

verses.la: Dómine, Deus virtútum, quis símilis tibi? * potens es, Dómine, et véritas tua in circúitu tuo.
verses.en: O Lord God of hosts, who is like to thee? * thou art mighty, O Lord, and thy truth is round about thee.

verses.la: Tu domináris potestáti maris: * motum autem flúctuum eius tu mítigas.
verses.en: Thou rulest the power of the sea: * and appeasest the motion of the waves thereof.

verses.la: Tu humiliásti sicut vulnerátum, supérbum: * in brácchio virtútis tuæ dispersísti inimícos tuos.
verses.en: Thou hast humbled the proud one, as one that is slain: * with the arm of thy strength thou hast scattered thy enemies.

verses.la: Tui sunt cæli, et tua est terra, orbem terræ et plenitúdinem eius tu fundásti: * aquilónem, et mare tu creásti.
verses.en: Thine are the heavens, and thine is the earth: the world and the fulness thereof thou hast founded: * the north and the sea thou hast created.

verses.la: Thabor et Hermon in nómine tuo exsultábunt: * tuum brácchium cum poténtia.
verses.en: Thabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name: * thy arm is with might.

verses.la: Firmétur manus tua, et exaltétur déxtera tua: * iustítia et iudícium præparátio sedis tuæ.
verses.en: Let thy hand be strengthened, and thy right hand exalted: * justice and judgment are the preparation of thy throne.

verses.la: Misericórdia et véritas præcédent fáciem tuam: * beátus pópulus, qui scit iubilatiónem.
verses.en: Mercy and truth shall go before thy face: * blessed is the people that knoweth jubilation.

verses.la: Dómine, in lúmine vultus tui ambulábunt, et in nómine tuo exsultábunt tota die: * et in iustítia tua exaltabúntur.
verses.en: They shall walk, O Lord, in the light of thy countenance: and in thy name they shall rejoice all the day, * and in thy justice they shall be exalted.

verses.la: Quóniam glória virtútis eórum tu es: * et in beneplácito tuo exaltábitur cornu nostrum.
verses.en: For thou art the glory of their strength: * and in thy good pleasure shall our horn be exalted.

verses.la: Quia Dómini est assúmptio nostra, * et Sancti Israël, regis nostri.
verses.en: For our protection is of the Lord, * and of our king the holy one of Israel.

verses.la: Tunc locútus es in visióne sanctis tuis, et dixísti: * Pósui adiutórium in poténte: et exaltávi eléctum de plebe mea.
verses.en: Then thou spokest in a vision to thy saints, and saidst: * I have laid help upon one that is mighty, and have exalted one chosen out of my people.

verses.la: Invéni David, servum meum: * óleo sancto meo unxi eum.
verses.en: I have found David my servant: * with my holy oil I have anointed him.

verses.la: Manus enim mea auxiliábitur ei: * et brácchium meum confortábit eum.
verses.en: For my hand shall help him: * and my arm shall strengthen him.

verses.la: Nihil profíciet inimícus in eo, * et fílius iniquitátis non appónet nocére ei.
verses.en: The enemy shall have no advantage over him: * nor the son of iniquity have power to hurt him.

verses.la: Et concídam a fácie ipsíus inimícos eius: * et odiéntes eum in fugam convértam.
verses.en: And I will cut down his enemies before his face; * and them that hate him I will put to flight.

verses.la: Et véritas mea, et misericórdia mea cum ipso: * et in nómine meo exaltábitur cornu eius.
verses.en: And my truth and my mercy shall be with him: * and in my name shall his horn be exalted.

verses.la: Et ponam in mari manum eius: * et in flumínibus déxteram eius.
verses.en: And I will set his hand in the sea; * and his right hand in the rivers.

verses.la: Ipse invocábit me: Pater meus es tu: * Deus meus, et suscéptor salútis meæ.
verses.en: He shall cry out to me: Thou art my father: * my God, and the support of my salvation.

verses.la: Et ego primogénitum ponam illum * excélsum præ régibus terræ.
verses.en: And I will make him my firstborn, * high above the kings of the earth.

verses.la: In ætérnum servábo illi misericórdiam meam: * et testaméntum meum fidéle ipsi.
verses.en: I will keep my mercy for him for ever: * and my covenant faithful to him.

verses.la: Et ponam in sǽculum sǽculi semen eius: * et thronum eius sicut dies cæli.
verses.en: And I will make his seed to endure for evermore: * and his throne as the days of heaven.

verses.la: Si autem derelíquerint fílii eius legem meam: * et in iudíciis meis non ambuláverint:
verses.en: And if his children forsake my law, * and walk not in my judgments:

verses.la: Si iustítias meas profanáverint: * et mandáta mea non custodíerint:
verses.en: If they profane my justices: * and keep not my commandments:

verses.la: Visitábo in virga iniquitátes eórum: * et in verbéribus peccáta eórum.
verses.en: I will visit their iniquities with a rod: * and their sins with stripes.

verses.la: Misericórdiam autem meam non dispérgam ab eo: * neque nocébo in veritáte mea:
verses.en: But my mercy I will not take away from him: * nor will I suffer my truth to fail.

verses.la: Neque profanábo testaméntum meum: * et quæ procédunt de lábiis meis, non fáciam írrita.
verses.en: Neither will I profane my covenant: * and the words that proceed from my mouth I will not make void.

verses.la: Semel iurávi in sancto meo: Si David méntiar: * semen eius in ætérnum manébit.
verses.en: Once have I sworn by my holiness: I will not lie unto David: * his seed shall endure for ever.

verses.la: Et thronus eius sicut sol in conspéctu meo, * et sicut luna perfécta in ætérnum: et testis in cælo fidélis.
verses.en: And his throne as the sun before me: * and as the moon perfect for ever, and a faithful witness in heaven.

verses.la: Dómine, refúgium factus es nobis: * a generatióne in generatiónem.
verses.en: Lord, thou hast been our refuge * from generation to generation.

verses.la: Priúsquam montes fíerent, aut formarétur terra et orbis: * a sǽculo et usque in sǽculum tu es, Deus.
verses.en: Before the mountains were made, or the earth and the world was formed; * from eternity and to eternity thou art God.

verses.la: Ne avértas hóminem in humilitátem: * et dixísti: Convertímini, fílii hóminum.
verses.en: Turn not man away to be brought low: * and thou hast said: Be converted, O ye sons of men.

verses.la: Quóniam mille anni ante óculos tuos, * tamquam dies hestérna, quæ prætériit,
verses.en: For a thousand years in thy sight * are as yesterday, which is past.

verses.la: Et custódia in nocte, * quæ pro níhilo habéntur, eórum anni erunt.
verses.en: And as a watch in the night, * things that are counted nothing, shall their years be.

verses.la: Mane sicut herba tránseat, mane flóreat, et tránseat: * véspere décidat, indúret et aréscat.
verses.en: In the morning man shall grow up like grass; in the morning he shall flourish and pass away: * in the evening he shall fall, grow dry, and wither.

verses.la: Quia defécimus in ira tua, * et in furóre tuo turbáti sumus.
verses.en: For in thy wrath we have fainted away: * and are troubled in thy indignation.

verses.la: Posuísti iniquitátes nostras in conspéctu tuo: * sǽculum nostrum in illuminatióne vultus tui.
verses.en: Thou hast set our iniquities before thy eyes: * our life in the light of thy countenance.

verses.la: Anni nostri sicut aránea meditabúntur: * dies annórum nostrórum in ipsis, septuagínta anni.
verses.en: Our years shall be considered as a spider: * the days of our years in them are threescore and ten years.

verses.la: Quóniam supervénit mansuetúdo: * et corripiémur.
verses.en: For mildness is come upon us: * and we shall be corrected.

verses.la: Quis novit potestátem iræ tuæ: * et præ timóre tuo iram tuam dinumeráre?
verses.en: Who knoweth the power of thy anger, * and for thy fear can number thy wrath?

verses.la: Déxteram tuam sic notam fac: * et erudítos corde in sapiéntia.
verses.en: So make thy right hand known: * and men learned in heart, in wisdom.

verses.la: Convértere, Dómine, úsquequo? * et deprecábilis esto super servos tuos.
verses.en: Return, O Lord, how long? * and be entreated in favour of thy servants.

verses.la: Repléti sumus mane misericórdia tua: * et exsultávimus, et delectáti sumus ómnibus diébus nostris.
verses.en: We are filled in the morning with thy mercy: * and we have rejoiced, and are delighted all our days.

verses.la: Lætáti sumus pro diébus, quibus nos humiliásti: * annis, quibus vídimus mala.
verses.en: We have rejoiced for the days in which thou hast humbled us: * for the years in which we have seen evils.

verses.la: Réspice in servos tuos, et in ópera tua: * et dírige fílios eórum.
verses.en: Look upon thy servants and upon their works: * and direct their children.

verses.la: Et sit splendor Dómini, Dei nostri, super nos, et ópera mánuum nostrárum dírige super nos: * et opus mánuum nostrárum dírige.
