verses.en: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us: and direct thou the works of our hands over us; * yea, the work of our hands do thou direct.

verses.la: Qui hábitat in adiutório Altíssimi, * in protectióne Dei cæli commorábitur.
verses.en: He that dwelleth in the aid of the most High, * shall abide under the protection of the God of Jacob.

verses.la: Dicet Dómino: Suscéptor meus es tu, et refúgium meum: * Deus meus sperábo in eum.
verses.en: He shall say to the Lord: Thou art my protector, and my refuge: * my God, in him will I trust.

verses.la: Quóniam ipse liberávit me de láqueo venántium, * et a verbo áspero.
verses.en: For he hath delivered me from the snare of the hunters: * and from the sharp word.

verses.la: Scápulis suis obumbrábit tibi: * et sub pennis eius sperábis.
verses.en: He will overshadow thee with his shoulders: * and under his wings thou shalt trust.

verses.la: Scuto circúmdabit te véritas eius: * non timébis a timóre noctúrno,
verses.en: His truth shall compass thee with a shield: * thou shalt not be afraid of the terror of the night.

verses.la: A sagítta volánte in die, a negótio perambulánte in ténebris: * ab incúrsu, et dæmónio meridiáno.
verses.en: Of the arrow that flieth in the day, of the business that walketh about in the dark: * of invasion, or of the noonday devil.

verses.la: Cadent a látere tuo mille, et decem míllia a dextris tuis: * ad te autem non appropinquábit.
verses.en: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand: * but it shall not come nigh thee.

verses.la: Verúmtamen óculis tuis considerábis: * et retributiónem peccatórum vidébis.
verses.en: But thou shalt consider with thy eyes: * and shalt see the reward of the wicked.

verses.la: Quóniam tu es, Dómine, spes mea: * Altíssimum posuísti refúgium tuum.
verses.en: Because thou, O Lord, art my hope: * thou hast made the most High thy refuge.

verses.la: Non accédet ad te malum: * et flagéllum non appropinquábit tabernáculo tuo.
verses.en: There shall no evil come to thee: * nor shall the scourge come near thy dwelling.

verses.la: Quóniam Ángelis suis mandávit de te: * ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
verses.en: For he hath given his angels charge over thee; * to keep thee in all thy ways.

verses.la: In mánibus portábunt te: * ne forte offéndas ad lápidem pedem tuum.
verses.en: In their hands they shall bear thee up: * lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

verses.la: Super áspidem, et basilíscum ambulábis: * et conculcábis leónem et dracónem.
verses.en: Thou shalt walk upon the asp and the basilisk: * and thou shalt trample under foot the lion and the dragon.

verses.la: Quóniam in me sperávit, liberábo eum: * prótegam eum, quóniam cognóvit nomen meum.
verses.en: Because he hoped in me I will deliver him: * I will protect him because he hath known my name.

verses.la: Clamábit ad me, et ego exáudiam eum: * cum ipso sum in tribulatióne: erípiam eum et glorificábo eum.
verses.en: He shall cry to me, and I will hear him: * I am with him in tribulation, I will deliver him, and I will glorify him.

verses.la: Longitúdine diérum replébo eum: * et osténdam illi salutáre meum.
verses.en: I will fill him with length of days; * and I will shew him my salvation.

verses.la: Bonum est confitéri Dómino: * et psállere nómini tuo, Altíssime.
verses.en: It is good to give praise to the Lord: * and to sing to thy name, O most High.

verses.la: Ad annuntiándum mane misericórdiam tuam: * et veritátem tuam per noctem.
verses.en: To shew forth thy mercy in the morning, * and thy truth in the night:

verses.la: In decachórdo, psaltério: * cum cántico, in cíthara.
verses.en: Upon an instrument of ten strings, upon the psaltery: * with a canticle upon the harp.

verses.la: Quia delectásti me, Dómine, in factúra tua: * et in opéribus mánuum tuárum exsultábo.
verses.en: For thou hast given me, O Lord, a delight in thy doings: * and in the works of thy hands I shall rejoice.

verses.la: Quam magnificáta sunt ópera tua, Dómine! * nimis profúndæ factæ sunt cogitatiónes tuæ.
verses.en: O Lord, how great are thy works! * thy thoughts are exceeding deep.

verses.la: Vir insípiens non cognóscet: * et stultus non intélleget hæc.
verses.en: The senseless man shall not know: * nor will the fool understand these things.

verses.la: Cum exórti fúerint peccatóres sicut fænum: * et apparúerint omnes, qui operántur iniquitátem:
verses.en: When the wicked shall spring up as grass: * and all the workers of iniquity shall appear:

verses.la: Ut intéreant in sǽculum sǽculi: * tu autem Altíssimus in ætérnum, Dómine.
verses.en: That they may perish for ever and ever: * but thou, O Lord, art most high for evermore.

verses.la: Quóniam ecce inimíci tui, Dómine, quóniam ecce inimíci tui períbunt: * et dispergéntur omnes, qui operántur iniquitátem.
verses.en: For behold thy enemies, O Lord, for behold thy enemies shall perish: * and all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

verses.la: Et exaltábitur sicut unicórnis cornu meum: * et senéctus mea in misericórdia úberi.
verses.en: But my horn shall be exalted like that of the unicorn: * and my old age in plentiful mercy.

verses.la: Et despéxit óculus meus inimícos meos: * et in insurgéntibus in me malignántibus áudiet auris mea.
verses.en: My eye also hath looked down upon my enemies: * and my ear shall hear of the downfall of the malignant that rise up against me.

verses.la: Iustus, ut palma florébit: * sicut cedrus Líbani multiplicábitur.
verses.en: The just shall flourish like the palm tree: * he shall grow up like the cedar of Libanus.

verses.la: Plantáti in domo Dómini, * in átriis domus Dei nostri florébunt.
verses.en: They that are planted in the house of the Lord * shall flourish in the courts of the house of our God.

verses.la: Adhuc multiplicabúntur in senécta úberi: * et bene patiéntes erunt, ut annúntient:
verses.en: They shall still increase in a fruitful old age: * and shall be well treated, that they may shew,

verses.la: Quóniam rectus Dóminus, Deus noster: * et non est iníquitas in eo.
verses.en: That the Lord our God is righteous, * and there is no iniquity in him.

verses.la: Étenim firmávit orbem terræ, * qui non commovébitur.
verses.en: For he hath established the world * which shall not be moved.

verses.la: Paráta sedes tua ex tunc: * a sǽculo tu es.
verses.en: Thy throne is prepared from of old: * thou art from everlasting.

verses.la: Elevavérunt flúmina fluctus suos, * a vócibus aquárum multárum.
verses.en: The floods have lifted up their waves, * with the noise of many waters.

verses.la: Mirábiles elatiónes maris: * mirábilis in altis Dóminus.
verses.en: Wonderful are the surges of the sea: * wonderful is the Lord on high.

verses.la: Testimónia tua credibília facta sunt nimis: * domum tuam decet sanctitúdo, Dómine, in longitúdinem diérum.
verses.en: Thy testimonies are become exceedingly credible: * holiness becometh thy house, O Lord, unto length of days.

verses.la: Deus ultiónum Dóminus: * Deus ultiónum líbere egit.
verses.en: The Lord is the God to whom revenge belongeth: * the God of revenge hath acted freely.

verses.la: Exaltáre, qui iúdicas terram: * redde retributiónem supérbis.
verses.en: Lift up thyself, thou that judgest the earth: * render a reward to the proud.

verses.la: Úsquequo peccatóres, Dómine, * úsquequo peccatóres gloriabúntur:
verses.en: How long shall sinners, O Lord: * how long shall sinners glory?

verses.la: Effabúntur, et loquéntur iniquitátem: * loquéntur omnes, qui operántur iniustítiam?
verses.en: Shall they utter, and speak iniquity: * shall all speak who work injustice?

verses.la: Pópulum tuum, Dómine, humiliavérunt: * et hereditátem tuam vexavérunt.
verses.en: Thy people, O Lord, they have brought low: * and they have afflicted thy inheritance.

verses.la: Víduam, et ádvenam interfecérunt: * et pupíllos occidérunt.
verses.en: They have slain the widow and the stranger: * and they have murdered the fatherless.

verses.la: Et dixérunt: Non vidébit Dóminus, * nec intélleget Deus Iacob.
verses.en: And they have said: The Lord shall not see: * neither shall the God of Jacob understand.

verses.la: Intellégite, insipiéntes in pópulo: * et stulti, aliquándo sápite.
verses.en: Understand, ye senseless among the people: * and, you fools, be wise at last.

verses.la: Qui plantávit aurem, non áudiet? * aut qui finxit óculum, non consíderat?
verses.en: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? * or he that formed the eye, doth he not consider?

verses.la: Qui córripit gentes, non árguet: * qui docet hóminem sciéntiam?
verses.en: He that chastiseth nations, shall he not rebuke: * he that teacheth man knowledge?

verses.la: Dóminus scit cogitatiónes hóminum, * quóniam vanæ sunt.
verses.en: The Lord knoweth the thoughts of men, * that they are vain.

verses.la: Beátus homo, quem tu erudíeris, Dómine: * et de lege tua docúeris eum,
verses.en: Blessed is the man whom thou shalt instruct, O Lord: * and shalt teach him out of thy law.

verses.la: Ut mítiges ei a diébus malis: * donec fodiátur peccatóri fóvea.
verses.en: That thou mayst give him rest from the evil days: * till a pit be dug for the wicked.

verses.la: Quia non repéllet Dóminus plebem suam: * et hereditátem suam non derelínquet.
verses.en: For the Lord will not cast off his people: * neither will he forsake his own inheritance.

verses.la: Quoadúsque iustítia convertátur in iudícium: * et qui iuxta illam omnes qui recto sunt corde.
verses.en: Until justice be turned into judgment: * and they that are near it are all the upright in heart.

verses.la: Quis consúrget mihi advérsus malignántes? * aut quis stabit mecum advérsus operántes iniquitátem?
verses.en: Who shall rise up for me against the evildoers? * or who shall stand with me against the workers of iniquity?

verses.la: Nisi quia Dóminus adiúvit me: * paulo minus habitásset in inférno ánima mea.
verses.en: Unless the Lord had been my helper, * my soul had almost dwelt in hell.

verses.la: Si dicébam: Motus est pes meus: * misericórdia tua, Dómine, adiuvábat me.
verses.en: If I said: My foot is moved: * thy mercy, O Lord, assisted me.

verses.la: Secúndum multitúdinem dolórum meórum in corde meo: * consolatiónes tuæ lætificavérunt ánimam meam.
verses.en: According to the multitude of my sorrows in my heart, * thy comforts have given joy to my soul.

verses.la: Numquid adhǽret tibi sedes iniquitátis: * qui fingis labórem in præcépto?
verses.en: Doth the seat of iniquity stick to thee, * who framest labour in commandment?

verses.la: Captábunt in ánimam iusti: * et sánguinem innocéntem condemnábunt.
verses.en: They will hunt after the soul of the just, * and will condemn innocent blood.

verses.la: Et factus est mihi Dóminus in refúgium: * et Deus meus in adiutórium spei meæ.
verses.en: But the Lord is my refuge: * and my God the help of my hope.

verses.la: Et reddet illis iniquitátem ipsórum: et in malítia eórum dispérdet eos: * dispérdet illos Dóminus, Deus noster.
verses.en: And he will render them their iniquity: and in their malice he will destroy them: * the Lord our God will destroy them.

verses.la: Cantáte Dómino cánticum novum: * cantáte Dómino, omnis terra.
verses.en: Sing ye to the Lord a new canticle: * sing to the Lord, all the earth.

verses.la: Cantáte Dómino, et benedícite nómini eius: * annuntiáte de die in diem salutáre eius.
verses.en: Sing ye to the Lord and bless his name: * shew forth his salvation from day to day.

verses.la: Annuntiáte inter gentes glóriam eius, * in ómnibus pópulis mirabília eius.
verses.en: Declare his glory among the Gentiles: * his wonders among all people.

verses.la: Quóniam magnus Dóminus, et laudábilis nimis: * terríbilis est super omnes deos.
verses.en: For the Lord is great, and exceedingly to be praised: * he is to be feared above all gods.

verses.la: Quóniam omnes dii géntium dæmónia: * Dóminus autem cælos fecit.
verses.en: For all the gods of the Gentiles are devils: * but the Lord made the heavens.

verses.la: Conféssio, et pulchritúdo in conspéctu eius: * sanctimónia et magnificéntia in sanctificatióne eius.
verses.en: Praise and beauty are before him: * holiness and majesty in his sanctuary.

verses.la: Afférte Dómino, pátriæ géntium, afférte Dómino glóriam et honórem: * afférte Dómino glóriam nómini eius.
verses.en: Bring ye to the Lord, O ye kindreds of the Gentiles, bring ye to the Lord glory and honour: * bring to the Lord glory unto his name.

verses.la: Tóllite hóstias, et introíte in átria eius: * adoráte Dóminum in átrio sancto eius.
verses.en: Bring up sacrifices, and come into his courts: * adore ye the Lord in his holy court.

verses.la: Commoveátur a fácie eius univérsa terra: * dícite in géntibus quia Dóminus regnávit.
verses.en: Let all the earth be moved at his presence. * Say ye among the Gentiles, the Lord hath reigned.

verses.la: Étenim corréxit orbem terræ qui non commovébitur: * iudicábit pópulos in æquitáte.
verses.en: For he hath corrected the world, which shall not be moved: * he will judge the people with justice.

verses.la: Læténtur cæli, et exsúltet terra: commoveátur mare, et plenitúdo eius: * gaudébunt campi, et ómnia quæ in eis sunt.
verses.en: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad, let the sea be moved, and the fulness thereof: * the fields and all things that are in them shall be joyful.

verses.la: Tunc exsultábunt ómnia ligna silvárum a fácie Dómini, quia venit: * quóniam venit iudicáre terram.
verses.en: Then shall all the trees of the woods rejoice before the face of the Lord, because he cometh: * because he cometh to judge the earth.

verses.la: Iudicábit orbem terræ in æquitáte, * et pópulos in veritáte sua.
verses.en: He shall judge the world with justice, * and the people with his truth.

verses.la: Dóminus regnávit, exsúltet terra: * læténtur ínsulæ multæ.
verses.en: The Lord hath reigned, let the earth rejoice: * let many islands be glad.

verses.la: Nubes, et calígo in circúitu eius: * iustítia, et iudícium corréctio sedis eius.
verses.en: Clouds and darkness are round about him: * justice and judgment are the establishment of his throne.

verses.la: Ignis ante ipsum præcédet, * et inflammábit in circúitu inimícos eius.
verses.en: A fire shall go before him, * and shall burn his enemies round about.

verses.la: Illuxérunt fúlgura eius orbi terræ: * vidit, et commóta est terra.
verses.en: His lightnings have shone forth to the world: * the earth saw and trembled.

verses.la: Montes, sicut cera fluxérunt a fácie Dómini: * a fácie Dómini omnis terra.
verses.en: The mountains melted like wax, at the presence of the Lord: * at the presence of the Lord of all the earth.

verses.la: Annuntiavérunt cæli iustítiam eius: * et vidérunt omnes pópuli glóriam eius.
verses.en: The heavens declared his justice: * and all people saw his glory.

verses.la: Adoráte eum, omnes Ángeli eius: * audívit, et lætáta est Sion.
verses.en: Adore him, all you his angels: * Sion heard, and was glad.

verses.la: Et exsultavérunt fíliæ Iudæ, * propter iudícia tua, Dómine:
verses.en: And the daughters of Juda rejoiced, * because of thy judgments, O Lord.

verses.la: Quóniam tu Dóminus Altíssimus super omnem terram: * nimis exaltátus es super omnes deos.
verses.en: For thou art the most high Lord over all the earth: * thou art exalted exceedingly above all gods.

verses.la: Qui dilígitis Dóminum, odíte malum: * custódit Dóminus ánimas sanctórum suórum, de manu peccatóris liberábit eos.
verses.en: You that love the Lord, hate evil: * the Lord preserveth the souls of his saints, he will deliver them out of the hand of the sinner.

verses.la: Lux orta est iusto, * et rectis corde lætítia.
verses.en: Light is risen to the just, * and joy to the right of heart.

verses.la: Lætámini, iusti, in Dómino: * et confitémini memóriæ sanctificatiónis eius.
verses.en: Rejoice, ye just, in the Lord: * and give praise to the remembrance of his holiness.

verses.la: Salvávit sibi déxtera eius: * et brácchium sanctum eius.
verses.en: His right hand hath wrought for him salvation, * and his arm is holy.

verses.la: Notum fecit Dóminus salutáre suum: * in conspéctu géntium revelávit iustítiam suam.
verses.en: The Lord hath made known his salvation: * he hath revealed his justice in the sight of the Gentiles.

verses.la: Vidérunt omnes términi terræ * salutáre Dei nostri.
verses.en: All the ends of the earth have seen * the salvation of our God.

verses.la: Iubiláte Deo, omnis terra: * cantáte, et exsultáte, et psállite.
verses.en: Sing joyfully to God, all the earth; * make melody, rejoice and sing.

verses.la: Psállite Dómino in cíthara, in cíthara et voce psalmi: * in tubis ductílibus, et voce tubæ córneæ.
verses.en: Sing praise to the Lord on the harp, on the harp, and with the voice of a psalm: * with long trumpets, and sound of cornet.

verses.la: Iubiláte in conspéctu regis Dómini: * moveátur mare, et plenitúdo eius: orbis terrárum, et qui hábitant in eo.
verses.en: Make a joyful noise before the Lord our king: * let the sea be moved and the fulness thereof: the world and they that dwell therein.

verses.la: Flúmina plaudent manu, simul montes exsultábunt a conspéctu Dómini: * quóniam venit iudicáre terram.
verses.en: The rivers shall clap their hands, the mountains shall rejoice together at the presence of the Lord: * because he cometh to judge the earth.

verses.la: Iudicábit orbem terrárum in iustítia, * et pópulos in æquitáte.
verses.en: He shall judge the world with justice, * and the people with equity.

verses.la: Dóminus regnávit, irascántur pópuli: * qui sedet super Chérubim, moveátur terra.
verses.en: The Lord hath reigned, let the people be angry: * he that sitteth on the cherubims: let the earth be moved.

verses.la: Dóminus in Sion magnus: * et excélsus super omnes pópulos.
verses.en: The Lord is great in Sion, * and high above all people.

verses.la: Confiteántur nómini tuo magno: quóniam terríbile, et sanctum est: * et honor regis iudícium díligit.
verses.en: Let them give praise to thy great name: for it is terrible and holy: * and the king’s honour loveth judgment.

verses.la: Tu parásti directiónes: * iudícium et iustítiam in Iacob tu fecísti.
verses.en: Thou hast prepared directions: * thou hast done judgment and justice in Jacob.

verses.la: Exaltáte Dóminum, Deum nostrum, et adoráte scabéllum pedum eius: * quóniam sanctum est.
verses.en: Exalt ye the Lord our God, and adore his footstool, * for it is holy.

verses.la: Invocábant Dóminum, et ipse exaudiébat eos: * in colúmna nubis loquebátur ad eos.
verses.en: They called upon the Lord, and he heard them: * he spoke to them in the pillar of the cloud.

verses.la: Custodiébant testimónia eius, * et præcéptum quod dedit illis.
verses.en: They kept his testimonies, * and the commandment which he gave them.

verses.la: Dómine, Deus noster, tu exaudiébas eos: * Deus, tu propítius fuísti eis, et ulcíscens in omnes adinventiónes eórum.
verses.en: Thou didst hear them, O Lord our God: * thou wast a merciful God to them, and taking vengeance on all their inventions.

verses.la: Exaltáte Dóminum, Deum nostrum, et adoráte in monte sancto eius: * quóniam sanctus Dóminus, Deus noster.
verses.en: Exalt ye the Lord our God, and adore at his holy mountain: * for the Lord our God is holy.

verses.la: Introíte in conspéctu eius, * in exsultatióne.
verses.en: Come in before his presence * with exceeding great joy.

verses.la: Pópulus eius, et oves páscuæ eius: * introíte portas eius in confessióne, átria eius in hymnis: confitémini illi.
verses.en: We are his people and the sheep of his pasture. * Go ye into his gates with praise, into his courts with hymns: and give glory to him.

verses.la: Laudáte nomen eius: quóniam suávis est Dóminus, in ætérnum misericórdia eius, * et usque in generatiónem et generatiónem véritas eius.
verses.en: Praise ye his name: for the Lord is sweet, his mercy endureth for ever, * and his truth to generation and generation.

verses.la: Misericórdiam, et iudícium * cantábo tibi, Dómine:
verses.en: Mercy and judgment * I will sing to thee, O Lord:

verses.la: Perambulábam in innocéntia cordis mei, * in médio domus meæ.
verses.en: I walked in the innocence of my heart, * in the midst of my house.

verses.la: Non proponébam ante óculos meos rem iniústam: * faciéntes prævaricatiónes odívi.
verses.en: I did not set before my eyes any unjust thing: * I hated the workers of iniquities.

verses.la: Non adhǽsit mihi cor pravum: * declinántem a me malígnum non cognoscébam.
verses.en: The perverse heart did not cleave to me: * and the malignant, that turned aside from me, I would not know.

verses.la: Supérbo óculo, et insatiábili corde, * cum hoc non edébam.
verses.en: With him that had a proud eye, and an unsatiable heart, * I would not eat.

verses.la: Óculi mei ad fidéles terræ ut sédeant mecum: * ámbulans in via immaculáta, hic mihi ministrábat.
verses.en: My eyes were upon the faithful of the earth, to sit with me: * the man that walked in the perfect way, he served me.

verses.la: Non habitábit in médio domus meæ qui facit supérbiam: * qui lóquitur iníqua, non diréxit in conspéctu oculórum meórum.
verses.en: He that worketh pride shall not dwell in the midst of my house: * he that speaketh unjust things did not prosper before my eyes.

verses.la: In matutíno interficiébam omnes peccatóres terræ: * ut dispérderem de civitáte Dómini omnes operántes iniquitátem.
verses.en: In the morning I put to death all the wicked of the land: * that I might cut off all the workers of iniquity from the city of the Lord.

verses.la: Bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino: * et ómnia, quæ intra me sunt, nómini sancto eius.
verses.en: Bless the Lord, O my soul: * and let all that is within me bless his holy name.

verses.la: Bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino: * et noli oblivísci omnes retributiónes eius.
verses.en: Bless the Lord, O my soul, * and never forget all he hath done for thee.

verses.la: Qui propitiátur ómnibus iniquitátibus tuis: * qui sanat omnes infirmitátes tuas.
verses.en: Who forgiveth all thy iniquities: * who healeth all thy diseases.

verses.la: Qui rédimit de intéritu vitam tuam: * qui corónat te in misericórdia et miseratiónibus.
verses.en: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction: * who crowneth thee with mercy and compassion.

verses.la: Qui replet in bonis desidérium tuum: * renovábitur ut áquilæ iuvéntus tua:
verses.en: Who satisfieth thy desire with good things: * thy youth shall be renewed like the eagle’s.

verses.la: Fáciens misericórdias Dóminus: * et iudícium ómnibus iniúriam patiéntibus.
verses.en: The Lord doth mercies, * and judgment for all that suffer wrong.

verses.la: Notas fecit vias suas Móysi, * fíliis Israël voluntátes suas.
verses.en: He hath made his ways known to Moses: * his wills to the children of Israel.

verses.la: Miserátor, et miséricors Dóminus: * longánimis, et multum miséricors.
verses.en: The Lord is compassionate and merciful: * longsuffering and plenteous in mercy.

verses.la: Non in perpétuum irascétur: * neque in ætérnum comminábitur.
verses.en: He will not always be angry: * nor will he threaten for ever.

verses.la: Non secúndum peccáta nostra fecit nobis: * neque secúndum iniquitátes nostras retríbuit nobis.
verses.en: He hath not dealt with us according to our sins: * nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.

verses.la: Quóniam secúndum altitúdinem cæli a terra: * corroborávit misericórdiam suam super timéntes se.
verses.en: For according to the height of the heaven above the earth: * he hath strengthened his mercy towards them that fear him.

verses.la: Quantum distat ortus ab occidénte: * longe fecit a nobis iniquitátes nostras.
verses.en: As far as the east is from the west, * so far hath he removed our iniquities from us.

verses.la: Quómodo miserétur pater filiórum, misértus est Dóminus timéntibus se: * quóniam ipse cognóvit figméntum nostrum.
verses.en: As a father hath compassion on his children, so hath the Lord compassion on them that fear him: * for he knoweth our frame.

verses.la: Recordátus est quóniam pulvis sumus: * homo, sicut fænum dies eius, tamquam flos agri sic efflorébit.
verses.en: He remembereth that we are dust: * man’s days are as grass, as the flower of the field so shall he flourish.

verses.la: Quóniam spíritus pertransíbit in illo, et non subsístet: * et non cognóscet ámplius locum suum.
verses.en: For the spirit shall pass in him, and he shall not be: * and he shall know his place no more.

verses.la: Et iustítia illíus in fílios filiórum, * his qui servant testaméntum eius:
verses.en: And his justice unto children’s children, * to such as keep his covenant,

verses.la: Et mémores sunt mandatórum ipsíus, * ad faciéndum ea.
verses.en: And are mindful of his commandments * to do them.

verses.la: Dóminus in cælo parávit sedem suam: * et regnum ipsíus ómnibus dominábitur.
verses.en: The Lord hath prepared his throne in heaven: * and his kingdom shall rule over all.

verses.la: Benedícite Dómino, omnes Ángeli eius: * poténtes virtúte, faciéntes verbum illíus, ad audiéndam vocem sermónum eius.
verses.en: Bless the Lord, all ye his angels: * you that are mighty in strength, and execute his word, hearkening to the voice of his orders.

verses.la: Benedícite Dómino, omnes virtútes eius: * minístri eius, qui fácitis voluntátem eius.
verses.en: Bless the Lord, all ye his hosts: * you ministers of his that do his will.

verses.la: Benedícite Dómino, ómnia ópera eius: * in omni loco dominatiónis eius, bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino.
verses.en: Bless the Lord, all his works: * in every place of his dominion, O my soul, bless thou the Lord.

verses.la: Confessiónem, et decórem induísti: * amíctus lúmine sicut vestiménto:
verses.en: Thou hast put on praise and beauty: * and art clothed with light as with a garment.

verses.la: Exténdens cælum sicut pellem: * qui tegis aquis superióra eius.
verses.en: Who stretchest out the heaven like a pavilion: * who coverest the higher rooms thereof with water.

verses.la: Qui ponis nubem ascénsum tuum: * qui ámbulas super pennas ventórum.
verses.en: Who makest the clouds thy chariot: * who walkest upon the wings of the winds.

verses.la: Qui facis ángelos tuos, spíritus: * et minístros tuos ignem uréntem.
verses.en: Who makest thy angels spirits: * and thy ministers a burning fire.

verses.la: Qui fundásti terram super stabilitátem suam: * non inclinábitur in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.en: Who hast founded the earth upon its own bases: * it shall not be moved for ever and ever.

verses.la: Abýssus, sicut vestiméntum, amíctus eius: * super montes stabunt aquæ.
verses.en: The deep like a garment is its clothing: * above the mountains shall the waters stand.

verses.la: Ab increpatióne tua fúgient: * a voce tonítrui tui formidábunt.
verses.en: At thy rebuke they shall flee: * at the voice of thy thunder they shall fear.

verses.la: Ascéndunt montes: et descéndunt campi * in locum, quem fundásti eis.
verses.en: The mountains ascend, and the plains descend * into the place which thou hast founded for them.

verses.la: Términum posuísti, quem non transgrediéntur: * neque converténtur operíre terram.
verses.en: Thou hast set a bound which they shall not pass over; * neither shall they return to cover the earth.

verses.la: Qui emíttis fontes in convállibus: * inter médium móntium pertransíbunt aquæ.
verses.en: Thou sendest forth springs in the vales: * between the midst of the hills the waters shall pass.

verses.la: Potábunt omnes béstiæ agri: * exspectábunt ónagri in siti sua.
verses.en: All the beasts of the field shall drink: * the wild asses shall expect in their thirst.

verses.la: Super ea vólucres cæli habitábunt: * de médio petrárum dabunt voces.
verses.en: Over them the birds of the air shall dwell: * from the midst of the rocks they shall give forth their voices.

verses.la: Rigans montes de superióribus suis: * de fructu óperum tuórum satiábitur terra:
verses.en: Thou waterest the hills from thy upper rooms: * the earth shall be filled with the fruit of thy works:

verses.la: Ut edúcas panem de terra: * et vinum lætíficet cor hóminis:
verses.en: That thou mayst bring bread out of the earth: * and that wine may cheer the heart of man.

verses.la: Ut exhílaret fáciem in óleo: * et panis cor hóminis confírmet.
verses.en: That he may make the face cheerful with oil: * and that bread may strengthen man’s heart.

verses.la: Saturabúntur ligna campi, et cedri Líbani, quas plantávit: * illic pásseres nidificábunt.
verses.en: The trees of the field shall be filled, and the cedars of Libanus which he hath planted: * there the sparrows shall make their nests.

verses.la: Heródii domus dux est eórum: * montes excélsi cervis: petra refúgium herináciis.
verses.en: The highest of them is the house of the heron. * The high hills are a refuge for the harts, the rock for the irchins.

verses.la: Fecit lunam in témpora: * sol cognóvit occásum suum.
verses.en: He hath made the moon for seasons: * the sun knoweth his going down.

verses.la: Posuísti ténebras, et facta est nox: * in ipsa pertransíbunt omnes béstiæ silvæ.
verses.en: Thou hast appointed darkness, and it is night: * in it shall all the beasts of the woods go about:

verses.la: Cátuli leónum rugiéntes, ut rápiant, * et quærant a Deo escam sibi.
verses.en: The young lions roaring after their prey, * and seeking their meat from God.

verses.la: Ortus est sol, et congregáti sunt: * et in cubílibus suis collocabúntur.
verses.en: The sun ariseth, and they are gathered together: * and they shall lie down in their dens.

verses.la: Exíbit homo ad opus suum: * et ad operatiónem suam usque ad vésperum.
verses.en: Man shall go forth to his work, * and to his labour until the evening.

verses.la: Quam magnificáta sunt ópera tua, Dómine! * ómnia in sapiéntia fecísti: impléta est terra possessióne tua.
verses.en: How great are thy works, O Lord? * thou hast made all things in wisdom: the earth is filled with thy riches.

verses.la: Hoc mare magnum, et spatiósum mánibus: * illic reptília, quorum non est númerus.
verses.en: So is this great sea, which stretcheth wide its arms: * there are creeping things without number:

verses.la: Animália pusílla cum magnis: * illic naves pertransíbunt.
verses.en: Creatures little and great. * There the ships shall go.

verses.la: Draco iste, quem formásti ad illudéndum ei: * ómnia a te exspéctant ut des illis escam in témpore.
verses.en: This sea dragon which thou hast formed to play therein. * All expect of thee that thou give them food in season.

verses.la: Dante te illis, cólligent: * aperiénte te manum tuam, ómnia implebúntur bonitáte.
verses.en: What thou givest to them they shall gather up: * when thou openest thy hand, they shall all be filled with good.

verses.la: Averténte autem te fáciem, turbabúntur: * áuferes spíritum eórum, et defícient, et in púlverem suum reverténtur.
verses.en: But if thou turnest away thy face, they shall be troubled: * thou shalt take away their breath, and they shall fail, and shall return to their dust.

verses.la: Emíttes spíritum tuum, et creabúntur: * et renovábis fáciem terræ.
verses.en: Thou shalt send forth thy spirit, and they shall be created: * and thou shalt renew the face of the earth.

verses.la: Sit glória Dómini in sǽculum: * lætábitur Dóminus in opéribus suis:
verses.en: May the glory of the Lord endure for ever: * the Lord shall rejoice in his works.

verses.la: Qui réspicit terram, et facit eam trémere: * qui tangit montes, et fúmigant.
verses.en: He looketh upon the earth, and maketh it tremble: * he toucheth the mountains, and they smoke.

verses.la: Cantábo Dómino in vita mea: * psallam Deo meo, quámdiu sum.
verses.en: I will sing to the Lord as long as I live: * I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

verses.la: Iucúndum sit ei elóquium meum: * ego vero delectábor in Dómino.
verses.en: Let my speech be acceptable to him: * but I will take delight in the Lord.

verses.la: Defíciant peccatóres a terra, et iníqui ita ut non sint: * bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino.
verses.en: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth, and the unjust, so that they be no more: * O my soul, bless thou the Lord.

verses.la: Confitémini Dómino, et invocáte nomen eius: * annuntiáte inter gentes ópera eius.
verses.en: Give glory to the Lord, and call upon his name: * declare his deeds among the Gentiles.

verses.la: Cantáte ei, et psállite ei: * narráte ómnia mirabília eius.
verses.en: Sing to him, yea sing praises to him: * relate all his wondrous works.

verses.la: Laudámini in nómine sancto eius: * lætétur cor quæréntium Dóminum.
verses.en: Glory ye in his holy name: * let the heart of them rejoice that seek the Lord.

verses.la: Quǽrite Dóminum, et confirmámini: * quǽrite fáciem eius semper.
verses.en: Seek ye the Lord, and be strengthened: * seek his face evermore.

verses.la: Mementóte mirabílium eius, quæ fecit: * prodígia eius, et iudícia oris eius.
verses.en: Remember his marvellous works which he hath done; * his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth.

verses.la: Semen Ábraham, servi eius: * fílii Iacob, elécti eius.
verses.en: O ye seed of Abraham his servant; * ye sons of Jacob his chosen.

verses.la: Ipse Dóminus Deus noster: * in univérsa terra iudícia eius.
verses.en: He is the Lord our God: * his judgments are in all the earth.

verses.la: Memor fuit in sǽculum testaménti sui: * verbi, quod mandávit in mille generatiónes:
verses.en: He hath remembered his covenant for ever: * the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.

verses.la: Quod dispósuit ad Ábraham: * et iuraménti sui ad Isaac:
verses.en: Which he made to Abraham; * and his oath to Isaac:

verses.la: Et státuit illud Iacob in præcéptum: * et Israël in testaméntum ætérnum:
verses.en: And he appointed the same to Jacob for a law, * and to Israel for an everlasting testament:

verses.la: Dicens: Tibi dabo terram Chánaan, * funículum hereditátis vestræ.
verses.en: Saying: To thee will I give the land of Chanaan, * the lot of your inheritance.

verses.la: Cum essent número brevi, * paucíssimi et íncolæ eius:
verses.en: When they were but a small number: * yea very few, and sojourners therein:

verses.la: Et pertransiérunt de gente in gentem, * et de regno ad pópulum álterum.
verses.en: And they passed from nation to nation, * and from one kingdom to another people.

verses.la: Non relíquit hóminem nocére eis: * et corrípuit pro eis reges.
verses.en: He suffered no man to hurt them: * and he reproved kings for their sakes.

verses.la: Nolíte tángere christos meos: * et in prophétis meis nolíte malignári.
verses.en: Touch ye not my anointed: * and do no evil to my prophets.

verses.la: Et vocávit famem super terram: * et omne firmaméntum panis contrívit.
verses.en: And he called a famine upon the land: * and he broke in pieces all the support of bread.

verses.la: Misit ante eos virum: * in servum venúmdatus est Ioseph.
verses.en: He sent a man before them: * Joseph, who was sold for a slave.

verses.la: Humiliavérunt in compédibus pedes eius, ferrum pertránsiit ánimam eius * donec veníret verbum eius.
verses.en: They humbled his feet in fetters: the iron pierced his soul, * until his word came.

verses.la: Elóquium Dómini inflammávit eum: * misit rex, et solvit eum; princeps populórum, et dimísit eum.
verses.en: The word of the Lord inflamed him: * the king sent, and he released him: the ruler of the people, and he set him at liberty.

verses.la: Constítuit eum dóminum domus suæ: * et príncipem omnis possessiónis suæ:
verses.en: He made him master of his house, * and ruler of all his possession.

verses.la: Ut erudíret príncipes eius sicut semetípsum: * et senes eius prudéntiam docéret.
verses.en: That he might instruct his princes as himself, * and teach his ancients wisdom.

verses.la: Et intrávit Israël in Ægýptum: * et Iacob áccola fuit in terra Cham.
verses.en: And Israel went into Egypt: * and Jacob was a sojourner in the land of Cham.

verses.la: Et auxit pópulum suum veheménter: * et firmávit eum super inimícos eius.
verses.en: And he increased his people exceedingly: * and strengthened them over their enemies,

verses.la: Convértit cor eórum ut odírent pópulum eius: * et dolum fácerent in servos eius.
verses.en: He turned their heart to hate his people: * and to deal deceitfully with his servants.

verses.la: Misit Móysen, servum suum: * Aaron, quem elégit ipsum.
verses.en: He sent Moses his servant: * Aaron the man whom he had chosen.

verses.la: Pósuit in eis verba signórum suórum: * et prodigiórum in terra Cham.
verses.en: He gave them power to shew his signs, * and his wonders in the land of Cham.

verses.la: Misit ténebras, et obscurávit: * et non exacerbávit sermónes suos.
verses.en: He sent darkness, and made it obscure: * and grieved not his words.

verses.la: Convértit aquas eórum in sánguinem: * et occídit pisces eórum.
verses.en: He turned their waters into blood, * and destroyed their fish.

verses.la: Édidit terra eórum ranas: * in penetrálibus regum ipsórum.
verses.en: Their land brought forth frogs, * in the inner chambers of their kings.

verses.la: Dixit, et venit cœnomyía: * et cínifes in ómnibus fínibus eórum.
verses.en: He spoke, and there came diverse sorts of flies, * and sciniphs in all their coasts.

verses.la: Pósuit plúvias eórum grándinem: * ignem comburéntem in terra ipsórum.
verses.en: He gave them hail for rain, * a burning fire in the land.

verses.la: Et percússit víneas eórum, et ficúlneas eórum: * et contrívit lignum fínium eórum.
verses.en: And he destroyed their vineyards, and their fig trees: * and he broke in pieces the trees of their coasts.

verses.la: Dixit, et venit locústa, et bruchus, * cuius non erat númerus:
verses.en: He spoke, and the locust came, and the bruchus, * of which there was no number.

verses.la: Et comédit omne fænum in terra eórum: * et comédit omnem fructum terræ eórum.
verses.en: And they devoured all the grass in their land, * and consumed all the fruit of their ground.

verses.la: Et percússit omne primogénitum in terra eórum: * primítias omnis labóris eórum.
verses.en: And he slew all the firstborn in their land: * the firstfruits of all their labour.

verses.la: Et edúxit eos cum argénto et auro: * et non erat in tríbubus eórum infírmus.
verses.en: And he brought them out with silver and gold: * and there was not among their tribes one that was feeble.

verses.la: Lætáta est Ægýptus in profectióne eórum: * quia incúbuit timor eórum super eos.
verses.en: Egypt was glad when they departed: * for the fear of them lay upon them.

verses.la: Expándit nubem in protectiónem eórum: * et ignem ut lucéret eis per noctem.
verses.en: He spread a cloud for their protection, * and fire to give them light in the night.

verses.la: Petiérunt, et venit cotúrnix: * et pane cæli saturávit eos.
verses.en: They asked, and the quail came: * and he filled them with the bread of heaven.

verses.la: Dirúpit petram et fluxérunt aquæ: * abiérunt in sicco flúmina;
verses.en: He opened the rock, and waters flowed: * rivers ran down in the dry land.

verses.la: Quóniam memor fuit verbi sancti sui: * quod hábuit ad Ábraham, púerum suum.
verses.en: Because he remembered his holy word, * which he had spoken to his servant Abraham.

verses.la: Et edúxit pópulum suum in exsultatióne, * et eléctos suos in lætítia.
verses.en: And he brought forth his people with joy, * and his chosen with gladness.

verses.la: Et dedit illis regiónes géntium: * et labóres populórum possedérunt:
verses.en: And he gave them the lands of the Gentiles: * and they possessed the labours of the people:

verses.la: Ut custódiant iustificatiónes eius, * et legem eius requírant.
verses.en: That they might observe his justifications, * and seek after his law.

verses.la: Confitémini Dómino, quóniam bonus: * quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: Give glory to the Lord, for he is good: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Quis loquétur poténtias Dómini, * audítas fáciet omnes laudes eius?
verses.en: Who shall declare the powers of the Lord? * who shall set forth all his praises?

verses.la: Beáti, qui custódiunt iudícium, * et fáciunt iustítiam in omni témpore.
verses.en: Blessed are they that keep judgment, * and do justice at all times.

verses.la: Meménto nostri, Dómine, in beneplácito pópuli tui: * vísita nos in salutári tuo:
verses.en: Remember us, O Lord, in the favour of thy people: * visit us with thy salvation.

verses.la: Ad vidéndum in bonitáte electórum tuórum, ad lætándum in lætítia gentis tuæ: * ut laudéris cum hereditáte tua.
verses.en: That we may see the good of thy chosen, that we may rejoice in the joy of thy nation: * that thou mayst be praised with thy inheritance.

verses.la: Peccávimus cum pátribus nostris: * iniúste égimus, iniquitátem fécimus.
verses.en: We have sinned with our fathers: * we have acted unjustly, we have wrought iniquity.

verses.la: Et irritavérunt ascendéntes in mare, * Mare Rubrum.
verses.en: And they provoked to wrath going up to the sea, * even the Red Sea.

verses.la: Et salvávit eos propter nomen suum: * ut notam fáceret poténtiam suam.
verses.en: And he saved them for his own name’s sake: * that he might make his power known.

verses.la: Et incrépuit Mare Rubrum, et exsiccátum est, * et dedúxit eos in abýssis sicut in desérto.
verses.en: And he rebuked the Red Sea, and it was dried up: * and he led them through the depths, as in a wilderness.

verses.la: Et salvávit eos de manu odiéntium: * et redémit eos de manu inimíci.
verses.en: And he saved them from the hand of them that hated them: * and he redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

verses.la: Et opéruit aqua tribulántes eos: * unus ex eis non remánsit.
verses.en: And the water covered them that afflicted them: * there was not one of them left.

verses.la: Et credidérunt verbis eius: * et laudavérunt laudem eius.
verses.en: And they believed his words: * and they sang his praises.

verses.la: Cito fecérunt, oblíti sunt óperum eius: * et non sustinuérunt consílium eius.
verses.en: They had quickly done, they forgot his works: * and they waited not for his counsels.

verses.la: Et concupiérunt concupiscéntiam in desérto: * et tentavérunt Deum in inaquóso.
verses.en: And they coveted their desire in the desert: * and they tempted God in the place without water.

verses.la: Et dedit eis petitiónem ipsórum: * et misit saturitátem in ánimas eórum.
verses.en: And he gave them their request: * and sent fulness into their souls.

verses.la: Et irritavérunt Móysen in castris: * Aaron, sanctum Dómini.
verses.en: And they provoked Moses in the camp, * Aaron the holy one of the Lord.

verses.la: Apérta est terra, et deglutívit Dathan: * et opéruit super congregatiónem Abíron.
verses.en: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan: * and covered the congregation of Abiron.

verses.la: Et exársit ignis in synagóga eórum * flamma combússit peccatóres.
verses.en: And a fire was kindled in their congregation: * the flame burned the wicked.

verses.la: Et fecérunt vítulum in Horeb * et adoravérunt scúlptile.
verses.en: They made also a calf in Horeb: * and they adored the graven thing.

verses.la: Et mutavérunt glóriam suam * in similitúdinem vítuli comedéntis fænum.
verses.en: And they changed their glory * into the likeness of a calf that eateth grass.

verses.la: Oblíti sunt Deum, qui salvávit eos, * qui fecit magnália in Ægýpto, mirabília in terra Cham: terribília in Mari Rubro.
verses.en: They forgot God, who saved them, * who had done great things in Egypt, wondrous works in the land of Cham: terrible things in the Red Sea.

verses.la: Et dixit ut dispérderet eos: * si non Móyses, eléctus eius, stetísset in confractióne in conspéctu eius:
verses.en: And he said that he would destroy them: * had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach:

verses.la: Ut avérteret iram eius ne dispérderet eos: * et pro níhilo habuérunt terram desiderábilem:
verses.en: To turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them; * and they set at nought the desirable land.

verses.la: Non credidérunt verbo eius, et murmuravérunt in tabernáculis suis: * non exaudiérunt vocem Dómini.
verses.en: They believed not his word, and they murmured in their tents: * they hearkened not to the voice of the Lord.

verses.la: Et elevávit manum suam super eos: * ut prostérneret eos in desérto:
verses.en: And he lifted up his hand over them: * to overthrow them in the desert;

verses.la: Et ut deíceret semen eórum in natiónibus: * et dispérgeret eos in regiónibus.
verses.en: And to cast down their seed among the nations, * and to scatter them in the countries.

verses.la: Et initiáti sunt Beélphegor: * et comedérunt sacrifícia mortuórum.
verses.en: They also were initiated to Beelphegor: * and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

verses.la: Et irritavérunt eum in adinventiónibus suis: * et multiplicáta est in eis ruína.
verses.en: And they provoked him with their inventions: * and destruction was multiplied among them.

verses.la: Et stetit Phínees, et placávit: * et cessávit quassátio.
verses.en: Then Phinees stood up, and pacified him: * and the slaughter ceased.

verses.la: Et reputátum est ei in iustítiam: * in generatiónem et generatiónem usque in sempitérnum.
verses.en: And it was reputed to him unto justice, * to generation and generation for evermore.

verses.la: Et irritavérunt eum ad aquas contradictiónis: * et vexátus est Móyses propter eos: quia exacerbavérunt spíritum eius.
verses.en: They provoked him also at the waters of contradiction: * and Moses was afflicted for their sakes: because they exasperated his spirit.

verses.la: Et distínxit in lábiis suis: * non disperdidérunt gentes, quas dixit Dóminus illis.
verses.en: And he distinguished with his lips; * they did not destroy the nations of which the Lord spoke unto them.

verses.la: Et commísti sunt inter gentes, et didicérunt ópera eórum: et serviérunt sculptílibus eórum: * et factum est illis in scándalum.
verses.en: And they were mingled among the heathens, and learned their works: and served their idols, * and it became a stumblingblock to them.

verses.la: Et immolavérunt fílios suos, * et fílias suas dæmóniis.
verses.en: And they sacrificed their sons, * and their daughters to devils.

verses.la: Et effudérunt sánguinem innocéntem: * sánguinem filiórum suórum et filiárum suárum, quas sacrificavérunt sculptílibus Chánaan.
verses.en: And they shed innocent blood: * the blood of their sons and of their daughters which they sacrificed to the idols of Chanaan.

verses.la: Et infécta est terra in sanguínibus, et contamináta est in opéribus eórum: * et fornicáti sunt in adinventiónibus suis.
verses.en: And the land was polluted with blood, and was defiled with their works: * and they went aside after their own inventions.

verses.la: Et irátus est furóre Dóminus in pópulum suum: * et abominátus est hereditátem suam.
verses.en: And the Lord was exceedingly angry with his people: * and he abhorred his inheritance.

verses.la: Et trádidit eos in manus géntium: * et domináti sunt eórum qui odérunt eos.
verses.en: And he delivered them into the hands of the nations: * and they that hated them had dominion over them.

verses.la: Et tribulavérunt eos inimíci eórum, et humiliáti sunt sub mánibus eórum: * sæpe liberávit eos.
verses.en: And their enemies afflicted them: and they were humbled under their hands: * many times did he deliver them.

verses.la: Ipsi autem exacerbavérunt eum in consílio suo: * et humiliáti sunt in iniquitátibus suis.
verses.en: But they provoked him with their counsel: * and they were brought low by their iniquities.

verses.la: Et vidit, cum tribularéntur: * et audívit oratiónem eórum.
verses.en: And he saw when they were in tribulation: * and he heard their prayer.

verses.la: Et memor fuit testaménti sui: * et pœnítuit eum secúndum multitúdinem misericórdiæ suæ.
verses.en: And he was mindful of his covenant: * and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.

verses.la: Et dedit eos in misericórdias * in conspéctu ómnium qui céperant eos.
verses.en: And he gave them unto mercies, * in the sight of all those that had made them captives.

verses.la: Ut confiteámur nómini sancto tuo: * et gloriémur in laude tua.
verses.en: That we may give thanks to thy holy name, * and may glory in thy praise.

verses.la: Benedíctus Dóminus, Deus Israël, a sǽculo et usque in sǽculum: * et dicet omnis pópulus: Fiat, fiat.
verses.en: Blessed be the Lord the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting: * and let all the people say: So be it, so be it.

verses.la: Confitémini Dómino quóniam bonus: * quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: Give glory to the Lord, for he is good: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Dicant qui redémpti sunt a Dómino, quos redémit de manu inimíci: * et de regiónibus congregávit eos:
verses.en: Let them say so that have been redeemed by the Lord, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy: * and gathered out of the countries.

verses.la: A solis ortu, et occásu: * ab aquilóne, et mari.
verses.en: From the rising and the setting of the sun, * from the north and from the sea.

verses.la: Erravérunt in solitúdine in inaquóso: * viam civitátis habitáculi non invenérunt.
verses.en: They wandered in a wilderness, in a place without water: * they found not the way of a city for their habitation.

verses.la: Esuriéntes, et sitiéntes: * ánima eórum in ipsis defécit.
verses.en: They were hungry and thirsty: * their soul fainted in them.

verses.la: Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: * et de necessitátibus eórum erípuit eos.
verses.en: And they cried to the Lord in their tribulation: * and he delivered them out of their distresses.

verses.la: Et dedúxit eos in viam rectam: * ut irent in civitátem habitatiónis.
verses.en: And he led them into the right way: * that they might go to a city of habitation.

verses.la: Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ eius: * et mirabília eius fíliis hóminum.
verses.en: Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to him: * and his wonderful works to the children of men.

verses.la: Quia satiávit ánimam inánem: * et ánimam esuriéntem satiávit bonis.
verses.en: For he hath satisfied the empty soul, * and hath filled the hungry soul with good things.

verses.la: Sedéntes in ténebris, et umbra mortis: * vinctos in mendicitáte et ferro.
verses.en: Such as sat in darkness and in the shadow of death: * bound in want and in iron.

verses.la: Quia exacerbavérunt elóquia Dei: * et consílium Altíssimi irritavérunt.
verses.en: Because they had exasperated the words of God: * and provoked the counsel of the most High:

verses.la: Et humiliátum est in labóribus cor eórum: * infirmáti sunt, nec fuit qui adiuváret.
verses.en: And their heart was humbled with labours: * they were weakened, and there was none to help them.

verses.la: Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: * et de necessitátibus eórum liberávit eos.
verses.en: Then they cried to the Lord in their affliction: * and he delivered them out of their distresses.

verses.la: Et edúxit eos de ténebris, et umbra mortis: * et víncula eórum disrúpit.
verses.en: And he brought them out of darkness, * and the shadow of death; and broke their bonds in sunder.

verses.la: Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ eius: * et mirabília eius fíliis hóminum.
verses.en: Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to him, * and his wonderful works to the children of men.

verses.la: Quia contrívit portas ǽreas: * et vectes férreos confrégit.
verses.en: Because he hath broken gates of brass, * and burst the iron bars.

verses.la: Suscépit eos de via iniquitátis eórum: * propter iniustítias enim suas humiliáti sunt.
verses.en: He took them out of the way of their iniquity: * for they were brought low for their injustices.

verses.la: Omnem escam abomináta est ánima eórum: * et appropinquavérunt usque ad portas mortis.
verses.en: Their soul abhorred all manner of meat: * and they drew nigh even to the gates of death.

verses.la: Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: * et de necessitátibus eórum liberávit eos.
verses.en: And they cried to the Lord in their affliction: * and he delivered them out of their distresses.

verses.la: Misit verbum suum, et sanávit eos: * et erípuit eos de interitiónibus eórum.
verses.en: He sent his word, and healed them: * and delivered them from their destructions.

verses.la: Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ eius: * et mirabília eius fíliis hóminum.
verses.en: Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to him: * and his wonderful works to the children of men.

verses.la: Et sacríficent sacrifícium laudis: * et annúntient ópera eius in exsultatióne.
verses.en: And let them sacrifice the sacrifice of praise: * and declare his works with joy.

verses.la: Qui descéndunt mare in návibus, * faciéntes operatiónem in aquis multis.
verses.en: They that go down to the sea in ships, * doing business in the great waters:

verses.la: Ipsi vidérunt ópera Dómini, * et mirabília eius in profúndo.
verses.en: These have seen the works of the Lord, * and his wonders in the deep.

verses.la: Dixit, et stetit spíritus procéllæ: * et exaltáti sunt fluctus eius.
verses.en: He said the word, and there arose a storm of wind: * and the waves thereof were lifted up.

verses.la: Ascéndunt usque ad cælos, et descéndunt usque ad abýssos: * ánima eórum in malis tabescébat.
verses.en: They mount up to the heavens, and they go down to the depths: * their soul pined away with evils.

verses.la: Turbáti sunt, et moti sunt sicut ébrius: * et omnis sapiéntia eórum devoráta est.
verses.en: They were troubled, and reeled like a drunken man; * and all their wisdom was swallowed up.

verses.la: Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: * et de necessitátibus eórum edúxit eos.
verses.en: And they cried to the Lord in their affliction: * and he brought them out of their distresses.

verses.la: Et státuit procéllam eius in auram: * et siluérunt fluctus eius.
verses.en: And he turned the storm into a breeze: * and its waves were still.

verses.la: Et lætáti sunt quia siluérunt: * et dedúxit eos in portum voluntátis eórum.
verses.en: And they rejoiced because they were still: * and he brought them to the haven which they wished for.

verses.la: Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ eius: * et mirabília eius fíliis hóminum.
verses.en: Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to him, * and his wonderful works to the children of men.

verses.la: Et exáltent eum in ecclésia plebis: * et in cáthedra seniórum laudent eum.
verses.en: And let them exalt him in the church of the people: * and praise him in the chair of the ancients.

verses.la: Pósuit flúmina in desértum: * et éxitus aquárum in sitim.
verses.en: He hath turned rivers into a wilderness: * and the sources of water into dry ground:

verses.la: Terram fructíferam in salsúginem: * a malítia inhabitántium in ea.
verses.en: A fruitful land into barrenness, * for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

verses.la: Pósuit desértum in stagna aquárum: * et terram sine aqua in éxitus aquárum.
verses.en: He hath turned a wilderness into pools of water, * and a dry land into water springs.

verses.la: Et collocávit illic esuriéntes: * et constituérunt civitátem habitatiónis.
verses.en: And hath placed there the hungry; * and they made a city for their habitation.

verses.la: Et seminavérunt agros, et plantavérunt víneas: * et fecérunt fructum nativitátis.
verses.en: And they sowed fields, and planted vineyards: * and they yielded fruit of birth.

verses.la: Et benedíxit eis, et multiplicáti sunt nimis: * et iuménta eórum non minorávit.
verses.en: And he blessed them, and they were multiplied exceedingly: * and their cattle he suffered not to decrease.

verses.la: Et pauci facti sunt: * et vexáti sunt a tribulatióne malórum, et dolóre.
verses.en: Then they were brought to be few: * and they were afflicted through the trouble of evils and sorrow.

verses.la: Effúsa est contémptio super príncipes: * et erráre fecit eos in ínvio, et non in via.
verses.en: Contempt was poured forth upon their princes: * and he caused them to wander where there was no passing, and out of the way.

verses.la: Et adiúvit páuperem de inópia: * et pósuit sicut oves famílias.
verses.en: And he helped the poor out of poverty: * and made him families like a flock of sheep.

verses.la: Vidébunt recti, et lætabúntur: * et omnis iníquitas oppilábit os suum.
verses.en: The just shall see, and shall rejoice, * and all iniquity shall stop their mouth.

verses.la: Quis sápiens et custódiet hæc? * et intélleget misericórdias Dómini.
verses.en: Who is wise, and will keep these things: * and will understand the mercies of the Lord?

verses.la: Parátum cor meum, Deus, parátum cor meum: * cantábo, et psallam in glória mea.
verses.en: My heart is ready, O God, my heart is ready: * I will sing, and will give praise, with my glory.

verses.la: Exsúrge, glória mea, exsúrge, psaltérium et cíthara: * exsúrgam dilúculo.
verses.en: Arise, my glory; arise, psaltery and harp * I will arise in the morning early.

verses.la: Confitébor tibi in pópulis, Dómine: * et psallam tibi in natiónibus.
verses.en: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: * and I will sing unto thee among the nations.

verses.la: Quia magna est super cælos misericórdia tua: * et usque ad nubes véritas tua:
verses.en: For thy mercy is great above the heavens: * and thy truth even unto the clouds.

verses.la: Exaltáre super cælos, Deus, et super omnem terram glória tua: * ut liberéntur dilécti tui.
verses.en: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens, and thy glory over all the earth: * that thy beloved may be delivered.

verses.la: Salvum fac déxtera tua, et exáudi me: * Deus locútus est in sancto suo:
verses.en: Save with thy right hand and hear me. * God hath spoken in his holiness.

verses.la: Exsultábo, et dívidam Síchimam, * et convállem tabernaculórum dimétiar.
verses.en: I will rejoice, and I will divide Sichem * and I will mete out the vale of tabernacles.

verses.la: Meus est Gálaad, et meus est Manásses: * et Éphraim suscéptio cápitis mei.
verses.en: Galaad is mine: and Manasses is mine: * and Ephraim the protection of my head.

verses.la: In Idumǽam exténdam calceaméntum meum: * mihi alienígenæ amíci facti sunt.
verses.en: Over Edom I will stretch out my shoe: * the aliens are become my friends.

verses.la: Quis dedúcet me in civitátem munítam? * quis dedúcet me usque in Idumǽam?
verses.en: Who will bring me into the strong city? * who will lead me into Edom?

verses.la: Nonne tu, Deus, qui repulísti nos, * et non exíbis, Deus, in virtútibus nostris?
verses.en: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? * and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our armies?

verses.la: Da nobis auxílium de tribulatióne: * quia vana salus hóminis.
verses.en: O grant us help from trouble: * for vain is the help of man.

verses.la: In Deo faciémus virtútem: * et ipse ad níhilum dedúcet inimícos nostros.
verses.en: Through God we shall do mightily: * and he will bring our enemies to nothing.

verses.la: Donec ponam inimícos tuos, * scabéllum pedum tuórum.
verses.en: Until I make thy enemies * thy footstool.

verses.la: Virgam virtútis tuæ emíttet Dóminus ex Sion: * domináre in médio inimicórum tuórum.
verses.en: The Lord will send forth the sceptre of thy power out of Sion: * rule thou in the midst of thy enemies.

verses.la: Tecum princípium in die virtútis tuæ in splendóribus sanctórum: * ex útero ante lucíferum génui te.
verses.en: With thee is the principality in the day of thy strength: in the brightness of the saints: * from the womb before the day star I begot thee.

verses.la: Iurávit Dóminus, et non pœnitébit eum: * Tu es sacérdos in ætérnum secúndum órdinem Melchísedech.
verses.en: The Lord hath sworn, and he will not repent: * Thou art a priest for ever according to the order of Melchisedech.

verses.la: Dóminus a dextris tuis, * confrégit in die iræ suæ reges.
verses.en: The Lord at thy right hand * hath broken kings in the day of his wrath.

verses.la: Iudicábit in natiónibus, implébit ruínas: * conquassábit cápita in terra multórum.
verses.en: He shall judge among nations, he shall fill ruins: * he shall crush the heads in the land of many.

verses.la: De torrénte in via bibet: * proptérea exaltábit caput.
verses.en: He shall drink of the torrent in the way: * therefore shall he lift up the head.

verses.la: Confitébor tibi, Dómine, in toto corde meo: * in consílio iustórum, et congregatióne.
verses.en: I will praise thee, O Lord, with my whole heart; * in the council of the just, and in the congregation.

verses.la: Magna ópera Dómini: * exquisíta in omnes voluntátes eius.
verses.en: Great are the works of the Lord: * sought out according to all his wills.

verses.la: Conféssio et magnificéntia opus eius: * et iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.en: His work is praise and magnificence: * and his justice continueth for ever and ever.

verses.la: Memóriam fecit mirabílium suórum, miséricors et miserátor Dóminus: * escam dedit timéntibus se.
verses.en: He hath made a remembrance of his wonderful works, being a merciful and gracious Lord: * he hath given food to them that fear him.

verses.la: Memor erit in sǽculum testaménti sui: * virtútem óperum suórum annuntiábit pópulo suo:
verses.en: He will be mindful for ever of his covenant: * he will shew forth to his people the power of his works.

verses.la: Ut det illis hereditátem géntium: * ópera mánuum eius véritas, et iudícium.
verses.en: That he may give them the inheritance of the Gentiles: * the works of his hands are truth and judgment.

verses.la: Fidélia ómnia mandáta eius: confirmáta in sǽculum sǽculi, * facta in veritáte et æquitáte.
verses.en: All his commandments are faithful: confirmed for ever and ever, * made in truth and equity.

verses.la: (fit reverentia) Sanctum, et terríbile nomen eius: * inítium sapiéntiæ timor Dómini.
verses.en: (bow head) Holy and terrible is his name: * the fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom.

verses.la: Intelléctus bonus ómnibus faciéntibus eum: * laudátio eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.en: A good understanding to all that do it: * his praise continueth for ever and ever.

verses.la: Beátus vir, qui timet Dóminum: * in mandátis eius volet nimis.
verses.en: Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord: * he shall delight exceedingly in his commandments.

verses.la: Potens in terra erit semen eius: * generátio rectórum benedicétur.
verses.en: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: * the generation of the righteous shall be blessed.

verses.la: Glória, et divítiæ in domo eius: * et iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.en: Glory and wealth shall be in his house: * and his justice remaineth for ever and ever.

verses.la: Exórtum est in ténebris lumen rectis: * miséricors, et miserátor, et iustus.
verses.en: To the righteous a light is risen up in darkness: * he is merciful, and compassionate and just.

verses.la: Iucúndus homo qui miserétur et cómmodat, dispónet sermónes suos in iudício: * quia in ætérnum non commovébitur.
verses.en: Acceptable is the man that sheweth mercy and lendeth: he shall order his words with judgment: * because he shall not be moved for ever.

verses.la: Parátum cor eius speráre in Dómino, confirmátum est cor eius: * non commovébitur donec despíciat inimícos suos.
verses.en: His heart is ready to hope in the Lord: his heart is strengthened, * he shall not be moved until he look over his enemies.

verses.la: Dispérsit, dedit paupéribus: iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi, * cornu eius exaltábitur in glória.
verses.en: He hath distributed, he hath given to the poor: his justice remaineth for ever and ever: * his horn shall be exalted in glory.

verses.la: Peccátor vidébit, et irascétur, déntibus suis fremet et tabéscet: * desidérium peccatórum períbit.
verses.en: The wicked shall see, and shall be angry, he shall gnash with his teeth and pine away: * the desire of the wicked shall perish.

verses.la: Laudáte, púeri, Dóminum: * laudáte nomen Dómini.
verses.en: Praise the Lord, ye children: * praise ye the name of the Lord.

verses.la: (fit reverentia) Sit nomen Dómini benedíctum, * ex hoc nunc, et usque in sǽculum.
verses.en: (bow head) Blessed be the name of the Lord, * from henceforth now and for ever.

verses.la: A solis ortu usque ad occásum, * laudábile nomen Dómini.
verses.en: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same, * the name of the Lord is worthy of praise.

verses.la: Excélsus super omnes gentes Dóminus, * et super cælos glória eius.
verses.en: The Lord is high above all nations; * and his glory above the heavens.

verses.la: Quis sicut Dóminus, Deus noster, qui in altis hábitat, * et humília réspicit in cælo et in terra?
verses.en: Who is as the Lord our God, who dwelleth on high: * and looketh down on the low things in heaven and in earth?

verses.la: Súscitans a terra ínopem, * et de stércore érigens páuperem:
verses.en: Raising up the needy from the earth, * and lifting up the poor out of the dunghill:

verses.la: Ut cóllocet eum cum princípibus, * cum princípibus pópuli sui.
verses.en: That he may place him with princes, * with the princes of his people.

verses.la: Qui habitáre facit stérilem in domo, * matrem filiórum lætántem.
verses.en: Who maketh a barren woman to dwell in a house, * the joyful mother of children.

verses.la: In éxitu Israël de Ægýpto, * domus Iacob de pópulo bárbaro:
verses.en: When Israel went out of Egypt, * the house of Jacob from a barbarous people:

verses.la: Facta est Iudǽa sanctificátio eius, * Israël potéstas eius.
verses.en: Judea was made his sanctuary, * Israel his dominion.

verses.la: Mare vidit, et fugit: * Iordánis convérsus est retrórsum.
verses.en: The sea saw and fled: * Jordan was turned back.

verses.la: Montes exsultavérunt ut aríetes, * et colles sicut agni óvium.
verses.en: The mountains skipped like rams, * and the hills like the lambs of the flock.

verses.la: Quid est tibi, mare, quod fugísti: * et tu, Iordánis, quia convérsus es retrórsum?
verses.en: What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou didst flee: * and thou, O Jordan, that thou wast turned back?

verses.la: Montes, exsultástis sicut aríetes, * et colles, sicut agni óvium.
verses.en: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams, * and ye hills, like lambs of the flock?

verses.la: A fácie Dómini mota est terra, * a fácie Dei Iacob.
verses.en: At the presence of the Lord the earth was moved, * at the presence of the God of Jacob:

verses.la: Qui convértit petram in stagna aquárum, * et rupem in fontes aquárum.
verses.en: Who turned the rock into pools of water, * and the stony hill into fountains of waters.

verses.la: Non nobis, Dómine, non nobis: * sed nómini tuo da glóriam.
verses.en: Not to us, O Lord, not to us; * but to thy name give glory.

verses.la: Super misericórdia tua, et veritáte tua: * nequándo dicant gentes: Ubi est Deus eórum?
verses.en: For thy mercy, and for thy truth’s sake: * lest the Gentiles should say: Where is their God?

verses.la: Deus autem noster in cælo: * ómnia quæcúmque vóluit, fecit.
verses.en: But our God is in heaven: * he hath done all things whatsoever he would.

verses.la: Simulácra géntium argéntum, et aurum, * ópera mánuum hóminum.
verses.en: The idols of the Gentiles are silver and gold, * the works of the hands of men.

verses.la: Os habent, et non loquéntur: * óculos habent, et non vidébunt.
verses.en: They have mouths and speak not: * they have eyes and see not.

verses.la: Aures habent, et non áudient: * nares habent, et non odorábunt.
verses.en: They have ears and hear not: * they have noses and smell not.

verses.la: Manus habent, et non palpábunt: pedes habent, et non ambulábunt: * non clamábunt in gútture suo.
verses.en: They have hands and feel not: they have feet and walk not: * neither shall they cry out through their throat.

verses.la: Símiles illis fiant qui fáciunt ea: * et omnes qui confídunt in eis.
verses.en: Let them that make them become like unto them: * and all such as trust in them.

verses.la: Domus Israël sperávit in Dómino: * adiútor eórum et protéctor eórum est,
verses.en: The house of Israel hath hoped in the Lord: * he is their helper and their protector.

verses.la: Domus Aaron sperávit in Dómino: * adiútor eórum et protéctor eórum est,
verses.en: The house of Aaron hath hoped in the Lord: * he is their helper and their protector.

verses.la: Qui timent Dóminum, speravérunt in Dómino: * adiútor eórum et protéctor eórum est.
verses.en: They that fear the Lord have hoped in the Lord: * he is their helper and their protector.

verses.la: Benedíxit dómui Israël: * benedíxit dómui Aaron.
verses.en: He hath blessed the house of Israel: * he hath blessed the house of Aaron.

verses.la: Benedíxit ómnibus, qui timent Dóminum, * pusíllis cum maióribus.
verses.en: He hath blessed all that fear the Lord, * both little and great.

verses.la: Adíciat Dóminus super vos: * super vos, et super fílios vestros.
verses.en: May the Lord add blessings upon you: * upon you, and upon your children.

verses.la: Benedícti vos a Dómino, * qui fecit cælum, et terram.
verses.en: Blessed be you of the Lord, * who made heaven and earth.

verses.la: Cælum cæli Dómino: * terram autem dedit fíliis hóminum.
verses.en: The heaven of heaven is the Lord’s: * but the earth he has given to the children of men.

verses.la: Non mórtui laudábunt te, Dómine: * neque omnes, qui descéndunt in inférnum.
verses.en: The dead shall not praise thee, O Lord: * nor any of them that go down to hell.

verses.la: Sed nos qui vívimus, benedícimus Dómino, * ex hoc nunc et usque in sǽculum.
verses.en: But we that live bless the Lord: * from this time now and for ever.

verses.la: Diléxi, quóniam exáudiet Dóminus * vocem oratiónis meæ.
verses.en: I have loved, because the Lord will hear * the voice of my prayer.

verses.la: Quia inclinávit aurem suam mihi: * et in diébus meis invocábo.
verses.en: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me: * and in my days I will call upon him.

verses.la: Tribulatiónem et dolórem invéni: * et nomen Dómini invocávi.
verses.en: I met with trouble and sorrow: * and I called upon the name of the Lord.

verses.la: O Dómine, líbera ánimam meam: * miséricors Dóminus, et iustus, et Deus noster miserétur.
verses.en: O Lord, deliver my soul. * The Lord is merciful and just, and our God sheweth mercy.

verses.la: Custódiens párvulos Dóminus: * humiliátus sum, et liberávit me.
verses.en: The Lord is the keeper of little ones: * I was humbled, and he delivered me.

verses.la: Convértere, ánima mea, in réquiem tuam: * quia Dóminus benefécit tibi.
verses.en: Turn, O my soul, into thy rest: * for the Lord hath been bountiful to thee.

verses.la: Quia erípuit ánimam meam de morte: * óculos meos a lácrimis, pedes meos a lapsu.
verses.en: For he hath delivered my soul from death: * my eyes from tears, my feet from falling.

verses.la: Placébo Dómino * in regióne vivórum.
verses.en: I will please the Lord * in the land of the living.

verses.la: Crédidi, propter quod locútus sum: * ego autem humiliátus sum nimis.
verses.en: I have believed, therefore have I spoken; * but I have been humbled exceedingly.

verses.la: Ego dixi in excéssu meo: * Omnis homo mendax.
verses.en: I said in my excess: * Every man is a liar.

verses.la: Quid retríbuam Dómino, * pro ómnibus, quæ retríbuit mihi?
verses.en: What shall I render to the Lord, * for all the things that he hath rendered to me?

verses.la: Cálicem salutáris accípiam: * et nomen Dómini invocábo.
verses.en: I will take the chalice of salvation; * and I will call upon the name of the Lord.

verses.la: Vota mea Dómino reddam coram omni pópulo eius: * pretiósa in conspéctu Dómini mors sanctórum eius:
verses.en: I will pay my vows to the Lord before all his people: * precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his saints.

verses.la: Dirupísti víncula mea: * tibi sacrificábo hóstiam laudis, et nomen Dómini invocábo.
verses.en: Thou hast broken my bonds: * I will sacrifice to thee the sacrifice of praise, and I will call upon the name of the Lord.

verses.la: Vota mea Dómino reddam in conspéctu omnis pópuli eius: * in átriis domus Dómini, in médio tui, Ierúsalem.
verses.en: I will pay my vows to the Lord in the sight of all his people: * in the courts of the house of the Lord, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem.

verses.la: Laudáte Dóminum, omnes gentes: * ‡ laudáte eum, omnes pópuli:
verses.en: O Praise the Lord, all ye nations: * ‡ praise him, all ye people.

verses.la: Quóniam confirmáta est super nos misericórdia eius: * et véritas Dómini manet in ætérnum.
verses.en: For his mercy is confirmed upon us: * and the truth of the Lord remaineth for ever.

verses.la: Confitémini Dómino quóniam bonus: * quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: Give praise to the Lord, for he is good: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Dicat nunc Israël quóniam bonus: * quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: Let Israel now say, that he is good: * that his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Dicat nunc domus Aaron: * quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: Let the house of Aaron now say, * that his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Dicant nunc qui timent Dóminum: * quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: Let them that fear the Lord now say, * that his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: De tribulatióne invocávi Dóminum: * et exaudívit me in latitúdine Dóminus.
verses.en: In my trouble I called upon the Lord: * and the Lord heard me, and enlarged me.

verses.la: Dóminus mihi adiútor: * non timébo quid fáciat mihi homo.
verses.en: The Lord is my helper: * I will not fear what man can do unto me.

verses.la: Dóminus mihi adiútor: * et ego despíciam inimícos meos.
verses.en: The Lord is my helper: * and I will look over my enemies.

verses.la: Bonum est confídere in Dómino, * quam confídere in hómine:
verses.en: It is good to confide in the Lord, * rather than to have confidence in man.

verses.la: Bonum est speráre in Dómino, * quam speráre in princípibus.
verses.en: It is good to trust in the Lord, * rather than to trust in princes.

verses.la: Omnes gentes circuiérunt me: * et in nómine Dómini quia ultus sum in eos.
verses.en: All nations compassed me about; * and in the name of the Lord I have been revenged on them.

verses.la: Circumdántes circumdedérunt me: * et in nómine Dómini quia ultus sum in eos.
verses.en: Surrounding me they compassed me about: * and in the name of the Lord I have been revenged on them.

verses.la: Circumdedérunt me sicut apes, et exarsérunt sicut ignis in spinis: * et in nómine Dómini quia ultus sum in eos.
verses.en: They surrounded me like bees, and they burned like fire among thorns: * and in the name of the Lord I was revenged on them.

verses.la: Impúlsus evérsus sum ut cáderem: * et Dóminus suscépit me.
verses.en: Being pushed I was overturned that I might fall: * but the Lord supported me.

verses.la: Fortitúdo mea, et laus mea Dóminus: * et factus est mihi in salútem.
verses.en: The Lord is my strength and my praise: * and he is become my salvation.

verses.la: Vox exsultatiónis, et salútis * in tabernáculis iustórum.
verses.en: The voice of rejoicing and of salvation * is in the tabernacles of the just.

verses.la: Déxtera Dómini fecit virtútem: déxtera Dómini exaltávit me, * déxtera Dómini fecit virtútem.
verses.en: The right hand of the Lord hath wrought strength: the right hand of the Lord hath exalted me: * the right hand of the Lord hath wrought strength.

verses.la: Non móriar, sed vivam: * et narrábo ópera Dómini.
verses.en: I shall not die, but live: * and shall declare the works of the Lord.

verses.la: Castígans castigávit me Dóminus: * et morti non trádidit me.
verses.en: The Lord chastising hath chastised me: * but he hath not delivered me over to death.

verses.la: Aperíte mihi portas iustítiæ, ingréssus in eas confitébor Dómino: * hæc porta Dómini, iusti intrábunt in eam.
verses.en: Open ye to me the gates of justice: I will go in to them, and give praise to the Lord. * This is the gate of the Lord, the just shall enter into it.

verses.la: Confitébor tibi quóniam exaudísti me: * et factus es mihi in salútem.
verses.en: I will give glory to thee because thou hast heard me: * and art become my salvation.

verses.la: Lápidem, quem reprobavérunt ædificántes: * hic factus est in caput ánguli.
verses.en: The stone which the builders rejected; * the same is become the head of the corner.

verses.la: A Dómino factum est istud: * et est mirábile in óculis nostris.
verses.en: This is the Lord’s doing: * and it is wonderful in our eyes.

verses.la: Hæc est dies, quam fecit Dóminus: * exsultémus, et lætémur in ea.
verses.en: This is the day which the Lord hath made: * let us be glad and rejoice therein.

verses.la: O Dómine, salvum me fac, o Dómine, bene prosperáre: * benedíctus qui venit in nómine Dómini.
verses.en: O Lord, save me: O Lord, give good success: * Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the Lord.

verses.la: Benedíximus vobis de domo Dómini: * Deus Dóminus, et illúxit nobis.
verses.en: We have blessed you out of the house of the Lord: * The Lord is God, and he hath shone upon us.

verses.la: Constitúite diem solémnem in condénsis, * usque ad cornu altáris.
verses.en: Appoint a solemn day, with shady boughs, * even to the horn of the altar.

verses.la: Confitébor tibi quóniam exaudísti me * et factus es mihi in salútem.
verses.en: I will praise thee, because thou hast heard me, * and art become my salvation.

verses.la: Confitémini Dómino quóniam bonus: * quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: O praise ye the Lord, for he is good: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Ad Dóminum cum tribulárer clamávi: * et exaudívit me.
verses.en: In my trouble I cried to the Lord: * and he heard me.

verses.la: Dómine, líbera ánimam meam a lábiis iníquis, * et a lingua dolósa.
verses.en: O Lord, deliver my soul from wicked lips, * and a deceitful tongue.

verses.la: Quid detur tibi, aut quid apponátur tibi * ad linguam dolósam?
verses.en: What shall be given to thee, or what shall be added to thee, * to a deceitful tongue?

verses.la: Sagíttæ poténtis acútæ, * cum carbónibus desolatóriis.
verses.en: The sharp arrows of the mighty, * with coals that lay waste.

verses.la: Heu mihi, quia incolátus meus prolongátus est: habitávi cum habitántibus Cedar: * multum íncola fuit ánima mea.
verses.en: Woe is me, that my sojourning is prolonged! I have dwelt with the inhabitants of Cedar: * my soul hath been long a sojourner.

verses.la: Cum his, qui odérunt pacem, eram pacíficus: * cum loquébar illis, impugnábant me gratis.
verses.en: With them that hated peace I was peaceable: * when I spoke to them they fought against me without cause.

verses.la: Levávi óculos meos in montes, * unde véniet auxílium mihi.
verses.en: I have lifted up my eyes to the mountains, * from whence help shall come to me.

verses.la: Auxílium meum a Dómino, * qui fecit cælum et terram.
verses.en: My help is from the Lord, * who made heaven and earth.

verses.la: Non det in commotiónem pedem tuum: * neque dormítet qui custódit te.
verses.en: May he not suffer thy foot to be moved: * neither let him slumber that keepeth thee.

verses.la: Ecce, non dormitábit neque dórmiet, * qui custódit Israël.
verses.en: Behold he shall neither slumber nor sleep, * that keepeth Israel.

verses.la: Dóminus custódit te, Dóminus protéctio tua, * super manum déxteram tuam.
verses.en: The Lord is thy keeper, the Lord is thy protection * upon thy right hand.

verses.la: Per diem sol non uret te: * neque luna per noctem.
verses.en: The sun shall not burn thee by day: * nor the moon by night.

verses.la: Dóminus custódit te ab omni malo: * custódiat ánimam tuam Dóminus.
verses.en: The Lord keepeth thee from all evil: * may the Lord keep thy soul.

verses.la: Dóminus custódiat intróitum tuum, et éxitum tuum: * ex hoc nunc, et usque in sǽculum.
