verses.en: May the Lord keep thy coming in and thy going out; * from henceforth now and for ever.

verses.la: Lætátus sum in his, quæ dicta sunt mihi: * In domum Dómini íbimus.
verses.en: I rejoiced at the things that were said to me: * We shall go into the house of the Lord.

verses.la: Stantes erant pedes nostri, * in átriis tuis, Ierúsalem.
verses.en: Our feet were standing * in thy courts, O Jerusalem.

verses.la: Ierúsalem, quæ ædificátur ut cívitas: * cuius participátio eius in idípsum.
verses.en: Jerusalem, which is built as a city, * which is compact together.

verses.la: Illuc enim ascendérunt tribus, tribus Dómini: * testimónium Israël ad confiténdum nómini Dómini.
verses.en: For thither did the tribes go up, the tribes of the Lord: * the testimony of Israel, to praise the name of the Lord.

verses.la: Quia illic sedérunt sedes in iudício, * sedes super domum David.
verses.en: Because their seats have sat in judgment, * seats upon the house of David.

verses.la: Rogáte quæ ad pacem sunt Ierúsalem: * et abundántia diligéntibus te:
verses.en: Pray ye for the things that are for the peace of Jerusalem: * and abundance for them that love thee.

verses.la: Fiat pax in virtúte tua: * et abundántia in túrribus tuis.
verses.en: Let peace be in thy strength: * and abundance in thy towers.

verses.la: Propter fratres meos, et próximos meos, * loquébar pacem de te:
verses.en: For the sake of my brethren, and of my neighbours, * I spoke peace of thee.

verses.la: Propter domum Dómini, Dei nostri, * quæsívi bona tibi.
verses.en: Because of the house of the Lord our God, * I have sought good things for thee.

verses.la: Ad te levávi óculos meos, * qui hábitas in cælis.
verses.en: To thee have I lifted up my eyes, * who dwellest in heaven.

verses.la: Sicut óculi ancíllæ in mánibus dóminæ suæ: * ita óculi nostri ad Dóminum, Deum nostrum, donec misereátur nostri.
verses.en: As the eyes of the handmaid are on the hands of her mistress: * so are our eyes unto the Lord our God, until he have mercy on us.

verses.la: Miserére nostri, Dómine, miserére nostri: * quia multum repléti sumus despectióne:
verses.en: Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us: * for we are greatly filled with contempt.

verses.la: Quia multum repléta est ánima nostra: * oppróbrium abundántibus, et despéctio supérbis.
verses.en: For our soul is greatly filled: * we are a reproach to the rich, and contempt to the proud.

verses.la: Nisi quia Dóminus erat in nobis, dicat nunc Israël: * nisi quia Dóminus erat in nobis,
verses.en: If it had not been that the Lord was with us, let Israel now say: * If it had not been that the Lord was with us,

verses.la: Cum exsúrgerent hómines in nos, * forte vivos deglutíssent nos:
verses.en: When men rose up against us, * perhaps they had swallowed us up alive.

verses.la: Cum irascerétur furor eórum in nos, * fórsitan aqua absorbuísset nos.
verses.en: When their fury was enkindled against us, * perhaps the waters had swallowed us up.

verses.la: Torréntem pertransívit ánima nostra: * fórsitan pertransísset ánima nostra aquam intolerábilem.
verses.en: Our soul hath passed through a torrent: * perhaps our soul had passed through a water insupportable.

verses.la: Benedíctus Dóminus * qui non dedit nos in captiónem déntibus eórum.
verses.en: Blessed be the Lord, * who hath not given us to be a prey to their teeth.

verses.la: Láqueus contrítus est, * et nos liberáti sumus.
verses.en: The snare is broken, * and we are delivered.

verses.la: Adiutórium nostrum in nómine Dómini, * qui fecit cælum et terram.
verses.en: Our help is in the name of the Lord, * who made heaven and earth.

verses.la: Qui confídunt in Dómino, sicut mons Sion: * non commovébitur in ætérnum, qui hábitat in Ierúsalem.
verses.en: They that trust in the Lord shall be as mount Sion: * he shall not be moved for ever that dwelleth in Jerusalem.

verses.la: Montes in circúitu eius: * et Dóminus in circúitu pópuli sui, ex hoc nunc et usque in sǽculum.
verses.en: Mountains are round about it: * so the Lord is round about his people from henceforth now and for ever.

verses.la: Quia non relínquet Dóminus virgam peccatórum super sortem iustórum: * ut non exténdant iusti ad iniquitátem manus suas.
verses.en: For the Lord will not leave the rod of sinners upon the lot of the just: * that the just may not stretch forth their hands to iniquity.

verses.la: Bénefac, Dómine, bonis, * et rectis corde.
verses.en: Do good, O Lord, to those that are good, * and to the upright of heart.

verses.la: Declinántes autem in obligatiónes addúcet Dóminus cum operántibus iniquitátem: * pax super Israël.
verses.en: But such as turn aside into bonds, the Lord shall lead out with the workers of iniquity: * peace upon Israel.

verses.la: In converténdo Dóminus captivitátem Sion: * facti sumus sicut consoláti:
verses.en: When the Lord brought back the captivity of Sion, * we became like men comforted.

verses.la: Tunc dicent inter gentes: * Magnificávit Dóminus fácere cum eis.
verses.en: Then shall they say among the Gentiles: * The Lord hath done great things for them.

verses.la: Magnificávit Dóminus fácere nobíscum: * facti sumus lætántes.
verses.en: The Lord hath done great things for us: * we are become joyful.

verses.la: Convérte, Dómine, captivitátem nostram, * sicut torrens in Austro.
verses.en: Turn again our captivity, O Lord, * as a stream in the south.

verses.la: Qui séminant in lácrimis, * in exsultatióne metent.
verses.en: They that sow in tears * shall reap in joy.

verses.la: Veniéntes autem vénient cum exsultatióne, * portántes manípulos suos.
verses.en: But coming they shall come with joyfulness, * carrying their sheaves.

verses.la: Nisi Dóminus custodíerit civitátem, * frustra vígilat qui custódit eam.
verses.en: Unless the Lord keep the city, * he watcheth in vain that keepeth it.

verses.la: Cum déderit diléctis suis somnum: * ecce heréditas Dómini fílii: merces, fructus ventris.
verses.en: When he shall give sleep to his beloved, * behold the inheritance of the Lord are children: the reward, the fruit of the womb.

verses.la: Sicut sagíttæ in manu poténtis: * ita fílii excussórum.
verses.en: As arrows in the hand of the mighty, * so the children of them that have been shaken.

verses.la: Beátus vir, qui implévit desidérium suum ex ipsis: * non confundétur cum loquétur inimícis suis in porta.
verses.en: Blessed is the man that hath filled the desire with them; * he shall not be confounded when he shall speak to his enemies in the gate.

verses.la: Beáti, omnes, qui timent Dóminum, * ‡ qui ámbulant in viis eius.
verses.en: Blessed are all they that fear the Lord: * ‡ that walk in his ways.

verses.la: Labóres mánuum tuárum quia manducábis: * beátus es, et bene tibi erit.
verses.en: For thou shalt eat the labours of thy hands: * blessed art thou, and it shall be well with thee.

verses.la: Fílii tui sicut novéllæ olivárum, * in circúitu mensæ tuæ.
verses.en: Thy children as olive plants, * round about thy table.

verses.la: Ecce, sic benedicétur homo, * qui timet Dóminum.
verses.en: Behold, thus shall the man be blessed * that feareth the Lord.

verses.la: Benedícat tibi Dóminus ex Sion: * et vídeas bona Ierúsalem ómnibus diébus vitæ tuæ.
verses.en: May the Lord bless thee out of Sion: * and mayst thou see the good things of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.

verses.la: Et vídeas fílios filiórum tuórum, * pacem super Israël.
verses.en: And mayst thou see thy children’s children, * peace upon Israel.

verses.la: Sæpe expugnavérunt me a iuventúte mea, * dicat nunc Israël.
verses.en: Often have they fought against me from my youth, * let Israel now say.

verses.la: Sæpe expugnavérunt me a iuventúte mea: * étenim non potuérunt mihi.
verses.en: Often have they fought against me from my youth: * but they could not prevail over me.

verses.la: Supra dorsum meum fabricavérunt peccatóres: * prolongavérunt iniquitátem suam.
verses.en: The wicked have wrought upon my back: * they have lengthened their iniquity.

verses.la: Dóminus iustus concídit cervíces peccatórum: * confundántur et convertántur retrórsum omnes, qui odérunt Sion.
verses.en: The Lord who is just will cut the necks of sinners: * let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Sion.

verses.la: Fiant sicut fænum tectórum: * quod priúsquam evellátur, exáruit:
verses.en: Let them be as grass upon the tops of houses: * which withereth before it be plucked up:

verses.la: De quo non implévit manum suam qui metit, * et sinum suum qui manípulos cólligit.
verses.en: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand: * nor he that gathereth sheaves his bosom.

verses.la: Et non dixérunt qui præteríbant: Benedíctio Dómini super vos: * benedíximus vobis in nómine Dómini.
verses.en: And they that passed by have not said: The blessing of the Lord be upon you: * we have blessed you in the name of the Lord.

verses.la: De profúndis clamávi ad te, Dómine: * Dómine, exáudi vocem meam:
verses.en: Out of the depths I have cried to thee, O Lord: * Lord, hear my voice.

verses.la: Fiant aures tuæ intendéntes, * in vocem deprecatiónis meæ.
verses.en: Let thy ears be attentive * to the voice of my supplication.

verses.la: Si iniquitátes observáveris, Dómine: * Dómine, quis sustinébit?
verses.en: If thou, O Lord, wilt mark iniquities: * Lord, who shall stand it.

verses.la: Sustínuit ánima mea in verbo eius: * sperávit ánima mea in Dómino.
verses.en: My soul hath relied on his word: * my soul hath hoped in the Lord.

verses.la: A custódia matutína usque ad noctem: * speret Israël in Dómino.
verses.en: From the morning watch even until night, * let Israel hope in the Lord.

verses.la: Quia apud Dóminum misericórdia: * et copiósa apud eum redémptio.
verses.en: Because with the Lord there is mercy: * and with him plentiful redemption.

verses.la: Et ipse rédimet Israël, * ex ómnibus iniquitátibus eius.
verses.en: And he shall redeem Israel * from all his iniquities.

verses.la: Neque ambulávi in magnis: * neque in mirabílibus super me.
verses.en: Neither have I walked in great matters, * nor in wonderful things above me.

verses.la: Sicut ablactátus est super matre sua, * ita retribútio in ánima mea.
verses.en: As a child that is weaned is towards his mother, * so reward in my soul.

verses.la: Speret Israël in Dómino, * ex hoc nunc et usque in sǽculum.
verses.en: Let Israel hope in the Lord, * from henceforth now and for ever.

verses.la: Meménto, Dómine, David, * et omnis mansuetúdinis eius:
verses.en: Lord, remember David, * and all his meekness.

verses.la: Sicut iurávit Dómino, * votum vovit Deo Iacob:
verses.en: How he swore to the Lord, * he vowed a vow to the God of Jacob:

verses.la: Si introíero in tabernáculum domus meæ, * si ascéndero in lectum strati mei:
verses.en: If I shall enter into the tabernacle of my house: * if I shall go up into the bed wherein I lie:

verses.la: Si dédero somnum óculis meis, * et pálpebris meis dormitatiónem:
verses.en: If I shall give sleep to my eyes, * or slumber to my eyelids,

verses.la: Et réquiem tempóribus meis: donec invéniam locum Dómino, * tabernáculum Deo Iacob.
verses.en: Or rest to my temples: until I find out a place for the Lord, * a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.

verses.la: Ecce, audívimus eam in Éphrata: * invénimus eam in campis silvæ.
verses.en: Behold we have heard of it in Ephrata: * we have found it in the fields of the wood.

verses.la: Introíbimus in tabernáculum eius: * adorábimus in loco, ubi stetérunt pedes eius.
verses.en: We will go into his tabernacle: * we will adore in the place where his feet stood.

verses.la: Surge, Dómine, in réquiem tuam, * tu et arca sanctificatiónis tuæ.
verses.en: Arise, O Lord, into thy resting place: * thou and the ark, which thou hast sanctified.

verses.la: Sacerdótes tui induántur iustítiam: * et sancti tui exsúltent.
verses.en: Let thy priests be clothed with justice: * and let thy saints rejoice.

verses.la: Propter David, servum tuum, * non avértas fáciem Christi tui.
verses.en: For thy servant David’s sake, * turn not away the face of thy anointed.

verses.la: Iurávit Dóminus David veritátem, et non frustrábitur eam: * De fructu ventris tui ponam super sedem tuam.
verses.en: The Lord hath sworn truth to David, and he will not make it void: * of the fruit of thy womb I will set upon thy throne.

verses.la: Et fílii eórum usque in sǽculum, * sedébunt super sedem tuam.
verses.en: Their children also for evermore * shall sit upon thy throne.

verses.la: Quóniam elégit Dóminus Sion: * elégit eam in habitatiónem sibi.
verses.en: For the Lord hath chosen Sion: * he hath chosen it for his dwelling.

verses.la: Hæc réquies mea in sǽculum sǽculi: * hic habitábo quóniam elégi eam.
verses.en: This is my rest for ever and ever: * here will I dwell, for I have chosen it.

verses.la: Víduam eius benedícens benedícam: * páuperes eius saturábo pánibus.
verses.en: Blessing I will bless her widow: * I will satisfy her poor with bread.

verses.la: Sacerdótes eius índuam salutári: * et sancti eius exsultatióne exsultábunt.
verses.en: I will clothe her priests with salvation: * and her saints shall rejoice with exceeding great joy.

verses.la: Illuc prodúcam cornu David, * parávi lucérnam Christo meo.
verses.en: There will I bring forth a horn to David: * I have prepared a lamp for my anointed.

verses.la: Inimícos eius índuam confusióne: * super ipsum autem efflorébit sanctificátio mea.
verses.en: His enemies I will clothe with confusion: * but upon him shall my sanctification flourish.

verses.la: Ecce quam bonum et quam iucúndum, habitáre fratres in unum:
verses.en: Behold how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity:

verses.la: Quod descéndit in oram vestiménti eius: * sicut ros Hermon, qui descéndit in montem Sion.
verses.en: Which ran down to the skirt of his garment: * as the dew of Hermon, which descendeth upon mount Sion.

verses.la: Quóniam illic mandávit Dóminus benedictiónem, * et vitam usque in sǽculum.
verses.en: For there the Lord hath commanded blessing, * and life for evermore.

verses.la: Qui statis in domo Dómini, * in átriis domus Dei nostri.
verses.en: Who stand in the house of the Lord, * in the courts of the house of our God.

verses.la: In nóctibus extóllite manus vestras in sancta, * et benedícite Dóminum.
verses.en: In the nights lift up your hands to the holy places, * and bless ye the Lord.

verses.la: Benedícat te Dóminus ex Sion, * qui fecit cælum et terram.
verses.en: May the Lord out of Sion bless thee, * he that made heaven and earth.

verses.la: Laudáte nomen Dómini, * laudáte, servi, Dóminum.
verses.en: Praise ye the name of the Lord: * O you his servants, praise the Lord:

verses.la: Qui statis in domo Dómini, * in átriis domus Dei nostri.
verses.en: You that stand in the house of the Lord, * in the courts of the house of our God.

verses.la: Laudáte Dóminum, quia bonus Dóminus: * psállite nómini eius, quóniam suáve.
verses.en: Praise ye the Lord, for the Lord is good: * sing ye to his name, for it is sweet.

verses.la: Quóniam Iacob elégit sibi Dóminus, * Israël in possessiónem sibi.
verses.en: For the Lord hath chosen Jacob unto himself: * Israel for his own possession.

verses.la: Quia ego cognóvi quod magnus est Dóminus, * et Deus noster præ ómnibus diis.
verses.en: For I have known that the Lord is great, * and our God is above all gods.

verses.la: Ómnia quæcúmque vóluit, Dóminus fecit in cælo, et in terra, * in mari, et in ómnibus abýssis.
verses.en: Whatsoever the Lord pleased he hath done, in heaven, in earth, * in the sea, and in all the deeps.

verses.la: Qui prodúcit ventos de thesáuris suis: * qui percússit primogénita Ægýpti ab hómine usque ad pecus.
verses.en: He bringeth forth winds out of his stores: * He slew the firstborn of Egypt from man even unto beast.

verses.la: Et misit signa, et prodígia in médio tui, Ægýpte: * in Pharaónem, et in omnes servos eius.
verses.en: He sent forth signs and wonders in the midst of thee, O Egypt: * upon Pharao, and upon all his servants.

verses.la: Qui percússit gentes multas: * et occídit reges fortes:
verses.en: He smote many nations, * and slew mighty kings:

verses.la: Sehon, regem Amorrhæórum, et Og, regem Basan, * et ómnia regna Chánaan.
verses.en: Sehon king of the Amorrhites, and Og king of Basan, * and all the kingdoms of Chanaan.

verses.la: Et dedit terram eórum hereditátem, * hereditátem Israël, pópulo suo.
verses.en: And gave their land for an inheritance, * for an inheritance to his people Israel.

verses.la: Dómine, nomen tuum in ætérnum: * Dómine, memoriále tuum in generatiónem et generatiónem.
verses.en: Thy name, O Lord, is for ever: * thy memorial, O Lord, unto all generations.

verses.la: Quia iudicábit Dóminus pópulum suum: * et in servis suis deprecábitur.
verses.en: For the Lord will judge his people, * and will be entreated in favour of his servants.

verses.la: Simulácra géntium argéntum, et aurum, * ópera mánuum hóminum.
verses.en: The idols of the Gentiles are silver and gold, * the works of men’s hands.

verses.la: Os habent, et non loquéntur: * óculos habent, et non vidébunt.
verses.en: They have a mouth, but they speak not: * they have eyes, but they see not.

verses.la: Aures habent, et non áudient: * neque enim est spíritus in ore ipsórum.
verses.en: They have ears, but they hear not: * neither is there any breath in their mouths.

verses.la: Símiles illis fiant qui fáciunt ea: * et omnes qui confídunt in eis.
verses.en: Let them that make them be like to them: * and every one that trusteth in them.

verses.la: Domus Israël, benedícite Dómino: * domus Aaron, benedícite Dómino.
verses.en: Bless the Lord, O house of Israel: * bless the Lord, O house of Aaron.

verses.la: Domus Levi, benedícite Dómino: * qui timétis Dóminum, benedícite Dómino.
verses.en: Bless the Lord, O house of Levi: * you that fear the Lord, bless the Lord.

verses.la: Benedíctus Dóminus ex Sion, * qui hábitat in Ierúsalem.
verses.en: Blessed be the Lord out of Sion, * who dwelleth in Jerusalem.

verses.la: Confitémini Dómino quóniam bonus: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: Praise the Lord, for he is good: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Confitémini Deo deórum: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: Praise ye the God of gods: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Confitémini Dómino dominórum: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: Praise ye the Lord of lords: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Qui facit mirabília magna solus: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: Who alone doth great wonders: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Qui fecit cælos in intelléctu: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: Who made the heavens in understanding: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Qui firmávit terram super aquas: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: Who established the earth above the waters: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Qui fecit luminária magna: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: Who made the great lights: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Solem in potestátem diéi: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: The sun to rule the day: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Lunam, et stellas in potestátem noctis: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: The moon and the stars to rule the night: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Qui percússit Ægýptum cum primogénitis eórum: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: Who smote Egypt with their firstborn: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Qui edúxit Israël de médio eórum: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: Who brought out Israel from among them: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: In manu poténti, et brácchio excélso: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: With a mighty hand and with a stretched out arm: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Qui divísit Mare Rubrum in divisiónes: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: Who divided the Red sea into parts: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Et edúxit Israël per médium eius: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: And brought out Israel through the midst thereof: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Et excússit Pharaónem, et virtútem eius in Mari Rubro: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: And overthrew Pharao and his host in the Red sea: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Qui tradúxit pópulum suum per desértum: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: Who led his people through the desert: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Qui percússit reges magnos: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: Who smote great kings: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Et occídit reges fortes: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: And slew strong kings: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Sehon, regem Amorrhæórum: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: Sehon king of the Amorrhites: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Et Og, regem Basan: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: And Og king of Basan: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Et dedit terram eórum hereditátem: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: And he gave their land for an inheritance: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Hereditátem Israël, servo suo: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: For an inheritance to his servant Israel: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Quia in humilitáte nostra memor fuit nostri: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: For he was mindful of us in our affliction: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Et redémit nos ab inimícis nostris: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: And he redeemed us from our enemies: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Qui dat escam omni carni: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: Who giveth food to all flesh: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Confitémini Dómino dominórum: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
verses.en: Give glory to the Lord of lords: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.la: Super flúmina Babylónis, illic sédimus et flévimus: * cum recordarémur Sion:
verses.en: Upon the rivers of Babylon, there we sat and wept: * when we remembered Sion:

verses.la: In salícibus in médio eius, * suspéndimus órgana nostra.
verses.en: On the willows in the midst thereof * we hung up our instruments.

verses.la: Et qui abduxérunt nos: * Hymnum cantáte nobis de cánticis Sion.
verses.en: And they that carried us away, said: * Sing ye to us a hymn of the songs of Sion.

verses.la: Quómodo cantábimus cánticum Dómini * in terra aliéna?
verses.en: How shall we sing the song of the Lord * in a strange land?

verses.la: Si oblítus fúero tui, Ierúsalem, * oblivióni detur déxtera mea.
verses.en: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, * let my right hand be forgotten.

verses.la: Si non proposúero Ierúsalem, * in princípio lætítiæ meæ.
verses.en: If I make not Jerusalem * the beginning of my joy.

verses.la: Qui dicunt: Exinaníte, exinaníte * usque ad fundaméntum in ea.
verses.en: Who say: Rase it, rase it, * even to the foundation thereof.

verses.la: Fília Babylónis mísera: * beátus, qui retríbuet tibi retributiónem tuam, quam retribuísti nobis.
verses.en: O daughter of Babylon, miserable: * blessed shall he be who shall repay thee thy payment which thou hast paid us.

verses.la: Beátus, qui tenébit, * et allídet párvulos tuos ad petram.
verses.en: Blessed be he that shall take * and dash thy little ones against the rock.

verses.la: In conspéctu Angelórum psallam tibi: * adorábo ad templum sanctum tuum, et confitébor nómini tuo.
verses.en: I will sing praise to thee in the sight of the Angels: * I will worship towards thy holy temple, and I will give glory to thy name.

verses.la: Super misericórdia tua, et veritáte tua: * quóniam magnificásti super omne, nomen sanctum tuum.
verses.en: For thy mercy, and for thy truth: * for thou hast magnified thy holy name.

verses.la: In quacúmque die invocávero te, exáudi me: * multiplicábis in ánima mea virtútem.
verses.en: In what day soever I shall call upon thee, hear me: * thou shalt multiply strength in my soul.

verses.la: Confiteántur tibi, Dómine, omnes reges terræ: * quia audiérunt ómnia verba oris tui:
verses.en: May all the kings of the earth give glory to thee: * for they have heard all the words of thy mouth.

verses.la: Et cantent in viis Dómini: * quóniam magna est glória Dómini.
verses.en: And let them sing in the ways of the Lord: * for great is the glory of the Lord.

verses.la: Quóniam excélsus Dóminus, et humília réspicit: * et alta a longe cognóscit.
verses.en: For the Lord is high, and looketh on the low: * and the high he knoweth afar off.

verses.la: Si ambulávero in médio tribulatiónis, vivificábis me: * et super iram inimicórum meórum extendísti manum tuam, et salvum me fecit déxtera tua.
verses.en: If I shall walk in the midst of tribulation, thou wilt quicken me: * and thou hast stretched forth thy hand against the wrath of my enemies: and thy right hand hath saved me.

verses.la: Dóminus retríbuet pro me: * Dómine, misericórdia tua in sǽculum: ópera mánuum tuárum ne despícias.
verses.en: The Lord will repay for me: * thy mercy, O Lord, endureth for ever: O despise not the works of thy hands.

verses.la: Dómine, probásti me, et cognovísti me: * tu cognovísti sessiónem meam, et resurrectiónem meam.
verses.en: Lord, thou hast proved me, and known me: * thou hast known my sitting down, and my rising up.

verses.la: Intellexísti cogitatiónes meas de longe: * sémitam meam, et funículum meum investigásti.
verses.en: Thou hast understood my thoughts afar off: * my path and my life thou hast searched out.

verses.la: Et omnes vias meas prævidísti: * quia non est sermo in lingua mea.
verses.en: And thou hast foreseen all my ways: * for there is no speech on my tongue.

verses.la: Ecce, Dómine, tu cognovísti ómnia novíssima, et antíqua: * tu formásti me, et posuísti super me manum tuam.
verses.en: Behold, O Lord, thou hast known all things, the last and those of old: * thou hast formed me, and hast laid thy hand upon me.

verses.la: Mirábilis facta est sciéntia tua ex me: * confortáta est, et non pótero ad eam.
verses.en: Thy knowledge is become wonderful to me: * it is high, and I cannot reach to it.

verses.la: Quo ibo a spíritu tuo? * et quo a fácie tua fúgiam?
verses.en: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? * or whither shall I flee from thy face?

verses.la: Si ascéndero in cælum, tu illic es: * si descéndero in inférnum, ades.
verses.en: If I ascend into heaven, thou art there: * if I descend into hell, thou art present.

verses.la: Si súmpsero pennas meas dilúculo, * et habitávero in extrémis maris:
verses.en: If I take my wings early in the morning, * and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea:

verses.la: Étenim illuc manus tua dedúcet me: * et tenébit me déxtera tua.
verses.en: Even there also shall thy hand lead me: * and thy right hand shall hold me.

verses.la: Et dixi: Fórsitan ténebræ conculcábunt me: * et nox illuminátio mea in delíciis meis.
verses.en: And I said: Perhaps darkness shall cover me: * and night shall be my light in my pleasures.

verses.la: Quia ténebræ non obscurabúntur a te, et nox sicut dies illuminábitur: * sicut ténebræ eius, ita et lumen eius.
verses.en: But darkness shall not be dark to thee, and night shall be light as the day: * the darkness thereof, and the light thereof are alike to thee.

verses.la: Quia tu possedísti renes meos: * suscepísti me de útero matris meæ.
verses.en: For thou hast possessed my reins: * thou hast protected me from my mother’s womb.

verses.la: Confitébor tibi quia terribíliter magnificátus es: * mirabília ópera tua, et ánima mea cognóscit nimis.
verses.en: I will praise thee, for thou art fearfully magnified: * wonderful are thy works, and my soul knoweth right well.

verses.la: Non est occultátum os meum a te, quod fecísti in occúlto: * et substántia mea in inferióribus terræ.
verses.en: My bone is not hidden from thee, which thou hast made in secret: * and my substance in the lower parts of the earth.

verses.la: Imperféctum meum vidérunt óculi tui, et in libro tuo omnes scribéntur: * dies formabúntur, et nemo in eis.
verses.en: Thy eyes did see my imperfect being, and in thy book all shall be written: * days shall be formed, and no one in them.

verses.la: Mihi autem nimis honorificáti sunt amíci tui, Deus: * nimis confortátus est principátus eórum.
verses.en: But to me thy friends, O God, are made exceedingly honourable: * their principality is exceedingly strengthened.

verses.la: Dinumerábo eos, et super arénam multiplicabúntur: * exsurréxi, et adhuc sum tecum.
verses.en: I will number them, and they shall be multiplied above the sand: * I rose up and am still with thee.

verses.la: Si occíderis, Deus, peccatóres: * viri sánguinum, declináte a me:
verses.en: If thou wilt kill the wicked, O God: * ye men of blood, depart from me:

verses.la: Quia dícitis in cogitatióne: * Accípient in vanitáte civitátes tuas.
verses.en: Because you say in thought: * They shall receive thy cities in vain.

verses.la: Nonne qui odérunt te, Dómine, óderam? * et super inimícos tuos tabescébam?
verses.en: Have I not hated them, O Lord, that hated thee: * and pined away because of thy enemies?

verses.la: Perfécto ódio óderam illos: * et inimíci facti sunt mihi.
verses.en: I have hated them with a perfect hatred: * and they are become enemies to me.

verses.la: Proba me, Deus, et scito cor meum: * intérroga me, et cognósce sémitas meas.
verses.en: Prove me, O God, and know my heart: * examine me, and know my paths.

verses.la: Et vide, si via iniquitátis in me est: * et deduc me in via ætérna.
verses.en: And see if there be in me the way of iniquity: * and lead me in the eternal way.

verses.la: Éripe me, Dómine, ab hómine malo: * a viro iníquo éripe me.
verses.en: Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man: * rescue me from the unjust man.

verses.la: Qui cogitavérunt iniquitátes in corde: * tota die constituébant prǽlia.
verses.en: Who have devised iniquities in their hearts: * all the day long they designed battles.

verses.la: Acuérunt linguas suas sicut serpéntis: * venénum áspidum sub lábiis eórum.
verses.en: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent: * the venom of asps is under their lips.

verses.la: Qui cogitavérunt supplantáre gressus meos: * abscondérunt supérbi láqueum mihi:
verses.en: Who have proposed to supplant my steps: * the proud have hidden a net for me.

verses.la: Et funes extendérunt in láqueum: * iuxta iter scándalum posuérunt mihi.
verses.en: And they have stretched out cords for a snare: * they have laid for me a stumbling block by the wayside.

verses.la: Dixi Dómino: Deus meus es tu: * exáudi, Dómine, vocem deprecatiónis meæ.
verses.en: I said to the Lord: Thou art my God: * hear, O Lord, the voice of my supplication.

verses.la: Dómine, Dómine, virtus salútis meæ: * obumbrásti super caput meum in die belli.
verses.en: O Lord, Lord, the strength of my salvation: * thou hast overshadowed my head in the day of battle.

verses.la: Ne tradas me, Dómine, a desidério meo peccatóri: * cogitavérunt contra me, ne derelínquas me, ne forte exalténtur.
verses.en: Give me not up, O Lord, from my desire to the wicked: * they have plotted against me; do not thou forsake me, lest they should triumph.

verses.la: Caput circúitus eórum: * labor labiórum ipsórum opériet eos.
verses.en: The head of them compassing me about: * the labour of their lips shall overwhelm them.

verses.la: Cadent super eos carbónes, in ignem deícies eos: * in misériis non subsístent.
verses.en: Burning coals shall fall upon them; thou wilt cast them down into the fire: * in miseries they shall not be able to stand.

verses.la: Vir linguósus non dirigétur in terra: * virum iniústum mala cápient in intéritu.
verses.en: A man full of tongue shall not be established in the earth: * evil shall catch the unjust man unto destruction.

verses.la: Cognóvi quia fáciet Dóminus iudícium ínopis: * et vindíctam páuperum.
verses.en: I know that the Lord will do justice to the needy, * and will revenge the poor.

verses.la: Verúmtamen iusti confitebúntur nómini tuo: * et habitábunt recti cum vultu tuo.
verses.en: But as for the just, they shall give glory to thy name: * and the upright shall dwell with thy countenance.

verses.la: Dómine, clamávi ad te, exáudi me: * inténde voci meæ, cum clamávero ad te.
verses.en: I have cried to thee, O Lord, hear me: * hearken to my voice, when I cry to thee.

verses.la: Dirigátur orátio mea sicut incénsum in conspéctu tuo: * elevátio mánuum meárum sacrifícium vespertínum.
verses.en: Let my prayer be directed as incense in thy sight; * the lifting up of my hands, as evening sacrifice.

verses.la: Pone, Dómine, custódiam ori meo: * et óstium circumstántiæ lábiis meis.
verses.en: Set a watch, O Lord, before my mouth: * and a door round about my lips.

verses.la: Cum homínibus operántibus iniquitátem: * et non communicábo cum eléctis eórum.
verses.en: With men that work iniquity: * and I will not communicate with the choicest of them.

verses.la: Corrípiet me iustus in misericórdia, et increpábit me: * óleum autem peccatóris non impínguet caput meum.
verses.en: The just man shall correct me in mercy, and shall reprove me: * but let not the oil of the sinner fatten my head.

verses.la: Quóniam adhuc et orátio mea in beneplácitis eórum: * absórpti sunt iuncti petræ iúdices eórum.
verses.en: For my prayer also shall still be against the things with which they are well pleased: * their judges falling upon the rock have been swallowed up.

verses.la: Áudient verba mea quóniam potuérunt: * sicut crassitúdo terræ erúpta est super terram.
verses.en: They shall hear my words, for they have prevailed: * as when the thickness of the earth is broken up upon the ground.

verses.la: Dissipáta sunt ossa nostra secus inférnum: * quia ad te, Dómine, Dómine, óculi mei: in te sperávi, non áuferas ánimam meam.
verses.en: Our bones are scattered by the side of hell. * But to thee, O Lord, Lord, are my eyes: in thee have I put my trust, take not away my soul.

verses.la: Custódi me a láqueo, quem statuérunt mihi: * et a scándalis operántium iniquitátem.
verses.en: Keep me from the snare, which they have laid for me, * and from the stumbling blocks of them that work iniquity.

verses.la: Cadent in retiáculo eius peccatóres: * singuláriter sum ego donec tránseam.
verses.en: The wicked shall fall in his net: * I am alone until I pass.

verses.la: Voce mea ad Dóminum clamávi: * voce mea ad Dóminum deprecátus sum:
verses.en: I cried to the Lord with my voice: * with my voice I made supplication to the Lord.

verses.la: Effúndo in conspéctu eius oratiónem meam, * et tribulatiónem meam ante ipsum pronúntio.
verses.en: In his sight I pour out my prayer, * and before him I declare my trouble:

verses.la: In via hac, qua ambulábam, * abscondérunt láqueum mihi.
verses.en: In this way wherein I walked, * they have hidden a snare for me.

verses.la: Périit fuga a me, * et non est qui requírat ánimam meam.
verses.en: Flight hath failed me: * and there is no one that hath regard to my soul.

verses.la: Clamávi ad te, Dómine, * dixi: Tu es spes mea, pórtio mea in terra vivéntium.
verses.en: I cried to thee, O Lord: * I said: Thou art my hope, my portion in the land of the living.

verses.la: Líbera me a persequéntibus me: * quia confortáti sunt super me.
verses.en: Deliver me from my persecutors; * for they are stronger than I.

verses.la: Educ de custódia ánimam meam ad confiténdum nómini tuo: * me exspéctant iusti, donec retríbuas mihi.
verses.en: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: * the just wait for me, until thou reward me.

verses.la: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam: áuribus pércipe obsecratiónem meam in veritáte tua: * exáudi me in tua iustítia.
verses.en: Hear, O Lord, my prayer: give ear to my supplication in thy truth: * hear me in thy justice.

verses.la: Et non intres in iudícium cum servo tuo: * quia non iustificábitur in conspéctu tuo omnis vivens.
verses.en: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: * for in thy sight no man living shall be justified.

verses.la: Collocávit me in obscúris sicut mórtuos sǽculi: * et anxiátus est super me spíritus meus, in me turbátum est cor meum.
verses.en: He hath made me to dwell in darkness as those that have been dead of old: * and my spirit is in anguish within me: my heart within me is troubled.

verses.la: Memor fui diérum antiquórum, meditátus sum in ómnibus opéribus tuis: * in factis mánuum tuárum meditábar.
verses.en: I remembered the days of old, I meditated on all thy works: * I meditated upon the works of thy hands.

verses.la: Expándi manus meas ad te: * ánima mea sicut terra sine aqua tibi.
verses.en: I stretched forth my hands to thee: * my soul is as earth without water unto thee.

verses.la: Non avértas fáciem tuam a me: * et símilis ero descendéntibus in lacum.
verses.en: Turn not away thy face from me, * lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.

verses.la: Notam fac mihi viam, in qua ámbulem: * quia ad te levávi ánimam meam.
verses.en: Make the way known to me, wherein I should walk: * for I have lifted up my soul to thee.

verses.la: Éripe me de inimícis meis, Dómine, ad te confúgi: * doce me fácere voluntátem tuam, quia Deus meus es tu.
verses.en: Deliver me from my enemies, O Lord, to thee have I fled: * teach me to do thy will, for thou art my God.

verses.la: Spíritus tuus bonus dedúcet me in terram rectam: * propter nomen tuum, Dómine, vivificábis me, in æquitáte tua.
verses.en: Thy good spirit shall lead me into the right land: * for thy name’s sake, O Lord, thou wilt quicken me in thy justice.

verses.la: Edúces de tribulatióne ánimam meam: * et in misericórdia tua dispérdes inimícos meos.
verses.en: Thou wilt bring my soul out of trouble: * and in thy mercy thou wilt destroy my enemies.

verses.la: Et perdes omnes, qui tríbulant ánimam meam: * quóniam ego servus tuus sum.
verses.en: And thou wilt cut off all them that afflict my soul: * for I am thy servant.

verses.la: Benedíctus Dóminus, Deus meus, qui docet manus meas ad prǽlium, * et dígitos meos ad bellum.
verses.en: Blessed be the Lord my God, who teacheth my hands to fight, * and my fingers to war.

verses.la: Protéctor meus, et in ipso sperávi: * qui subdit pópulum meum sub me.
verses.en: My protector, and I have hoped in him: * who subdueth my people under me.

verses.la: Dómine, quid est homo, quia innotuísti ei? * aut fílius hóminis, quia réputas eum?
verses.en: Lord, what is man, that thou art made known to him? * or the son of man, that thou makest account of him?

verses.la: Homo vanitáti símilis factus est: * dies eius sicut umbra prætéreunt.
verses.en: Man is like to vanity: * his days pass away like a shadow.

verses.la: Dómine, inclína cælos tuos, et descénde: * tange montes, et fumigábunt.
verses.en: Lord, bow down thy heavens and descend: * touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

verses.la: Fúlgura coruscatiónem, et dissipábis eos: * emítte sagíttas tuas, et conturbábis eos.
verses.en: Send forth lightning, and thou shalt scatter them: * shoot out thy arrows, and thou shalt trouble them.

verses.la: Emítte manum tuam de alto, éripe me, et líbera me de aquis multis: * de manu filiórum alienórum.
verses.en: Put forth thy hand from on high, take me out, and deliver me from many waters: * from the hand of strange children:

verses.la: Quorum os locútum est vanitátem: * et déxtera eórum, déxtera iniquitátis.
verses.en: Whose mouth hath spoken vanity: * and their right hand is the right hand of iniquity.

verses.la: Deus, cánticum novum cantábo tibi: * in psaltério decachórdo psallam tibi.
verses.en: To thee, O God, I will sing a new canticle: * on the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings I will sing praises to thee.

verses.la: Qui das salútem régibus: * qui redemísti David, servum tuum, de gládio malígno: éripe me.
verses.en: Who givest salvation to kings: * who hast redeemed thy servant David from the malicious sword: Deliver me,

verses.la: Et érue me de manu filiórum alienórum, quorum os locútum est vanitátem: * et déxtera eórum, déxtera iniquitátis:
verses.en: And rescue me out of the hand of strange children; whose mouth hath spoken vanity: * and their right hand is the right hand of iniquity:

verses.la: Fíliæ eórum compósitæ: * circumornátæ ut similitúdo templi.
verses.en: Their daughters decked out, * adorned round about after the similitude of a temple:

verses.la: Oves eórum fœtósæ, abundántes in egréssibus suis: * boves eórum crassæ.
verses.en: Their sheep fruitful in young, abounding in their goings forth: * their oxen fat.

verses.la: Non est ruína macériæ, neque tránsitus: * neque clamor in platéis eórum.
verses.en: There is no breach of wall, nor passage, * nor crying out in their streets.

verses.la: Beátum dixérunt pópulum, cui hæc sunt: * beátus pópulus, cuius Dóminus Deus eius.
verses.en: They have called the people happy, that hath these things: * but happy is that people whose God is the Lord.

verses.la: Exaltábo te, Deus meus, rex: * et benedícam nómini tuo in sǽculum, et in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.en: I will extol thee, O God my king: * and I will bless thy name for ever; yea, for ever and ever.

verses.la: Per síngulos dies benedícam tibi: * et laudábo nomen tuum in sǽculum, et in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.en: Every day will I bless thee: * and I will praise thy name for ever; yea, for ever and ever.

verses.la: Magnus Dóminus, et laudábilis nimis: * et magnitúdinis eius non est finis.
verses.en: Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised: * and of his greatness there is no end.

verses.la: Generátio et generátio laudábit ópera tua: * et poténtiam tuam pronuntiábunt.
verses.en: Generation and generation shall praise thy works: * and they shall declare thy power.

verses.la: Magnificéntiam glóriæ sanctitátis tuæ loquéntur: * et mirabília tua narrábunt.
verses.en: They shall speak of the magnificence of the glory of thy holiness: * and shall tell thy wondrous works.

verses.la: Et virtútem terribílium tuórum dicent: * et magnitúdinem tuam narrábunt.
verses.en: And they shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: * and shall declare thy greatness.

verses.la: Memóriam abundántiæ suavitátis tuæ eructábunt: * et iustítia tua exsultábunt.
verses.en: They shall publish the memory of the abundance of thy sweetness: * and shall rejoice in thy justice.

verses.la: Nolíte confídere in princípibus: * in fíliis hóminum, in quibus non est salus.
verses.en: Put not your trust in princes: * in the children of men, in whom there is no salvation.

verses.la: Exíbit spíritus eius, et revertétur in terram suam: * in illa die períbunt omnes cogitatiónes eórum.
verses.en: His spirit shall go forth, and he shall return into his earth: * in that day all their thoughts shall perish.

verses.la: Beátus, cuius Deus Iacob adiútor eius, spes eius in Dómino, Deo ipsíus: * qui fecit cælum et terram, mare, et ómnia, quæ in eis sunt.
verses.en: Blessed is he who hath the God of Jacob for his helper, whose hope is in the Lord his God: * who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all things that are in them.

verses.la: Dóminus solvit compedítos: * Dóminus illúminat cæcos.
verses.en: The Lord looseth them that are fettered: * the Lord enlighteneth the blind.

verses.la: Dóminus érigit elísos, * Dóminus díligit iustos.
verses.en: The Lord lifteth up them that are cast down: * the Lord loveth the just.

verses.la: Dóminus custódit ádvenas, pupíllum et víduam suscípiet: * et vias peccatórum dispérdet.
verses.en: The Lord keepeth the strangers, he will support the fatherless and the widow: * and the ways of sinners he will destroy.

verses.la: Regnábit Dóminus in sǽcula, Deus tuus, Sion, * in generatiónem et generatiónem.
verses.en: The Lord shall reign for ever: thy God, O Sion, * unto generation and generation.

verses.la: Laudáte Dóminum quóniam bonus est psalmus: * Deo nostro sit iucúnda, decóraque laudátio.
verses.en: Praise ye the Lord, because psalm is good: * to our God be joyful and comely praise.

verses.la: Ædíficans Ierúsalem Dóminus: * dispersiónes Israélis congregábit.
verses.en: The Lord buildeth up Jerusalem: * he will gather together the dispersed of Israel.

verses.la: Qui sanat contrítos corde: * et álligat contritiónes eórum.
verses.en: Who healeth the broken of heart, * and bindeth up their bruises.

verses.la: Qui númerat multitúdinem stellárum: * et ómnibus eis nómina vocat.
verses.en: Who telleth the number of the stars: * and calleth them all by their names.

verses.la: Magnus Dóminus noster, et magna virtus eius: * et sapiéntiæ eius non est númerus.
verses.en: Great is our Lord, and great is his power: * and of his wisdom there is no number.

verses.la: Suscípiens mansuétos Dóminus: * humílians autem peccatóres usque ad terram.
verses.en: The Lord lifteth up the meek, * and bringeth the wicked down even to the ground.

verses.la: Præcínite Dómino in confessióne: * psállite Deo nostro in cíthara.
verses.en: Sing ye to the Lord with praise: * sing to our God upon the harp.

verses.la: Qui prodúcit in móntibus fænum: * et herbam servitúti hóminum.
verses.en: Who maketh grass to grow on the mountains, * and herbs for the service of men.

verses.la: Qui dat iuméntis escam ipsórum: * et pullis corvórum invocántibus eum.
verses.en: Who giveth to beasts their food: * and to the young ravens that call upon him.

verses.la: Non in fortitúdine equi voluntátem habébit: * nec in tíbiis viri beneplácitum erit ei.
verses.en: He shall not delight in the strength of the horse: * nor take pleasure in the legs of a man.

verses.la: Beneplácitum est Dómino super timéntes eum: * et in eis, qui sperant super misericórdia eius.
verses.en: The Lord taketh pleasure in them that fear him: * and in them that hope in his mercy.

verses.la: Lauda, Ierúsalem, Dóminum: * lauda Deum tuum, Sion.
verses.en: Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem: * praise thy God, O Sion.

verses.la: Quóniam confortávit seras portárum tuárum: * benedíxit fíliis tuis in te.
verses.en: Because he hath strengthened the bolts of thy gates * he hath blessed thy children within thee.

verses.la: Qui pósuit fines tuos pacem: * et ádipe fruménti sátiat te.
verses.en: Who hath placed peace in thy borders: * and filleth thee with the fat of corn.

verses.la: Qui emíttit elóquium suum terræ: * velóciter currit sermo eius.
verses.en: Who sendeth forth his speech to the earth: * his word runneth swiftly.

verses.la: Qui dat nivem sicut lanam: * nébulam sicut cínerem spargit.
verses.en: Who giveth snow like wool: * scattereth mists like ashes.

verses.la: Mittit crystállum suam sicut buccéllas: * ante fáciem frígoris eius quis sustinébit?
verses.en: He sendeth his crystal like morsels: * who shall stand before the face of his cold?

verses.la: Emíttet verbum suum, et liquefáciet ea: * flabit spíritus eius, et fluent aquæ.
verses.en: He shall send out his word, and shall melt them: * his wind shall blow, and the waters shall run.

verses.la: Qui annúntiat verbum suum Iacob: * iustítias, et iudícia sua Israël.
verses.en: Who declareth his word to Jacob: * his justices and his judgments to Israel.

verses.la: Non fecit táliter omni natióni: * et iudícia sua non manifestávit eis.
verses.en: He hath not done in like manner to every nation: * and his judgments he hath not made manifest to them.

verses.la: Laudáte Dóminum de cælis: * laudáte eum in excélsis.
verses.en: Praise ye the Lord from the heavens * praise ye him in the high places.

verses.la: Laudáte eum, omnes Ángeli eius: * laudáte eum, omnes virtútes eius.
verses.en: Praise ye him, all his angels: * praise ye him, all his hosts.

verses.la: Laudáte eum, sol et luna: * laudáte eum, omnes stellæ et lumen.
verses.en: Praise ye him, O sun and moon: * praise him, all ye stars and light.

verses.la: Laudáte eum, cæli cælórum: * et aquæ omnes, quæ super cælos sunt, laudent nomen Dómini.
verses.en: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens: * and let all the waters that are above the heavens, praise the name of the Lord.

verses.la: Quia ipse dixit, et facta sunt: * ipse mandávit, et creáta sunt.
verses.en: For he spoke, and they were made: * he commanded, and they were created.

verses.la: Státuit ea in ætérnum, et in sǽculum sǽculi: * præcéptum pósuit, et non præteríbit.
verses.en: He hath established them for ever, and for ages of ages: * he hath made a decree, and it shall not pass away.

verses.la: Laudáte Dóminum de terra, * dracónes, et omnes abýssi.
verses.en: Praise the Lord from the earth, * ye dragons, and all ye deeps:

verses.la: Ignis, grando, nix, glácies, spíritus procellárum: * quæ fáciunt verbum eius:
verses.en: Fire, hail, snow, ice, stormy winds * which fulfill his word:

verses.la: Montes, et omnes colles: * ligna fructífera, et omnes cedri.
verses.en: Mountains and all hills, * fruitful trees and all cedars:

verses.la: Béstiæ, et univérsa pécora: * serpéntes, et vólucres pennátæ:
verses.en: Beasts and all cattle: * serpents and feathered fowls:

verses.la: Reges terræ, et omnes pópuli: * príncipes, et omnes iúdices terræ.
verses.en: Kings of the earth and all people: * princes and all judges of the earth:

verses.la: Iúvenes, et vírgines: senes cum iunióribus laudent nomen Dómini: * quia exaltátum est nomen eius solíus.
verses.en: Young men and maidens: let the old with the younger, praise the name of the Lord: * For his name alone is exalted.

verses.la: Hymnus ómnibus sanctis eius: * fíliis Israël, pópulo appropinquánti sibi.
verses.en: A hymn to all his saints: to the children of Israel, a people approaching him.

verses.la: Cantáte Dómino cánticum novum: * laus eius in ecclésia sanctórum.
verses.en: Sing ye to the Lord a new canticle: * let his praise be in the church of the saints.

verses.la: Lætétur Israël in eo, qui fecit eum: * et fílii Sion exsúltent in rege suo.
verses.en: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: * and let the children of Sion be joyful in their king.

verses.la: Laudent nomen eius in choro: * in týmpano, et psaltério psallant ei:
verses.en: Let them praise his name in choir: * let them sing to him with the timbrel and the psaltery.

verses.la: Quia beneplácitum est Dómino in pópulo suo: * et exaltábit mansuétos in salútem.
verses.en: For the Lord is well pleased with his people: * and he will exalt the meek unto salvation.

verses.la: Exsultábunt sancti in glória: * lætabúntur in cubílibus suis.
verses.en: The saints shall rejoice in glory: * they shall be joyful in their beds.

verses.la: Exaltatiónes Dei in gútture eórum: * et gládii ancípites in mánibus eórum.
verses.en: The high praises of God shall be in their mouth: * and two-edged swords in their hands:

verses.la: Ad faciéndam vindíctam in natiónibus: * increpatiónes in pópulis.
verses.en: To execute vengeance upon the nations, * chastisements among the people:

verses.la: Ad alligándos reges eórum in compédibus: * et nóbiles eórum in mánicis férreis.
verses.en: To bind their kings with fetters, * and their nobles with manacles of iron.

verses.la: Ut fáciant in eis iudícium conscríptum: * glória hæc est ómnibus sanctis eius.
verses.en: To execute upon them the judgment that is written: * this glory is to all his saints.

verses.la: Laudáte Dóminum in sanctis eius: * laudáte eum in firmaménto virtútis eius.
verses.en: Praise ye the Lord in his holy places: * praise ye him in the firmament of his power.

verses.la: Laudáte eum in virtútibus eius: * laudáte eum secúndum multitúdinem magnitúdinis eius.
verses.en: Praise ye him for his mighty acts: * praise ye him according to the multitude of his greatness.

verses.la: Laudáte eum in sono tubæ: * laudáte eum in psaltério, et cíthara.
verses.en: Praise him with sound of trumpet: * praise him with psaltery and harp.

verses.la: Laudáte eum in týmpano, et choro: * laudáte eum in chordis, et órgano.
verses.en: Praise him with timbrel and choir: * praise him with strings and organs.

verses.la: Laudáte eum in cýmbalis benesonántibus: laudáte eum in cýmbalis iubilatiónis: * omnis spíritus laudet Dóminum.
verses.en: Praise him on high sounding cymbals: praise him on cymbals of joy: * let every spirit praise the Lord.

verses.la: Benedíctus es, Dómine, in firmaménto cæli: * et laudábilis, et gloriósus, et superexaltátus in sǽcula.
verses.en: Blessed art thou, O Lord, in the firmament of heaven: * and worthy of praise, and glorious for ever.

verses.la: Benedícite, ómnia ópera Dómini, Dómino: * laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.
verses.en: All ye works of the Lord, bless the Lord: * praise and exalt him above all for ever.

verses.la: Benedícite, Ángeli Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, cæli, Dómino.
verses.en: O ye angels of the Lord, bless the Lord: * O ye heavens, bless the Lord:

verses.la: Benedícite, aquæ omnes, quæ super cælos sunt, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes virtútes Dómini, Dómino.
verses.en: O all ye waters that are above the heavens, bless the Lord: * O all ye powers of the Lord, bless the Lord.

verses.la: Benedícite, sol et luna, Dómino: * benedícite, stellæ cæli, Dómino.
verses.en: O ye sun and moon, bless the Lord: * O ye stars of heaven, bless the Lord.

verses.la: Benedícite, omnis imber et ros, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes spíritus Dei, Dómino.
verses.en: O every shower and dew, bless ye the Lord: * O all ye spirits of God, bless the Lord.

verses.la: Benedícite, ignis et æstus, Dómino: * benedícite, frigus et æstus, Dómino.
verses.en: O ye fire and heat, bless the Lord: * O ye cold and heat, bless the Lord.

verses.la: Benedícite, rores et pruína, Dómino: * benedícite, gelu et frigus, Dómino.
verses.en: O ye dews and hoar frosts, bless the Lord: * O ye frost and cold, bless the Lord.

verses.la: Benedícite, glácies et nives, Dómino: * benedícite, noctes et dies, Dómino.
verses.en: O ye ice and snow, bless the Lord: * O ye nights and days, bless the Lord.

verses.la: Benedícite, lux et ténebræ, Dómino: * benedícite, fúlgura et nubes, Dómino.
verses.en: O ye light and darkness, bless the Lord: * O ye lightnings and clouds, bless the Lord.

verses.la: Benedícat terra Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.
verses.en: O let the earth bless the Lord: * let it praise and exalt him above all for ever.

verses.la: Benedícite, montes et colles, Dómino: * benedícite, univérsa germinántia in terra, Dómino.
verses.en: O ye mountains and hills, bless the Lord: * O all ye things that spring up in the earth, bless the Lord.

verses.la: Benedícite, fontes, Dómino: * benedícite, mária et flúmina, Dómino.
verses.en: O ye fountains, bless the Lord: * O ye seas and rivers, bless the Lord.

verses.la: Benedícite, cete, et ómnia, quæ movéntur in aquis, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes vólucres cæli, Dómino.
verses.en: O ye whales, and all that move in the waters, bless the Lord: * O all ye fowls of the air, bless the Lord.

verses.la: Benedícite, omnes béstiæ et pécora, Dómino: * benedícite, fílii hóminum, Dómino.
verses.en: O all ye beasts and cattle, bless the Lord: * O ye sons of men, bless the Lord.

verses.la: Benedícat Israël Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.
verses.en: O let Israel bless the Lord: * let them praise and exalt him above all for ever.

verses.la: Benedícite, sacerdótes Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, servi Dómini, Dómino.
verses.en: O ye priests of the Lord, bless the Lord: * O ye servants of the Lord, bless the Lord.

verses.la: Benedícite, spíritus, et ánimæ iustórum, Dómino: * benedícite, sancti, et húmiles corde, Dómino.
verses.en: O ye spirits and souls of the just, bless the Lord: * O ye holy and humble of heart, bless the Lord.

verses.la: Benedícite, Ananía, Azaría, Mísaël, Dómino: * laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.
verses.en: O Ananias, Azarias, and Misael, bless ye the Lord: * praise and exalt him above all for ever.

verses.la: (Fit reverentia:) Benedicámus Patrem et Fílium cum Sancto Spíritu: * laudémus et superexaltémus eum in sǽcula.
verses.en: (Bow head) Let us bless the Father and the Son, with the Holy Ghost; * let us praise and exalt him above all for ever.

verses.la: Benedíctus es, Dómine, Deus Israël patris nostri, * ab ætérno in ætérnum.
verses.en: Blessed art thou, O Lord the God of Israel, our father * from eternity to eternity.

verses.la: Tuum, Dómine, regnum, * et tu es super omnes príncipes.
verses.en: Thine is the kingdom, O Lord, * and thou art above all princes.

verses.la: In manu tua virtus et poténtia: * in manu tua magnitúdo, et impérium ómnium.
verses.en: In thy hand is power and might: * in thy hand greatness, and the empire of all things.

verses.la: Nunc ígitur, Deus noster, confitémur tibi, * et laudámus nomen tuum ínclitum.
verses.en: Now therefore our God we give thanks to thee, * and we praise thy glorious name.

verses.la: Magnus es, Dómine, in ætérnum, * et in ómnia sǽcula regnum tuum:
verses.en: Thou art great, O Lord, for ever, * and thy kingdom is unto all ages:

verses.la: Quóniam tu flagéllas, et salvas: dedúcis ad ínferos, et redúcis: * et non est qui effúgiat manum tuam.
verses.en: For thou scourgest, and thou savest: thou leadest down to hell, and bringest up again: * and there is none that can escape thy hand.

verses.la: Confitémini Dómino, fílii Israël, * et in conspéctu géntium laudáte eum:
verses.en: Give glory to the Lord, ye children of Israel, * and praise him in the sight of the Gentiles:

verses.la: Quóniam ídeo dispérsit vos inter gentes, quæ ignórant eum, * ut vos enarrétis mirabília eius,
verses.en: Because he hath therefore scattered you among the Gentiles, who know not him, * that you may declare his wonderful works,

verses.la: Et faciátis scire eos, * quia non est álius Deus omnípotens præter eum.
verses.en: And make them know * that there is no other almighty God besides him.

verses.la: Ipse castigávit nos propter iniquitátes nostras: * et ipse salvábit nos propter misericórdiam suam.
verses.en: He hath chastised us for our iniquities: * and he will save us for his own mercy.

verses.la: Aspícite ergo quæ fecit nobíscum, et cum timóre et tremóre confitémini illi: * Regémque sæculórum exaltáte in opéribus vestris.
verses.en: See then what he hath done with us, and with fear and trembling give ye glory to him: * and extol the eternal King of worlds in your works.

verses.la: Ego autem in terra captivitátis meæ confitébor illi: * quóniam osténdit maiestátem suam in gentem peccatrícem.
verses.en: As for me, I will praise him in the land of my captivity: * because he hath shewn his majesty toward a sinful nation.

verses.la: Convertímini ítaque, peccatóres, et fácite iustítiam coram Deo, * credéntes quod fáciat vobíscum misericórdiam suam:
verses.en: Be converted therefore, ye sinners, and do justice before God, * believing that he will shew his mercy to you.

verses.la: Ego autem, et ánima mea * in eo lætábimur.
verses.en: And I and my soul * will rejoice in him.

verses.la: Benedícite Dóminum, omnes elécti eius: * ágite dies lætítiæ, et confitémini illi.
verses.en: Bless ye the Lord, all his elect, * keep days of joy, and give glory to him.

verses.la: Hymnum cantémus Dómino, * hymnum novum cantémus Deo nostro.
verses.en: Let us sing a hymn to the Lord, * let us sing a new hymn to our God.

verses.la: Adonái, Dómine, magnus es tu, et præclárus in virtúte tua, * et quem superáre nemo potest.
verses.en: O Adonai, Lord, great art thou, and glorious in thy power, * and no one can overcome thee.

verses.la: Tibi sérviat omnis creatúra tua: * quia dixísti, et facta sunt:
verses.en: Let all thy creatures serve thee: * because thou hast spoken, and they were made:

verses.la: Misísti spíritum tuum, et creáta sunt, * et non est qui resístat voci tuæ.
verses.en: Thou didst send forth thy spirit, and they were created, * and there is no one that can resist thy voice.

verses.la: Montes a fundaméntis movebúntur cum aquis: * petræ, sicut cera, liquéscent ante fáciem tuam.
verses.en: The mountains shall be moved from the foundations with the waters: * the rocks shall melt as wax before thy face.

verses.la: Qui autem timent te, * magni erunt apud te per ómnia.
verses.en: But they that fear thee, * shall be great with thee in all things.

verses.la: Væ genti insurgénti super genus meum: Dóminus enim omnípotens vindicábit in eis, * in die iudícii visitábit illos.
verses.en: Woe be to the nation that riseth up against my people: for the Lord almighty will take revenge on them, * in the day of judgment he will visit them.

verses.la: Dabit enim ignem, et vermes in carnes eórum, * ut urántur, et séntiant usque in sempitérnum.
verses.en: For he will give fire, and worms into their flesh, * that they may burn, and may feel for ever.

verses.la: Audíte verbum Dómini, gentes, * et annuntiáte in ínsulis, quæ procul sunt,
verses.en: Hear the word of the Lord, O ye nations, * and declare it in the islands that are afar off,

verses.la: Et dícite: Qui dispérsit Israël, congregábit eum: * et custódiet eum sicut pastor gregem suum.
verses.en: And say: He that scattered Israel will gather him: * and he will keep him as the shepherd doth his flock.

verses.la: Redémit enim Dóminus Iacob, * et liberávit eum de manu potentióris.
verses.en: For the Lord hath redeemed Jacob, * and delivered him out of the hand of one that was mightier than he.

verses.la: Et vénient, et laudábunt in monte Sion: * et cónfluent ad bona Dómini,
verses.en: And they shall come, and shall give praise in mount Sion: * and they shall flow together to the good things of the Lord,

verses.la: Super fruménto, et vino, et óleo, * et fœtu pécorum et armentórum:
verses.en: For the corn, and wine, and oil, * and the increase of cattle and herds,

verses.la: Erítque ánima eórum quasi hortus irríguus, * et ultra non esúrient.
verses.en: And their soul shall be as a watered garden, * and they shall be hungry no more.

verses.la: Tunc lætábitur virgo in choro, * iúvenes et senes simul:
verses.en: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, * the young men and old men together:

verses.la: Et convértam luctum eórum in gáudium, * et consolábor eos, et lætificábo a dolóre suo.
verses.en: And I will turn their mourning into joy, * and will comfort them, and make them joyful after their sorrow.

verses.la: Et inebriábo ánimam sacerdótum pinguédine: * et pópulus meus bonis meis adimplébitur.
verses.en: And I will fill the soul of the priests with fatness: * and my people shall be filled with my good things.

verses.la: Vere tu es Deus abscónditus, * Deus Israël, Salvátor.
verses.en: Verily thou art a hidden God, * the God of Israel the saviour.

verses.la: Confúsi sunt, et erubuérunt omnes: * simul abiérunt in confusiónem fabricatóres errórum.
verses.en: They are all confounded and ashamed: * the forgers of errors are gone together into confusion.

verses.la: Israël salvátus est in Dómino salúte ætérna: * non confundémini, et non erubescétis usque in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.en: Israel is saved in the Lord with an eternal salvation: * you shall not be confounded, and you shall not be ashamed for ever and ever.

verses.la: Quia hæc dicit Dóminus creans cælos, * ipse Deus formans terram, et fáciens eam, ipse plastes eius:
verses.en: For thus saith the Lord that created the heavens, * God himself that formed the earth, and made it, the very maker thereof:

verses.la: Non in vanum creávit eam, ut habitarétur, formávit eam: * Ego Dóminus, et non est álius.
verses.en: He did not create it in vain: he formed it to be inhabited. * I am the Lord, and there is no other.

verses.la: Non in abscóndito locútus sum, * in loco terræ tenebróso:
verses.en: I have not spoken in secret, * in a dark place of the earth:

verses.la: Non dixi sémini Iacob frustra: Quǽrite me: * ego Dóminus loquens iustítiam, annúntians recta.
verses.en: I have not said to the seed of Jacob: Seek me in vain. * I am the Lord that speak justice, that declare right things.

verses.la: Congregámini, et veníte, et accédite simul * qui salváti estis ex géntibus:
verses.en: Assemble yourselves, and come, and draw near together, * ye that are saved of the Gentiles:

verses.la: Nesciérunt qui levant lignum sculptúræ suæ, * et rogant deum non salvántem.
verses.en: They have no knowledge that set up the wood of their graven work, * and pray to a god that cannot save.

verses.la: Annuntiáte, et veníte, et consiliámini simul: * Quis audítum fecit hoc ab inítio, ex tunc prædíxit illud?
verses.en: Tell ye, and come, and consult together: * who hath declared this from the beginning, who hath foretold this from that time?

verses.la: Numquid non ego Dóminus, et non est ultra Deus absque me? * Deus iustus, et salvans non est præter me.
verses.en: Have not I the Lord, and there is no God else besides me? * A just God and a saviour, there is none besides me.

verses.la: Convertímini ad me, et salvi éritis, omnes fines terræ: * quia ego Deus, et non est álius.
verses.en: Be converted to me, and you shall be saved, all ye ends of the earth: * for I am God, and there is no other.

verses.la: In memetípso iurávi, egrediétur de ore meo iustítiæ verbum, * et non revertétur:
verses.en: I have sworn by myself, the word of justice shall go out of my mouth, * and shall not return:

verses.la: Quia mihi curvábitur omne genu, * et iurábit omnis lingua.
verses.en: For every knee shall be bowed to me, * and every tongue shall swear.

verses.la: Ergo in Dómino, dicet, meæ sunt iustítiæ et impérium: * ad eum vénient, et confundéntur omnes qui repúgnant ei.
verses.en: Therefore shall he say: In the Lord are my justices and empire: * they shall come to him, and all that resist him shall be confounded.

verses.la: In Dómino iustificábitur, et laudábitur * omne semen Israël.
verses.en: In the Lord shall all the seed * of Israel be justified and praised.

verses.la: Miserére nostri, Deus ómnium, et réspice nos, * et osténde nobis lucem miseratiónum tuárum:
verses.en: Have mercy upon us, O God of all, and behold us, * and shew us the light of thy mercies:

verses.la: Et immítte timórem tuum super gentes, * quæ non exquisiérunt te,
verses.en: And send thy fear upon the nations, * that have not sought after thee:

verses.la: Ut cognóscant quia non est Deus nisi tu, * et enárrent magnália tua.
verses.en: That they may know that there is no God beside thee, * and that they may shew forth thy wonders.

verses.la: Álleva manum tuam super gentes aliénas, * ut vídeant poténtiam tuam.
verses.en: Lift up thy hand over the strange nations, * that they may see thy power.

verses.la: Sicut enim in conspéctu eórum sanctificátus es in nobis, * sic in conspéctu nostro magnificáberis in eis,
verses.en: For as thou hast been sanctified in us in their sight, * so thou shalt be magnified among them in our presence,

verses.la: Ut cognóscant te, sicut et nos cognóvimus, * quóniam non est Deus præter te, Dómine.
verses.en: That they may know thee, as we also have known thee, * that there is no God beside thee, O Lord.

verses.la: Ínnova signa, et immúta mirabília. * Glorífica manum, et brácchium dextrum.
verses.en: Renew thy signs, and work new miracles. * Glorify thy hand, and thy right arm.

verses.la: Éxcita furórem, et effúnde iram. * Tolle adversárium, et afflíge inimícum.
verses.en: Raise up indignation, and pour out wrath. * Take away the adversary, and crush the enemy.

verses.la: Festína tempus, et meménto finis, * ut enárrent mirabília tua.
verses.en: Hasten the time, and remember the end, * that they may declare thy wonderful works.

verses.la: In ira flammæ devorétur qui salvátur: * et qui péssimant plebem tuam, invéniant perditiónem.
verses.en: Let him that escapeth be consumed by the rage of the fire: * and let them perish that oppress thy people.

verses.la: Cóntere caput príncipum inimicórum, * dicéntium: Non est álius præter nos.
verses.en: Crush the head of the princes of the enemies * that say: There is no other beside us.

verses.la: Cóngrega omnes tribus Iacob: ut cognóscant quia non est Deus nisi tu, * et enárrent magnália tua:
verses.en: Gather together all the tribes of Jacob: that they may know that there is no God besides thee, * and may declare thy great works.

verses.la: Et hereditábis eos, * sicut ab inítio.
verses.en: And thou shalt inherit them * as from the beginning.

verses.la: Miserére plebi tuæ, super quam invocátum est nomen tuum: * et Israël, quem coæquásti primogénito tuo.
verses.en: Have mercy on thy people, upon whom thy name is invoked: * and upon Israel, whom thou hast raised up to be thy firstborn.

verses.la: Miserére civitáti sanctificatiónis tuæ Ierúsalem, * civitáti requiéi tuæ.
verses.en: Have mercy on Jerusalem, the city which thou hast sanctified, * the city of thy rest.

verses.la: Reple Sion inenarrabílibus verbis tuis, * et glória tua pópulum tuum.
verses.en: Fill Sion with thy unspeakable words, * and thy people with thy glory.

verses.la: Benedíctus es, Dómine, Deus patrum nostrórum: * et laudábilis, et gloriósus, et superexaltátus in sǽcula.
verses.en: Blessed art thou, O Lord the God of our fathers: * and worthy to be praised, and glorified, and exalted above all for ever:

verses.la: Et benedíctum nomen glóriæ tuæ sanctum: * et laudábile, et superexaltátum in ómnibus sǽculis.
verses.en: And blessed is the holy name of thy glory: * and worthy to be praised, and exalted above all in all ages.

verses.la: Benedíctus es in templo sancto glóriæ tuæ: * et superlaudábilis, et supergloriósus in sǽcula.
verses.en: Blessed art thou in the holy temple of thy glory: * and exceedingly to be praised, and exceeding glorious for ever.

verses.la: Benedíctus es in throno regni tui: * et superlaudábilis, et superexaltátus in sǽcula.
verses.en: Blessed art thou on the throne of thy kingdom, * and exceedingly to be praised, and exalted above all for ever.

verses.la: Benedíctus es, qui intuéris abýssos, et sedes super Chérubim: * et laudábilis, et superexaltátus in sǽcula.
verses.en: Blessed art thou, that beholdest the depths, and sittest upon the cherubims: * and worthy to be praised and exalted above all for ever.

verses.la: Benedíctus es in firmaménto cæli: * et laudábilis, et gloriósus in sǽcula.
verses.en: Blessed art thou in the firmament of heaven: * and worthy of praise, and glorious for ever.

verses.la: Benedícite, ómnia ópera Dómini, Dómino: * laudáte, et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.
verses.en: All ye works of the Lord, bless the Lord: * praise and exalt him above all for ever.

verses.la: Confitébor tibi, Dómine, quóniam irátus es mihi: * convérsus est furor tuus, et consolátus es me.
verses.en: I will give thanks to thee, O Lord, for thou wast angry with me: * thy wrath is turned away, and thou hast comforted me.

verses.la: Ecce Deus salvátor meus, * fiduciáliter agam, et non timébo:
verses.en: Behold, God is my saviour, * I will deal confidently, and will not fear:

verses.la: Quia fortitúdo mea, et laus mea Dóminus, * et factus est mihi in salútem.
verses.en: Because the Lord is my strength, and my praise, * and he is become my salvation.

verses.la: Hauriétis aquas in gáudio de fóntibus Salvatóris: * et dicétis in die illa: Confitémini Dómino, et invocáte nomen eius:
verses.en: You shall draw waters with joy out of the saviour’s fountains: * And you shall say in that day: Praise ye the Lord, and call upon his name:

verses.la: Notas fácite in pópulis adinventiónes eius: * mementóte quóniam excélsum est nomen eius.
verses.en: Make his works known among the people: * remember that his name is high.

verses.la: Cantáte Dómino quóniam magnífice fecit: * annuntiáte hoc in univérsa terra.
verses.en: Sing ye to the Lord, for he hath done great things: * shew this forth in all the earth.

verses.la: Exsúlta, et lauda, habitátio Sion: * quia magnus in médio tui Sanctus Israël.
verses.en: Rejoice, and praise, O thou habitation of Sion: * for great is he that is in the midst of thee the Holy One of Israel.

verses.la: Ego dixi: In dimídio diérum meórum * vadam ad portas ínferi.
verses.en: I said: In the midst of my days * I shall go to the gates of hell:

verses.la: Quæsívi resíduum annórum meórum. * Dixi: Non vidébo Dóminum Deum in terra vivéntium.
verses.en: I sought for the residue of my years. * I said: I shall not see the Lord God in the land of the living.

verses.la: Non aspíciam hóminem ultra, * et habitatórem quiétis.
verses.en: I shall behold man no more, * nor the inhabitant of rest.

verses.la: Generátio mea abláta est, et convolúta est a me, * quasi tabernáculum pastórum.
verses.en: My generation is at an end, and it is rolled away from me, * as a shepherd’s tent.

verses.la: Præcísa est velut a texénte, vita mea: dum adhuc ordírer, succídit me: * de mane usque ad vésperam fínies me.
verses.en: My life is cut off, as by a weaver: whilst I was yet but beginning, he cut me off: * from morning even to night thou wilt make an end of me.

verses.la: Sperábam usque ad mane, * quasi leo sic contrívit ómnia ossa mea:
verses.en: I hoped till morning, * as a lion so hath he broken all my bones:

verses.la: De mane usque ad vésperam fínies me: * sicut pullus hirúndinis sic clamábo, meditábor ut colúmba:
verses.en: From morning even to night thou wilt make an end of me. * I will cry like a young swallow, I will meditate like a dove:

verses.la: Attenuáti sunt óculi mei, * suspiciéntes in excélsum.
verses.en: My eyes are weakened * looking upward:

verses.la: Dómine, vim pátior, respónde pro me. * Quid dicam, aut quid respondébit mihi, cum ipse fécerit?
verses.en: Lord, I suffer violence, answer thou for me. * What shall I say, or what shall he answer for me, whereas he himself hath done it?

verses.la: Recogitábo tibi omnes annos meos * in amaritúdine ánimæ meæ.
verses.en: I will recount to thee all my years * in the bitterness of my soul.

verses.la: Dómine, si sic vívitur, et in tálibus vita spíritus mei, corrípies me, et vivificábis me. * Ecce, in pace amaritúdo mea amaríssima:
verses.en: O Lord, if man’s life be such, and the life of my spirit be in such things as these, thou shalt correct me, and make me to live. * Behold in peace is my bitterness most bitter:

verses.la: Tu autem eruísti ánimam meam ut non períret: * proiecísti post tergum tuum ómnia peccáta mea.
verses.en: But thou hast delivered my soul that it should not perish, * thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back.

verses.la: Quia non inférnus confitébitur tibi, neque mors laudábit te: * non exspectábunt qui descéndunt in lacum, veritátem tuam.
verses.en: For hell shall not confess to thee, neither shall death praise thee: * nor shall they that go down into the pit, look for thy truth.

verses.la: Vivens vivens ipse confitébitur tibi, sicut et ego hódie: * pater fíliis notam fáciet veritátem tuam.
verses.en: The living, the living, he shall give praise to thee, as I do this day: * the father shall make thy truth known to the children.

verses.la: Dómine, salvum me fac * et psalmos nostros cantábimus cunctis diébus vitæ nostræ in domo Dómini.
verses.en: O Lord, save me, and we will sing our psalms all the days of our life * in the house of the Lord.

verses.la: Exsultávit cor meum in Dómino, * et exaltátum est cornu meum in Deo meo.
verses.en: My heart hath rejoiced in the Lord, * and my horn is exalted in my God:

verses.la: Dilatátum est os meum super inimícos meos: * quia lætáta sum in salutári tuo.
verses.en: My mouth is enlarged over my enemies: * because I have joyed in thy salvation.

verses.la: Non est sanctus, ut est Dóminus: neque enim est álius extra te, * et non est fortis sicut Deus noster.
verses.en: There is none holy as the Lord is: for there is no other beside thee, * and there is none strong like our God.

verses.la: Nolíte multiplicáre loqui sublímia, * gloriántes:
verses.en: Do not multiply to speak lofty things, * boasting:

verses.la: Recédant vétera de ore vestro: quia Deus scientiárum, Dóminus est, * et ipsi præparántur cogitatiónes.
verses.en: Let old matters depart from your mouth: for the Lord is a God of all knowledge, * and to him are thoughts prepared.

verses.la: Arcus fórtium superátus est, * et infírmi accíncti sunt róbore.
verses.en: The bow of the mighty is overcome, * and the weak are girt with strength.

verses.la: Repléti prius, pro pánibus se locavérunt: * et famélici saturáti sunt.
verses.en: They that were full before have hired out themselves for bread: * and the hungry are filled,

verses.la: Donec stérilis péperit plúrimos: * et quæ multos habébat fílios, infirmáta est.
verses.en: So that the barren hath borne many: * and she that had many children is weakened.

verses.la: Dóminus mortíficat et vivíficat, * dedúcit ad ínferos et redúcit.
verses.en: The Lord killeth and maketh alive, * he bringeth down to hell and bringeth back again.

verses.la: Dóminus páuperem facit et ditat, * humíliat et súblevat.
verses.en: The Lord maketh poor and maketh rich, * he humbleth and he exalteth.

verses.la: Súscitat de púlvere egénum, * et de stércore élevat páuperem:
verses.en: He raiseth up the needy from the dust, * and lifteth up the poor from the dunghill:

verses.la: Ut sédeat cum princípibus, * et sólium glóriæ téneat.
verses.en: That he may sit with princes, * and hold the throne of glory.

verses.la: Dómini enim sunt cárdines terræ, * et pósuit super eos orbem.
verses.en: For the poles of the earth are the Lord’s, * and upon them he hath set the world.

verses.la: Pedes sanctórum suórum servábit, et ímpii in ténebris conticéscent: * quia non in fortitúdine sua roborábitur vir.
verses.en: He will keep the feet of his saints, and the wicked shall be silent in darkness, * because no man shall prevail by his own strength.

verses.la: Dóminum formidábunt adversárii eius: * et super ipsos in cælis tonábit:
verses.en: The adversaries of the Lord shall fear him: * and upon them shall he thunder in the heavens.

verses.la: Dóminus iudicábit fines terræ, et dabit impérium regi suo, * et sublimábit cornu Christi sui.
verses.en: The Lord shall judge the ends of the earth, and he shall give empire to his king, * and shall exalt the horn of his Christ.

verses.la: Cantémus Dómino: glorióse enim magnificátus est, * equum et ascensórem deiécit in mare.
verses.en: Let us sing to the Lord: for he is gloriously magnified, * the horse and the rider he hath thrown into the sea.

verses.la: Fortitúdo mea, et laus mea Dóminus, * et factus est mihi in salútem.
verses.en: The Lord is my strength and my praise, * and he is become salvation to me:

verses.la: Iste Deus meus, et glorificábo eum: * Deus patris mei, et exaltábo eum.
verses.en: He is my God and I will glorify him: * the God of my father, and I will exalt him.

verses.la: Dóminus quasi vir pugnátor, Omnípotens nomen eius. * Currus Pharaónis et exércitum eius proiécit in mare.
verses.en: The Lord is as a man of war, Almighty is his name. * Pharao’s chariots and his army he hath cast into the sea:

verses.la: Elécti príncipes eius submérsi sunt in Mari Rubro: * abýssi operuérunt eos, descendérunt in profúndum quasi lapis.
verses.en: His chosen captains are drowned in the Red Sea. * The depths have covered them, they are sunk to the bottom like a stone.

verses.la: Déxtera tua, Dómine, magnificáta est in fortitúdine: déxtera tua, Dómine, percússit inimícum. * Et in multitúdine glóriæ tuæ deposuísti adversários tuos:
verses.en: Thy right hand, O Lord, is magnified in strength: thy right hand, O Lord, hath slain the enemy. * And in the multitude of thy glory thou hast put down thy adversaries:

verses.la: Misísti iram tuam, quæ devorávit eos sicut stípulam. * Et in spíritu furóris tui congregátæ sunt aquæ:
