verses.en: Thou hast sent thy wrath, which hath devoured them like stubble. * And with the blast of thy anger the waters were gathered together:

verses.la: Stetit unda fluens, * congregátæ sunt abýssi in médio mari.
verses.en: The flowing water stood, * the depths were gathered together in the midst of the sea.

verses.la: Dixit inimícus: Pérsequar et comprehéndam, * dívidam spólia, implébitur ánima mea:
verses.en: The enemy said: I will pursue and overtake, * I will divide the spoils, my soul shall have its fill:

verses.la: Evaginábo gládium meum, * interfíciet eos manus mea.
verses.en: I will draw my sword, * my hand shall slay them.

verses.la: Flavit spíritus tuus, et opéruit eos mare: * submérsi sunt quasi plumbum in aquis veheméntibus.
verses.en: Thy wind blew and the sea covered them: * they sunk as lead in the mighty waters.

verses.la: Quis símilis tui in fórtibus, Dómine? * quis símilis tui, magníficus in sanctitáte, terríbilis atque laudábilis, fáciens mirabília?
verses.en: Who is like to thee, among the strong, O Lord? * who is like to thee, glorious in holiness, terrible and praiseworthy, doing wonders?

verses.la: Extendísti manum tuam, et devorávit eos terra. * Dux fuísti in misericórdia tua pópulo quem redemísti:
verses.en: Thou stretchedst forth thy hand, and the earth swallowed them. * In thy mercy thou hast been a leader to the people which thou hast redeemed:

verses.la: Et portásti eum in fortitúdine tua, * ad habitáculum sanctum tuum.
verses.en: And in thy strength thou hast carried them * to thy holy habitation.

verses.la: Ascendérunt pópuli, et iráti sunt: * dolóres obtinuérunt habitatóres Philísthiim.
verses.en: Nations rose up, and were angry: * sorrows took hold on the inhabitants of Philisthiim.

verses.la: Tunc conturbáti sunt príncipes Edom, robústos Moab obtínuit tremor: * obriguérunt omnes habitatóres Chánaan.
verses.en: Then were the princes of Edom troubled, trembling seized on the stout men of Moab: * all the inhabitants of Chanaan became stiff.

verses.la: Írruat super eos formído et pavor, * in magnitúdine brácchii tui:
verses.en: Let fear and dread fall upon them, * in the greatness of thy arm:

verses.la: Fiant immóbiles quasi lapis, donec pertránseat pópulus tuus, Dómine, * donec pertránseat pópulus tuus iste, quem possedísti.
verses.en: Let them become unmoveable as a stone, until thy people, O Lord, pass by: * until this thy people pass by, which thou hast possessed.

verses.la: Introdúces eos, et plantábis in monte hereditátis tuæ, * firmíssimo habitáculo tuo quod operátus es, Dómine:
verses.en: Thou shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of thy inheritance, * in thy most firm habitation which thou hast made, O Lord;

verses.la: Sanctuárium tuum, Dómine, quod firmavérunt manus tuæ. * Dóminus regnábit in ætérnum et ultra.
verses.en: Thy sanctuary, O Lord, which thy hands have established. * The Lord shall reign for ever and ever.

verses.la: Ingréssus est enim eques Phárao cum cúrribus et equítibus eius in mare: * et redúxit super eos Dóminus aquas maris:
verses.en: For Pharao went in on horseback with his chariots and horsemen into the sea: * and the Lord brought back upon them the waters of the sea:

verses.la: Fílii autem Israël ambulavérunt per siccum * in médio eius.
verses.en: But the children of Israel walked on dry ground * in the midst thereof.

verses.la: In médio annórum notum fácies: * cum irátus fúeris, misericórdiæ recordáberis.
verses.en: In the midst of the years thou shalt make it known: * when thou art angry, thou wilt remember mercy.

verses.la: Opéruit cælos glória eius: * et laudis eius plena est terra.
verses.en: His glory covered the heavens, * and the earth is full of his praise.

verses.la: Ibi abscóndita est fortitúdo eius: * ante fáciem eius ibit mors.
verses.en: There is his strength hid: * Death shall go before his face.

verses.la: Et egrediétur diábolus ante pedes eius. * Stetit, et mensus est terram.
verses.en: And the devil shall go forth before his feet. * He stood and measured the earth.

verses.la: Incurváti sunt colles mundi, * ab itinéribus æternitátis eius.
verses.en: The hills of the world were bowed down * by the journeys of his eternity.

verses.la: Pro iniquitáte vidi tentória Æthiópiæ, * turbabúntur pelles terræ Mádian.
verses.en: I saw the tents of Ethiopia for their iniquity, * the curtains of the land of Madian shall be troubled.

verses.la: Qui ascéndes super equos tuos: * et quadrígæ tuæ salvátio.
verses.en: Who will ride upon thy horses: * and thy chariots are salvation.

verses.la: Flúvios scindes terræ: vidérunt te, et doluérunt montes: * gurges aquárum tránsiit.
verses.en: Thou wilt divide the rivers of the earth. The mountains saw thee, and were grieved: * the great body of waters passed away.

verses.la: Dedit abýssus vocem suam: * altitúdo manus suas levávit.
verses.en: The deep put forth its voice: * the deep lifted up its hands.

verses.la: Sol, et luna stetérunt in habitáculo suo, * in luce sagittárum tuárum, ibunt in splendóre fulgurántis hastæ tuæ.
verses.en: The sun and the moon stood still in their habitation, * in the light of thy arrows, they shall go in the brightness of thy glittering spear.

verses.la: In frémitu conculcábis terram: * et in furóre obstupefácies gentes.
verses.en: In thy anger thou wilt tread the earth under foot: * in thy wrath thou wilt astonish the nations.

verses.la: Percussísti caput de domo ímpii: * denudásti fundaméntum eius usque ad collum.
verses.en: Thou struckest the head of the house of the wicked: * thou hast laid bare his foundation even to the neck.

verses.la: Exsultátio eórum * sicut eius, qui dévorat páuperem in abscóndito.
verses.en: Their joy * was like that of him that devoureth the poor man in secret.

verses.la: Viam fecísti in mari equis tuis, * in luto aquárum multárum.
verses.en: Thou madest a way in the sea for thy horses, * in the mud of many waters.

verses.la: Ut requiéscam in die tribulatiónis: * ut ascéndam ad pópulum accínctum nostrum.
verses.en: That I may rest in the day of tribulation: * that I may go up to our people that are girded.

verses.la: Abscindétur de ovíli pecus: * et non erit arméntum in præsépibus.
verses.en: The flock shall be cut off from the fold, * and there shall be no herd in the stalls.

verses.la: Ego autem in Dómino gaudébo: * et exsultábo in Deo Iesu meo.
verses.en: But I will rejoice in the Lord: * and I will joy in God my Jesus.

verses.la: Et super excélsa mea dedúcet me victor * in psalmis canéntem.
verses.en: And he the conqueror will lead me upon my high places * singing psalms.

verses.la: Audíte, cæli, quæ loquor: * áudiat terra verba oris mei.
verses.en: Hear, O ye heavens, the things I speak, * let the earth give ear to the words of my mouth.

verses.la: Concréscat ut plúvia doctrína mea, * fluat ut ros elóquium meum.
verses.en: Let my doctrine gather as the rain, * let my speech distill as the dew,

verses.la: Quasi imber super herbam, et quasi stillæ super grámina. * Quia nomen Dómini invocábo.
verses.en: As a shower upon the herb, and as drops upon the grass. * Because I will invoke the name of the Lord:

verses.la: Date magnificéntiam Deo nostro. * Dei perfécta sunt ópera, et omnes viæ eius iudícia:
verses.en: Give ye magnificence to our God. * The works of God are perfect, and all his ways are judgments:

verses.la: Deus fidélis, et absque ulla iniquitáte, iustus et rectus. * Peccavérunt ei, et non fílii eius in sórdibus:
verses.en: God is faithful and without any iniquity, he is just and right. * They have sinned against him, and are none of his children in their filth:

verses.la: Generátio prava atque pervérsa. * Hǽccine reddis Dómino, pópule stulte et insípiens?
verses.en: They are a wicked and perverse generation. * Is this the return thou makest to the Lord, O foolish and senseless people?

verses.la: Numquid non ipse est pater tuus, * qui possédit te, et fecit, et creávit te?
verses.en: Is not he thy father, * that hath possessed thee, and made thee, and created thee?

verses.la: Meménto diérum antiquórum, * cógita generatiónes síngulas:
verses.en: Remember the days of old, * think upon every generation:

verses.la: Intérroga patrem tuum, et annuntiábit tibi: * maióres tuos, et dicent tibi.
verses.en: Ask thy father, and he will declare to thee: * thy elders and they will tell thee.

verses.la: Quando dividébat Altíssimus gentes: * quando separábat fílios Adam.
verses.en: When the Most High divided the nations: * when he separated the sons of Adam,

verses.la: Constítuit términos populórum * iuxta númerum filiórum Israël.
verses.en: He appointed the bounds of people * according to the number of the children of Israel.

verses.la: Pars autem Dómini, pópulus eius: * Iacob funículus hereditátis eius.
verses.en: But the Lord’s portion is his people: * Jacob the lot of his inheritance.

verses.la: Invénit eum in terra desérta, * in loco horróris et vastæ solitúdinis:
verses.en: He found him in a desert land, * in a place of horror, and of vast wilderness:

verses.la: Circumdúxit eum, et dócuit: * et custodívit quasi pupíllam óculi sui.
verses.en: He led him about, and taught him: * and he kept him as the apple of his eye.

verses.la: Sicut áquila próvocans ad volándum pullos suos, * et super eos vólitans,
verses.en: As the eagle enticing her young to fly, * and hovering over them,

verses.la: Expándit alas suas, et assúmpsit eum, * atque portávit in húmeris suis.
verses.en: He spread his wings, and hath taken him * and carried him on his shoulders.

verses.la: Dóminus solus dux eius fuit: * et non erat cum eo deus aliénus.
verses.en: The Lord alone was his leader: * and there was no strange god with him.

verses.la: Constítuit eum super excélsam terram: * ut coméderet fructus agrórum,
verses.en: He set him upon high land: * that he might eat the fruits of the fields,

verses.la: Ut súgeret mel de petra, * oleúmque de saxo duríssimo.
verses.en: That he might suck honey out of the rock, * and oil out of the hardest stone,

verses.la: Butýrum de arménto, et lac de óvibus * cum ádipe agnórum, et aríetum filiórum Basan:
verses.en: Butter of the herd, and milk of the sheep * with the fat of lambs, and of the rams of the breed of Basan:

verses.la: Et hircos cum medúlla trítici, * et sánguinem uvæ bíberet meracíssimum.
verses.en: And goats with the marrow of wheat, * and might drink the purest blood of the grape.

verses.la: Incrassátus est diléctus, et recalcitrávit: * incrassátus, impinguátus, dilatátus,
verses.en: The beloved grew fat, and kicked: * he grew fat, and thick and gross,

verses.la: Derelíquit Deum, factórem suum, * et recéssit a Deo, salutári suo.
verses.en: He forsook God who made him, * and departed from God his saviour.

verses.la: Provocavérunt eum in diis aliénis, * et in abominatiónibus ad iracúndiam concitavérunt.
verses.en: They provoked him by strange gods, * and stirred him up to anger, with their abominations.

verses.la: Immolavérunt dæmóniis, et non Deo, * diis, quos ignorábant:
verses.en: They sacrificed to devils and not to God: * to gods whom they knew not:

verses.la: Novi recentésque venérunt, * quos non coluérunt patres eórum.
verses.en: That were newly come up, * whom their fathers worshipped not.

verses.la: Deum qui te génuit dereliquísti, * et oblítus es Dómini, creatóris tui.
verses.en: Thou hast forsaken the God that beget * and hast forgotten the Lord that created thee.

verses.la: Veníte, exsultémus Dómino, iubilémus Deo, salutári nostro: præoccupémus fáciem eius in confessióne, et in psalmis iubilémus ei.
verses.en: Come let us praise the Lord with joy: let us joyfully sing to God our saviour. Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving; and make a joyful noise to him with psalms.

verses.la: Quóniam Deus magnus Dóminus, et Rex magnus super omnes deos, quóniam non repéllet Dóminus plebem suam: quia in manu eius sunt omnes fines terræ, et altitúdines móntium ipse cónspicit.
verses.en: For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods. For the Lord will not cast off his people: for in his hand are all the ends of the earth, and the heights of the mountains are his.

verses.la: Quóniam ipsíus est mare, et ipse fecit illud, et áridam fundavérunt manus eius veníte, adorémus, et procidámus ante Deum: plorémus coram Dómino, qui fecit nos, quia ipse est Dóminus, Deus noster; nos autem pópulus eius, et oves páscuæ eius.
verses.en: For the sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land. Come let us adore and fall down: and weep before the Lord that made us: For he is the Lord our God: and we are the people of his pasture and the sheep of his hand.

verses.la: Hódie, si vocem eius audiéritis, nolíte obduráre corda vestra, sicut in exacerbatióne secúndum diem tentatiónis in desérto: ubi tentavérunt me patres vestri, probavérunt et vidérunt ópera mea.
verses.en: Today if you shall hear his voice, harden not your hearts: As in the provocation, according to the day of temptation in the wilderness: where your fathers tempted me, they proved me, and saw my works.

verses.la: Quadragínta annis próximus fui generatióni huic, et dixi: Semper hi errant corde, ipsi vero non cognovérunt vias meas: quibus iurávi in ira mea: Si introíbunt in réquiem meam.
verses.en: Forty years long was I offended with that generation, and I said: These always err in heart. And these men have not known my ways: so I swore in my wrath that they shall not enter into my rest.
